# Language

> Foundations · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

The texts the controls write, the locale their dates and numbers follow, and the direction: one `uiLocale` for the kit, with a pack per language loaded as it is asked for.

## Import

```tsx
import { uiLocale, connectI18n } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Switching the language

`uiLocale.use('tr')` loads the Turkish pack the first time, then every control on the page draws its texts and formats again. The Language menu in the header of these docs does the same.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DateBox, NumberBox, Pagination, Stack, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** The kit's language switched live: the pack is loaded first, then every control draws its texts and formats again. */
export default function Switch() {
    const s = reactive({ price: 1234.5, when: new Date(2026, 2, 18) as Date | null });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md">
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button text="English" variant="outline" onclick={() => void uiLocale.use('en')} />
                <Button text="Türkçe" variant="outline" onclick={() => void uiLocale.use('tr')} />
                <span>
                    In use: <output class="lang-locale">{() => kitTexts.locale}</output>
                </span>
            </Stack>
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <NumberBox label="Price" x-model={() => s.price} format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }} />
                <DateBox label="When" x-model={() => s.when} clearButton />
            </Stack>
            <Pagination total={95} pageSizes={[10, 20, 50]} label="Orders" />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## The rules

| Rule | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Start` | The page’s `<html lang>`, else the browser’s language. Set `lang` before the first control is made; `uiLocale.ready` settles once that language is in. |
| `Texts` | Every text a control writes itself (a button’s name, a message, “No items”) comes from the pack of the language in use; English fills what the pack leaves out. |
| `Formats` | Dates, numbers, the first day of the week and 12 or 24 hours follow `uiLocale.locale`; a control’s own `locale` prop wins for that control. |
| `Direction` | `uiLocale.dir` is `rtl` for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu…; the controls lay themselves out from `<html dir>`, which `@motifx-community/i18n` keeps in step. |
| `Nothing follows` | A change is one event, `onChanged`: the controls draw again on it, and so can your own texts. No binding reads `uiLocale`. |
| `Plurals` | A text with a count is an ICU message, `{count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}`; a pack writes it the way its language counts. |

## Packs

| Pack | Where it comes from |
| --- | --- |
| `English` | Built in. What a pack leaves out is shown in English. |
| `Turkish` | `uiLocale.use('tr')` loads it the first time, as a chunk of the package. |
| `@motifx-community/ui/locales/<language>.json` | The same packs as files, for an app that bundles or serves them its own way: `uiLocale.add('tr', pack)`. |
| `uiLocale.loader` | Where the kit asks for a pack it does not have: `(language) => fetch(`/i18n/ui/${language}.json`).then((r) => r.json())`. A language without a pack keeps the English texts. |

A pack of your own is a plain object of the kit’s texts: `uiLocale.add` gives a language its texts, `use` switches to it. A few texts are enough to start; the rest stay English until the pack has them.

```tsx
import { Button, DropDown, Stack, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';

// A few German texts; what is left out stays English.
uiLocale.add('de', {
    close: 'Schließen',
    clear: 'Leeren',
    search: 'Suchen',
    noItems: 'Keine Einträge',
    loading: 'Wird geladen…',
    ok: 'OK',
    cancel: 'Abbrechen',
});

/** A pack of your own: `uiLocale.add` gives a language its texts, `use` switches to it. */
export default function OwnPack() {
    return (
        <Stack gap="md">
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button text="Deutsch" variant="outline" onclick={() => void uiLocale.use('de')} />
                <Button text="English" variant="outline" onclick={() => void uiLocale.use('en')} />
            </Stack>
            <DropDown label="Empty list" items={[]} placeholder="Open me" />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## With your app’s translations

An app translated with `@motifx-community/i18n` has one locale already. `connectI18n(i18n)` makes the kit follow it: when the app switches, the kit loads its own pack and switches too. The link is undone by what it returns.

```tsx
import { Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { createI18n } from '@motifx-community/i18n';
import { Button, connectI18n, Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

// The app's own translations; the kit follows their locale.
const i18n = createI18n({
    locale: 'en',
    messages: {
        en: { greeting: 'Hello {name}', hint: 'The clear button is named by the kit' },
        tr: { greeting: 'Merhaba {name}', hint: 'Temizle düğmesini kit adlandırır' },
    },
    dom: false,
});

/** One locale for the app and the kit: `connectI18n` switches the kit whenever the app's translations switch. */
export default class Connect extends Component<HTMLDivElement> {
    override onBuilt(): void {
        this.motif.setDisposable(connectI18n(i18n));
    }

    override view() {
        return (
            <Stack gap="md">
                <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                    <Button text="English" variant="outline" onclick={() => void i18n.setLocale('en')} />
                    <Button text="Türkçe" variant="outline" onclick={() => void i18n.setLocale('tr')} />
                </Stack>
                <p class="lang-greeting">{() => i18n.t('greeting', { name: 'Ada' })}</p>
                <TextBox label={() => i18n.t('hint')} value="Clear me" clearButton />
            </Stack>
        );
    }
}
```

## Your own texts that follow

The kit follows nothing: a change of language is told once, through `uiLocale.onChanged`. Keep your own texts with it, and fill the kit’s own texts with `uiLocale.text`, plurals included.

```tsx
import { Component, reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, NumberBox, Stack, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const OWN = {
    en: { title: 'Orders', hint: 'Written by the app, kept with the kit’s language' },
    tr: { title: 'Siparişler', hint: 'Uygulama yazar, kitin diliyle birlikte değişir' },
};

/** Your own texts drawn again on `uiLocale.onChanged`, and the kit's plural texts filled with `uiLocale.text`. */
export default class OwnTexts extends Component<HTMLDivElement> {
    s = reactive({ count: 3, title: '', hint: '', records: '' });

    override onBuilt(): void {
        this.motif.register(uiLocale.onChanged(() => this.draw()));
        this.draw();
    }

    draw(): void {
        const own = uiLocale.locale.startsWith('tr') ? OWN.tr : OWN.en;
        this.s.title = own.title;
        this.s.hint = own.hint;
        this.s.records = uiLocale.text('gridRecords', { count: this.s.count });
    }

    override view() {
        return (
            <Stack gap="md">
                <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                    <Button text="English" variant="outline" onclick={() => void uiLocale.use('en')} />
                    <Button text="Türkçe" variant="outline" onclick={() => void uiLocale.use('tr')} />
                </Stack>
                <p>
                    <strong class="lang-own-title">{this.s.title}</strong>
                </p>
                <p>{this.s.hint}</p>
                <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                    <NumberBox label="Count" min={0} max={99} x-model={() => this.s.count} onValueChanged={() => this.draw()} />
                    <output class="lang-records">{this.s.records}</output>
                </Stack>
            </Stack>
        );
    }
}
```

## Formats of one control

Dates and numbers follow the kit’s locale. A control given a `locale` of its own writes that one, whatever the kit’s language is.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DateBox, NumberBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A control's own `locale` wins over the kit's: these write German and Japanese whatever the kit's language is. */
export default function Formats() {
    const s = reactive({ amount: 98765.43, day: new Date(2026, 2, 18) as Date | null });
    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
            <NumberBox label="Betrag" locale="de-DE" format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }} x-model={() => s.amount} />
            <DateBox label="日付" locale="ja-JP" x-model={() => s.day} />
            <NumberBox label="The kit's locale" format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }} x-model={() => s.amount} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Checking a pack

In the repository, `npm run locales` checks every pack the kit ships, and `npm run locales -- path/to/de.json` one of your own. The texts themselves are in `src/locales/en.json`; a pack is the same keys in another language.

| Check | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| `Every text` | A pack names every text of `en.json`; one it leaves out is shown in English, and the check says which. |
| `Only the kit’s texts` | A key `en.json` does not have is a typo. |
| `The same arguments` | A text fills the same `{values}` as the English one, in ICU; the plural forms are the language’s own. |
| `The interface` | `UiStrings` and `en.json` name the same keys. |

## API reference

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `uiLocale.use(locale)` | `Promise<void>` | Switches to `locale` (`tr`, `tr-TR`): its pack is loaded first when it is not there, then every control draws again. A later call wins over one still loading. |
| `uiLocale.locale` | `string` | The locale in use. |
| `uiLocale.dir` | `'ltr' \| 'rtl'` | The direction of the locale in use. |
| `uiLocale.strings` | `UiStrings` | The texts in use. Assigning a set changes the texts and keeps the locale: `uiLocale.strings = { ...uiLocale.strings, close: 'Shut' }`. |
| `uiLocale.text(key, values)` | `string` | A text of the kit with its values filled in: `uiLocale.text('gridRecords', { count: 3 })`. |
| `uiLocale.add(language, pack)` | `void` | Adds the pack of a language, or more texts to it; a language in use shows them at once. |
| `uiLocale.loader` | `(language) => Promise<UiPackModule>` | Where packs come from; the package by default. |
| `uiLocale.ready` | `Promise<void>` | Settles once the starting language is in. |
| `uiLocale.onChanged` | event | Raised once the language changed, with `locale` and `previous`. |
| `connectI18n(i18n)` | `() => void` | Keeps the kit’s language with your app’s translations (`@motifx-community/i18n`, or anything with `locale` and `onLocaleChanged`); returns what stops it. |


---

# Button

> Buttons · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A native `<button>` drawn from the design tokens: three variants, three tones, three sizes, an icon, an `&` access key. It can be a toggle, show that work is running, and open a menu or any content — from the whole button, or with `split` from an arrow next to it while the button keeps its own action.

## Import

```tsx
import { Button, type MenuItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

Both ways are complete. Every prop takes a value or a function; a function of a reactive object keeps the button in step with it. A property set from code takes the same.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A button in JSX, and buttons created with `new`, added and bound from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  let added = 0;
  let toolbar: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const n = ++added;
    const state = reactive({ marks: '' });
    const b = new Button({ variant: 'outline' });
    b.text = () => `Button ${n}${state.marks}`; // a function is followed
    b.motif.on('click', () => (state.marks += ' ✓'));
    toolbar?.controls.add(b);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Add a button from code" onclick={addFromCode} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (toolbar = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Variants, tones, sizes

`solid` buttons are pressable: an opaque fill, a bottom edge, a highlight along the top and a small move when pressed. `outline` has a frame, `ghost` shows only on hover. The tone picks the colors; the size the height, from the density tokens (switch Compact above).

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, type ButtonSize, type ButtonTone, type ButtonVariant } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const VARIANTS: ButtonVariant[] = ['solid', 'outline', 'ghost'];
const TONES: ButtonTone[] = ['standard', 'accent', 'danger'];
const SIZES: ButtonSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** Every tone in every variant, in the size picked above them. */
export default function VariantsTonesSizes() {
  const s = reactive({ size: 'md' as ButtonSize });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Size">
        {SIZES.map((size) => (
          <Button
            key={size}
            text={size}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.size === size ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.size === size}
            onclick={() => (s.size = size)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      {TONES.map((tone) => (
        <Stack key={tone} orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
          {VARIANTS.map((variant) => (
            <Button key={variant} text={`${tone} ${variant}`} tone={tone} variant={variant} size={() => s.size} />
          ))}
        </Stack>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Text, icon, children

`text` is the caption; JSX children come after it. `icon` takes an image address or any element or component, before the text or after it (`iconPosition`). A button with only an icon needs a name: give it a `hint`.

```tsx
import { Button } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SaveIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M3 2.5h8l2.5 2.5v8.5h-10.5zM5.5 2.5v3.5h5v-3.5M5 13.5v-4h6v4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** An icon from JSX or from an image address, an icon-only button named by its hint, and JSX children. */
export default function IconAndChildren() {
  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Save" icon={() => <SaveIcon />} />
      <Button text="Next" icon="../favicon.svg" iconPosition="end" variant="outline" />
      <Button icon={() => <SaveIcon />} hint="Save" variant="ghost" />
      <Button tone="accent">
        Total <b>42</b>
      </Button>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Toggle

With `toggle` a click turns `pressed` on and off; `x-model` binds it two-way.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A toggle button bound two-way with x-model. */
export default function Toggle() {
  const s = reactive({ bold: false });
  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Bold" toggle x-model={() => s.bold} />
      <span>
        bold: <output class="bold-state">{() => String(s.bold)}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Busy

While `busy`, a spinner shows over the content, presses are ignored and the size does not change. The text stays for screen readers, with `aria-busy`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A button that shows a spinner while its work runs. */
export default function Busy() {
  const s = reactive({ sending: false });

  const send = () => {
    s.sending = true;
    setTimeout(() => (s.sending = false), 1500);
  };

  return <Button text="Send" tone="accent" busy={() => s.sending} onclick={send} />;
}
```

## Disabled

A disabled button is natively disabled: it leaves the Tab order and cannot be pressed. With `focusableWhenDisabled` it keeps its place and only gets `aria-disabled`, so a keyboard or screen reader user can still find it — and a hint can say why it is off.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A disabled button leaves the Tab order; with focusableWhenDisabled it keeps its place. */
export default function Disabled() {
  const s = reactive({ enabled: false });
  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Toggle enabled" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.enabled = !s.enabled)} />
      <Button text="Plain" enabled={() => s.enabled} />
      <Button text="Focusable" enabled={() => s.enabled} focusableWhenDisabled hint="Fill in the form first" />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Menu

With `menu` the whole button opens a list of commands. Items can have an icon, a check mark, a group line, be disabled or hidden; each `&` key chooses its item while the menu is open. An item field may be a function: the open menu follows what it reads.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, type MenuItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const NewIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M3 2.5h8l2.5 2.5v8.5h-10.5zM5.5 2.5v3.5h5v-3.5M5 13.5v-4h6v4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A button that opens a menu: an icon, a disabled item, a check mark, group lines and & keys. */
export default function Menu() {
  const s = reactive({ last: '', wrap: true });

  const fileMenu = (): MenuItem[] => [
    { text: '&New', icon: () => <NewIcon />, click: () => (s.last = 'New') },
    { text: '&Open…', click: () => (s.last = 'Open…') },
    { text: 'Open &recent', enabled: false },
    { text: '&Word wrap', checked: () => s.wrap, beginGroup: true, click: () => (s.wrap = !s.wrap) },
    { text: 'E&xit', beginGroup: true, click: () => (s.last = 'Exit') },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <Button text="&File" menu={fileMenu} variant="outline" />
      <span>
        Last: <output class="menu-log">{() => s.last || '—'}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Split

With `split` the button keeps its own action (`onclick`) and an arrow next to it opens the menu. The two are separate Tab stops; Alt+Down on the button opens the menu too. `split` can change at any time; a menu itself (`split`, `menu` or `dropDown`) must be there when the button is created, since it makes the button two parts.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A split button: its own action, and an arrow that opens the menu. `split` can be switched off. */
export default function Split() {
  const s = reactive({ last: '', split: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Button
        text="Sa&ve"
        tone="accent"
        split={() => s.split}
        onclick={() => (s.last = 'Save')}
        menu={[
          { text: 'Save &as…', click: () => (s.last = 'Save as…') },
          { text: 'Save a&ll', click: () => (s.last = 'Save all') },
        ]}
      />
      <Button text="split" size="sm" variant="ghost" toggle x-model={() => s.split} />
      <span>
        Last: <output class="split-log">{() => s.last || '—'}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Any content

`dropDown` opens any component instead of a menu: a picker, a small form. Focus goes to its first field; Escape or a press outside closes it.

```tsx
import { Button, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A button that opens a small form instead of a menu. */
export default function DropDown() {
  return (
    <Button
      text="Filter"
      variant="outline"
      dropDown={
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" padding="sm">
          <label>
            From <input name="from" type="date" />
          </label>
          <label>
            To <input name="to" type="date" />
          </label>
        </Stack>
      }
    />
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter, Space` | Press the button. With a menu and no `split`: open the menu, focus on its first item. |
| `Alt + key (`&Save`)` | Press it (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |
| `Down / Up` | On a button that opens a menu (or on the arrow of a split button): open it, focus on the first / last item. |
| `Alt + Down` | On the main part of a split button: open the menu. |
| `In the menu: Down / Up` | The next / previous item, wrapping around. Disabled items are reachable. |
| `In the menu: Home / End` | The first / last item. |
| `In the menu: a letter` | The item whose `&` key it is is chosen; otherwise focus goes to the next item starting with it. |
| `In the menu: Enter, Space` | Choose the focused item. |
| `Escape` | Close the menu or drop-down; focus goes back to the part that opened it. |
| `Tab` | Close the menu and go on to the next control. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Element` | A native `<button>` (two with `split`: the button and the arrow), so forms, Enter, Space and screen readers work as they always do. |
| `Name` | The text, without the `&` marker. An icon-only button is named by its `hint` (or your `aria-label`). The arrow of a split button is named from `uiLocale` ("More options"). |
| `Toggle` | `aria-pressed`. |
| `Busy` | `aria-busy="true"`; the text stays readable under the spinner. |
| `Menu` | `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded` on the part that opens it; the list is `role="menu"`, items `menuitem` or `menuitemcheckbox` with `aria-checked`, disabled items `aria-disabled`, group lines `separator`. |
| `Drop-down` | `aria-haspopup="dialog"`; the popup is `role="dialog"`, named by the button's text. Focus goes to its first field. |
| `Focus ring` | Only for keyboard use, the design system's double ring. |

## Localization

The only text a button writes itself is the name of a split button's arrow. It comes from `uiLocale.strings`, which starts with the page's `lang` (English and Turkish ship) and can be set to any `UiStrings`; every button follows at once. The set is kept as it is given: to change one text, assign a new set (`uiLocale.strings = { ...uiLocale.strings, moreOptions: 'Mehr' }`); a text changed inside the set is not seen.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** The name of a split button's arrow, from uiLocale: a shipped language or a text of your own. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });

  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <Button text="Own text" variant="outline" onclick={() => (uiLocale.strings = { ...uiLocale.strings, moreOptions: 'Mehr' })} />
      <span>
        The arrow above is named <output class="arrow-name">{() => kitTexts.strings.moreOptions}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-button` | The button (or the group of a button with a menu). `data-variant`, `data-tone`, `data-size`, `data-icon-position`, `data-stretch`, `data-pressed`, `data-busy`, `data-icon`, `data-mode="menu\|split"`. |
| `.mx-button__face` | What is pressed: the button itself, or `.mx-button__main` and `.mx-button__arrow`. |
| `.mx-button__icon, .mx-button__chevron, .mx-button__spinner` | The icon, the arrow glyph of a menu button, the busy spinner. |
| `.mx-popup` | The surface the menu opens on (`data-side="bottom\|top"`). |
| `.mx-menu, .mx-menu__item, .mx-menu__separator` | The menu, its items, its group lines. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `button.face` | Unit: what is pressed, with its frame (the bottom side is a key’s edge), its fill and state layer (`image`) and its focus ring (outline and `glow`). Each look is a state (`accent`, `danger`, `outline`, `outline-accent`, `ghost`, …), and each look in each state too (`hover`, `toggled-hover`, `open`, `pressed`, `focus`, `toggled`, `disabled`: `outline-hover`, `accent-pressed`, …); also `icon-only`, `busy`, and a split button’s `main` and `arrow`. |
| `button.icon, button.caption, button.chevron, button.spinner, button.divider` | Units: the icon, the text, the arrow of a menu (`open`), the busy spinner and the line of a split button, each look a state. |
| `button.height.{sm,md,lg}, button.padding.{sm,md,lg}, button.font-size.{sm,md,lg}, button.line-height.{sm,md,lg}` | Sizes, from the density tokens. |
| `button.press-offset, button.icon-only-square, button.text-box, button.spinner-duration` | How far a solid button moves when pressed, a square icon button, the caption’s line box, the spinner’s turn. |
| `popup.surface, menu.*` | The popup surface and the menu items. |

All of them reference design-system tokens; see [Tokens](tokens.md). Override one after `styles.css` to restyle every button.

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The caption. `&` marks the access key (`&Save` → Alt+S), `&&` is a literal `&`. JSX children come after it. |
| `variant` | `Bind<ButtonVariant>` | `'solid'` | `solid` (filled, pressable), `outline` (a frame), `ghost` (only on hover). |
| `tone` | `Bind<ButtonTone>` | `'standard'` | `standard`, `accent` (the main action), `danger` (a destructive one). |
| `size` | `Bind<ButtonSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`: the density tokens' control heights. |
| `icon` | `Bind<IconSource \| null>` | — | An image address, or any element or component (an `<svg>` in JSX, an icon font tag). Decorative: hidden from screen readers. |
| `iconPosition` | `Bind<'start' \| 'end'>` | `'start'` | The icon before or after the text. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Fills the width of what it sits in. |
| `type` | `Bind<'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'>` | `'button'` | The native type. `button` by default, so a button in a form never submits by accident. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A tooltip (`title`). It also names a button that has only an icon. |
| `toggle` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A toggle button: a click turns `pressed` on and off (`aria-pressed`). |
| `pressed` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The state of a toggle button. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `busy` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Work is running: a spinner shows over the content, presses are ignored, the size stays, `aria-busy` is set. |
| `focusableWhenDisabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Disabled, it keeps its place in the Tab order with `aria-disabled`, so a screen reader finds it and reads it as dimmed. |
| `split` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | With a menu: the button keeps its own action and an arrow next to it opens the menu. Without it the whole button opens the menu. |
| `menu` | `Bind<readonly MenuItem[]>` | — | The commands of the menu, read each time it opens. |
| `dropDown` | `Bind<ComponentBase \| null>` | — | Any content to open instead of a menu: a picker, a small form. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | Set from code with a value or a function, like the prop: `b.tone = () => this.state.tone` is followed, `b.tone = 'accent'` replaces it. |
| `value` | read/write | `pressed`, for `x-model`. |
| `opened` | read/write, reactive | Whether the menu or drop-down is open; setting it opens or closes it. |
| `hasMenu` | read-only | Whether it was created with `split`, `menu` or `dropDown`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open()` | `boolean` | Opens the menu or drop-down with focus on its first item; `false` when there is nothing to open, or it is disabled or busy. |
| `close()` | `void` | Closes it; focus inside goes back to the part that opened it. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your menu items may be plain or reactive; the button reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. An open menu shows the change at once. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Focuses the button (its main part with a menu). |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onclick` | The DOM click of the button: its own action. With `split`, the arrow and the menu do not fire it; with a menu and no `split`, the click opens the menu. |
| `onItemClick(e)` | A menu item was chosen, after the item's own `click`. `e`: `{ item, source, event }`. |

### MenuItem

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `Bind<string>` | The label; `&` marks the key that chooses it while the menu is open. |
| `icon` | `Bind<IconSource>` | An icon; a function is called each time the item is drawn. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | A tooltip. |
| `enabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false`: shown dimmed, reachable, cannot be chosen. |
| `visible` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false`: left out. |
| `checked` | `Bind<boolean>` | Given, the item is a `menuitemcheckbox` and shows a check mark when `true`. Flip it in its `click`. |
| `beginGroup` | `Bind<boolean>` | A line before the item. |
| `click(e)` | function | Runs when it is chosen, after the menu closed. |
| `data` | `unknown` | The app's own value. |

The menu and the surface it opens on are shared parts, `MenuList` and `Popup`, exported for other components to use.


---

# ButtonGroup

> Buttons · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Buttons that belong together: a segmented choice of one or several, or a row of actions. The buttons are the kit’s own, touching by default.

## Import

```tsx
import { ButtonGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

Every prop takes a value or a function; `x-model` binds the value two-way. Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ButtonGroup, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** One choice bound with `x-model`; a group made with `new` takes the same properties from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ view: 'Week' as unknown });
  const coded = new ButtonGroup({ label: 'Density', items: ['Compact', 'Comfortable'], value: 'Compact' });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <ButtonGroup label="View" items={['Day', 'Week', 'Month']} x-model={() => s.view} />
      <span>{() => `View: ${s.view}`}</span>
      <span onConfig={(c) => c.controls.add(coded)} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Several, or only actions

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ButtonGroup, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const MARKS = [
  { value: 'bold', text: 'Bold' },
  { value: 'italic', text: 'Italic' },
  { value: 'underline', text: 'Underline' },
];

/** Several on and off (`multiple`), and plain actions (`none`, `onItemClick`). */
export default function Selections() {
  const s = reactive({ marks: ['bold'] as unknown, last: '' });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <ButtonGroup label="Text marks" selection="multiple" items={MARKS} x-model={() => s.marks} />
      <span>{() => `Marks: ${(s.marks as string[]).join(', ') || 'none'}`}</span>
      <ButtonGroup label="Clipboard" selection="none" items={['Cut', 'Copy', 'Paste']} onItemClick={(e) => (s.last = String(e.value))} />
      <span>{() => (s.last ? `Pressed: ${s.last}` : 'Nothing pressed yet')}</span>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Sizes and layout

```tsx
import { ButtonGroup, Stack, type ButtonSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ButtonSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];
const ITEMS = ['One', 'Two', { value: 'Three', enabled: false }, 'Four'];

/** Each size; apart instead of touching; filling the width; and one button disabled. */
export default function Looks() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <ButtonGroup key={size} label={`Size ${size}`} size={size} items={ITEMS} value="Two" />
      ))}
      <ButtonGroup label="Apart" attached={false} items={ITEMS} value="One" />
      <ButtonGroup label="Stretched" stretch items={['Left', 'Center', 'Right']} value="Center" />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | One stop: the button focused last, else the chosen one, else the first. |
| `Arrow keys, Home, End` | Move between the buttons (disabled ones are skipped). |
| `Space, Enter` | Press the button: choose it, turn it on or off, or do its action. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Group` | `role="group"` with its label. |
| `Buttons` | Kit buttons; with a selection each says whether it is on (`aria-pressed`). A button with only an icon is named by its `hint`. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-button-group` | The group. `data-attached`, `data-stretch`. |
| `.mx-button-group__item` | Each button (a `.mx-button`). |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `button-group.item.*` | Place: each button’s look in a group (`variant`) and the look of the chosen one (`face.*-toggled.*`). |
| `button-group.inner-start.*, button-group.inner-end.*` | Places: the corners where two buttons touch. |
| `button-group.attached, button-group.gap` | Whether buttons touch when not told, and the space between them when they do not. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly (ButtonGroupItem<T> \| T)[]>` | `[]` | The buttons: `ButtonGroupItem`s (`value`, `text`, `icon`, `hint`, `enabled`, `visible`), plain values (each its own text), or objects of your own shape. |
| `itemText, itemValue` | `ItemField` | `'text'`, `'value'` | Where an item of your own shape keeps its text and its value: a property name or a function. |
| `selection` | `Bind<ButtonGroupSelection>` | `'single'` | `single`: one of them; `multiple`: each on and off; `none`: only actions. |
| `value` | `Bind<T \| readonly T[] \| null>` | `null` / `[]` | The chosen value, or an array of the values turned on. Two-way with `x-model`; a change gives a new array. |
| `allowEmpty` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | `single`: pressing the chosen button again leaves none chosen. |
| `attached` | `Bind<boolean>` | the language’s (`true`) | The buttons touch, sharing their edges. |
| `variant` | `Bind<ButtonVariant>` | the language’s (`outline`) | The look of every button. |
| `size` | `Bind<ButtonSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Fills the width, the buttons sharing it. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | What screen readers call the group (“Text alignment”). |
| `enabled, visible` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged` | event | The value changed (`value`), by the user or by code (`byUser`). |
| `onItemClick` | event | A button was pressed (`item`, `value`), with any selection. |
| `buttons` | read-only | The kit buttons of the group, in the order of the items. |
| `isSelected(value)` | `boolean` | Whether the button of `value` is chosen or on. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Reads the items again after they were changed in place. |


---

# Toolbar

> Buttons · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A bar of commands: buttons, toggle buttons, menus and fields in groups between separators. It is one Tab stop and the arrow keys move inside it; items that do not fit move into a “more” menu at the end. Items come as data, as JSX children, or both.

## Import

```tsx
import { Toolbar, ToolbarSeparator, type ToolbarItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

`items` describes the commands as data, each field a value or a function; JSX children (any control) come after them. From code, a toolbar is filled like any control: `toolbar.controls.add(button)`. Every prop is also a property.

```tsx
/** A small outline icon drawn from one path. */
function icon(d: string) {
  return () => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d={d} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export const BoldIcon = icon('M4.5 3h4.25a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5H4.5zM4.5 8h5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5h-5z');
export const ItalicIcon = icon('M7 3h5M4 13h5M10 3L6 13');
export const UnderlineIcon = icon('M4.5 2.5v5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 7 0v-5M3.5 14h9');
export const AlignLeftIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M2.5 8h7M2.5 12h9');
export const AlignCenterIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M4.5 8h7M3.5 12h9');
export const AlignRightIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M6.5 8h7M4.5 12h9');
export const UndoIcon = icon('M5.5 3.5L2.5 6.5l3 3M2.5 6.5h7a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7h-2');
export const RedoIcon = icon('M10.5 3.5l3 3-3 3M13.5 6.5h-7a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h2');
export const LinkIcon = icon('M7 9a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 3.5 0l2-2a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5-3.5l-.75.75M9 7a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5 0l-2 2A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 7 12.5l.75-.75');
export const ImageIcon = icon('M2.5 3.5h11v9h-11zM2.5 10.5l3-3 3 3 2-2 3 3M10 6.25v.1');
```

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Toolbar } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A toolbar made with `new` and filled with `controls.add`. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ log: '' });
  let added = 0;

  const bar = new Toolbar({ label: 'Actions', size: 'sm' });
  bar.controls.add(new Button({ text: 'First', onclick: () => (s.log = 'First pressed') }));

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const n = ++added;
    bar.controls.add(new Button({ text: `Button ${n}`, onclick: () => (s.log = `Button ${n} pressed`) }));
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Add a button from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
      <div style="inline-size: 100%" ref={(c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => c.controls.add(bar)} />
      <output>{() => s.log}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Toggle groups and separators

A `toggle` item is a toggle button (`aria-pressed`). Bound to the app with a function, it shows the app’s state: Bold, Italic and Underline above are three independent toggles, the alignment buttons a group where one is pressed. `separator` items (or `<ToolbarSeparator />`) draw the lines between groups.

```tsx
/** A small outline icon drawn from one path. */
function icon(d: string) {
  return () => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d={d} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export const BoldIcon = icon('M4.5 3h4.25a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5H4.5zM4.5 8h5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5h-5z');
export const ItalicIcon = icon('M7 3h5M4 13h5M10 3L6 13');
export const UnderlineIcon = icon('M4.5 2.5v5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 7 0v-5M3.5 14h9');
export const AlignLeftIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M2.5 8h7M2.5 12h9');
export const AlignCenterIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M4.5 8h7M3.5 12h9');
export const AlignRightIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M6.5 8h7M4.5 12h9');
export const UndoIcon = icon('M5.5 3.5L2.5 6.5l3 3M2.5 6.5h7a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7h-2');
export const RedoIcon = icon('M10.5 3.5l3 3-3 3M13.5 6.5h-7a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h2');
export const LinkIcon = icon('M7 9a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 3.5 0l2-2a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5-3.5l-.75.75M9 7a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5 0l-2 2A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 7 12.5l.75-.75');
export const ImageIcon = icon('M2.5 3.5h11v9h-11zM2.5 10.5l3-3 3 3 2-2 3 3M10 6.25v.1');
```

## Overflow

With `overflow` set to `menu` (the default) the items that do not fit move into a “more” menu at the end, from the last one back; the toolbar watches its own size. There they keep their names (an icon-only button its `hint` or `aria-label`), a toggle becomes a check item and a menu button a submenu. An item’s `overflow` says `always` or `never`; fields stay in the bar. `wrap` starts a second row, `scroll` lets the bar scroll.

```tsx
/** A small outline icon drawn from one path. */
function icon(d: string) {
  return () => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d={d} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export const BoldIcon = icon('M4.5 3h4.25a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5H4.5zM4.5 8h5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5h-5z');
export const ItalicIcon = icon('M7 3h5M4 13h5M10 3L6 13');
export const UnderlineIcon = icon('M4.5 2.5v5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 7 0v-5M3.5 14h9');
export const AlignLeftIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M2.5 8h7M2.5 12h9');
export const AlignCenterIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M4.5 8h7M3.5 12h9');
export const AlignRightIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M6.5 8h7M4.5 12h9');
export const UndoIcon = icon('M5.5 3.5L2.5 6.5l3 3M2.5 6.5h7a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7h-2');
export const RedoIcon = icon('M10.5 3.5l3 3-3 3M13.5 6.5h-7a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h2');
export const LinkIcon = icon('M7 9a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 3.5 0l2-2a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5-3.5l-.75.75M9 7a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5 0l-2 2A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 7 12.5l.75-.75');
export const ImageIcon = icon('M2.5 3.5h11v9h-11zM2.5 10.5l3-3 3 3 2-2 3 3M10 6.25v.1');
```

## Orientation, size, fields

`size` and `buttonVariant` reach the controls inside that have none of their own. A vertical toolbar moves with Up and Down. A text field inside keeps the arrow keys for its text.

```tsx
/** A small outline icon drawn from one path. */
function icon(d: string) {
  return () => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d={d} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export const BoldIcon = icon('M4.5 3h4.25a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5H4.5zM4.5 8h5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5h-5z');
export const ItalicIcon = icon('M7 3h5M4 13h5M10 3L6 13');
export const UnderlineIcon = icon('M4.5 2.5v5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 7 0v-5M3.5 14h9');
export const AlignLeftIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M2.5 8h7M2.5 12h9');
export const AlignCenterIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M4.5 8h7M3.5 12h9');
export const AlignRightIcon = icon('M2.5 4h11M6.5 8h7M4.5 12h9');
export const UndoIcon = icon('M5.5 3.5L2.5 6.5l3 3M2.5 6.5h7a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 7h-2');
export const RedoIcon = icon('M10.5 3.5l3 3-3 3M13.5 6.5h-7a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0 7h2');
export const LinkIcon = icon('M7 9a2.5 2.5 0 0 0 3.5 0l2-2a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5-3.5l-.75.75M9 7a2.5 2.5 0 0 0-3.5 0l-2 2A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 7 12.5l.75-.75');
export const ImageIcon = icon('M2.5 3.5h11v9h-11zM2.5 10.5l3-3 3 3 2-2 3 3M10 6.25v.1');
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Into the toolbar, to the control used last; Tab again leaves it. |
| `Right / Left` | The next / previous control, wrapping around (Left / Right in a right-to-left page). Down / Up when vertical. |
| `Home / End` | The first / last control. |
| `In a text field` | The arrows, Home and End move in the text; Tab leaves. |
| `Down on a menu button` | Opens its menu (horizontal toolbar). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Role` | `role="toolbar"` with `aria-orientation`, named by `label`. |
| `Focus` | One Tab stop: the control used last has `tabindex="0"`, the others `-1` (roving tabindex). |
| `Separators` | `role="separator"`, turned across the toolbar. |
| `Toggles` | Toggle items are buttons with `aria-pressed`. |
| `“More” menu` | A menu button named from `uiLocale` (“More options”); the items keep their names (an icon-only button its `hint` or `aria-label`), toggles become check items, menu buttons submenus. |

## Localization

The only text a toolbar writes itself is the name of its “more” button, from `uiLocale.strings.moreOptions`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of the kit; the “more” buttons take the new name at once. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        The “more” button is named <output class="tb-more-name">{() => kitTexts.strings.moreOptions}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-toolbar` | The toolbar. `data-orientation`, `data-size`, `data-overflow`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-toolbar__separator` | A separator. |
| `.mx-toolbar__more` | The “more” button (a `Button` with a menu). |
| `[data-overflowed]` | On a control that is in the “more” menu now. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `toolbar.height` | The bar’s least height (the density-aware bar height). |
| `toolbar.bar, toolbar.separator` | Units: the bar (`vertical`: a column of controls) and the separators across it. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly ToolbarItem[]>` | `[]` | Items as data, drawn before the JSX children (see Items). |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Names the toolbar for screen readers (`aria-label`). The same property as `text`. |
| `orientation` | `Bind<'horizontal' \| 'vertical'>` | `'horizontal'` | Which way it runs; the arrow keys follow it. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | Given to the controls inside that have no `size` of their own. |
| `buttonVariant` | `Bind<ButtonVariant>` | `'ghost'` | Given to the buttons inside that have no `variant` of their own. |
| `overflow` | `Bind<'menu' \| 'wrap' \| 'scroll'>` | `'menu'` | `menu`: what does not fit goes into a “more” menu at the end; `wrap`: a second row; `scroll`: the bar scrolls. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | `enabled={false}` disables every control inside. |

### ToolbarItem

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `Bind<'button' \| 'toggle' \| 'separator' \| 'menu'>` | Default `'button'`. |
| `text, icon, hint` | `Bind<…>` | The caption (`&Bold` is an access key), an icon, a tooltip. A button with only an icon is named by its `hint`. |
| `pressed` | `Bind<boolean>` | A toggle’s state. As a function the item follows the app: its `click` changes what it reads. |
| `enabled, visible` | `Bind<boolean>` | Dimmed, or left out. |
| `menu` | `Bind<readonly MenuItem[]>` | The commands of a `menu` item: submenus, check and radio items, shortcuts. |
| `overflow` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'always' \| 'never'>` | Whether it may move into the “more” menu; wins over the toolbar. A JSX child says it with `data-overflow`. |
| `click` | `(e) => void` | Pressed, in the bar or in the “more” menu. `e`: `{ item, source, event }`. |
| `data` | `unknown` | Your own value. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `overflowed` | read-only, reactive | The controls in the “more” menu now. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `controlOf(item)` | `Control \| null` | The control made for an item of `items`. |
| `updateOverflow()` | `void` | Works out again what fits, e.g. after a control changed its width. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items may be plain or reactive; the toolbar reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. The list and each item's fields are read again; the controls made for items that stay are kept. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Focuses the control Tab reaches. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onItemClick(e)` | An item of `items` was pressed, after its own `click`. `e`: `{ item, source, event }`. |

## Example files

`Editor.tsx`

```tsx
import { Toolbar } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { draft } from './draft';
import { editorItems } from './editor-items';

/** An editor toolbar from `items`: buttons, toggles, an alignment group, a menu, and a button kept out of the “more” menu. */
export default function Editor() {
  const preview = () =>
    `font-weight: ${draft.bold ? 600 : 400}; font-style: ${draft.italic ? 'italic' : 'normal'}; text-decoration: ${draft.underline ? 'underline' : 'none'}; text-align: ${draft.align}; inline-size: 100%; margin: 0`;
  return (
    <>
      <Toolbar label="Format" items={editorItems()} style="inline-size: 100%" />
      <p style={preview}>The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.</p>
      <output class="tb-log">{() => draft.log}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

`editor-items.tsx`

```tsx
import type { ToolbarItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { draft } from './draft';
import { AlignCenterIcon, AlignLeftIcon, AlignRightIcon, BoldIcon, ImageIcon, ItalicIcon, LinkIcon, RedoIcon, UnderlineIcon, UndoIcon } from './icons';

const did = (what: string) => (draft.log = what);

const align = (value: 'left' | 'center' | 'right', hint: string, Icon: typeof BoldIcon): ToolbarItem => ({
  type: 'toggle',
  icon: () => <Icon />,
  hint,
  pressed: () => draft.align === value,
  click: () => (draft.align = value),
});

/** The items of the editor toolbar, bound to the draft. */
export function editorItems(): ToolbarItem[] {
  return [
    { icon: () => <UndoIcon />, hint: 'Undo', click: () => did('Undo') },
    { icon: () => <RedoIcon />, hint: 'Redo', click: () => did('Redo') },
    { type: 'separator' },
    { type: 'toggle', icon: () => <BoldIcon />, hint: 'Bold', pressed: () => draft.bold, click: () => (draft.bold = !draft.bold) },
    { type: 'toggle', icon: () => <ItalicIcon />, hint: 'Italic', pressed: () => draft.italic, click: () => (draft.italic = !draft.italic) },
    { type: 'toggle', icon: () => <UnderlineIcon />, hint: 'Underline', pressed: () => draft.underline, click: () => (draft.underline = !draft.underline) },
    { type: 'separator' },
    align('left', 'Align left', AlignLeftIcon),
    align('center', 'Center', AlignCenterIcon),
    align('right', 'Align right', AlignRightIcon),
    { type: 'separator' },
    {
      type: 'menu',
      text: 'Insert',
      menu: [
        { text: '&Link', icon: () => <LinkIcon />, shortcut: 'Ctrl+K', click: () => did('Insert link') },
        { text: '&Image', icon: () => <ImageIcon />, click: () => did('Insert image') },
        { text: '&Table', items: [2, 3, 4].map((n) => ({ text: `${n} × ${n}`, click: () => did(`Insert a ${n} × ${n} table`) })) },
      ],
    },
    { text: '&Publish', click: () => did('Publish'), overflow: 'never' },
  ];
}
```

}

/** The editor toolbar in less room: a “more” menu, a second row, or a bar that scrolls. */

# MenuBar and ContextMenu

> Buttons · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A menu bar of an app (File, Edit, View) and the menu that opens on a right-click. Both show the same menu items: submenus, check and radio items, shortcuts, access keys.

## Import

```tsx
import { MenuBar, ContextMenu, attachContextMenu, type MenuItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## MenuBar

A `MenuBar` takes its top items as `items`; each one's `items` is its menu. `&File` makes Alt+F open File. Left and Right move along the bar and, while a menu is open, to the next menu; Escape goes back to the bar.

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { CheckBox, MenuBar, Stack, type MenuItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** An app's menu bar made with `new`: submenus, check and radio items, shortcuts, access keys, and `onItemClick`. */
export default function MainMenu() {
  const s = reactive({
    log: 'Nothing chosen yet.',
    chosen: 0,
    wrap: true,
    statusBar: false,
    zoom: '100%',
    theme: 'light',
    f10: false,
    canUndo: true,
  });

  const did = (what: string) => (s.log = what);
  const undo = (back: boolean) => {
    s.canUndo = !back;
    did(back ? 'Undo' : 'Redo');
  };
  const zoom = (value: string): MenuItem => ({ text: value, group: 'zoom', checked: () => s.zoom === value, click: () => (s.zoom = value) });
  const theme = (value: string, text: string): MenuItem => ({ text, group: 'theme', checked: () => s.theme === value, click: () => (s.theme = value) });

  const menus: MenuItem[] = [
    {
      text: '&File',
      items: [
        { text: '&New', shortcut: 'Ctrl+N', click: () => did('New') },
        { text: '&Open…', shortcut: 'Ctrl+O', click: () => did('Open…') },
        { text: 'Open &recent', items: ['report.docx', 'budget.xlsx', 'notes.md'].map((name) => ({ text: name, click: () => did(`Open ${name}`) })) },
        { text: '&Save', shortcut: 'Ctrl+S', beginGroup: true, click: () => did('Save') },
        { text: 'Save &as…', click: () => did('Save as…') },
        { text: 'E&xit', beginGroup: true, click: () => did('Exit') },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: '&Edit',
      items: [
        { text: '&Undo', shortcut: 'Ctrl+Z', enabled: () => s.canUndo, click: () => undo(true) },
        { text: '&Redo', shortcut: 'Ctrl+Y', click: () => undo(false) },
        { text: 'Cu&t', shortcut: 'Ctrl+X', beginGroup: true, click: () => did('Cut') },
        { text: '&Copy', shortcut: 'Ctrl+C', click: () => did('Copy') },
        { text: '&Paste', shortcut: 'Ctrl+V', click: () => did('Paste') },
        { text: 'Paste &special', enabled: false },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: '&View',
      items: [
        { text: '&Word wrap', checked: () => s.wrap, click: () => (s.wrap = !s.wrap) },
        { text: '&Status bar', checked: () => s.statusBar, click: () => (s.statusBar = !s.statusBar) },
        { ...zoom('100%'), beginGroup: true },
        zoom('125%'),
        zoom('150%'),
        { text: '&Theme', beginGroup: true, items: [theme('light', 'Light'), theme('dark', 'Dark'), theme('system', 'Same as the system')] },
      ],
    },
    { text: '&Help', items: [{ text: '&About', click: () => did('About') }] },
  ];

  const bar = new MenuBar({ label: 'Main', items: menus, focusOnF10: () => s.f10 });
  bar.onItemClick(() => s.chosen++);

  return (
    <>
      <div style="inline-size: 100%" ref={(c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => c.controls.add(bar)} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <CheckBox label="F10 focuses the bar" x-model={() => s.f10} />
        <output class="mb-log">{() => s.log}</output>
        <output class="mb-count">{() => `onItemClick ran ${s.chosen} times.`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <span class="mb-view">{() => `Word wrap ${s.wrap ? 'on' : 'off'} · status bar ${s.statusBar ? 'on' : 'off'} · zoom ${s.zoom} · theme ${s.theme}`}</span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Submenus, checks, radios, shortcuts

An item with `items` opens a submenu at its side: Right (Left in a right-to-left page), Enter or Space open it, Left and Escape close it, and the pointer opens it after a short rest. `checked` makes a check item; `checked` with a `group` one choice of several, shown with a dot. `shortcut` is shown at the end of the item; register the key itself with `addShortcut`. The same items work in `Button`’s menu.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `Bind<string>` | The label; `&Copy` makes C choose it while the menu is open (Alt+C on a menu bar’s top item). |
| `icon, hint` | `Bind<…>` | An icon at the start, a tooltip. |
| `shortcut` | `Bind<string>` | A key combination shown at the end (`Ctrl+S`). Only shown: register the key with `addShortcut`. |
| `description` | `Bind<string>` | A second, dimmer text after the label: what tells the item apart, such as a folder. Part of the item’s name, never a key. |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly MenuItem[]>` | A submenu, opened at the side. |
| `checked` | `Bind<boolean>` | A check item (`menuitemcheckbox`). |
| `group` | `Bind<string>` | With `checked`: one choice of a group (`menuitemradio`), shown with a dot. |
| `enabled, visible` | `Bind<boolean>` | Dimmed and not chosen, or left out. |
| `beginGroup` | `Bind<boolean>` | A line before the item. |
| `tone` | `Bind<'standard' \| 'accent' \| 'success' \| 'caution' \| 'danger'>` | The item in the kit tone color (`danger` for a destructive one); a toolbar button moved into the overflow menu keeps its tone. |
| `click` | `(e) => void` | Chosen, after the menu closed. `e`: `{ item, source, event }`. |
| `data` | `unknown` | Your own value. |

## ContextMenu

A `ContextMenu` opens on its target’s right-click at the pointer, and with the Menu key or Shift+F10 at the focused element. `onOpening` gets the element (`e.target`) and builds the items for it, here for the row of a list; `e.cancel = true` leaves the browser its own menu. It closes on Escape and a press outside; when the page scrolls it goes along with the element it opened on, and closes once that element is out of sight.

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { ContextMenu, type MenuItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface FileRow {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  locked: boolean;
  starred: boolean;
}

const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; margin: 0; list-style: none; padding: var(--mx-space-4); background: var(--mx-color-bg-card); border: var(--mx-border-width-1) solid var(--mx-color-stroke-card); border-radius: var(--mx-radius-lg)';

/** A context menu whose items `onOpening` builds for the row of a list it opens on. */
export default function FileList() {
  const s = reactive({
    log: 'Nothing chosen yet.',
    files: [
      { id: 1, name: 'report.docx', locked: false, starred: true },
      { id: 2, name: 'budget.xlsx', locked: true, starred: false },
      { id: 3, name: 'photo.png', locked: false, starred: false },
    ] as FileRow[],
  });
  let renamed = 0;
  let list: Component<HTMLUListElement> | null = null;

  const did = (what: string) => (s.log = what);
  const rename = (row: FileRow) => {
    row.name = `copy-${++renamed}-${row.name}`;
    did(`Renamed to ${row.name}`);
  };

  const rowItems = (row: FileRow): MenuItem[] => [
    { text: '&Open', click: () => did(`Open ${row.name}`) },
    { text: '&Rename', enabled: !row.locked, click: () => rename(row) },
    { text: '&Star', checked: row.starred, click: () => (row.starred = !row.starred) },
    { text: '&Move to', items: ['Documents', 'Pictures', 'Archive'].map((folder) => ({ text: folder, click: () => did(`Move ${row.name} to ${folder}`) })) },
    { text: '&Delete', shortcut: 'Del', beginGroup: true, enabled: !row.locked, click: () => (s.files = s.files.filter((f) => f !== row)) },
  ];

  const rowOf = (el: Element) => {
    const id = Number(el.closest('[data-id]')?.getAttribute('data-id'));
    return s.files.find((f) => f.id === id);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ul class="cm-list" aria-label="Files" ref={(c: Component<HTMLUListElement>) => (list = c)} style={BOX}>
        {s.files.map((file) => (
          <li key={file.id} data-id={String(file.id)} tabindex="0" style="padding-block: var(--mx-space-2)">
            {() => `${file.starred ? '★ ' : ''}${file.name}${file.locked ? ' (locked)' : ''}`}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <ContextMenu
        target={() => list}
        label="File"
        onOpening={(e) => {
          const row = rowOf(e.target);
          if (row) e.items = rowItems(row);
          else e.cancel = true;
        }}
      />
      <output class="cm-log">{() => s.log}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { attachContextMenu } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const START = 'Right-click here, or focus me and press the Menu key.';
const BOX = 'padding: var(--mx-space-4); background: var(--mx-color-bg-card); border: var(--mx-border-width-1) solid var(--mx-color-stroke-card); border-radius: var(--mx-radius-lg)';

/** A menu given to an element with `attachContextMenu`, its items built from the opening. */
export default function AttachedMenu() {
  const s = reactive({ zone: START });

  const attach = (c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const remove = attachContextMenu(c, (e) => [
      { text: '&Say where', click: () => (s.zone = `Opened ${e.byKeyboard ? 'from the keyboard' : 'with the pointer'} on <${e.target.tagName.toLowerCase()}>.`) },
      { text: '&Reset', click: () => (s.zone = START) },
    ]);
    c.motif.setDisposable(remove);
  };

  return (
    <div class="cm-zone" tabindex="0" style={BOX} onBuilt={attach}>
      {() => s.zone}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Into the menu bar (one stop), and out of it. |
| `Left / Right` | On the bar: the previous / next top item. In a menu: the neighbour’s menu, or close a submenu (Right opens one). Mirrored right to left. |
| `Down, Enter, Space` | On the bar: open the menu, first item. Up opens it on the last item. |
| `Up / Down, Home / End` | In a menu: move between the items, wrapping around. |
| `A letter` | The next item starting with it; an item’s `&` key chooses it. |
| `Alt + key` | Opens the top item with that `&` key (Control + Option on Apple platforms). |
| `Escape` | Closes a submenu, then the menu, back to where it opened. |
| `F10` | Focuses the menu bar, with `focusOnF10`. |
| `Menu key, Shift+F10` | Opens a context menu at the focused element. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `MenuBar` | `role="menubar"` named by `label`; top items are `menuitem`s with `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded`, one Tab stop (roving tabindex). |
| `Menus` | `role="menu"`; items are `menuitem`, `menuitemcheckbox` or `menuitemradio` with `aria-checked`; disabled ones `aria-disabled`, still reachable. |
| `Submenus` | The item has `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`; the submenu opens next to it, focus goes in and comes back. |
| `Focus` | A menu opened from the keyboard focuses its first item; from the pointer, the menu itself. Closing gives focus back. |
| `Shortcuts` | The shortcut text is part of the item’s name; access keys are in `aria-keyshortcuts` on the top items. |

## Localization

Menus write no text of their own: every label, shortcut and name comes from your items, so they follow your own translations (a function in `text` follows a language change at once).

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-menubar, .mx-menubar__bar, .mx-menubar__item` | The menu bar, its row, a top item (`aria-expanded="true"` while open). |
| `.mx-context-menu, .mx-context-menu__anchor` | The context menu (no box of its own) and the point it opens at. |
| `.mx-menu, .mx-menu__item, .mx-menu__separator` | A menu (shared with Button), an item, a line. |
| `.mx-menu__check, .mx-menu__icon, .mx-menu__label, .mx-menu__description, .mx-menu__shortcut, .mx-menu__arrow` | The parts of an item. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `menubar.height, menubar.item-height` | The heights of the bar and of a top item. |
| `menubar.bar, menubar.item, menubar.icon, menubar.mnemonic` | Units: the bar; a top item with its box per state (`hover`, `pressed`, `open`, `disabled`, `focus`); its icon; its access key’s mark (`shown`). |
| `menu.item, menu.item-height, menu.item-white-space` | Menu items (shared with Button’s menu): the item unit in each state (`highlight`, `pressed`, `focus`, `checked`, `disabled`, `first`, `last`, each tone and `<tone>-highlight`), the row height, whether a text wraps. |
| `menu.panel, menu.check, menu.icon, menu.check-mark, menu.radio-mark, menu.separator` | Units: the column of items, the leading mark and icon, the check and radio marks, the line between groups. |
| `menu.label, menu.description, menu.shortcut, menu.arrow` | Units: an item’s text, its description, the shortcut and the submenu arrow. |

## API reference

### MenuBar props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly MenuItem[]>` | `[]` | The top items; their `items` are the menus they open. A top item without `items` runs its `click`. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Names the bar for screen readers. The same property as `text`. |
| `focusOnF10` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | F10 moves focus to the bar from anywhere on the page. Off by default: browsers use F10. |
| `openOnHover` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | While a menu is open, pointing at another top item opens its menu; pointing at an item opens its submenu. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### ContextMenu props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly MenuItem[]>` | `[]` | The commands; `onOpening` can give others per element. |
| `target` | `Bind<Element \| Component \| null>` | its parent | Whose menu it is. Without it, the element the `ContextMenu` is placed in. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Names the menu for screen readers. |
| `keyboard` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The Menu key and Shift+F10 open it at the focused element. |
| `closeOnScroll` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Scrolling that takes the element it opened on out of sight closes it; until then the menu goes along with that element. |
| `openOnHover` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Pointing at an item opens its submenu. |
| `enabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false`: the browser shows its own menu. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MenuBar.openItem` | read-only, reactive | The top item whose menu is open. |
| `ContextMenu.opened` | read-only, reactive | Whether it is open. |
| `ContextMenu.targetElement` | read-only, reactive | The element it was last opened on. |
| `ContextMenu.target` | read/write, reactive | The element it listens on. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MenuBar.open(item \| index)` | `boolean` | Opens a top item’s menu with focus on its first item. |
| `MenuBar.close()` | `void` | Closes the open menu. |
| `ContextMenu.open(at, target?)` | `boolean` | Opens it from code, at `{ x, y }` or at an element. |
| `ContextMenu.close()` | `void` | Closes it. |
| `MenuBar.refresh(), ContextMenu.refresh()` | `void` | Your items may be plain or reactive; the menu reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. The bar, the open menu and its submenus follow. |
| `attachContextMenu(target, items)` | `() => void` | Gives an element or component a menu; `items` can be a function of the opening (`e.target`). Returns the remover. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onItemClick(e)` | Both: an item was chosen, after its own `click`. |
| `ContextMenu.onOpening(e)` | About to open. `e`: `{ target, items, cancel, byKeyboard, event, source }`; set `e.items` for the element, or `e.cancel = true`. |
| `ContextMenu.onClosed(reason)` | `escape`, `outside`, `focus` or `code`. |
