# TextBox

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A one-line text field with its label, help text and error: placeholder, prefix and suffix, buttons in the box, a clear button, a password that can be shown, a character counter, an input mask and validation — alone, in a group, or every field in a panel.

## Import

```tsx
import { TextBox, ValidationGroup, validateFields, type ValidationRule } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

Every prop takes a value or a function; a function of a reactive object keeps the field in step with it. `x-model` binds the value two-way. Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A field bound to state with x-model, and fields created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const form = reactive({ name: 'Ada', result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const box = new TextBox({ label: `Field ${++added}`, clearButton: true, placeholder: 'Created with new' });
    box.onValueChanged((e) => (form.result = `${box.label}: ${e.value}`));
    host?.controls.add(box);
    box.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <TextBox label="&Name" x-model={() => form.name} clearButton helpText={() => `Hello, ${form.name || 'stranger'}.`} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a field from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
        <output class="tb-result">{() => form.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Label

The label goes above the box, next to it (`side`), inside it until there is a value (`floating`), or only to screen readers (`hidden`). `&` marks its access key.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox, type FieldLabelMode } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const MODES: FieldLabelMode[] = ['top', 'side', 'floating', 'hidden'];

/** The label above the box, next to it, floating inside it, or only for screen readers. */
export default function LabelModes() {
  const s = reactive({ email: '', labelMode: 'top' as FieldLabelMode });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Label mode">
        {MODES.map((mode) => (
          <Button
            key={mode}
            text={mode}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.labelMode === mode ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.labelMode === mode}
            onclick={() => (s.labelMode = mode)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <TextBox label="&Email" labelMode={() => s.labelMode} type="email" x-model={() => s.email} helpText="We never share it." />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Variants and sizes

```tsx
import { Stack, TextBox, type FieldVariant } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const VARIANTS: FieldVariant[] = ['outline', 'filled', 'underline'];

/** Every variant in the three sizes. */
export default function VariantsAndSizes() {
  return (
    <>
      {VARIANTS.map((variant) => (
        <Stack key={variant} orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
          <TextBox label={`${variant} sm`} variant={variant} size="sm" placeholder="Small" />
          <TextBox label={`${variant} md`} variant={variant} placeholder="Medium" />
          <TextBox label={`${variant} lg`} variant={variant} size="lg" placeholder="Large" />
        </Stack>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Prefix, suffix, icon, buttons

`prefix` and `suffix` are fixed text around the value; `icon` sits at the start; `buttons` adds your own, each with its own `enabled`, `visible` and `position`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SearchIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <circle cx="7" cy="7" r="4.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <path d="M10.5 10.5l3 3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
  </svg>
);

const CopyIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M5.5 5.5h8v8h-8zM3 10.5h-.5v-8h8v.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** Fixed text around the value, an icon at the start, and a button of your own in the box. */
export default function PrefixSuffix() {
  const s = reactive({ site: '', query: '' });
  const link = 'https://motifjs.com/invite/42';
  return (
    <>
      <TextBox label="Site" prefix="https://" suffix=".com" x-model={() => s.site} />
      <TextBox label="Search" type="search" icon={() => <SearchIcon />} clearButton x-model={() => s.query} />
      <TextBox
        label="Invite link"
        readOnly
        value={link}
        buttons={[{ icon: () => <CopyIcon />, hint: 'Copy', click: () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(link) }]}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Password, counter

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A password that can be shown, and a field that counts its characters; a password sits in a form. */
export default function PasswordCounter() {
  const s = reactive({ password: '', note: '' });
  return (
    <form onsubmit={(e: SubmitEvent) => e.preventDefault()}>
      <Stack>
        <TextBox label="Password" type="password" x-model={() => s.password} autocomplete="new-password" />
        <TextBox label="Note" maxLength={40} showCounter x-model={() => s.note} />
      </Stack>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Mask

A mask keeps the text in shape while it is typed, deleted or pasted; the caret skips the fixed characters. The value is the typed characters only, or with `maskValue="formatted"` the text as shown. A mask that is not filled in fails validation.

| Character | Means |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | A digit. |
| `9` | A digit that may stay empty. |
| `a` | A letter. |
| `*` | A letter or a digit. |
| `\\` | The next character is fixed: `\\0` is a fixed zero. |
| `anything else` | A fixed character, skipped while typing. |

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A phone number, an IBAN kept with its spaces, and a plate with a mask character of its own. */
export default function Masks() {
  const s = reactive({ phone: '', iban: '', plate: '' });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <TextBox label="Phone" type="tel" mask="(000) 000 00 00" x-model={() => s.phone} />
        <output class="tb-phone">{() => `value: "${s.phone}"`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <TextBox label="IBAN" mask="TR00 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 00" maskValue="formatted" stretch x-model={() => s.iban} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <TextBox label="Plate" mask="00 LLL 099" maskChars={{ L: { test: /\p{L}/u, transform: 'upper' } }} x-model={() => s.plate} />
        <output>{() => `value: "${s.plate}"`}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Validation

A field checks itself when it is left after a change, then on every change until the value passes. `required`, `minLength`, `type="email"` and a mask bring their own rules; `rules` adds yours, async ones too. `error` shows a message from outside, e.g. from the server.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Stands in for a server call: "ada" is taken. */
const isFree = (value: string) =>
  new Promise<boolean | string>((done) => setTimeout(() => done(value.toLowerCase() === 'ada' ? `“${value}” is taken.` : true), 600));

/** Built-in rules, rules of your own (an async one too), an error from outside, and a group checked on Save. */
export default function Validation() {
  const s = reactive({ user: '', serverError: '' as string | null, result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const save = async () => {
    const result = await group.validate();
    s.result = result.valid ? 'Saved.' : `${result.invalid.length} field(s) to fix.`;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <TextBox label="Email" type="email" required validationGroup={group} />
      <TextBox
        label="User name"
        required
        helpText="Try “ada”: the server says it is taken."
        x-model={() => s.user}
        rules={[
          { type: 'length', min: 3 },
          { type: 'pattern', pattern: '[a-z0-9_]+', message: 'Lower case letters, digits and _ only.' },
          { type: 'custom', check: isFree },
        ]}
        validationGroup={group}
      />
      <TextBox label="Code" error={() => s.serverError} validationGroup={group} helpText="An error from outside shows until cleared." />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Save" tone="accent" onclick={save} />
        <Button text="Server error" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.serverError = s.serverError ? null : 'This code expired.')} />
        <Button text="Reset" variant="ghost" onclick={() => group.reset()} />
        <output class="tb-save">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

Without a group, `validateFields(panel)` checks every field inside a component or an element: a panel, a dialog, a page.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox, validateFields } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Every field inside a panel checked at once, without a group. */
export default function CheckPanel() {
  const s = reactive({ result: '' });
  let panel: Stack | null = null;

  const check = async () => {
    const result = await validateFields(panel!);
    s.result = result.valid ? 'All fields are fine.' : `${result.invalid.length} field(s) to fix.`;
  };

  return (
    <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (panel = c)}>
      <TextBox label="First name" required />
      <TextBox label="Last name" required />
      <Button text="Check the panel" variant="outline" onclick={check} />
      <output>{() => s.result}</output>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Read-only and disabled

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Read-only and disabled, both following state. */
export default function ReadOnly() {
  const s = reactive({ editing: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editing = !s.editing)} />
      <TextBox label="Read-only" value="#1042" readOnly={() => !s.editing} clearButton />
      <TextBox label="Disabled" value="#1042" enabled={() => s.editing} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Focus the field (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |
| `Enter` | Commits the value (with `updateOn="change"`) and fires `onEnter`. |
| `Escape` | With `clearButton`, empties a field that has a value; otherwise it goes on to the window around it. |
| `Tab` | The buttons you add and the password button are Tab stops; the clear button is not (Escape does its job). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Element` | A native `<input>`; its `<label>` is tied to it with `for`. |
| `Description` | `aria-describedby` names the prefix, the suffix and the line under the box. |
| `Errors` | `aria-invalid="true"`; the message line is a polite live region, so a new error is read out. |
| `Required` | `aria-required="true"`; the mark after the label is hidden from screen readers. |
| `Buttons` | The clear and password buttons are named from `uiLocale`; the password button has `aria-pressed`. |

## Localization

The names of the clear and password buttons and every validation message come from `uiLocale.strings`; every field follows a change at once, errors already shown included.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of every field on the page; errors already shown follow too. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        Required reads <output class="tb-required">{() => kitTexts.strings.required}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-field` | The field. `data-size`, `data-variant`, `data-label-mode`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`, `data-filled`, `data-required`, `data-stretch`. |
| `.mx-text-box` | Added by TextBox. |
| `.mx-field__label, .mx-field__box, .mx-field__input` | The label, the box, the input. |
| `.mx-field__icon, .mx-field__prefix, .mx-field__suffix` | The parts at the sides of the input. |
| `.mx-field__button, .mx-text-box__clear, .mx-text-box__reveal` | The buttons in the box. |
| `.mx-field__message, .mx-field__counter` | The line under the box. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `field.width` | The width when not stretched. |
| `field.height.*, field.padding.*, field.font-size.*` | Sizes, from the density tokens. |
| `field.box, field.layer, field.frame, field.indicator, field.ring` | Units: the box, a state layer over its fill, the frame (with `frame-start`, `frame-notch`, `frame-end` around a notch), the line along its bottom and a ring under the keys, each with its box per state: per variant (`filled-…`, `underline-…`), status (`invalid`, `readonly`, `disabled`) and `hover`, `focus`, `pressed`. |
| `field.label, field.required, field.icon, field.prefix, field.suffix, field.placeholder` | Units: the label (`focus`, `invalid`, `disabled`, `floating-…`), the required mark and the parts beside the text. |
| `field.slot, field.button, field.glyph, field.button-icon` | Units: the groups of buttons in the box, the buttons (`hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled`) and what they show. |
| `field.foot, field.message, field.counter` | Units: the line under the box (`shown`, `invalid`, `disabled`), the help or error text and the counter. |
| `field.border-width, field.gap, field.label-gap, field.label-width, field.label-font-weight, field.label-font-size` | The frame’s width, spacing and the label. |
| `field.icon-size, field.button-inset` | Icons, and how far the buttons sit from the box’s edges. |
| `field.floating-height, field.floating-font-size, field.floating-padding, field.notch-gap` | The floating label and the notch cut for it. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The text. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The caption; `&Name` makes Alt+N focus the field. The same property as `text`. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | `'top'` | `top`, `side` (next to the box), `floating` (inside the box until there is a value), `hidden` (only for screen readers). |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Shown while the field is empty. |
| `helpText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A line under the box. An error message takes its place. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A tooltip. |
| `type` | `Bind<TextBoxType>` | `'text'` | `text`, `password`, `email`, `search`, `tel`, `url`. `email` and `url` also check the format. |
| `prefix / suffix` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Fixed text before / after the value inside the box (`https://`, `kg`). |
| `icon` | `Bind<IconSource \| null>` | — | An icon at the start of the box. |
| `buttons` | `Bind<readonly FieldButton[]>` | `[]` | Buttons of your own inside the box, at the start or the end. |
| `clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A button that empties the field; Escape does the same. |
| `passwordReveal` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | With `type="password"`: a button that shows the password. |
| `maxLength / minLength` | `Bind<number>` | — | Limits; `minLength` is checked by validation. |
| `showCounter` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | `12/50` under the box (`12` without `maxLength`). |
| `updateOn` | `Bind<'input' \| 'change'>` | `'input'` | `change`: the value changes when the field is left or Enter is pressed. |
| `selectOnFocus` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Selects the whole text when the field gets focus. |
| `align` | `Bind<'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'>` | `'start'` | Text alignment. |
| `readOnly` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Can be read, selected and copied, not changed. |
| `required` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A mark after the label, `aria-required`, and a `required` rule. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`, from the density tokens. |
| `variant` | `Bind<FieldVariant>` | `'outline'` | `outline`, `filled`, `underline`. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Fills the width of what it sits in. |
| `mask` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | See Mask. |
| `maskChars` | `Bind<Record<string, MaskChar>>` | `{}` | Mask characters of your own. |
| `maskPlaceholder` | `Bind<string>` | `'_'` | Shown in the places not filled yet. |
| `maskValue` | `Bind<'raw' \| 'formatted'>` | `'raw'` | `raw`: only the typed characters; `formatted`: with the fixed ones. |
| `showMask` | `Bind<'always' \| 'focus'>` | `'focus'` | `focus`: an empty mask shows only while the field has focus. |
| `rules` | `Bind<readonly ValidationRule[]>` | `[]` | See Validation. |
| `error` | `Bind<string \| null>` | — | An error from outside (the server); shown until cleared. |
| `validateOn` | `Bind<ValidateOn>` | `'blur'` | `blur`, `input`, `manual`. |
| `validationGroup` | `Bind<ValidationGroup \| null>` | — | The group it is checked with. |
| `inputMode, autocomplete, spellcheck, name` | `Bind<…>` | — | Passed to the `<input>`. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop: `box.error = () => this.model.nameError` is followed. |
| `isValid` | read-only, reactive | `false` while an error shows. |
| `validationMessage` | read-only, reactive | The error shown, `''` without one. |
| `validating` | read-only, reactive | An asynchronous rule is running. |
| `maskComplete` | read-only | Every place of the mask is filled. |
| `inputElement` | read-only | The native `<input>`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `validate()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Checks the value and shows the outcome. |
| `resetValidation()` | `void` | Hides the outcome of earlier checks. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Focuses the input. |
| `select()` | `void` | Selects the whole text. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Empties the field as its clear button does. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your `buttons` may be plain or reactive; the field reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. Every editor has it; a list editor reads its items again too. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | The value changed. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`; `byUser` tells the user from code. |
| `onValidated(e)` | A check ended. `e`: `{ valid, message, source }`. |
| `onEnter(e)` | Enter was pressed. `e`: `{ value, source, event }`. |
| `oninput, onchange, onkeydown, onfocusin, onfocusout` | The DOM events of the input reach the field. |

### Validation rules

| Rule | Checks |
| --- | --- |
| `{ type: 'required' }` | Something must be entered. |
| `{ type: 'email' } / { type: 'url' }` | An email address / a web address. |
| `{ type: 'pattern', pattern }` | A `RegExp`, or a string that must match the whole value (like the HTML `pattern`). |
| `{ type: 'length', min?, max? }` | The number of characters. |
| `{ type: 'range', min?, max? }` | A number or a date between bounds. |
| `{ type: 'compare', with, not? }` | Equal to another value (a repeated password), or different with `not`. |
| `{ type: 'custom', check, ignoreEmpty? }` | `check(value)` returns `true`, `false` or a message, or a promise of one (a server call). |
| `every rule` | `message` (a value or a function) and `enabled`. Empty values pass every rule but `required` and `compare`. |

The frame (`Field`), the mask (`InputMask`, which works on any `<input>`) and validation (`ValidationGroup`, `validateFields`, `checkRules`) are shared parts, exported for other components and your own.


---

# TextArea

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A text field of several lines: a box that grows with the text or that the user drags bigger, a character counter, a clear button, Ctrl+Enter to send, and the label, help text and validation every field has.

## Import

```tsx
import { TextArea, type TextAreaProps } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

Every prop takes a value or a function; `x-model` binds the text two-way. Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextArea } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A textarea bound with x-model, and notes created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ comment: 'MotifJS keeps the DOM it builds.', log: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const note = new TextArea({ label: `Note ${++added}`, rows: 2, autoGrow: true, maxRows: 5, clearButton: true });
    note.onValueChanged((e) => (s.log = `${note.label}: ${e.value.split('\n').length} line(s)`));
    host?.controls.add(note);
    note.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <TextArea label="&Comment" x-model={() => s.comment} helpText={() => `${s.comment.length} characters`} stretch />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a note from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
        <output class="ta-log">{() => s.log}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Growing with the text

With `autoGrow` the box follows the text: never smaller than `minRows` lines, never taller than `maxRows`; past that it scrolls. A narrower box wraps into more lines and grows too.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TextArea } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A box that grows with the text from two lines to six, then scrolls. */
export default function AutoGrow() {
  const s = reactive({ story: '' });
  return <TextArea label="Story" autoGrow minRows={2} maxRows={6} placeholder="Type a few lines…" x-model={() => s.story} stretch />;
}
```

## Resize

The grip at the corner of the box lets the user drag it taller (`vertical`, the default), in both directions (`both`), or not at all (`none`).

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextArea, type TextAreaResize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const RESIZES: TextAreaResize[] = ['none', 'vertical', 'both'];

/** Which way the user can drag the box bigger. */
export default function Resize() {
  const s = reactive({ resize: 'vertical' as TextAreaResize });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Resize">
        {RESIZES.map((resize) => (
          <Button
            key={resize}
            text={resize}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.resize === resize ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.resize === resize}
            onclick={() => (s.resize = resize)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <TextArea label="Notes" resize={() => s.resize} rows={4} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Counter and limits

`maxLength` stops typing at the limit, `minLength` is checked when the field is left; `showCounter` shows the count under the box.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TextArea } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A limit while typing, a minimum checked on leaving, a counter and a clear button. */
export default function CounterAndLimits() {
  const s = reactive({ bio: '' });
  return <TextArea label="Bio" maxLength={160} minLength={10} showCounter clearButton x-model={() => s.bio} stretch />;
}
```

## Ctrl+Enter

Enter starts a new line. Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on a Mac) fires `onEnter` with the value: the usual way to send a message or save a note.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TextArea } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A message box: Enter starts a new line, Ctrl+Enter sends. */
export default function CtrlEnter() {
  const s = reactive({ message: '', sent: [] as { id: number; text: string }[] });
  let sentCount = 0;

  const send = (text: string) => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    s.sent.push({ id: ++sentCount, text });
    s.message = '';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ul class="ta-sent">
        {s.sent.map((m) => (
          <li key={m.id}>{m.text}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      <TextArea label="Message" helpText="Ctrl+Enter sends." autoGrow rows={1} maxRows={4} x-model={() => s.message} onEnter={(e) => send(e.value)} stretch />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Label

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextArea, type FieldLabelMode } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const MODES: FieldLabelMode[] = ['top', 'side', 'floating', 'hidden'];

/** The label above the box, next to it, floating inside it, or only for screen readers. */
export default function LabelModes() {
  const s = reactive({ labelMode: 'top' as FieldLabelMode });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Label mode">
        {MODES.map((mode) => (
          <Button
            key={mode}
            text={mode}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.labelMode === mode ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.labelMode === mode}
            onclick={() => (s.labelMode = mode)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <TextArea label="Address" labelMode={() => s.labelMode} rows={2} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Read-only, disabled, required

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, TextArea } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const TERMS = 'Line one of the terms.\nLine two of the terms.';

/** Read-only and disabled, both following state, and a required field. */
export default function States() {
  const s = reactive({ editing: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editing = !s.editing)} />
      <TextArea label="Terms" readOnly={() => !s.editing} value={TERMS} rows={2} />
      <TextArea label="Reason" required enabled={() => s.editing} rows={2} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter` | A new line. |
| `Ctrl + Enter, Cmd + Enter` | Commits the value (with `updateOn="change"`) and fires `onEnter`: send, save. |
| `Escape` | With `clearButton`, empties a field that has a value; otherwise it goes on to the window around it. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Focus the field (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |
| `Tab` | Leaves the field; the clear button is not a Tab stop (Escape does its job). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Element` | A native `<textarea>` (multi-line by nature); its `<label>` is tied to it with `for`. |
| `Description` | `aria-describedby` names the prefix, the suffix and the line under the box. |
| `Errors` | `aria-invalid="true"`; the message line is a polite live region. |
| `Required` | `aria-required="true"`; the mark after the label is hidden from screen readers. |
| `Ctrl + Enter` | Say it in the label or the help text when it sends something, as in the example above. |

## Localization

The name of the clear button and the validation messages come from `uiLocale.strings`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of every field on the page, the clear button's name included. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        The clear button reads <output>{() => kitTexts.strings.clear}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

TextArea uses the field tokens (`field.*`, see TextBox) and has none of its own: the first line lines up with a one-line field of the same size.

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-field.mx-text-area` | The field. `data-resize`, `data-auto-grow`, and the field attributes (`data-size`, `data-variant`, `data-label-mode`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`, `data-filled`). |
| `.mx-field__box` | The box; it carries the resize grip. |
| `.mx-field__input.mx-text-area__input` | The textarea. |
| `.mx-text-area__clear` | The clear button. |
| `.mx-field__message, .mx-field__counter` | The line under the box. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The text, lines separated by `\n`. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The caption; `&Name` makes Alt+N focus the field. The same property as `text`. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | `'top'` | `top`, `side`, `floating`, `hidden`. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Shown while the field is empty. |
| `rows` | `Bind<number>` | `3` | Visible lines. |
| `autoGrow` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The box follows the text, from `minRows` to `maxRows` lines, then scrolls. |
| `minRows` | `Bind<number>` | `rows` | The smallest box with `autoGrow`. |
| `maxRows` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The largest box with `autoGrow`; without it the box grows without a limit. |
| `resize` | `Bind<TextAreaResize>` | `'vertical'` | `none`, `vertical`, `both`: which way the user can drag the box. `none` while `autoGrow` is on. |
| `maxLength / minLength` | `Bind<number>` | — | Limits; both are checked by validation. |
| `showCounter` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | `12/500` under the box (`12` without `maxLength`). |
| `clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A button that empties the field; Escape does the same. |
| `updateOn` | `Bind<'input' \| 'change'>` | `'input'` | `change`: the value changes when the field is left or Ctrl+Enter is pressed. |
| `selectOnFocus` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Selects the whole text when the field gets focus. |
| `wrap` | `Bind<'soft' \| 'hard' \| 'off'>` | `'soft'` | `off` keeps long lines on one line and scrolls sideways. |
| `helpText, hint, prefix, suffix, icon, buttons` | see TextBox |  | The parts every field has. |
| `readOnly, required, size, variant, stretch` | see TextBox |  | The states and the look every field has. |
| `rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | Validation, as for every field. |
| `spellcheck, name, autocomplete` | `Bind<…>` | — | Passed to the `<textarea>`. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `isValid, validationMessage, validating` | read-only, reactive | The outcome of the checks. |
| `textAreaElement` | read-only | The native `<textarea>`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `validate()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Checks the value and shows the outcome. |
| `resetValidation()` | `void` | Hides the outcome of earlier checks. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Focuses the textarea. |
| `select()` | `void` | Selects the whole text. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Empties the field as its clear button does. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | The value changed. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`. |
| `onValidated(e)` | A check ended. `e`: `{ valid, message, source }`. |
| `onEnter(e)` | Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter) was pressed. `e`: `{ value, source, event }`. |
| `oninput, onchange, onkeydown, onfocusin, onfocusout` | The DOM events of the textarea reach the field. |

# NumberBox

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A number field: arrow keys, PageUp / PageDown and spin buttons that repeat while held, bounds, a step without float noise, a format for display (currency, percent) and typing in the locale’s own way.

## Import

```tsx
import { NumberBox, type NumberBoxProps } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

`x-model` binds a number (`null` when empty). Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, NumberBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const show = (value: number | null) => (value === null ? 'null' : String(value));

/** A field bound to a number with x-model, and fields created with `new` and stepped from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ quantity: 3 as number | null, log: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const box = new NumberBox({ label: `Count ${++added}`, min: 0, max: 10, value: 5, locale: 'en' });
    box.onValueChanged((e) => (s.log = `${box.label}: ${show(e.value)}`));
    host?.controls.add(box);
    box.stepUp();
    box.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <NumberBox label="&Quantity" min={1} max={99} locale="en" x-model={() => s.quantity} />
        <output class="nb-quantity">{() => `value: ${show(s.quantity)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a field from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
        <output class="nb-log">{() => s.log}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Steps and keys

Up / Down add `step`, PageUp / PageDown add `largeStep` (10 × `step` by default), Home / End go to `min` / `max`. Steps are added on the decimal digits, so 0.1 + 0.2 is 0.3. With `wheel`, the mouse wheel steps while the field has focus.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { NumberBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const show = (value: number | null) => (value === null ? 'null' : String(value));

/** A step of 0.1 without float noise, and the mouse wheel stepping while the field has focus. */
export default function Steps() {
  const s = reactive({ rate: 0.1 as number | null });
  return (
    <>
      <NumberBox label="Rate" step={0.1} min={0} max={5} wheel locale="en" x-model={() => s.rate} />
      <output class="nb-rate">{() => `value: ${show(s.rate)}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Spin buttons

Pressing a spin button steps once; holding it repeats until it is let go or a bound is reached. They sit on top of each other (`stacked`) or side by side (`inline`), or not at all.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, NumberBox, Stack, type SpinLayout } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const LAYOUTS: SpinLayout[] = ['stacked', 'inline'];

/** Spin buttons on top of each other, side by side, or none. */
export default function SpinButtons() {
  const s = reactive({ seats: 2 as number | null, layout: 'stacked' as SpinLayout, spin: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Spin buttons">
        {LAYOUTS.map((layout) => (
          <Button
            key={layout}
            text={layout}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.spin && s.layout === layout ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.spin && s.layout === layout}
            onclick={() => {
              s.layout = layout;
              s.spin = true;
            }}
          />
        ))}
        <Button text="none" size="sm" variant={() => (s.spin ? 'ghost' : 'solid')} aria-pressed={() => !s.spin} onclick={() => (s.spin = false)} />
      </Stack>
      <NumberBox label="Seats" min={1} max={9} locale="en" spinLayout={() => s.layout} showSpinButtons={() => s.spin} x-model={() => s.seats} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Format and locale

Without focus the value shows through `Intl.NumberFormat` with `format` and `locale` (the page `lang` by default); with focus it turns into the plain number to edit. What is typed is read in that locale: `1.234,5` in Turkish, `1,234.5` in English; a `.` also works as the decimal point where it cannot be a group separator. A percent is edited as shown: 12.5 for 0.125.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { NumberBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const show = (value: number | null) => (value === null ? 'null' : String(value));

/** A Turkish lira price, a percent edited as shown, and US dollars. */
export default function Format() {
  const s = reactive({ price: 1234.5 as number | null, share: 0.125 as number | null, dollars: 99.99 as number | null });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <NumberBox label="Price" locale="tr-TR" min={0} format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY' }} x-model={() => s.price} />
        <output class="nb-price">{() => `value: ${show(s.price)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <NumberBox label="Share" locale="en" min={0} max={1} step={0.01} format={{ style: 'percent', maximumFractionDigits: 1 }} x-model={() => s.share} />
        <output class="nb-share">{() => `value: ${show(s.share)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <NumberBox label="Amount" locale="en-US" format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' }} x-model={() => s.dollars} />
        <output>{() => `value: ${show(s.dollars)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Min, max and clamp

An entered value outside `min` / `max` is brought inside when the field is left. With `clamp={false}` it stays as typed and the range check reports it.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { NumberBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A value brought inside its bounds, and one left as typed for the range check to report. */
export default function MinMaxClamp() {
  const s = reactive({ score: 50 as number | null, age: null as number | null });
  return (
    <>
      <NumberBox label="Score" min={0} max={100} locale="en" x-model={() => s.score} helpText="Try 250." />
      <NumberBox label="Age" min={18} max={120} clamp={false} locale="en" x-model={() => s.age} helpText="Try 12." />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Decimals and empty

`decimals` rounds every value, the one given as well as the one entered, and shows exactly that many digits while the field is not edited (`72.50`); `format` can show them otherwise. An empty field is `null`; with `allowEmpty={false}` it gets `min` (or 0) when the field is left.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { NumberBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const show = (value: number | null) => (value === null ? 'null' : String(value));

/** Rounding to one decimal, and a field that cannot stay empty. */
export default function DecimalsAndEmpty() {
  const s = reactive({ weight: 72.456 as number | null });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <NumberBox label="Weight" decimals={1} step={0.1} suffix="kg" locale="en" x-model={() => s.weight} />
        <output class="nb-weight">{() => `value: ${show(s.weight)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <NumberBox label="Guests" min={1} allowEmpty={false} locale="en" value={2} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Up / Down arrow` | Adds / takes away `step`. |
| `PageUp / PageDown` | Adds / takes away `largeStep`. |
| `Home / End` | Goes to `min` / `max` when they are set; otherwise moves the caret. |
| `Enter` | Enters the typed text (rounded, kept in range) and fires `onEnter`. |
| `Mouse wheel` | With `wheel`, steps while the field has focus. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Focus the field (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Role` | `spinbutton` on a text `<input inputmode="decimal">`, so phones show a number keyboard and any locale can be typed. |
| `Value` | `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, and `aria-valuetext` with the formatted value (`₺1.234,50`). |
| `Spin buttons` | Named “Increase” / “Decrease” from `uiLocale`; not Tab stops (the arrow keys do their job). |
| `Errors` | `aria-invalid="true"`; the message line is a polite live region. |

## Localization

The names of the spin buttons and the range messages come from `uiLocale.strings`; numbers follow `locale`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the names of the spin buttons and the range messages. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });

  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        The up button reads <output class="nb-increase">{() => kitTexts.strings.increase}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-field.mx-number-box` | The field. `data-spin` while the spin buttons show, and the field attributes. |
| `.mx-number-box__spin` | The spin buttons; `data-layout="stacked" \| "inline"`. |
| `.mx-number-box__step` | One spin button; `data-step="up" \| "down"`. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `number-box.spin, number-box.step, number-box.glyph` | Units: the spin buttons together (`stacked`, `inline`, `disabled`), each step (`up`, `down`, `next`, `hover`, `pressed`, `disabled`) and its glyph. |
| `number-box.spin-layout, number-box.spin-order` | Where the steps stand (stacked at the end, or one on each side) and in which order. |
| `number-box.spin-inset` | The space around the stacked spin buttons. |
| `field.*` | Everything else, as for TextBox. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The number; `null` when empty. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `min / max` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | Bounds: steps stop there, Home / End go there, entered values are kept inside (see `clamp`), the range is checked. |
| `step` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | What the arrow keys, the spin buttons and the wheel add. |
| `largeStep` | `Bind<number>` | 10 × `step` | What PageUp / PageDown add. |
| `showSpinButtons` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The up and down buttons in the box. |
| `spinLayout` | `Bind<SpinLayout>` | `'stacked'` | `stacked`: arrows on top of each other; `inline`: − and + side by side. |
| `wheel` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The mouse wheel changes the value while the field has focus. |
| `format` | `Bind<Intl.NumberFormatOptions>` | `{}` | How the value shows without focus: `{ style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY' }`, `{ style: 'percent' }`, `{ minimumFractionDigits: 2 }`… |
| `locale` | `Bind<string>` | the page `lang` | The locale of the format and of what is typed. |
| `decimals` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | Digits after the point: every value is rounded to them (half away from zero), wherever it comes from, and shown with exactly that many while the field is not edited. |
| `clamp` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A value outside `min` / `max` is brought inside when entered; `false` leaves it to the range check. |
| `allowEmpty` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | An empty field is `null`; `false` puts `min` (or 0) in its place when the field is left. |
| `updateOn` | `Bind<'input' \| 'change'>` | `'input'` | `input`: the value changes as soon as the text is a whole number in range; `change`: when the field is left or Enter is pressed. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Shown while the field is empty. |
| `selectOnFocus` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Selects the whole text when the field gets focus. |
| `align` | `Bind<'start' \| 'center' \| 'end'>` | `'start'` | Text alignment. |
| `label, labelMode, helpText, hint, prefix, suffix, icon, buttons` | see TextBox |  | The parts every field has. |
| `readOnly, required, size, variant, stretch` | see TextBox |  | The states and the look every field has. |
| `rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | Validation, as for every field. |
| `name, autocomplete` | `Bind<string>` | —, `'off'` | Passed to the `<input>`. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. `locale` reads back the locale in use. |
| `formattedValue` | read-only, reactive | The value as it shows without focus, `''` when empty. |
| `isValid, validationMessage, validating` | read-only, reactive | The outcome of the checks. |
| `inputElement` | read-only | The native `<input>`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stepUp(times = 1)` | `void` | Adds `step` × `times`, kept within `min` / `max`. |
| `stepDown(times = 1)` | `void` | Takes `step` × `times` away. |
| `validate()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Checks the value and shows the outcome. |
| `resetValidation()` | `void` | Hides the outcome of earlier checks. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Focuses the input. |
| `select()` | `void` | Selects the whole text. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | The value changed. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`; a held spin button reports every step. |
| `onValidated(e)` | A check ended. `e`: `{ valid, message, source }`. |
| `onEnter(e)` | Enter was pressed. `e`: `{ value, source, event }`. |

# DateBox

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A date, a time or both. It is typed in the order of the locale through a mask, or picked from a calendar and a list of times; `min`, `max` and `disabledDates` limit both ways.

## Import

```tsx
import { DateBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DateBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const today = new Date();

/** A date box bound with x-model, and date boxes created with `new`, given a value and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const order = reactive({ delivery: new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + 3) as Date | null, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const due = new DateBox({ label: `Due ${++added}`, locale: 'tr-TR', clearButton: true });
    due.value = new Date(2026, 9, 25);
    due.onValueChanged((e) => (order.result = `${due.label}: ${e.value ? e.value.toDateString() : '—'}`));
    host?.controls.add(due);
    due.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <DateBox label="&Delivery" x-model={() => order.delivery} clearButton />
      <output class="db-day">{() => (order.delivery ? order.delivery.toDateString() : '—')}</output>
      <Button text="Add a date box from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
      <output class="db-made">{() => order.result}</output>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Locales

The mask follows the locale: day, month and year in its order, with its separators. Month and day names in the calendar, and the first day of the week, come from it too.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DateBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** One date in three locales: each types and shows it in its own order and separators. */
export default function Locales() {
  const s = reactive({ trip: null as Date | null });
  return (
    <>
      <DateBox label="Türkçe" locale="tr-TR" x-model={() => s.trip} />
      <DateBox label="English (US)" locale="en-US" x-model={() => s.trip} />
      <DateBox label="日本語" locale="ja-JP" x-model={() => s.trip} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Time and date with time

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DateBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A date with a time in steps of 15 minutes, and a time alone. */
export default function TimeAndDate() {
  const s = reactive({ meeting: null as Date | null, alarm: null as Date | null });
  return (
    <>
      <DateBox label="Meeting" type="datetime" timeStep={15} displayFormat={{ dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }} x-model={() => s.meeting} stretch />
      <DateBox label="Alarm" type="time" x-model={() => s.alarm} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Limits and validation

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DateBox, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const today = new Date();
const inDays = (n: number) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + n);

/** A required weekday in the next 60 days: `min`, `max` and `disabledDates` limit typing and picking, a group checks it. */
export default function Limits() {
  const s = reactive({ result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const check = async () => {
    const result = await group.validate();
    s.result = result.valid ? 'Booked.' : 'Pick a weekday in the next 60 days.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <DateBox
        label="Appointment"
        required
        min={today}
        max={inDays(60)}
        disabledDates={(d: Date) => d.getDay() === 0 || d.getDay() === 6}
        helpText="A weekday in the next 60 days."
        validationGroup={group}
        showTodayButton
      />
      <Button text="Check" variant="outline" onclick={check} />
      <output class="db-check">{() => s.result}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Digits` | Fill the mask; the separators are skipped. The value changes once the date is whole and real. |
| `Alt + Down, the button` | Open the calendar (or the times); focus goes to the chosen day. |
| `In the calendar` | Arrows, Home, End, Page Up / Down (with Shift: a year), Enter to choose — see Calendar. |
| `In the times` | Up, Down, Home, End, Page Up / Down, Enter. |
| `Escape` | Close the picker; with `clearButton` and the picker closed, empty the value. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Field` | A native `<input>` with its label; the format is the mask the user types into. |
| `Button` | `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, named from `uiLocale` ("Choose date" / "Choose time"). |
| `Picker` | A `role="dialog"` with the calendar grid (see Calendar) and a list of times (`role="listbox"`). |
| `Errors` | A date that does not exist, outside `min` / `max` or disabled fails validation with a message from `uiLocale`. |

## Localization

Button names and messages come from `uiLocale.strings`; dates and names from `locale`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Switches the button names and messages of every date box on the page. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />;
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-date-box` | Added to the field; `data-type="date\|time\|datetime"`. |
| `.mx-date-box__toggle, .mx-date-box__clear` | The picker and clear buttons. |
| `.mx-date-box__popup, .mx-date-box__times` | The picker and its list of times. |
| `date-box.times, date-box.popup-gap, date-box.calendar` | The list of times (a unit: `focus`, `beside`), the space between the field and its popup, and the calendar as it looks in the popup (a place); the rest is `field.*` and `calendar.*`. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<Date \| null>` | `null` | The date. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `type` | `Bind<'date' \| 'time' \| 'datetime'>` | `'date'` | A day, a time of day, or both. |
| `locale` | `Bind<string>` | the page's | The order of the parts (`25.10.2026`, `10/25/2026`), month and day names, where weeks start. |
| `min / max` | `Bind<Date \| null>` | — | Limits for typing and picking; checked by validation. |
| `disabledDates` | `Bind<(date) => boolean>` | — | Days that cannot be chosen, e.g. weekends. |
| `displayFormat` | `Bind<Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions \| null>` | — | How the value reads while the field is not edited: `{ dateStyle: 'long' }`. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Shown while empty and not focused. |
| `clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Empties the value; Escape too. |
| `showPickerButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The button that opens the calendar or the times. |
| `timeStep` | `Bind<number>` | `30` | The minutes between the times offered. |
| `showSeconds` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Seconds in the time. |
| `firstDayOfWeek, showWeekNumbers, showTodayButton` | see Calendar |  | Passed to the calendar. |
| `label, helpText, required, rules, readOnly, size, variant, …` | see TextBox |  | The field props every editor has. |

### Properties, methods, events

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `unfinished` | The text typed is not a whole, real date yet. |
| `opened, open(), close()` | The picker. |
| `clear()` | Empties the value. |
| `inputElement` | The native `<input>`. |
| `onValueChanged, onOpened, onClosed, onValidated` | As for DropDown and TextBox. |

The date helpers are shared: `datePatternOf(locale, kind)`, `dateToDigits`, `digitsToDate`.

# DateRangeBox

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A start and an end date in one field: typed through two masks, or picked on two months side by side, from ready-made ranges, within the dates and the span allowed. The value is a `[start, end]` pair.

## Import

```tsx
import { DateRangeBox, type DateRange } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DateRangeBox, Stack, type DateRange } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const say = (d: Date | null) => (d ? d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB') : '—');

/** A range bound with x-model, and one made from code and read through its properties. */
export default function FromCode() {
    const s = reactive({ stay: [new Date(2026, 2, 10), new Date(2026, 2, 14)] as DateRange, told: '' });
    const coded = new DateRangeBox({ label: 'Report period', clearButton: true, onValueChanged: e => (s.told = `${say(e.value[0])} to ${say(e.value[1])}`) });

    return (
        <Stack gap="md">
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <DateRangeBox label="Stay" x-model={() => s.stay} clearButton />
                <output class="dr-stay">{() => `${say(s.stay[0])} to ${say(s.stay[1])}`}</output>
            </Stack>
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <span onConfig={c => c.controls.add(coded)} />
                <Button text="This week" variant="outline" onclick={() => (coded.value = [new Date(2026, 2, 16), new Date(2026, 2, 22)])} />
                <output class="dr-told">{() => s.told}</output>
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Presets

`presets` puts ready-made ranges beside the calendars: `true` for the kit’s, or your own, each made when it is chosen. `calendars={1}` shows one month.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DateRangeBox, Stack, type DateRange, type DateRangePreset } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const day = (offset: number) => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset);
    return d;
};

// Ranges of our own, made when chosen so they are about today.
const QUARTERS: DateRangePreset[] = [
    { text: 'Next 3 days', range: () => [day(0), day(2)] },
    { text: 'Next week', range: () => [day(1), day(7)] },
    { text: 'Next 90 days', range: () => [day(0), day(89)] }
];

/** The kit's presets beside the calendars, and presets of your own. */
export default function Presets() {
    const s = reactive({ sales: [null, null] as DateRange, plan: [null, null] as DateRange });
    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
            <DateRangeBox label="Sales period" presets x-model={() => s.sales} />
            <DateRangeBox label="Planning" presets={QUARTERS} calendars={1} x-model={() => s.plan} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Limits

`min`, `max` and `disabledDates` bound both ends, typed or picked; `minDays` and `maxDays` bound the span, and the calendars offer only the days within while the end is being picked. A failed rule says which.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DateRangeBox, Stack, type DateRange } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const today = new Date();
const inMonths = (n: number) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth() + n, today.getDate());

/** A stay of one to fourteen nights, within the next six months, never starting on a Sunday; the message says which rule failed. */
export default function Limits() {
    const s = reactive({ stay: [null, null] as DateRange, told: '' });
    let box!: DateRangeBox;
    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
            <DateRangeBox
                ref={(b: DateRangeBox) => (box = b)}
                label="Stay"
                min={today}
                max={inMonths(6)}
                minDays={1}
                maxDays={14}
                disabledDates={d => d.getDay() === 0}
                required
                x-model={() => s.stay}
            />
            <Button text="Check" variant="outline" onclick={() => void box.validate().then(ok => (s.told = ok ? 'Fine.' : box.validationMessage))} />
            <output class="dr-check">{() => s.told}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## With a time, and in another locale

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DateRangeBox, Stack, type DateRange } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Date and time on both ends: the time is typed after the date, the calendars keep it; one box in Turkish. */
export default function DateTime() {
    const s = reactive({ shift: [new Date(2026, 2, 10, 8, 30), new Date(2026, 2, 10, 17, 0)] as DateRange, trip: [null, null] as DateRange });
    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
            <DateRangeBox label="Shift" type="datetime" x-model={() => s.shift} displayFormat={{ dateStyle: 'short', timeStyle: 'short' }} />
            <DateRangeBox label="Seyahat" locale="tr-TR" showWeekNumbers x-model={() => s.trip} startPlaceholder="gidiş" endPlaceholder="dönüş" />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Behaviour

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Typing` | Each side is a masked input in the locale’s order (`22.11.2006`); a whole, real date is taken as it is finished, an emptied side becomes `null`. Tab moves from the start to the end. |
| `Picking` | On the popup the first pick is the start, the second the end: an earlier second pick becomes the start. With both chosen, the next pick starts a new range. While the end is being picked, the pointer shows the range it would make. |
| `Two months` | The calendars show the start’s month and the next; paging one pages the other with it. |
| `Presets` | A list beside the calendars; a press takes the range and closes. |
| `Keyboard` | Alt+Down opens the popup; in it the calendars take the arrow keys, Enter picks; Escape closes, and clears the field when `clearButton` is on and the popup is closed. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Inputs` | Two text boxes named “<label>, Start date” and “<label>, End date” in the kit language; the field’s label marks the start. |
| `Popup` | A dialog named “Choose date”; the calendars are the kit’s grids, the presets a list box. |
| `Messages` | The rules speak in the kit language; a rule of your own in yours. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-date-range-box` | The field. `data-type`. |
| `.mx-date-range-box__start, .mx-date-range-box__end, .mx-date-range-box__separator` | The inputs and the glyph between them. |
| `.mx-date-range-box__toggle, .mx-date-range-box__clear` | The buttons in the box. |
| `.mx-date-range-box__popup, .mx-date-range-box__calendar, .mx-date-range-box__presets` | The popup, each calendar, the presets. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `date-range-box.separator, .presets` | Units: the glyph between the inputs (`icon`, `bg`), the list of presets (`focus`, `beside`). |
| `date-range-box.calendar` | Place: a calendar on the popup. |
| `date-range-box.popup-gap` | Between the calendars and the presets. |
| `calendar.cell range-start, range-end, range-single, range-in` | The calendar’s cells in a range: its ends and the days between, drawn by each language. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<DateRange>` | `[null, null]` | The `[start, end]` pair; either `null` while not chosen. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `type` | `Bind<'date' \| 'datetime'>` | `'date'` | With `datetime` the time is typed after the date; the calendars keep it. |
| `min, max, disabledDates` | `Bind<Date \| null>`, `Bind<(d: Date) => boolean>` | — | The dates allowed, on both ends, typed or picked. |
| `minDays, maxDays` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The least and the most days a range may span, the end counted from the start; while the end is picked the calendars offer only days within. |
| `presets` | `Bind<readonly DateRangePreset[] \| boolean>` | `false` | `true`: the kit’s ready-made ranges beside the calendars (today, yesterday, the last 7 and 30 days, this and last month); your own as `{ text, range: () => DateRange }`. |
| `calendars` | `Bind<1 \| 2>` | `2` | Months side by side on the popup; two stay a month apart as one is paged. |
| `closeOnComplete` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The popup closes once both ends are picked. |
| `locale, displayFormat, firstDayOfWeek, showWeekNumbers, showSeconds` |  |  | As on the `DateBox`. |
| `startPlaceholder, endPlaceholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Shown in an empty box. |
| `clearButton, showPickerButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false`, `true` | The clear button; the button that opens the calendars. |
| `label, helpText, required, rules, readOnly, size, variant…` |  |  | The field props, as on every editor. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `startDate, endDate` | `Date \| null` | The ends as properties of their own. |
| `inputElement, endInputElement` | read-only | The start’s and the end’s inputs. |
| `open(), close(), opened` | `boolean` / `void` | The popup with the calendars; `onOpened`, `onClosed`. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Empties both ends. |
| `validate(), validationMessage, isValid` |  | As on every field: an unfinished date, a date outside `min`, `max` or `disabledDates`, a start after the end, a span under `minDays` or over `maxDays`. |
| `onValueChanged` | event | The pair changed (`value`, `previousValue`, `byUser`). |

# ColorBox and ColorPicker

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A colour as a field, with a picker in a popup; or the picker on its own. The picker has an area of saturation and brightness, a hue strip, an opacity strip, inputs for the channels and preset colours.

## Import

```tsx
import { ColorBox, ColorPicker } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## A colour field

Type a hex or any `rgb(…)` form, or open the picker; the value is kept as hex. Every prop takes a value or a function.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ColorBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PALETTE = ['#3b5bdb', '#1971c2', '#0c8599', '#2b8a3e', '#f08c00', '#e8590c', '#e03131', '#c2255c', '#862e9c', '#495057'];

/** A colour field bound with `x-model`: type a hex, or open the picker (Alt+Down); one made with `new` from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ accent: '#3b5bdb' as string | null });
  const coded = new ColorBox({ label: 'Made in code', value: '#2b8a3e', clearButton: true });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 18rem; max-inline-size: 100%">
      <ColorBox label="&Accent" palette={PALETTE} x-model={() => s.accent} helpText={() => `Value: ${s.accent ?? 'none'}`} />
      <span onConfig={(c) => c.controls.add(coded)} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## The picker on its own

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ColorPicker, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PALETTE = ['#ffffff', '#ced4da', '#495057', '#000000', '#e03131', '#f08c00', '#2b8a3e', '#1971c2', '#862e9c', '#3b5bdb80'];

/** The picker on its own, in the page: with opacity (`alpha`) and preset colours. */
export default function Picker() {
  const s = reactive({ color: '#1971c2cc' as string | null });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <ColorPicker alpha palette={PALETTE} x-model={() => s.color} />
      <span>{() => `Value: ${s.color}`}</span>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## OK and Cancel

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ColorBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Applied with buttons: the value changes on OK, Cancel leaves it; with opacity it keeps `#rrggbbaa`. */
export default function Buttons() {
  const s = reactive({ overlay: '#00000080' as string | null });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 18rem; max-inline-size: 100%">
      <ColorBox label="Overlay" alpha apply="useButtons" x-model={() => s.overlay} />
      <span>{() => `Value: ${s.overlay ?? 'none'}`}</span>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Arrow keys` | On the area: saturation (left, right) and brightness (up, down); on a strip: hue or opacity. Shift moves by 10. |
| `Home, End` | A strip’s ends. |
| `Alt+Down` | In the colour box: opens the picker. |
| `Enter` | In the colour box: takes the hex typed. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Handles` | Sliders named “Saturation and brightness”, “Hue”, “Opacity”, saying where they stand, in the kit language. |
| `Inputs` | Kit text and number boxes, each with its label (Hex, Red, Green, Blue, Opacity). |
| `Presets` | Buttons named by their colour; the chosen one is pressed (`aria-pressed`). |
| `Popup` | A dialog named “Choose color”; focus goes to the area and comes back to the box. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-color-picker` | The picker. `data-alpha`. |
| `.mx-color-picker__area, __strip, __hue, __alpha, __thumb` | The area, the strips and their handles. |
| `.mx-color-picker__preview, __inputs, __hex, __channel, __swatches, __swatch, __pick` | The rest of the picker. |
| `.mx-color-box, .mx-color-box__swatch, .mx-color-box__toggle, .mx-color-box__popup` | The colour box and its parts. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `color-picker.area, .strip, .thumb, .preview, .swatch` | Units: their corners, the handle’s ring and focus, a preset’s hover, chosen and focus looks. |
| `color-picker.width, .gap, .area-height, .strip-height, .thumb-size, .preview-size, .swatch-size, .swatch-gap` | The picker’s sizes and spaces. |
| `color-picker.checker-*, color-box.checker-*` | The checker under a see-through colour. |
| `color-box.swatch, color-box.swatch-size, color-box.popup-gap` | The swatch in the box, and the space in the popup. |

## API reference

### ColorBox props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | The colour, kept as `#rrggbb` (`#rrggbbaa` with `alpha`); any `#…` or `rgb(…)` form is read. Two-way with `x-model`. |
| `alpha` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | An opacity strip and input; the value keeps its opacity. |
| `palette` | `Bind<readonly string[] \| null>` | `null` | Preset colours in the popup. |
| `apply` | `Bind<ColorBoxApply>` | `'instantly'` | `instantly`: the value follows every move in the popup; `useButtons`: it changes on OK, Cancel leaves it. |
| `clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A button that empties it. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Shown while it is empty. |
| `label, helpText, readOnly, required, rules, size…` | see Field |  | Everything a field has. Text that is not a colour is reported as not valid. |

### ColorBox properties, methods and events

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(), close()` | methods | Opens or closes the picker (Alt+Down opens it too). |
| `opened` | read-only | Whether the picker is open. |
| `onOpened, onClosed` | events | The picker opened, or closed (with the reason). |
| `picker` | read-only | The `ColorPicker` in the popup, once it was opened. |
| `clear()` | method | Empties it. |

### ColorPicker props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | The colour; it follows every move. Two-way with `x-model`. |
| `alpha` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | An opacity strip and input. |
| `palette` | `Bind<readonly string[] \| null>` | `null` | Preset colours to choose with one press. |
| `showInputs` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The hex and red, green, blue inputs. |
| `eyeDropper` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A button that picks a colour from the screen, where the browser can (EyeDropper). |
| `onValueChanged` | `ColorChangedEventArgs` |  | The colour changed (`value`), by the user or by code (`byUser`). |

### Functions

| Function | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `parseColor(text)` | `ColorRgba \| null` | Reads `#rgb`, `#rgba`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `rgb(…)`, `rgba(…)`. |
| `formatColor(rgba)` | `string` | `#rrggbb`, or `#rrggbbaa` when it is not opaque. |

# Calendar

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A month of days to pick a date from, with a year and a decade view to get far quickly. It is the picker of DateBox, and it works on its own.

## Import

```tsx
import { Calendar } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Calendar, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A calendar bound with x-model, and calendars created with `new`, added from code and moved to a month. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const form = reactive({ day: new Date() as Date | null, result: '' });
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const calendar = new Calendar({ locale: 'tr-TR' });
    calendar.onValueChanged((e) => (form.result = e.value ? e.value.toDateString() : '—'));
    host?.controls.add(calendar);
    calendar.goTo(new Date(2027, 0, 1));
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Calendar x-model={() => form.day} showWeekNumbers showTodayButton />
      <output class="cal-day">{() => (form.day ? form.day.toDateString() : '—')}</output>
      <Button text="Add a calendar from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
      <output class="cal-made">{() => form.result}</output>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Limits

```tsx
import { Calendar } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** No day before today and no Sunday, in Turkish. */
export default function Limits() {
  return <Calendar min={new Date()} disabledDates={(d: Date) => d.getDay() === 0} locale="tr-TR" />;
}
```

## Views

The title zooms out to the months of the year and to twelve years; a choice there zooms back in. `minView` makes a month or a year the choice itself.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Calendar, Stack, type CalendarView } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const views: CalendarView[] = ['month', 'year', 'decade'];

/** The view set from state, and a calendar whose choice is a month. */
export default function Views() {
  const s = reactive({ view: 'month' as CalendarView, month: null as Date | null });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="View">
        {views.map((view) => (
          <Button key={view} text={view} size="sm" variant={() => (s.view === view ? 'solid' : 'ghost')} aria-pressed={() => s.view === view} onclick={() => (s.view = view)} />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Calendar currentView={() => s.view} />
      <Calendar minView="year" x-model={() => s.month} />
      <output>{() => (s.month ? s.month.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }) : '—')}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Left / Right` | The day before / after (mirrored right to left); a month or a year in the other views. |
| `Up / Down` | The same day a week before / after; four months or years in the other views. |
| `Home / End` | The first / last day of the week; the start / end of the row in the other views. |
| `Page Up / Page Down` | The month before / after; with Shift, the year. A year, a decade in the other views. |
| `Enter, Space` | Choose the day; in the other views, open the month or the year. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Pattern` | The APG date picker grid: `role="grid"`, one Tab stop on the focused day, the arrows inside. |
| `Cells` | Each day is named in full ("Sunday, 25 October 2026"); `aria-selected`, `aria-current="date"` for today, `aria-disabled`. |
| `Header` | Weekday names have their full form in `abbr`; the title is a live region, so a new month is read out. |
| `Buttons` | Previous / next are named from `uiLocale` for the view on screen. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-calendar` | `data-view="month\|year\|decade"`. |
| `.mx-calendar__header, __previous, __title, __next` | The header. |
| `.mx-calendar__cell` | `aria-selected`, `aria-disabled`, `data-today`, `data-outside`. |
| `calendar.container, header, title, nav, nav-icon, weekday, week, cell, ring, foot, today` | Units: every piece in its states (a cell: `block`, `hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `outside`, `today`, `selected`, `disabled` …). |
| `calendar.day-size, calendar.view-cell-width-scale, calendar.view-cell-height-scale, calendar.previous-rotate, calendar.next-rotate` | A day's size (the grid is built on it), the zoomed-out views' cells, the arrows' turns. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<Date \| null>` | `null` | The chosen date. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `min / max` | `Bind<Date \| null>` | — | Days outside cannot be chosen; the arrows stop there. |
| `disabledDates` | `Bind<(date) => boolean>` | — | Days that cannot be chosen. |
| `locale` | `Bind<string>` | the page's | Month and day names, and where weeks start. |
| `firstDayOfWeek` | `Bind<number \| null>` | the locale’s | 0 Sunday … 6 Saturday. |
| `showWeekNumbers` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | ISO week numbers before each week. |
| `showOtherMonths` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Days of the months before and after. |
| `showTodayButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A Today button under the grid. |
| `currentView` | `Bind<'month' \| 'year' \| 'decade'>` | `'month'` | The view on screen; the title zooms out, a choice zooms in. |
| `minView` | `Bind<CalendarView>` | `'month'` | The view a choice is made in: `year` picks a month, `decade` a year. |

### Properties, methods, events

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `focusedDate` | The day with the Tab stop; its month is on screen. |
| `goTo(date)` | Shows the month of a date. |
| `canChoose(date)` | Whether a day can be chosen. |
| `focus()` | Focuses the day with the Tab stop. |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`. |
