# Slider

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A value picked on a track by dragging a thumb or with the keys: one number, or a range with two thumbs. Steps, marks with labels, a value bubble, a vertical form and number formatting, with the label, help line and validation every field has.

## Import

```tsx
import { Slider, type SliderValue } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

Every prop takes a value or a function; `x-model` binds the value two-way. Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Slider, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A slider bound to state with x-model, and sliders created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ volume: 40, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const slider = new Slider({ label: `Slider ${++added}`, showValue: 'drag' });
    slider.value = 50;
    slider.onValueChanged((e) => (s.result = `${slider.label}: ${String(e.value)}`));
    host?.controls.add(slider);
    slider.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="&Volume" x-model={() => s.volume} helpText={() => `Volume: ${s.volume}`} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a slider from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
        <output class="sl-result">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Range

With `range` there are two thumbs and the value is `[start, end]`. The thumbs cannot cross; `minDistance` keeps them apart. A press on the track moves the nearer thumb.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Slider, type SliderValue } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const EURO: Intl.NumberFormatOptions = { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR', maximumFractionDigits: 0 };

/** Two thumbs that cannot cross, kept apart by minDistance. */
export default function Range() {
  const s = reactive({ price: [120, 380] as SliderValue });
  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="Price" range max={500} step={10} minDistance={50} format={EURO} showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.price} />
      <output class="sl-price">{() => `value: [${(s.price as number[]).join(', ')}]`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Centred

With `origin` the active part of the track runs from that value to the thumb, on either side of it: a balance, an offset, a correction.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Slider } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A value on either side of a middle: the active part runs from the origin to the thumb. */
export default function Centred() {
  const s = reactive({ balance: -30 });
  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="Balance" min={-100} max={100} origin={0} showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.balance} />
      <output class="sl-balance">{() => `balance: ${s.balance}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Steps and marks

`step` sets the values a thumb stops at. `ticks` draws a mark at every step, or with a number that many equal parts; `tickLabels` writes the values under them.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Slider } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Steps, a mark at every step or in equal parts, and formatted labels under them. */
export default function StepsAndMarks() {
  const s = reactive({ zoom: 100, rating: 6 });
  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="Zoom" min={25} max={200} step={25} ticks tickLabels format={{ style: 'unit', unit: 'percent' }} x-model={() => s.zoom} />
      <Slider label="Rating" max={10} ticks={5} tickLabels x-model={() => s.rating} />
      <Slider label="Opacity" max={1} step={0} value={0.5} tickLabels showValue="drag" format={{ style: 'percent' }} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Value bubble and format

`showValue` puts the value in a bubble over the thumb while it is moved (`drag`, also while a key moves it) or `always`. `format` writes it with `Intl.NumberFormat`; `valueText` gives screen readers their own words.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Slider, Stack, type SliderShowValue } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SHOW: SliderShowValue[] = ['never', 'drag', 'always'];

/** The value bubble shown never, while moved or always, written with a format and read out with valueText. */
export default function ValueBubble() {
  const s = reactive({ show: 'drag' as SliderShowValue, temp: 21 });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Show value">
        {SHOW.map((show) => (
          <Button
            key={show}
            text={show}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.show === show ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.show === show}
            onclick={() => (s.show = show)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Slider
        label="Temperature"
        min={16}
        max={28}
        step={0.5}
        showValue={() => s.show}
        format={{ style: 'unit', unit: 'celsius' }}
        valueText={(v) => `${v} degrees`}
        x-model={() => s.temp}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Vertical

`orientation="vertical"` stands the track up; up is more, and the Up arrow moves it up.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Slider } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Three vertical sliders, as in an equalizer: up is more. */
export default function Vertical() {
  const s = reactive({ bass: 4, mid: 0, treble: -2 });
  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="Bass" orientation="vertical" min={-12} max={12} ticks={4} tickLabels showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.bass} />
      <Slider label="Mid" orientation="vertical" min={-12} max={12} ticks={4} tickLabels showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.mid} />
      <Slider label="Treble" orientation="vertical" min={-12} max={12} ticks={4} tickLabels showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.treble} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## When the value changes

By default the value follows the thumb while it is dragged. With `updateOn="change"` it changes once, when the thumb is let go — for work that should not run on every move, such as a search. The keys change it at once either way.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Slider } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A value that follows the thumb, next to one that changes only when the thumb is let go. */
export default function UpdateOn() {
  const s = reactive({ live: 50, committed: 50 });
  return (
    <>
      <Slider label="Live" showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.live} />
      <output class="sl-live">{() => `live: ${s.live}`}</output>
      <Slider label="On release" updateOn="change" showValue="drag" x-model={() => s.committed} />
      <output class="sl-committed">{() => `on release: ${s.committed}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Sizes, read-only, disabled, validation

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Slider, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The three sizes, read-only and disabled following state, and a range rule checked while it moves. */
export default function States() {
  const s = reactive({ editable: true, age: 16 });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Slider label="Small" size="sm" value={30} />
        <Slider label="Medium" value={50} />
        <Slider label="Large" size="lg" value={70} />
      </Stack>
      <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editable = !s.editable)} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Slider label="Read-only" value={30} readOnly={() => !s.editable} />
        <Slider label="Disabled" range value={[20, 60]} enabled={() => s.editable} />
      </Stack>
      <Slider label="Age" max={99} validateOn="input" rules={[{ type: 'range', min: 18, message: 'You must be 18 or older.' }]} x-model={() => s.age} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Right / Up arrow` | One step more. In a right-to-left page, Left is more on a horizontal slider. |
| `Left / Down arrow` | One step less. |
| `Page Up / Page Down` | `largeStep` more / less. |
| `Home / End` | The least / the most; with two thumbs, as far as the other thumb lets. |
| `Tab` | Each thumb is a Tab stop. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Focuses the (first) thumb. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Thumb` | `role="slider"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-orientation`, and `aria-valuetext` when there is a `format` or a `valueText`. |
| `Name` | One thumb is named by the label. Two thumbs sit in a `role="group"` named by the label; each is named by the label and its end ("Minimum", "Maximum"). |
| `Two thumbs` | The start thumb's `aria-valuemax` is the end thumb's value, and the other way round, as the APG multi-thumb slider says. |
| `States` | `aria-readonly`, `aria-invalid` and `aria-disabled` on the thumbs; the line under the track describes them. |
| `Pointer` | The pointer is captured while it drags; a press on the track moves the nearest thumb there. The track is as tall as a touch target. |

## Localization

The names of the two thumbs of a range come from `uiLocale.strings` (`minimum`, `maximum`); numbers are written in `locale`, by default the page's `lang`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Slider, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the names of the thumbs; the price slider writes its numbers in the chosen language. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        The start thumb is named <output class="sl-minimum">{() => kitTexts.strings.minimum}</output>
      </span>
      <Slider
        label={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Price' : 'Fiyat')}
        range
        max={1000}
        step={50}
        value={[200, 800]}
        showValue="drag"
        locale={() => s.lang}
        format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-slider` | The field. `data-size`, `data-orientation`, `data-range`, `data-show-value`, `data-ticks`, `data-tick-labels`, `data-dragging`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`, `data-invalid`, `data-split`. |
| `.mx-slider__control` | What the pointer is pressed on: the track and the marks. |
| `.mx-slider__track, .mx-slider__rail` | The track, and the rail that holds its segments (`--_from`, `--_to`; `data-from="start \| thumb \| origin"`, `data-to="thumb \| origin \| end"`, `data-start-active`, `data-end-active`). |
| `.mx-slider__fill, .mx-slider__segment` | The active segment, and the inactive ones before and after it (`data-side`). |
| `.mx-slider__thumb` | A thumb: the pressable area (`data-thumb="start \| end"`, `data-dragging`, `--_at`). |
| `.mx-slider__halo, .mx-slider__knob, .mx-slider__core` | What a thumb shows, centred on it: a halo, the knob and the part inside the knob. |
| `.mx-slider__bubble` | The value over a thumb. |
| `.mx-slider__ticks, .mx-slider__tick, .mx-slider__tick-label` | The marks (`data-mark`, `data-active`, `--_at`) and their labels. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `slider.track, slider.active, slider.stop` | Units: the inactive segments (`before`, `after`), the active one (`from-start`, `to-end`) and the dots at the ends (`active`), each with its box per state (`hover`, `focus`, `pressed`, `readonly`, `disabled`). |
| `slider.halo, slider.knob, slider.core` | Units: what a thumb shows, with its box per state (`hover`, `focus`, `pressed`, `readonly`, `disabled`). |
| `slider.bubble, slider.bubble-arrow, slider.tick, slider.tick-label, slider.ring` | Units: the value bubble and its arrow, the marks, their labels, and a ring around the whole control under the keys. |
| `slider.track-thickness.*, slider.active-thickness.*` | The inactive and the active segments, per size. |
| `slider.thumb-width.*, slider.thumb-height.*, slider.thumb-core-size.*` | The knob along and across the track, and the part inside it, per size. |
| `slider.track-gap, slider.origin-gap, slider.stop-inset` | A track split around the thumbs and the origin, and where the dots at its ends sit. |
| `slider.hit-size` | How tall the track is for the pointer, and the touch target of a thumb. |
| `slider.vertical-length` | The length of a vertical slider. |
| `slider.tick-length, slider.tick-width, slider.tick-offset, slider.tick-gap, slider.tick-line-height, slider.tick-label-width` | Where the marks and their labels sit. |
| `slider.bubble-gap, slider.bubble-arrow-size` | How far the bubble is from its thumb, and its arrow. |
| `field.width` | The width of a horizontal slider, as for every field. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<number \| [number, number]>` | `min` / `[min, max]` | The value; `[start, end]` with `range`. `x-model` binds it two-way. It is kept on the steps and inside the bounds. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The caption; `&Name` makes Alt+N focus the thumb. The same property as `text`. |
| `min / max` | `Bind<number>` | `0` / `100` | The bounds. When they change the value follows and is written back. |
| `step` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | The values a thumb stops at, counted from `min`; `0` for any number. |
| `largeStep` | `Bind<number>` | `10 × step` | What Page Up and Page Down move by. |
| `range` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Two thumbs; the value is `[start, end]`. The thumbs cannot cross. |
| `minDistance` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | The least distance between the two thumbs. |
| `origin` | `Bind<number \| undefined>` | `undefined` | A centred slider: the active part of the track runs from this value to the thumb, on either side. Not with `range`. |
| `orientation` | `Bind<'horizontal' \| 'vertical'>` | `'horizontal'` | Vertical: up is more. |
| `ticks` | `Bind<boolean \| number>` | `false` | `true`: a mark at every step (up to 1000); a number: that many equal parts. |
| `tickLabels` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The values under the marks, or at the two ends without marks. |
| `showValue` | `Bind<'never' \| 'drag' \| 'always'>` | `'never'` | A bubble with the value over the thumb: never, while it is moved (by the pointer or the keys), or always. |
| `format` | `Bind<Intl.NumberFormatOptions \| null>` | `null` | How the bubble, the tick labels and screen readers write the value. |
| `locale` | `Bind<string>` | the page's `lang` | The locale of `format`. |
| `valueText` | `(value: number) => string` | — | What screen readers say for a value. A function, so it is stored as it is, not bound. |
| `updateOn` | `Bind<'input' \| 'change'>` | `'input'` | `change`: the value changes when the thumb is let go; the thumb still moves. |
| `name` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The name it is sent with in a form; a range sends two values. |
| `helpText, hint, prefix, suffix, icon` | see TextBox |  | The parts every field has; `prefix` and `suffix` sit at the two ends of the track. |
| `readOnly` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Can be focused and read, not moved. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`: the rail and the thumbs. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Fills the width of what it sits in. |
| `rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | Validation, as in every field. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `thumbElements` | read-only | The thumb elements, `[start, end]` (the end one is hidden without `range`). |
| `isValid, validationMessage, validating` | read-only, reactive | As in every field. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `formatValue(value)` | `string` | A value written the way the bubble writes it. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Focuses the (first) thumb. |
| `validate() / resetValidation()` | `Promise<boolean>` / `void` | As in every field. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | The value changed. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`. |
| `onValidated(e)` | A check ended. |

# Rating

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A row of stars to give a score or to show one, whole or by halves. It is a field: label, help text, rules and `x-model` work as in every field.

## Import

```tsx
import { Rating } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

Every prop takes a value or a function; `x-model` binds the score two-way. Under the pointer the stars show what a press would give.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Rating, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A rating bound with `x-model`, with a label and a help line like any field; one made with `new` from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ stars: 3 as number | null });
  const coded = new Rating({ label: 'Made in code', max: 10, value: 7 });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Rating label="Your rating" x-model={() => s.stars} helpText={() => (s.stars ? `You gave ${s.stars}` : 'Not rated yet')} />
      <span onConfig={(c) => c.controls.add(coded)} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Halves, sizes, tones

```tsx
import { Rating, Stack, type ControlSize, type RatingTone } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];
const TONES: RatingTone[] = ['accent', 'neutral'];

/** Halves, each size and tone, and a score only shown (`readOnly`). */
export default function Looks() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Rating label="By halves" step={0.5} value={3.5} />
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <Rating key={size} label={`Size ${size}`} size={size} value={4} />
      ))}
      {TONES.map((tone) => (
        <Rating key={tone} label={`Tone ${tone}`} tone={tone} value={2} />
      ))}
      <Rating label="Shown only" readOnly step={0.5} value={4.5} />
      <Rating label="Disabled" disabled value={3} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Icons of your own

```tsx
import { Rating } from '@motifx-community/ui';

// A heart of our own, as image addresses: an outline and a filled one, drawn in the stars' colours.
const svg = (body: string) => `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 16 16">${body}</svg>`)}`;
const HEART = 'M8 13.5S2 10 2 5.75A2.75 2.75 0 0 1 8 4.5a2.75 2.75 0 0 1 6 1.25C14 10 8 13.5 8 13.5z';
const EMPTY = svg(`<path d="${HEART}" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>`);
const FILLED = svg(`<path d="${HEART}" fill="black"/>`);

/** Icons of your own: a name of the kit's set, or an image address. */
export default function Icons() {
  return <Rating label="How much do you like it?" emptyIcon={EMPTY} filledIcon={FILLED} value={3} />;
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Arrow keys` | One step up or down (by halves with `step={0.5}`). |
| `Home, End` | None (or the least, without `allowClear`), and every star. |
| `1 … 9` | That many stars. |
| `Delete, Backspace` | None (with `allowClear`). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Role` | A `slider` from 0 to `max`, named by its label; the value is said as “3 of 5”, or “Not rated”, in the kit language. |
| `Read-only` | `aria-readonly`; the stars only show the score. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-rating` | The field. `data-tone`, `data-size`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-rating__stars` | The row of stars: the slider, which takes the focus. |
| `.mx-rating__item, .mx-rating__star, .mx-rating__fill` | One star, its empty shape and its filled part (`--_fill`: the share filled). |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `rating.stars, rating.item, rating.star, rating.fill` | Units: the row (focus, disabled), a star growing under the pointer, the empty shape, the filled part in each tone. |
| `rating.size.*, rating.gap.*` | A star and the space between stars, per size. |
| `rating.tone` | The tone when none is given. |
| `rating.field.*` | Place: the field under a rating, without a box. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | The score, rounded to `step`; `null`: none. Two-way with `x-model`. |
| `max` | `Bind<number>` | `5` | How many stars. |
| `step` | `Bind<1 \| 0.5>` | `1` | `0.5` takes halves: a press on a star’s first half, or the arrow keys. |
| `allowClear` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A press on the value chosen, Delete or Backspace leave none. |
| `preview` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Under the pointer, the stars show what a press would give. |
| `tone` | `Bind<RatingTone>` | the language’s | `accent`, `neutral`. Gold stars of your own: give `rating.fill.accent.bg` your colour. |
| `emptyIcon, filledIcon` | `Bind<string \| null>` | the language’s | The shape of an empty and of a filled star: a name of the kit’s icon set, or an image address (drawn in the stars’ colours). |
| `label, helpText, readOnly, required, rules, size…` | see Field |  | Everything a field has: a rating is one. |

# FileUploader

> Editors · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Files chosen with a button or dropped on the box, listed with their size and what happens to them: uploaded as they come, on a button or from code, with progress, cancel, retry and remove on each. Files outside the limits are listed with the reason.

## Import

```tsx
import { FileUploader } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Choosing, dropping, uploading

`upload` is your own way to send a file: report progress, stop on the signal, resolve to the response. With `uploadUrl` instead, the uploader sends the file itself, in one piece or in chunks (`chunkSize`).

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { FileUploader, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

// Stands in for a server: takes two seconds per megabyte, reports as it goes, stops on the signal.
const send = (file: File, report: (fraction: number) => void, signal: AbortSignal) =>
    new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
        const steps = 20;
        const wait = Math.max(600, Math.min(4000, (file.size / 1_000_000) * 2000)) / steps;
        let step = 0;
        const timer = setInterval(() => {
            step++;
            report(step / steps);
            if (step === steps) {
                clearInterval(timer);
                resolve(`id-${file.name}`);
            }
        }, wait);
        signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
            clearInterval(timer);
            reject(new Error('stopped'));
        });
    });

/** Files chosen or dropped go up as they come, through your own upload; each row shows progress, cancel, retry, remove. */
export default function Basic() {
    const s = reactive({ files: [] as readonly File[], told: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <FileUploader
                label="Attachments"
                helpText="Any files; a stand-in server takes them."
                upload={send}
                x-model={() => s.files}
                onUploaded={e => (s.told = `${e.file.name} is up as ${String(e.item.response)}.`)}
                onUploadAborted={e => (s.told = `${e.file.name} was stopped.`)}
            />
            <output class="fu-told">{() => s.told || `${s.files.length} file(s) taken`}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Limits

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { FileUploader, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Only pictures and PDFs, up to 2 MB each and three in all; a file outside is listed with the reason. */
export default function Limits() {
    const s = reactive({ files: [] as readonly File[], refused: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <FileUploader
                label="Documents"
                accept=".pdf,image/*"
                maxFileSize={2_000_000}
                maxFiles={3}
                required
                x-model={() => s.files}
                onFilesAdded={e => (s.refused = e.refused.length ? e.refused.map(r => r.message).join(' ') : '')}
            />
            <output class="fu-refused">{() => s.refused}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## When files go up

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, FileUploader, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const quick = (file: File, report: (fraction: number) => void) =>
    new Promise<void>(resolve => {
        let step = 0;
        const timer = setInterval(() => {
            report(++step / 10);
            if (step === 10) {
                clearInterval(timer);
                resolve();
            }
        }, 120);
    });

/** An Upload button sends what was chosen; or nothing goes until code says so. One file only, no dropping. */
export default function Modes() {
    const s = reactive({ one: [] as readonly File[] });
    let manual!: FileUploader;
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <FileUploader label="Photo" multiple={false} allowDrop={false} accept="image/*" upload={quick} uploadMode="button" x-model={() => s.one} />
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <FileUploader ref={(u: FileUploader) => (manual = u)} label="Logs" accept=".log,.txt" upload={quick} uploadMode="manual" />
                <Button text="Send the logs" variant="outline" onclick={() => void manual.upload()} />
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Sending to a server

The uploader posts a form with the file in `uploadField` (`file` by default) to `uploadUrl`, with `uploadHeaders`; a 2xx answer is the item’s `response`, JSON parsed when it is JSON. With `chunkSize` each piece carries `Content-Range` and the fields `chunkIndex` and `chunkCount`.

```tsx
<FileUploader
  label="Attachments"
  uploadUrl="/api/files"
  uploadHeaders={{ Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token }}
  chunkSize={1_000_000}
  onUploaded={(e) => this.attachments.push(e.item.response as Attachment)}
/>
```

## Behaviour

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Choosing` | The button opens the file dialog; files may be dropped on the box too, which lights up while they are over it. |
| `Refusing` | A file outside `accept`, the sizes or `maxFiles` is listed as refused with the reason, and is not in the value. |
| `Uploading` | As chosen, on the Upload button, or from code. A row shows the progress and a Cancel button meanwhile; afterwards “Uploaded”, or the failure with Retry. The server’s answer is the item’s `response` (JSON parsed). |
| `Chunks` | With `chunkSize` the file goes in pieces, each a request with `Content-Range: bytes start-end/total`; progress runs over the whole. |
| `Removing` | Each row has a remove button; a running upload is stopped first. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Button` | The select button is the field’s control: the label marks it, Space and Enter open the dialog. |
| `List` | A list of rows: the name, the size and the state as text; the progress bar named after the file; the buttons named “Cancel the upload of …”, “Retry”, “Remove …”. |
| `Messages` | The reasons a file was refused and the failures speak in the kit language, or in the server’s words. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-file-uploader` | The field. `data-dragover` while files are over it. |
| `.mx-file-uploader__select, .mx-file-uploader__drop, .mx-file-uploader__upload` | The select button, the hint, the Upload button. |
| `.mx-file-uploader__list, .mx-file-uploader__item` | The list and each row. `data-status` on the row. |
| `.mx-file-uploader__icon, __name, __size, __state, __progress, __actions, __action` | The parts of a row. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `file-uploader.over, .select, .upload, .hint, .list, .item, .icon, .name, .size, .state` | Units: the box with files over it, the two buttons (`hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled`), the hint, the list, a row per status, the file glyph, the texts. |
| `file-uploader.field, .action` | Places: the field’s box as a drop zone (a dashed frame, its corners, its padding); the row’s buttons. |
| `file-uploader.box-gap, .button-gap, .item-gap` | The spaces in the box, in a button and in a row. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<readonly File[]>` | `[]` | The files taken (the refused ones are not in it). `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `multiple` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Several files at once; `false` keeps one, the newest. |
| `accept` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | What may be chosen, as for `<input type="file">`: `.png,.jpg`, `image/*`, `application/pdf`. |
| `maxFileSize, minFileSize` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | Bytes. A file outside is listed as refused, with the reason. |
| `maxFiles` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | How many files may be taken in all. |
| `allowDrop` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Files may be dropped on the box. |
| `uploadMode` | `Bind<UploadMode>` | `instant` / `manual` | `instant`: as chosen; `button`: an Upload button; `manual`: `upload()` from code. Default `instant` with `uploadUrl` or `upload`, else `manual`. |
| `uploadUrl, uploadMethod, uploadHeaders, uploadField` | `Bind<string \| null>`, … | `null`, `POST`, `null`, `file` | Where and how the uploader itself sends a file (XMLHttpRequest, with progress), as a form with the file in `uploadField`. |
| `chunkSize` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | Bytes per request: the file goes in pieces, each with its `Content-Range` and `chunkIndex` / `chunkCount` fields; the last answer is the response. |
| `upload` | `(file, report, signal) => Promise<unknown>` | — | Your own upload instead of `uploadUrl`: call `report(0…1)` as it goes, stop on `signal`; what it resolves to is the response. |
| `selectText, dropText, uploadText` | `Bind<string>` | the kit’s | The button, the hint beside it, the Upload button. |
| `showFileList` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The list of files under the box. |
| `label, helpText, required, rules, readOnly, size, variant…` |  |  | The field props, as on every editor. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | read-only | Every file in the list with what happened to it: `file`, `status` (`ready`, `uploading`, `done`, `error`, `aborted`, `invalid`), `progress`, `response`, `message`. |
| `isUploading` | read-only | An upload is running. |
| `openDialog()` | `void` | Opens the browser’s file dialog, as the button does. |
| `addFiles(files)` | `void` | Takes files as if chosen: the limits apply, `onFilesAdded` is asked, uploads start as the mode says. |
| `upload(item?)` | `Promise<void>` | Uploads the files waiting, or one of them; what `manual` mode calls. |
| `abort(item?), remove(item), clear()` | `void` | Stops an upload (the file stays, cancelled); takes a file out; takes every file out. |
| `onFilesAdded` | event | Files were chosen or dropped (`files`, `refused`); `cancel = true` takes none. |
| `onFileRemoved, onUploadStarted, onProgress, onUploaded, onUploadError, onUploadAborted` | event | One file’s way through: each with `item` and `file`, a failure with `error`. |
| `onValueChanged` | event | The files taken changed. |

# CheckBox

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A checkbox with its caption: checked, unchecked or indeterminate, three states on request, read-only, required and checked with its group. A native checkbox underneath, drawn from the design tokens.

## Import

```tsx
import { CheckBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

Every prop takes a value or a function; `x-model` binds the value two-way. Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, CheckBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A checkbox bound to state with x-model, and checkboxes created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ remember: true, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const box = new CheckBox({ label: `Option ${++added}`, threeState: true });
    box.onValueChanged((e) => (s.result = `${box.label}: ${String(e.value)}`));
    host?.controls.add(box);
    box.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <CheckBox label="&Remember me" x-model={() => s.remember} helpText={() => (s.remember ? 'You stay signed in.' : 'You sign in every time.')} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a checkbox from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
        <output class="cb-result">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Checked, unchecked, indeterminate

`null` shows the indeterminate dash. A click on it checks the box; with `threeState` the user goes through all three: unchecked → checked → indeterminate.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { CheckBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Unchecked, checked and indeterminate, and a box the user takes through all three. */
export default function States() {
  const s = reactive({ mixed: null as boolean | null, three: false as boolean | null });
  return (
    <>
      <CheckBox label="Unchecked" value={false} />
      <CheckBox label="Checked" value={true} />
      <CheckBox label="Indeterminate" x-model={() => s.mixed} />
      <CheckBox label="Three st&ates" threeState x-model={() => s.three} />
      <output class="cb-three">{() => `value: ${String(s.three)}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

A box over a list is indeterminate while only some items are checked. Its value is a function of the list; a click on it checks or unchecks them all.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { CheckBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Topping {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  on: boolean;
}

/** A box over a list: indeterminate while only some are checked, and a click checks or unchecks them all. */
export default function SelectAll() {
  const toppings = reactive<Topping[]>([
    { id: 1, name: 'Cheese', on: true },
    { id: 2, name: 'Olives', on: false },
    { id: 3, name: 'Peppers', on: true },
  ]);

  const allToppings = (): boolean | null => {
    const on = toppings.filter((t) => t.on).length;
    return on === 0 ? false : on === toppings.length ? true : null;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <CheckBox
        label="All toppings"
        class="cb-all"
        value={allToppings}
        onValueChanged={(e) => {
          if (e.byUser) for (const t of toppings) t.on = e.value === true;
        }}
      />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" style="padding-inline-start: var(--mx-space-6)">
        {toppings.map((t) => (
          <CheckBox key={t.id} label={t.name} x-model={() => t.on} />
        ))}
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Caption

The caption sits after the box, or before it with `labelPosition="start"`. With `stretch` the field takes the width, so a box after its caption goes to the far end, as in a settings list. `labelMode="hidden"` keeps the caption for screen readers only.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, CheckBox, Stack, type LabelPosition } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const POSITIONS: LabelPosition[] = ['end', 'start'];

/** The caption after or before the box, stretched to the far end, or kept for screen readers only. */
export default function Caption() {
  const s = reactive({ position: 'end' as LabelPosition });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Caption position">
        {POSITIONS.map((position) => (
          <Button
            key={position}
            text={position}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.position === position ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.position === position}
            onclick={() => (s.position = position)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <CheckBox label="Show hidden files" labelPosition={() => s.position} />
      <div style="inline-size: 20rem">
        <CheckBox label="Wrap long lines" labelPosition={() => s.position} stretch value={true} />
      </div>
      <CheckBox label="Select row 3" labelMode="hidden" />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

```tsx
import { CheckBox, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** A checkbox in each size. */
export default function Sizes() {
  return (
    <>
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <CheckBox key={size} label={size} size={size} value={size !== 'sm'} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Required

`required` means the box must be checked. It is checked with its group, like any field: the first box left unchecked gets focus.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, CheckBox, Stack, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Boxes that must be checked, checked with their group; the first one left unchecked gets focus. */
export default function Required() {
  const s = reactive({ terms: false, privacy: false, result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const signUp = async () => {
    const result = await group.validate();
    s.result = result.valid ? 'Signed up.' : `${result.invalid.length} box(es) to check.`;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <CheckBox label="I accept the &terms" required validationGroup={group} x-model={() => s.terms} />
      <CheckBox label="I read the privacy notice" required validationGroup={group} x-model={() => s.privacy} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Sign up" tone="accent" onclick={signUp} />
        <Button text="Reset" variant="ghost" onclick={() => group.reset()} />
        <output class="cb-save">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Read-only and disabled

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, CheckBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Read-only and disabled, both following state. */
export default function ReadOnly() {
  const s = reactive({ editable: true, paid: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editable = !s.editable)} />
      <CheckBox label="Read-only" readOnly={() => !s.editable} x-model={() => s.paid} />
      <CheckBox label="Disabled" enabled={() => s.editable} x-model={() => s.paid} />
      <CheckBox label="Disabled, unchecked" enabled={() => s.editable} value={false} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Space` | Toggles it (the native checkbox key). |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Focuses and toggles it (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |
| `Tab` | One stop per checkbox. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Element` | A native `<input type="checkbox">` drawn with `appearance: none`; its caption is a `<label for>`, so a click on the caption toggles it. |
| `Indeterminate` | The native `indeterminate` state: read out as "mixed". |
| `Read-only` | `aria-readonly="true"`; it keeps its place in the Tab order. |
| `Errors` | `aria-invalid="true"`; the line under the caption is a polite live region and describes the box. |
| `Focus` | The design system focus ring, for the keyboard only. |

## Localization

The checkbox writes no text of its own; the `required` message comes from `uiLocale.strings`, and a message already shown follows a change at once.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of every field on the page; a required message already shown follows too. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        Required reads <output>{() => kitTexts.strings.required}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-check-box` | The field. `data-state` (`checked`, `unchecked`, `mixed`), `data-label-position`, `data-size`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`, `data-required`. |
| `.mx-toggle-field` | The layout CheckBox and Switch share: the box and its caption side by side. |
| `.mx-check-box__input` | The native checkbox: the box itself. |
| `.mx-check-box__mark, .mx-check-box__check, .mx-check-box__dash` | The mark drawn over the box. |
| `.mx-field__label, .mx-field__message` | The caption and the line under it. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `checkbox.box` | Unit: the box, with every state (`checked`, `mixed`, `invalid`, each with `-hover`, `-pressed`, `-focus`; `disabled`, `checked-disabled`). |
| `checkbox.mark, checkbox.dash, checkbox.overlay` | Units: the check mark, the dash of a mixed box, and a layer over the box (`pressed`, `disabled`). |
| `checkbox.halo, checkbox.ring` | Units: a halo centred on the box (`checked`, `hover`, `focus`, `pressed`) and a ring round the box and its caption under the keys, where the language has them. |
| `checkbox.label, checkbox.control` | Units: the caption (`disabled`) and the row it sits in. |
| `checkbox.size.*, checkbox.mark-size.*` | The box and its mark, per size. |
| `checkbox.height.*, checkbox.font-size.*` | The row height (density tokens) and the caption size. |
| `checkbox.gap, checkbox.press-offset, checkbox.focus-scope` | The space before the caption, how far a press moves the box, and what the ring under the keys goes round (`box` or `item`). |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<boolean \| null>` | `false` | `true` checked, `false` unchecked, `null` indeterminate. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The caption next to the box; `&Name` makes Alt+N toggle it. The same property as `text`. |
| `labelPosition` | `Bind<'start' \| 'end'>` | `'end'` | The caption after the box (`end`) or before it (`start`), in the reading direction. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | `'top'` | `hidden` keeps the caption for screen readers only; every other mode shows it next to the box. |
| `threeState` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A click goes unchecked → checked → indeterminate. Without it a click only checks and unchecks; code can still set `null`. |
| `helpText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A line under the caption. An error message takes its place. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A tooltip. |
| `readOnly` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Focusable and read out, but a click or Space changes nothing. |
| `required` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | It must be checked: a mark after the caption, `aria-required` and a `required` rule. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`; the row height follows the density tokens. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Fills the width of what it sits in; with `labelPosition="start"` the box goes to the far end. |
| `name` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The name it is sent with in a form. |
| `rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see Field |  | Validation, as in every field. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `isValid, validationMessage, validating` | read-only, reactive | The outcome of the last check. |
| `inputElement` | read-only | The native `<input type="checkbox">`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggle()` | `void` | Changes the value as a click does (with `threeState`, to the next of the three). |
| `validate()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Checks the value and shows the outcome. |
| `resetValidation()` | `void` | Hides the outcome of earlier checks. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Focuses the box. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | The value changed. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`; `null` stays `null`. |
| `onValidated(e)` | A check ended. `e`: `{ valid, message, source }`. |
| `onclick, onchange, onfocusin, onfocusout` | The DOM events of the input reach the field. |

`ToggleField`, the base CheckBox and Switch share (the caption next to a native checkbox, read-only, the access key), is exported for controls of your own.

# Switch

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

An on / off switch with its caption: a track with a thumb that slides, an optional on / off text inside or next to it, read-only and required. A native checkbox with the switch role underneath.

## Import

```tsx
import { Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

Every prop takes a value or a function; `x-model` binds the value two-way. Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A switch bound to state with x-model, and switches created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ wifi: true, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const sw = new Switch({ label: `Feature ${++added}`, onText: 'On', offText: 'Off' });
    sw.onValueChanged((e) => (s.result = `${sw.label}: ${e.value ? 'on' : 'off'}`));
    host?.controls.add(sw);
    sw.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Switch label="&Wi-Fi" x-model={() => s.wifi} helpText={() => (s.wifi ? 'Connected to Home.' : 'Not connected.')} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a switch from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
        <output class="sw-result">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## On / off text

`onText` and `offText` show in the track (the track grows to fit them) or next to it. The texts are for the eye; the switch says its state itself.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Switch, type SwitchStateText } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PLACES: SwitchStateText[] = ['inside', 'beside', 'none'];

/** An on / off text in the track, next to it, or not shown. */
export default function StateText() {
  const s = reactive({ place: 'inside' as SwitchStateText, sync: false, dark: false });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Text position">
        {PLACES.map((place) => (
          <Button
            key={place}
            text={place}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.place === place ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.place === place}
            onclick={() => (s.place = place)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Switch label="&Sync" class="sw-sync" onText="On" offText="Off" showStateText={() => s.place} x-model={() => s.sync} />
      <Switch label="Dark mode" onText="Dark" offText="Light" showStateText={() => s.place} x-model={() => s.dark} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Caption

The caption sits after the track, or before it with `labelPosition="start"`; with `stretch` the field takes the width and the track goes to the far end, as in a settings list.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Captions before the track, stretched so the tracks line up at the far end, as in a settings list. */
export default function Caption() {
  const s = reactive({ updates: true });
  return (
    <div style="inline-size: 22rem">
      <Switch label="Automatic updates" labelPosition="start" stretch x-model={() => s.updates} />
      <Switch label="Send usage data" labelPosition="start" stretch helpText="Anonymous, once a week." />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

```tsx
import { Switch, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** A switch in each size, with its on / off text. */
export default function Sizes() {
  return (
    <>
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <Switch key={size} label={size} size={size} value={size === 'md'} onText="On" offText="Off" />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Required, read-only, disabled

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Switch, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A switch that must be on, checked with its group, and read-only and disabled ones following state. */
export default function States() {
  const s = reactive({ terms: false, editable: true, result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const next = async () => {
    s.result = (await group.validate()).valid ? 'Thanks.' : 'Please agree first.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Switch label="I &agree to the terms" required validationGroup={group} x-model={() => s.terms} />
        <Button text="Continue" tone="accent" onclick={next} />
        <output>{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editable = !s.editable)} />
        <Switch label="Read-only" readOnly={() => !s.editable} value={true} />
        <Switch label="Disabled on" enabled={() => s.editable} value={true} />
        <Switch label="Disabled off" enabled={() => s.editable} />
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Space` | Flips it (the native key). |
| `Enter` | Flips it too, as on a button. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Focuses and flips it (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Element` | A native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`: screen readers say "switch, on / off"; the browser gives it Space, the form value, `:checked` and `:disabled`, and its caption is a `<label for>`, so a click on the caption flips it. |
| `On / off text` | Drawn for the eye only (`aria-hidden`): the state is read out from the switch itself. |
| `Read-only` | `aria-readonly="true"`; it keeps its place in the Tab order. |
| `Motion` | The thumb slides with the motion tokens; it stops sliding when the user asks for reduced motion. |
| `Focus` | The design system focus ring around the track, for the keyboard only. |

## Localization

The switch writes no text of its own: `onText` and `offText` are yours, and can be functions of your own language state. The `required` message comes from `uiLocale.strings`.

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-switch` | The field. `data-state` (`checked`, `unchecked`), `data-state-text`, `data-label-position`, `data-size`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-toggle-field` | The layout CheckBox and Switch share. |
| `.mx-switch__input` | The native checkbox: the track itself. |
| `.mx-switch__thumb` | The thumb drawn over the track. |
| `.mx-switch__text, .mx-switch__on, .mx-switch__off` | The on / off texts. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `switch.track, switch.thumb` | Units: the track and the thumb, each with every state (`checked`, `invalid`, `hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled` and their pairs). |
| `switch.thumb-icon, switch.halo` | Units: an icon in the thumb and a halo around it, where the language has them. |
| `switch.text, switch.side-text` | Units: the on / off text in the track and beside it. |
| `switch.track-width.*, switch.track-height.*` | The track, per size. |
| `switch.thumb-size.*, switch.thumb-size-checked.*, switch.thumb-size-hover.*, switch.thumb-size-pressed.*, switch.thumb-inset, switch.thumb-stretch` | The thumb per size and state, the space around it, and how far it stretches while pressed. |
| `switch.height.*, switch.font-size.*` | The row height (density tokens) and the caption size. |
| `switch.text-padding, switch.gap` | The space of the on / off text, and before the caption. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | On or off. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The caption next to the track; `&Name` makes Alt+N flip it. The same property as `text`. |
| `labelPosition` | `Bind<'start' \| 'end'>` | `'end'` | The caption after the track (`end`) or before it (`start`), in the reading direction. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | `'top'` | `hidden` keeps the caption for screen readers only; every other mode shows it next to the track. |
| `onText / offText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A short text for each state, e.g. `On` / `Off`. |
| `showStateText` | `Bind<SwitchStateText>` | `'inside'` | Where that text shows: `inside` the track, `beside` it, or `none`. |
| `helpText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A line under the caption. An error message takes its place. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A tooltip. |
| `readOnly` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Focusable and read out, but it does not flip. |
| `required` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | It must be on. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`; the row height follows the density tokens. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Fills the width; with `labelPosition="start"` the track goes to the far end. |
| `name` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The name it is sent with in a form. |
| `rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see Field |  | Validation, as in every field. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `isValid, validationMessage, validating` | read-only, reactive | The outcome of the last check. |
| `inputElement` | read-only | The native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `toggle()` | `void` | Flips it as a click does. |
| `validate()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Checks the value and shows the outcome. |
| `resetValidation()` | `void` | Hides the outcome of earlier checks. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Focuses the switch. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | The value changed. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`. |
| `onValidated(e)` | A check ended. `e`: `{ valid, message, source }`. |
| `onclick, onchange, onfocusin, onfocusout` | The DOM events of the input reach the field. |

# RadioGroup

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A set of options of which one is chosen: from plain values, from your own objects or from a live list; one under the other, side by side or in columns; options that are disabled, hidden or carry a help line; one Tab stop and the arrow keys.

## Import

```tsx
import { RadioGroup, type RadioItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

A plain value is its own text. `x-model` binds the chosen value two-way. Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A group of plain values bound with x-model, and a group created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ size: 'M' as string | null, result: '' });
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const wrap = new RadioGroup<string>({ label: 'Gift wrap', orientation: 'horizontal', items: ['None', 'Paper', 'Box'], value: 'None' });
    wrap.onValueChanged((e) => (s.result = `Gift wrap: ${e.value}`));
    host?.controls.add(wrap);
    wrap.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <RadioGroup label="&Size" items={['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL']} x-model={() => s.size} helpText={() => `Chosen: ${s.size ?? 'nothing'}`} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a group from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
        <output class="rg-result">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Items from data

Objects of your own shape take `itemText` and `itemValue` (a property name or a function). Plain or reactive, the items are read as they are: after adding, removing or renaming some in place, `refresh()` shows them, focus and choice kept.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Plan {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  price: number;
}

/** Options from a list of your own objects: after adding or changing some in place, `refresh()` shows them. */
export default function FromData() {
  const s = reactive({ plan: 2 as number | null });
  const plans = reactive<Plan[]>([
    { id: 1, name: 'Free', price: 0 },
    { id: 2, name: 'Pro', price: 12 },
    { id: 3, name: 'Team', price: 30 },
  ]);

  let group!: RadioGroup<number>;
  const addPlan = () => {
    plans.push({ id: plans.length + 1, name: `Plan ${plans.length + 1}`, price: plans.length * 20 });
    group.refresh();
  };
  const raisePrices = () => {
    for (const p of plans) p.price += 1;
    group.refresh();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <RadioGroup
        ref={(g: RadioGroup<number>) => (group = g)}
        label="&Plan"
        class="rg-plans"
        items={() => plans}
        itemText={(p) => `${(p as Plan).name} — ${(p as Plan).price} €`}
        itemValue="id"
        x-model={() => s.plan}
      />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a plan" variant="outline" enabled={() => plans.length < 6} onclick={addPlan} />
        <Button text="Raise prices" variant="outline" onclick={raisePrices} />
        <output class="rg-plan">{() => `value: ${String(s.plan)}`}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Disabled options, help lines, hints

A `RadioItem` brings its own `enabled`, `visible`, `hint` and `helpText`, each a value or a function. The arrow keys skip what cannot be chosen.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, type RadioItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Options with their own help line and hint, and one that is enabled only while state allows it. */
export default function OptionDetails() {
  const s = reactive({ shipping: 'std' as string | null, expressOpen: false });
  const shipping: RadioItem<string>[] = [
    { value: 'std', text: 'Standard', helpText: '3–5 working days', hint: 'Free over 50 €' },
    { value: 'exp', text: 'Express', helpText: () => (s.expressOpen ? 'Tomorrow' : 'Not before the weekend'), enabled: () => s.expressOpen },
    { value: 'pick', text: 'Pick up in store', helpText: 'Ready in 2 hours' },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.expressOpen ? 'Close express' : 'Open express')} variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.expressOpen = !s.expressOpen)} />
      <RadioGroup label="S&hipping" class="rg-shipping" items={shipping} x-model={() => s.shipping} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Orientation and columns

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, type RadioGroupOrientation } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const ORIENTATIONS: RadioGroupOrientation[] = ['vertical', 'horizontal'];
const COLUMNS = [0, 2, 4];
const COLORS = ['red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'green', 'teal', 'blue', 'indigo', 'violet'];

/** Options one under the other or side by side, and in columns. */
export default function Layout() {
  const s = reactive({ orientation: 'vertical' as RadioGroupOrientation, columns: 0, color: 'teal' as string | null });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Layout">
        {ORIENTATIONS.map((o) => (
          <Button
            key={o}
            text={o}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.orientation === o ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.orientation === o}
            onclick={() => (s.orientation = o)}
          />
        ))}
        {COLUMNS.map((n) => (
          <Button
            key={`c${n}`}
            text={n ? `${n} columns` : 'no grid'}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.columns === n ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.columns === n}
            onclick={() => (s.columns = n)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <RadioGroup label="&Color" class="rg-colors" items={COLORS} orientation={() => s.orientation} columns={() => s.columns} x-model={() => s.color} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

```tsx
import { RadioGroup, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** A group in each size. */
export default function Sizes() {
  return (
    <>
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <RadioGroup key={size} label={size} size={size} items={['One', 'Two']} value="Two" />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Required, read-only, disabled

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A choice that must be made, checked with its group, and read-only and disabled groups following state. */
export default function States() {
  const s = reactive({ payment: null as string | null, editable: true, result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const pay = async () => {
    s.result = (await group.validate()).valid ? 'Paid.' : 'Choose a payment.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <RadioGroup label="Pa&yment" orientation="horizontal" required validationGroup={group} items={['Card', 'Transfer', 'Cash']} x-model={() => s.payment} />
        <Button text="Pay" tone="accent" onclick={pay} />
        <output>{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Toggle" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.editable = !s.editable)} />
        <RadioGroup label="Read-only" readOnly={() => !s.editable} items={['Free', 'Pro']} value="Pro" />
        <RadioGroup label="Disabled" enabled={() => s.editable} items={['Free', 'Pro']} value="Pro" />
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Into the group, onto the chosen option (or the first one that can be chosen); the next Tab leaves the group. |
| `↓ / →` | Moves to the next option and chooses it, wrapping from the last to the first; skips disabled and hidden options. |
| `↑ / ←` | The same, backwards. Right to left, ← and → swap. |
| `Space` | Chooses the focused option. |
| `Alt + key (`&Name`)` | Focuses the group (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Group` | `role="radiogroup"`, named by the field label (`aria-labelledby`); `aria-orientation`, `aria-required`, `aria-readonly`, `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby` for the line under it. |
| `Options` | Native `<input type="radio">` sharing a name, each inside its own `<label>`, drawn with `appearance: none`. |
| `Help text` | An option’s `helpText` sits outside its label and describes it with `aria-describedby`, so it is not part of its name. |
| `Disabled options` | Native `disabled`: skipped by the keyboard and read out as unavailable. |
| `Focus` | One Tab stop; the design system focus ring, for the keyboard only. |

## Localization

The group writes no text of its own: the option texts are yours (functions of your language state work). The `required` message comes from `uiLocale.strings`.

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-radio-group` | The field. `data-orientation`, `data-columns`, `data-size`, `data-invalid`, `data-readonly`, `data-disabled`, `data-required`. |
| `.mx-radio-group__list` | The `radiogroup` element; `--_columns` and `--_rows` are set on it with `columns`. |
| `.mx-radio-group__item, .mx-radio-group__label` | One option, and the label that holds its radio and text. |
| `.mx-radio-group__input, .mx-radio-group__text, .mx-radio-group__help` | The radio, its text, its help line. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `radiogroup.circle, radiogroup.dot` | Units: the circle, with every state (`checked`, `invalid`, `hover`, `pressed`, `focus` and their pairs, `disabled`), and the dot of the chosen one (`checked`, `pressed`, `disabled`). |
| `radiogroup.row, radiogroup.text, radiogroup.help` | Units: an option's row (`hover`, `checked`, `disabled`), its text and its help line. |
| `radiogroup.halo, radiogroup.ring` | Units: a halo centred on the circle and a ring round an option under the keys, where the language has them. |
| `radiogroup.options, radiogroup.floating-label` | Units: the options together, and the group's label where it floats. |
| `radiogroup.size.*, radiogroup.dot-size.*, radiogroup.dot-size-hover.*, radiogroup.dot-size-pressed.*` | The circle and the dot, per size and state. |
| `radiogroup.height.*, radiogroup.font-size.*` | The row height (density tokens) and the text size. |
| `radiogroup.gap, radiogroup.column-gap, radiogroup.help-gap` | The space before the text, between options side by side, and above an option's help line. |
| `radiogroup.press-offset, radiogroup.focus-scope` | How far a press moves the circle, and what the ring under the keys goes round. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<T \| null>` | `null` | The value of the chosen item; `null` when none is chosen. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly (RadioItem<T> \| T)[]>` | `[]` | The options. A function is followed: a new list shows at once; items changed in place show after `refresh()`. |
| `itemText` | `string \| (item) => unknown` | `'text'` | Where an item keeps its text, for objects of your own shape. A reader, not a binding. |
| `itemValue` | `string \| (item) => T` | `'value'` | Where an item keeps its value. An object without one is its own value. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The caption of the group; `&Name` makes Alt+N focus it. The same property as `text`. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | `'top'` | `top`, `side` (next to the options) or `hidden` (for screen readers only). |
| `orientation` | `Bind<RadioGroupOrientation>` | `'vertical'` | `vertical`: one under the other; `horizontal`: side by side, wrapping. |
| `columns` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | Lays the options out in a grid of this many columns (down the columns when vertical, across when horizontal). |
| `helpText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A line under the group. An error message takes its place. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A tooltip on the group. |
| `readOnly` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The arrows move between the options, nothing can be chosen. |
| `required` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | One option must be chosen. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`; the row height follows the density tokens. |
| `name` | `Bind<string>` | generated | The name the radios are sent with in a form. |
| `rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see Field |  | Validation, as in every field. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### RadioItem

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T` | What `value` becomes when this option is chosen. |
| `text` | `Bind<string>` | Shown next to the circle. Default: the value as text. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | A tooltip. |
| `helpText` | `Bind<string>` | A smaller line under the text; it describes the radio. |
| `enabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` greys it out; the arrow keys skip it. |
| `visible` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` leaves it out. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `isValid, validationMessage, validating` | read-only, reactive | The outcome of the last check. |
| `listElement` | read-only | The element with `role="radiogroup"`. |
| `inputs` | read-only | The native radios, in the order of the items. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Focuses the chosen option, or the first one that can be chosen. |
| `validate()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Checks the value and shows the outcome. |
| `resetValidation()` | `void` | Hides the outcome of earlier checks. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items may be plain or reactive; the group reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. Their texts, values and states are read again; focus stays where it is. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | The value changed. `e`: `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }`. |
| `onValidated(e)` | A check ended. `e`: `{ valid, message, source }`. |
| `onchange, onkeydown, onfocusin, onfocusout` | The DOM events of the radios reach the group. |
