# DropDown

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Picks one item from a list. The field shows the chosen item; the list opens below it with the keyboard or a press, can be searched, grouped and drawn your way, and stays fast with thousands of items.

## Import

```tsx
import { DropDown, type DropDownItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

`items` can be plain values; `x-model` binds the value. Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
/** The cities the drop-downs of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Objects, groups, templates

Objects of your own are read through `textField` and `valueField` (a name or a function); `groupField` puts options under headers, `enabledField` keeps some from being chosen, and a template draws an option your way.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DropDown } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Country {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  region: string;
  flag: string;
  member?: boolean;
}

const countries: Country[] = [
  { code: 'TR', name: 'Türkiye', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇹🇷', member: true },
  { code: 'DE', name: 'Germany', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇩🇪', member: true },
  { code: 'FR', name: 'France', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇫🇷', member: true },
  { code: 'NO', name: 'Norway', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇳🇴', member: false },
  { code: 'JP', name: 'Japan', region: 'Asia', flag: '🇯🇵', member: true },
  { code: 'KR', name: 'Korea', region: 'Asia', flag: '🇰🇷', member: true },
  { code: 'BR', name: 'Brazil', region: 'Americas', flag: '🇧🇷', member: true },
  { code: 'CA', name: 'Canada', region: 'Americas', flag: '🇨🇦', member: true },
];

/** Draws a country as its flag and its name, in the list and in the field. */
const drawCountry = (c: Country, host: HTMLElement) => {
  host.textContent = `${c.flag}  ${c.name}`;
};

/** Objects read through textField and valueField, under group headers, one that cannot be chosen, drawn with templates. */
export default function Countries() {
  const form = reactive({ country: 'TR' as string | null });
  return (
    <>
      <DropDown
        label="Country"
        items={countries}
        textField="name"
        valueField="code"
        groupField="region"
        enabledField={(c: Country) => c.member !== false}
        itemTemplate={drawCountry}
        fieldTemplate={drawCountry}
        x-model={() => form.country}
      />
      <output class="dd-country">{() => `code: ${form.country ?? '—'}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Search and long lists

`searchEnabled` puts a search box at the top of the list. A long list draws only the rows in view: this one has 5,000 orders.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { DropDown } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const orders = Array.from({ length: 5000 }, (_, i) => ({ value: i + 1, text: `Order #${String(i + 1).padStart(5, '0')}` }));

/** 5,000 orders with a search box; the list draws only the rows in view. */
export default function LongList() {
  const form = reactive({ order: 1200 as number | null });
  return (
    <>
      <DropDown label="Order" items={orders} searchEnabled x-model={() => form.order} />
      <output class="dd-order">{() => `order: ${form.order ?? '—'}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Items that change

`items` given as a function is followed: a new list shows at once. Your items may be plain or reactive; the drop-down reads them as they are, so after changing them in place, call `refresh()`: the open list and the field show the change.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DropDown } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Items changed in place: the drop-down reads them again on `refresh()`. */
export default function LiveItems() {
  const model = reactive({ statuses: ['Draft', 'Review'], status: 'Draft' as string | null });
  let field!: DropDown<string, string>;
  const add = () => {
    model.statuses.push('Published');
    field.refresh();
  };
  return (
    <>
      <DropDown ref={(d: DropDown<string, string>) => (field = d)} label="Status" items={() => model.statuses} x-model={() => model.status} />
      <Button text="Add “Published”" variant="outline" enabled={() => !model.statuses.includes('Published')} onclick={add} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Validation and states

```tsx
/** The cities the drop-downs of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Down, Up, Enter, Space, Alt + Down` | Open the list on the chosen option (Home / End: on the first / last). |
| `A letter` | Open the list on the next option starting with it; letters typed quickly search together. |
| `In the list: Up, Down, Home, End, Page Up, Page Down` | Move the highlight; options that cannot be chosen are skipped. |
| `In the list: Enter, Space, Alt + Up` | Choose the highlighted option and close. |
| `In the list: Tab` | Choose the highlighted option and go on to the next field. |
| `Escape` | Close without choosing; with `clearButton` and the list closed, empty the value. |
| `Alt + key (`&City`)` | Focus the field. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Pattern` | The APG select-only combobox: the field is `role="combobox"` with `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; focus stays on it. |
| `Highlight` | `aria-activedescendant` names the highlighted option; options are `role="option"` with `aria-selected`, disabled ones `aria-disabled`. |
| `Groups` | Each group is `role="group"` named by its header. |
| `Long lists` | Only the rows in view are drawn; each option says where it is with `aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize`. |
| `Search` | The search box controls the list and names the highlighted option the same way. |
| `Waiting` | While the value's item is asked for, the combobox is `aria-busy` and its text says "Loading…" to screen readers; a key the source does not have carries the reason as its title. |

## Localization

The search box, the clear button, the empty list text, the wait (`loading`) and the reason a key is marked (`notInList`, `loadFailed`) come from `uiLocale.strings`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DropDown, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Switches the texts of every drop-down on the page: the search box, the clear button, the empty list. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <DropDown label="Empty" items={[]} placeholder="Open me" />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-drop-down` | Added to the field. `data-open` while the list is open, `data-loading` while the value's item is asked for; the field attributes of TextBox. |
| `.mx-drop-down__display, .mx-drop-down__text, .mx-drop-down__chevron` | The combobox, the chosen text (`data-placeholder` when empty, `data-missing` for a key the source does not have), the arrow. |
| `.mx-drop-down__spinner` | The spinner in the arrow's place while the value's item is asked for. |
| `.mx-drop-down__popup, .mx-drop-down__search` | The popup and its search box. |
| `.mx-list, .mx-list__item, .mx-list__header` | The list (shared), its options (`data-active`, `data-selected`) and group headers. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `field.*` | The field, as for TextBox. |
| `drop-down.value, drop-down.chevron, drop-down.spinner, drop-down.spinner-shape` | Units: the chosen text (`placeholder`, `missing`, `disabled`), the arrow (`open`, `disabled`), the ring that turns while the value's item is asked for and the shape a language may draw instead (with the spinner's shapes and timing). |
| `list.item-height, list.item` | The options: their row height, and the item unit in each state (`hover`, `pressed`, `active`, `selected`, `selected-hover`, `selected-pressed`, `disabled`, `next`, `select-all`). |
| `list.indicator, list.check, list.mark, list.icon, list.text` | Units: the bar on the chosen option (`multiple`), the check of a list of several choices and its mark, an icon, the text. |
| `list.container, list.group, list.header, list.select-all-divider, list.empty` | Units: the list (its space and most height), a group, group headers, the line under "Select all", the empty text. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<V \| null>` | `null` | The value of the chosen item. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` | `[]` | Plain values, `DropDownItem`s (`{ value, text, icon?, group?, enabled? }`) or objects of your own. A function is followed; items changed in place show after `refresh()`. |
| `dataSource` | `Bind<DataSource<T> \| null>` | `null` | Items from the data layer, loaded where the list is scrolled to and searched on its `searchFields`. Wins over `items`. A value on no loaded page is asked for by key; meanwhile the field waits (see Lookup). |
| `valueText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The value's text while its item is asked for from `dataSource`, shown at once instead of waiting (a record that carries the name: `valueText={() => order.customerName}`). |
| `searchDelay` | `Bind<number>` | `250` with a data source, else `0` | Milliseconds between the last key in the search box and the search. |
| `textField / valueField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | `'text'` / `'value'` | A property name or a function `(item) => …`. Without `valueField` an object with a `value` gives that, anything else is its own value. |
| `iconField, groupField, enabledField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | — | An icon per option; options with the same group follow each other under its name; options that cannot be chosen. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Shown while nothing is chosen. |
| `searchEnabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A search box at the top of the list. |
| `searchMode` | `Bind<'contains' \| 'startswith'>` | `'contains'` | How the search matches the option text. |
| `clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A button that empties the value; Escape does the same while the list is closed. |
| `itemTemplate / fieldTemplate` | `Bind<(item, host) => cleanup \| void>` | — | Draws an option / the chosen item yourself. |
| `matchWidth` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The list is at least as wide as the field. |
| `label, labelMode, helpText, hint, prefix, icon, buttons, readOnly, required, size, variant, stretch, rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | The field props every editor has. |

A prop whose value is a function of its own (`textField`, a template) takes the function itself when it has parameters; a function without parameters is a getter, as for every other prop.

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `selectedItem` | read-only, reactive | The item whose value is the value. |
| `opened` | read/write, reactive | Whether the list is open; setting it opens or closes it. |
| `isValid, validationMessage` | read-only, reactive | See TextBox. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(search?)` | `boolean` | Opens the list; `search` starts the search box with that text. `false` when disabled, read-only, or while the value's item is asked for. |
| `close()` | `void` | Closes it; focus goes back to the field. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Empties the value. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items may be plain or reactive; the drop-down reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. The field's text and the open list follow. |
| `validate(), resetValidation(), focus()` |  | See TextBox. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }` |
| `onOpened()` | The list opened. |
| `onClosed(reason)` | The list closed: `'escape'`, `'outside'`, `'focus'` or `'code'` (also after a choice). |
| `onValidated(e)` | See TextBox. |

The list is a shared part, `OptionList`, exported for combo boxes, list boxes and your own controls.

## Example files

`FromCode.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DropDown, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** Drop-downs bound with x-model, and drop-downs created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const form = reactive({ city: 'İzmir' as string | null, size: null as string | null, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const size = new DropDown<string, string>({ label: `Size ${++added}`, items: ['S', 'M', 'L'], placeholder: 'Pick one' });
    size.onValueChanged((e) => (form.result = `${size.label}: ${e.value}`));
    host?.controls.add(size);
    size.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <DropDown label="&City" items={cities} x-model={() => form.city} />
        <output class="dd-city">{() => `city: ${form.city ?? '—'}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <DropDown label="Size" items={['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL']} placeholder="Pick one" x-model={() => form.size} clearButton />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a drop-down from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
        <output class="dd-made">{() => form.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

`cities.ts`

```tsx
/** The cities the drop-downs of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

`Validation.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, DropDown, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** A required drop-down checked in a group, and the read-only and disabled states. */
export default function Validation() {
  const s = reactive({ priority: 'normal' as string | null, result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const check = async () => {
    const result = await group.validate();
    s.result = result.valid ? 'Fine.' : 'Pick a priority.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <DropDown label="Priority" items={['low', 'normal', 'high']} required clearButton validationGroup={group} x-model={() => s.priority} />
      <DropDown label="Read-only" items={cities} value="Bursa" readOnly />
      <DropDown label="Disabled" items={cities} value="Bursa" enabled={false} />
      <Button text="Check" variant="outline" onclick={check} />
      <output class="dd-check">{() => s.result}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

# ComboBox and Autocomplete

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A text field with a list that follows what is typed. The items come from memory or from a data source of the data layer, searched on the server. `Autocomplete` is the free-text kind: the value is the text.

## Import

```tsx
import { ComboBox, Autocomplete } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
```

## From JSX and from code

```tsx
/** The cities the combo boxes of the examples suggest. */
export const cities = ['Adana', 'Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'Diyarbakır', 'Erzurum', 'Eskişehir', 'Gaziantep', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Kayseri', 'Konya', 'Mersin', 'Samsun', 'Trabzon'];
```

## From a data source

With `dataSource` the search goes to the data source (its `searchFields`), after `searchDelay`. In `'blocks'` mode only the rows in view load; a value on no loaded page is found by key, so the field shows its text at once. This one holds 10,000 products and answers after 300 ms.

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

## Custom values and Autocomplete

```tsx
/** The cities the combo boxes of the examples suggest. */
export const cities = ['Adana', 'Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'Diyarbakır', 'Erzurum', 'Eskişehir', 'Gaziantep', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Kayseri', 'Konya', 'Mersin', 'Samsun', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Typing` | Searches and opens the list; the first match is highlighted. |
| `Down / Up, Alt + Down` | Open the list with every item; move in it. |
| `Enter` | Take the highlighted item (or the text, see `acceptCustomValue`) and close. |
| `Tab, leaving` | An item whose text is the text is taken; otherwise the custom value or the chosen item again. |
| `Escape` | Close the list; closed, undo the typing; then, with `clearButton`, empty it. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Pattern` | The APG combobox with list autocomplete: the input is `role="combobox"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`. |
| `Highlight` | `aria-activedescendant` names the highlighted option; focus stays in the input. |
| `Loading` | Rows not loaded yet are options with `aria-busy`, reading "Loading…" from `uiLocale`. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<V \| null>` | `null` | The value of the chosen item; `x-model` binds it. |
| `items / dataSource` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` / `Bind<DataSource \| null>` | — | Items in memory, searched here, or a data source of `@motifx-community/data`, searched where it lives. |
| `textField, valueField, iconField, groupField, enabledField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | — | As for DropDown; groups for items in memory. |
| `searchMode` | `Bind<'contains' \| 'startswith'>` | `'contains'` | How items in memory match. |
| `minSearchLength` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | Characters to type before the list opens. |
| `searchDelay` | `Bind<number>` | `0` / `250` | Milliseconds after the last key before searching (in memory / a data source). |
| `acceptCustomValue` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Text that matches no item becomes the value; otherwise the field goes back to the chosen item. |
| `autoHighlight` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The first match is highlighted, so Enter takes it. |
| `showDropDownButton, clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true`, `false` | The arrow that opens every item; the button that empties it. |
| `itemTemplate, matchWidth, placeholder` |  |  | As for DropDown. |

### Properties, methods, events

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `selectedItem` | The item of the value, when known. |
| `listItems` | The `DataItems` the list shows (what the last search matched). |
| `opened, open(), close(), clear()` | The list and the value. |
| `refresh()` | Your items may be plain or reactive; the box reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. The open list and the text of the value follow. Autocomplete has it too. |
| `onValueChanged, onOpened, onClosed, onValidated` | As for DropDown. |

The items part is shared: `DataItems` feeds any list control from an array or a data source.

## Example files

`FromCode.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ComboBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** A combo box bound with x-model, and combo boxes created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const form = reactive({ city: 'İzmir' as string | null, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const town = new ComboBox<string, string>({ label: `Town ${++added}`, items: cities, minSearchLength: 2 });
    town.onValueChanged((e) => (form.result = `${town.label}: ${e.value ?? '—'}`));
    host?.controls.add(town);
    town.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ComboBox label="&City" items={cities} x-model={() => form.city} clearButton />
      <output class="cb-city">{() => `city: ${form.city ?? '—'}`}</output>
      <Button text="Add a combo box from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
      <output class="cb-made">{() => form.result}</output>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

`cities.ts`

```tsx
/** The cities the combo boxes of the examples suggest. */
export const cities = ['Adana', 'Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'Diyarbakır', 'Erzurum', 'Eskişehir', 'Gaziantep', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Kayseri', 'Konya', 'Mersin', 'Samsun', 'Trabzon'];
```

`Products.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { ComboBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';

interface Product {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  category: string;
}

const categories = ['Beverages', 'Condiments', 'Dairy', 'Grains', 'Produce', 'Seafood'];
const rows: Product[] = Array.from({ length: 10000 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, name: `${categories[i % 6]} item ${i + 1}`, category: categories[i % 6] }));

/** 10,000 products behind a server that answers after 300 ms: the search goes to the data source, the value's text is found by key. */
export default function Products() {
  const line = reactive({ product: 2500 as number | null });
  const products = new data.DataSource<Product, number>({
    adapter: new SlowAdapter<Product, number>({ data: rows, key: 'id' }, 300),
    loadMode: 'blocks',
    pageSize: 50,
    searchFields: ['name'],
  });

  return (
    <>
      <ComboBox label="Product" dataSource={products} textField="name" valueField="id" x-model={() => line.product} stretch />
      <output class="cb-product">{() => `product: ${line.product ?? '—'}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

`slow-adapter.ts`

```tsx
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

`CustomValues.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Autocomplete, ComboBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** A combo box that takes text matching no item, and an Autocomplete whose value is the text itself. */
export default function CustomValues() {
  const form = reactive({ tag: '', query: '' });
  return (
    <>
      <ComboBox label="Tag" items={['bug', 'feature', 'docs']} acceptCustomValue x-model={() => form.tag} />
      <Autocomplete label="Search" items={cities} x-model={() => form.query} />
      <output class="cb-query">{() => `query: "${form.query}"`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

# Lookup

> Choice · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Picks one row of a table-like list, typically from a data source searched on the server: a customer by its company, contact and city. The field shows the chosen row's text; everything else works as in DropDown.

## Import

```tsx
import { Lookup, type LookupColumn } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Columns from a data source

`columns` lay every row out on one grid under a header; the search box searches the data source's `searchFields`. Rows load where the list is scrolled to.

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

## A value on no loaded page

A value whose row is not loaded is asked for by key, in one request with the keys other fields and grids over the same source need at that moment. Meanwhile the field waits: a spinner in the arrow's place, the list closed, never the key as its text. A record that carries the name too gives it as `valueText`, and the field shows it at once. A key the server does not have shows itself, muted and underlined, and its title says why; when the request failed, opening the list asks again.

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

## API reference

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `Bind<readonly LookupColumn[]>` | `[]` | `{ field, caption?, width?, align? }`: a field name or function, a header text, a CSS grid track, the alignment. |
| `showColumnHeaders` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The header above the rows. |
| `popupWidth` | `Bind<string>` | `lookup.popup-width` | The least width of the list. |
| `searchEnabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A search box above the list (DropDown has it off by default). |
| `everything of DropDown` |  |  | `items`, `dataSource`, `valueText`, `textField`, `valueField`, `searchDelay`, `clearButton`, validation, keyboard… |
| `refresh()` |  |  | Your items and columns may be plain or reactive; the lookup reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. |

## Example files

`Customers.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { Lookup } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';

interface Customer {
  id: string;
  company: string;
  contact: string;
  city: string;
  phone: string;
}

const cities = ['Berlin', 'London', 'Madrid', 'México D.F.', 'Paris', 'São Paulo', 'İstanbul', 'Seattle'];
const people = ['Maria Anders', 'Ana Trujillo', 'Antonio Moreno', 'Thomas Hardy', 'Christina Berglund', 'Hanna Moos', 'Frédérique Citeaux', 'Martín Sommer'];
const rows: Customer[] = Array.from({ length: 2000 }, (_, i) => ({
  id: `C${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}`,
  company: `${['Alfreds', 'Bon app', 'Ernst', 'Folk och fä', 'Hanari', 'Island', 'Lehmanns', 'Wartian'][i % 8]} ${['Futterkiste', 'Trading', 'Handel', 'HB', 'Carnes', 'Markt', 'Foods', 'Herkku'][(i >> 3) % 8]} ${i + 1}`,
  contact: people[i % 8],
  city: cities[(i * 3) % 8],
  phone: `0${(212 + (i % 9)).toString()} ${String(1000000 + i * 37).slice(0, 7)}`,
}));

/** 2,000 customers behind a server that answers after 250 ms, picked from columns and searched by company, contact and city. */
export default function Customers() {
  const order = reactive({ customer: 'C0042' as string | null });
  const customers = new data.DataSource<Customer, string>({
    adapter: new SlowAdapter<Customer, string>({ data: rows, key: 'id' }, 250),
    loadMode: 'blocks',
    pageSize: 50,
    searchFields: ['company', 'contact', 'city'],
  });

  return (
    <>
      <Lookup
        label="&Customer"
        dataSource={customers}
        textField="company"
        valueField="id"
        popupWidth="40rem"
        columns={[
          { field: 'company', caption: 'Company', width: '2fr' },
          { field: 'contact', caption: 'Contact' },
          { field: 'city', caption: 'City', width: '7rem' },
          { field: 'phone', caption: 'Phone', width: '8rem', align: 'end' },
        ]}
        clearButton
        x-model={() => order.customer}
        stretch
      />
      <output class="lk-customer">{() => `customer: ${order.customer ?? '—'}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

`slow-adapter.ts`

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

`ByKey.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { Button, Lookup } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';

interface Customer {
  id: number;
  company: string;
  city: string;
}

const companyOf = (id: number) => `${['Alfreds', 'Bon app', 'Ernst', 'Hanari', 'Island', 'Lehmanns'][id % 6]} ${['Trading', 'Handel', 'Markt', 'Foods'][id % 4]} ${id}`;
const rows: Customer[] = Array.from({ length: 2000 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, company: companyOf(i + 1), city: ['Berlin', 'Paris', 'İstanbul', 'Madrid'][i % 4] }));

/** Values on no loaded page of a server that answers after 1.2 s: one field waits for its row, one shows the name its record carries, one has a key the server does not have. */
export default function ByKey() {
  const customers = new data.DataSource<Customer, number>({
    adapter: new SlowAdapter<Customer, number>({ data: rows, key: 'id' }, 1200),
    loadMode: 'blocks',
    pageSize: 50,
    searchFields: ['company', 'city'],
  });
  const columns = [
    { field: 'company', caption: 'Company' },
    { field: 'city', caption: 'City', width: '7rem' },
  ];
  const waiting = reactive({ customer: 1500 as number | null });
  // A record as it came from the server: the customer's key and, beside it, the name.
  const order = reactive({ customer: 1500 as number | null, customerName: companyOf(1500) });

  const another = () => {
    const id = 100 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1900);
    waiting.customer = id;
    order.customer = id;
    order.customerName = companyOf(id);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Lookup class="lk-waits" label="Waits for its row" dataSource={customers} textField="company" valueField="id" columns={columns} x-model={() => waiting.customer} stretch />
      <Lookup
        class="lk-given"
        label="Shows the name it is given"
        dataSource={customers}
        textField="company"
        valueField="id"
        columns={columns}
        valueText={() => order.customerName}
        x-model={() => order.customer}
        stretch
      />
      <Lookup class="lk-missing" label="A key the server does not have" dataSource={customers} textField="company" valueField="id" columns={columns} value={9999} stretch />
      <Button class="lk-another" text="Another customer" variant="outline" onclick={another} />
    </>
  );
}
```

# ProgressBar and Spinner

> Feedback · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

ProgressBar shows how far some work is, as a line or a circle, or that it runs when that is not known. Spinner says "busy, wait": a turning ring, alone or over a panel while it loads, shown only after a delay so quick work does not flash it.

## Import

```tsx
import { ProgressBar, Spinner, type ProgressTone } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

Every prop takes a value or a function; a function of a reactive object keeps the bar in step with the work. Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ProgressBar, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A bar that follows an upload, and bars created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ upload: 0, uploading: false });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const upload = () => {
    if (s.uploading) return;
    s.uploading = true;
    s.upload = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      s.upload = Math.min(100, s.upload + 7);
      if (s.upload < 100) return;
      clearInterval(timer);
      s.uploading = false;
    }, 120);
  };

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const bar = new ProgressBar({ label: `Task ${++added}`, showValue: true, tone: 'success' });
    bar.value = 25 * added;
    host?.controls.add(bar);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ProgressBar label="Uploading" value={() => s.upload} showValue stretch />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Upload" tone="accent" enabled={() => !s.uploading} onclick={upload} />
        <Button text="Add a bar from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Not known yet

Without a value (`null`) the bar runs to and fro; give it a number once the work can tell how far it is.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ProgressBar } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A bar without a value, and one that runs until the work knows how much there is to do. */
export default function NotKnown() {
  const copy = reactive({ done: 0, total: 12, running: false });

  const start = () => {
    copy.running = true;
    copy.done = 0;
    copy.total = 0;
    // The files are counted first; until then there is no total.
    setTimeout(() => {
      copy.total = 12;
      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        copy.done++;
        if (copy.done < copy.total) return;
        clearInterval(timer);
        copy.running = false;
      }, 150);
    }, 1000);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ProgressBar label="Preparing" value={null} />
      <ProgressBar label="Copying" value={() => (copy.total ? copy.done : null)} max={() => copy.total} />
      <Button text="Copy" variant="outline" enabled={() => !copy.running} onclick={start} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Line or circle

`shape="circle"` draws the progress as an arc that goes round a ring from the top; without a value the arc turns. The caption goes under it (`labelPosition="bottom"`, its default), above it or beside it, and `size` sets the size of the circle and of its line. Where the design language gives it a wave (Material), the line and the arc swing while they grow, straight while little is done and again at the end.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ProgressBar, Stack, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const VALUES = [5, 30, 70, 100, null];

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** The same values as a line and as a circle, a circle in each size, and one of each that follows some work. */
export default function Shapes() {
  const s = reactive({ done: 0, running: false });

  const run = () => {
    if (s.running) return;
    s.running = true;
    s.done = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      s.done = Math.min(100, s.done + 4);
      if (s.done < 100) return;
      clearInterval(timer);
      s.running = false;
    }, 160);
  };

  return (
    <>
      {VALUES.map((value) => (
        <ProgressBar key={String(value)} label={value === null ? 'Not known' : 'Line'} value={value} showValue stretch />
      ))}
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="start">
        {VALUES.map((value) => (
          <ProgressBar key={String(value)} shape="circle" label={value === null ? 'Not known' : 'Circle'} value={value} showValue />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        {SIZES.map((size) => (
          <ProgressBar key={size} shape="circle" size={size} label={`Size ${size}`} labelPosition="side" value={60} />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <ProgressBar label="Importing" value={() => s.done} showValue stretch />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <ProgressBar shape="circle" label="Importing" labelPosition="side" value={() => s.done} showValue />
        <Button text="Import" variant="outline" enabled={() => !s.running} onclick={run} />
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Tones

```tsx
import { ProgressBar, type ProgressTone } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const TONES: ProgressTone[] = ['accent', 'neutral', 'success', 'caution', 'danger'];

/** A bar in every tone. */
export default function Tones() {
  return (
    <>
      {TONES.map((tone, i) => (
        <ProgressBar key={tone} label={tone} value={20 + i * 18} tone={tone} showValue />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Sizes, caption beside, your own text

`size` sets the thickness. `labelPosition="side"` puts the label before the bar and the value after it. `valueText` writes the value its own way.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ProgressBar, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** The three thicknesses, and a bar with its label beside it and the value in its own words. */
export default function Sizes() {
  const s = reactive({ files: 3 });
  return (
    <>
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <ProgressBar key={size} label={`Size ${size}`} size={size} value={60} />
      ))}
      <ProgressBar label="Files" labelPosition="side" max={12} value={() => s.files} showValue valueText={(v) => `${v} of 12`} stretch />
      <Button text="One more file" size="sm" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.files = s.files >= 12 ? 0 : s.files + 1)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Spinner

```tsx
import { Spinner, type ControlSize, type ProgressTone } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];
const TONES: ProgressTone[] = ['neutral', 'success', 'caution', 'danger'];

/** Spinners in every size, with a label beside or under them, in a container of their own, and in the tones. */
export default function Spinners() {
  return (
    <>
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <Spinner key={size} size={size} />
      ))}
      <Spinner label="Loading orders" />
      <Spinner label="Saving" labelPosition="bottom" size="lg" />
      <Spinner label="Syncing" labelPosition="bottom" size="lg" contained />
      {TONES.map((tone) => (
        <Spinner key={tone} tone={tone} size="sm" label={tone} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Delay

A spinner with `delay` stays unseen for that long, from when it is created or shown again. Quick work shows nothing; slow work shows the spinner.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Spinner, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A spinner with a delay: quick work shows nothing, slow work shows it. */
export default function Delay() {
  const s = reactive({ busy: false, result: '' });

  const work = (ms: number) => {
    s.busy = true;
    s.result = '';
    setTimeout(() => {
      s.busy = false;
      s.result = `Done after ${ms} ms.`;
    }, ms);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Quick work (200 ms)" variant="outline" onclick={() => work(200)} />
        <Button text="Slow work (2 s)" variant="outline" onclick={() => work(2000)} />
        <Spinner label="Working" delay={400} visible={() => s.busy} />
      </Stack>
      <output class="pr-result">{() => s.result}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Cover a panel while it loads

`Spinner.cover(target)` lays a spinner over a component or an element and returns the function that takes it away. What is under it cannot be pressed or focused; focus that was inside waits on the spinner and comes back afterwards.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Panel, Spinner, Stack, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A spinner over a panel while its orders load; focus waits on it and comes back. */
export default function Cover() {
  const s = reactive({ result: '' });
  let panel: Panel | null = null;

  // Stands in for a call to the server.
  const loadOrders = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));

  const load = async () => {
    if (!panel) return;
    const done = Spinner.cover(panel, { label: 'Loading orders' });
    try {
      await loadOrders();
    } finally {
      done();
    }
    s.result = 'Orders loaded.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Panel class="pr-panel" variant="outline" padding="md" ref={(c: Panel) => (panel = c)}>
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
          <TextBox label="Customer" value="Ada" />
          <Button text="Load orders" tone="accent" onclick={load} />
        </Stack>
      </Panel>
      <output>{() => s.result}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `ProgressBar` | `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuetext` (the percent or `valueText`); none of them while the progress is not known. |
| `Spinner` | `role="progressbar"` without a value: an indicator of unknown progress, found and named like any widget. Not a `status` live region: those interrupt the reader each time one appears, and a page with many would be noisy. |
| `Name` | The label (`aria-labelledby`), or `uiLocale.strings.loading` when there is none. |
| `Cover` | The container gets `aria-busy="true"`; what is under the spinner is `inert`. Focus inside it moves to the spinner and comes back to where it was. |
| `Motion` | With reduced motion the bar rests as a tinted track, a new value is shown at once, a wave keeps still, and the arcs, the ring and the shape stand still. A wave is drawn only while the bar is in sight. |

## Localization

A bar or a spinner without a label is named `uiLocale.strings.loading`. The percent is written in `locale`, by default the page's `lang`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ProgressBar, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the name of unlabelled bars and spinners, and the language the percent is written in. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <ProgressBar value={40} showValue locale={() => s.lang} />
      <span>
        Unlabelled ones are named <output class="pr-loading">{() => kitTexts.strings.loading}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-progress` | The bar. `data-state="determinate \| indeterminate"`, `data-complete`, `data-shape`, `data-wave` (a wave is drawn), `data-tone`, `data-size`, `data-label-position`, `data-stretch`; `--_fraction`: how much is done, 0 to 1. |
| `.mx-progress__head, .mx-progress__label, .mx-progress__value` | The caption row. |
| `.mx-progress__track, .mx-progress__bar` | The line: the track (`::before`: the rest of it, `::after`: the stop dot) and the part done (`::after`: the runner). |
| `.mx-progress__wave` | The wave drawn over the track instead of the bar. |
| `.mx-progress__circle, .mx-progress__ring, .mx-progress__arc` | The circle: its drawing, the ring and the arc. |
| `.mx-spinner` | The spinner. `data-size`, `data-tone`, `data-label-position`, `data-contained`, `data-waiting`, `data-cover`. |
| `.mx-spinner__box` | The container of what turns. |
| `.mx-spinner__ring, .mx-spinner__shape, .mx-spinner__label` | The ring, the shape (the language shows one of them) and the label. |
| `[data-mx-covered]` | A container under `Spinner.cover`. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `progress.track, progress.bar, progress.rest, progress.stop, progress.runner, progress.wave` | Units of the line, each with its box: the band, the part done, the rest of the track, the stop dot, the runner, the wave (its colour). States: `indeterminate`, `complete`, the tones. |
| `progress.ring, progress.arc, progress.label, progress.value` | Units of the circle and of the caption. |
| `progress.thickness.*, progress.rest-thickness.*, progress.active-gap, progress.dot-size, progress.stop-inset` | The line per size, the gap after the part done, the dot. |
| `progress.wave-amplitude, wave-length, wave-speed, wave-direction, wave-start, wave-end, wave-grow-duration` | The wave: how far it swings (0: none), how long a wave is and how fast and which way it travels, between which shares of the work it swings, how long it takes to grow in. |
| `progress.ring-size.*, ring-thickness.*, ring-active-gap, ring-runner-length, ring-turn-duration, ring-wave-*` | The circle per size, its gaps, its turning arc and its wave. |
| `progress.width, progress.gap, progress.head-gap, progress.accent … danger-subtle` | The width when not stretched, the caption, the tones. |
| `spinner.size.*, spinner.ring-width.*, spinner.shape-size.*` | The ring and the shape per size. |
| `spinner.box, spinner.ring, spinner.shape` | Units: the container (`contained`), the ring and the shape, each with its box. |
| `spinner.shape-1 … spinner.shape-7, spinner.morph-duration, spinner.morph-easing, spinner.spin-duration` | The shapes the shape becomes in turn (names from the shapes of the kit), how long the round takes, how each is reached, and one turn. |
| `spinner.gap` | Between the ring and the label. |
| `spinner.cover-padding, spinner.cover-background` | The layer over a covered container. |

## API reference

### ProgressBar props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | How far the work is. `null` (or no value) when that is not known: the bar runs to and fro, a circle turns. |
| `min / max` | `Bind<number>` | `0` / `100` | The bounds of `value`. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A caption; it names the bar. The same property as `text`. |
| `shape` | `Bind<'line' \| 'circle'>` | `'line'` | `line`: a bar along a track; `circle`: an arc that goes round a ring from the top. |
| `labelPosition` | `Bind<'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'side'>` | `'top'` (`'bottom'` for a circle) | `top`: the label and the value above the bar; `bottom`: under it; `side`: the label before it, the value after it. |
| `showValue` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Writes the percent (whole, rounded down) or `valueText`. |
| `valueText` | `(value, fraction) => string` | — | The text for a value, shown and read out (`3 of 12 files`). A function, so it is stored as it is, not bound. |
| `locale` | `Bind<string>` | the page's `lang` | The locale of the percent. |
| `tone` | `Bind<ProgressTone>` | `'accent'` | `accent`, `neutral`, `success`, `caution`, `danger`. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | The thickness, and the size of a circle: `sm`, `md`, `lg`. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Fills the width of what it sits in. |
| `visible, enabled, …` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Spinner props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Text next to the ring. The same property as `text`. |
| `labelPosition` | `Bind<'side' \| 'bottom'>` | `'side'` | After the ring or under it. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`. |
| `tone` | `Bind<ProgressTone>` | `'accent'` | The color of the turning part. |
| `contained` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Inside a container of its own (a disc behind it), where the design language draws one. |
| `delay` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | Milliseconds before it shows, from when it is created or shown again; quick work then shows nothing. |
| `visible, …` | see Control |  | Showing it again (`visible`) starts the delay again. |

### Properties and methods

| Member | Access / returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ProgressBar: every prop` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `ProgressBar: fraction` | read-only, reactive | How much is done, from 0 to 1; `null` while it is not known. |
| `Spinner: every prop` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `Spinner: waiting` | read-only | Still inside its delay. |
| `Spinner.cover(target, props?)` | `() => void` | Covers a component or an element with a spinner; call the returned function to take it away. See Cover. |
