## Clickable

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Card, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PLACES = ['Istanbul', 'Lisbon', 'Kyoto'];

/** The whole card can be pressed: with the mouse, Enter or Space. */
export default function Clickable() {
  const s = reactive({ chosen: '' });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="start">
        {PLACES.map((place) => (
          <Card key={place} title={place} subtitle="Press to choose" clickable onclick={() => (s.chosen = place)} style="inline-size: 12rem" />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <span>{() => (s.chosen ? `Chosen: ${s.chosen}` : 'Nothing chosen yet')}</span>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Links and selection

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Card, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PLACES = ['Istanbul', 'Lisbon', 'Kyoto'];

/**
 * A link card: its title is the link and a press anywhere on it follows it (`rel="router"` hands it to the router);
 * its own button stays a button. A selectable card turns on and off with a press or its check box.
 */
export default function Links() {
  const s = reactive({ picked: [] as string[] });
  const toggle = (place: string, on: boolean) => {
    s.picked = on ? [...s.picked, place] : s.picked.filter((p) => p !== place);
  };

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="start">
        <Card title="Tokens" subtitle="A link to the tokens page" href="/tokens" rel="router" footer={<Button text="Later" variant="ghost" />} style="inline-size: 14rem" />
        <Card title="Keyboard" subtitle="A link to the keyboard page" href="/keyboard" rel="router" style="inline-size: 14rem" />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="start">
        {PLACES.map((place) => (
          <Card
            key={place}
            title={place}
            subtitle="Press to pick"
            selectable
            selected={() => s.picked.includes(place)}
            onSelectedChanged={(e) => e.byUser && toggle(place, e.selected)}
            style="inline-size: 12rem"
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <span>{() => `Picked: ${s.picked.join(', ') || 'none'}`}</span>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

```tsx
import { Card, Stack, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** The space in and between the parts, per size. */
export default function Sizes() {
  return (
    <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="start" gap="lg">
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <Card key={size} size={size} title={`Size ${size}`} subtitle="Grace Hopper" avatar={{ name: 'Grace Hopper' }} style="inline-size: 15rem">
          Content of the card.
        </Card>
      ))}
    </Stack>
  );

```

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Name` | A `group` named by its title (`aria-labelledby`). |
| `Picture` | Adorns unless `mediaAlt` says what it shows. |
| `Clickable` | A Tab stop; Enter and Space press it. Buttons inside it stay buttons of their own. |
| `Link` | The title is a real link (read and followed as one); the card shows its focus. The card’s own buttons stay above it. |
| `Selectable` | A check box named “Select <title>” in the kit language; the card shows the selection with its frame. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-card` | The card. `data-variant`, `data-size`, `data-orientation`, `data-pressable`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-card__media` | The picture. |
| `.mx-card__body` | Header, content and actions. |
| `.mx-card__header, .mx-card__avatar, .mx-card__heading, .mx-card__title, .mx-card__subtitle, .mx-card__action` | The header and its parts. |
| `.mx-card__content, .mx-card__footer` | The content, and the row of actions. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `card.card` | Unit: the card at rest, then `elevated`, `filled`, `outline`, `selected`, `hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled`. |
| `card.title, card.subtitle, card.content` | Units: the title, the line under it, the content’s text. |
| `card.padding.*, card.gap.*` | The space around and between the parts, per size. |
| `card.header-gap, card.footer-gap, card.media-width` | The space in the header and between actions; the picture’s width at the start. |
| `card.variant, card.footer-align` | The look a card takes when none is given; where the actions sit (Fluent: at the start, the others: at the end). |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The title; it names the card for screen readers. |
| `subtitle` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The line under the title. |
| `avatar` | `Bind<AvatarProps \| null>` | `null` | An avatar before the titles (its props). |
| `action` | `Bind<ComponentBase \| null>` | `null` | Something at the end of the header: a menu button, a badge. |
| `media` | `Bind<IconSource \| null>` | `null` | A picture running to the card’s edges: an image address, an element or a component. |
| `mediaAlt` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | What the picture shows, for screen readers, when `media` is an image address. Without it the picture only adorns. |
| `content` | `Bind<ComponentBase \| null>` | `null` | What fills the content, besides JSX children. |
| `footer` | `Bind<ComponentBase \| null>` | `null` | A row of actions under the content. A component replaced leaves the card and stays yours. |
| `variant` | `Bind<CardVariant>` | the language’s (`elevated`) | `elevated`, `filled`, `outline`. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | The space in and between the parts: `sm`, `md`, `lg`. |
| `orientation` | `Bind<CardOrientation>` | `'vertical'` | `horizontal` puts the picture at the start. |
| `clickable` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The whole card can be pressed (`onclick`, Enter, Space). |
| `href` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | The whole card is a link there: its title is the link, and a press anywhere on the card follows it. |
| `rel` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The link’s `rel`; `router` lets the MotifJS router take it. |
| `selectable` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A check box on its top end corner; a press on the card turns it on and off. |
| `selected` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Whether it is selected. |
| `onSelectedChanged` | `CardSelectedChangedEventArgs` |  | It was selected or not any more (`selected`), by the user or by code (`byUser`). |
| `enabled, visible, tabStop` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `contentPart` | read-only | The part holding the content, for adding to it from code. |
| `avatarControl` | read-only | The avatar before the titles, when it has one. |

# Skeleton

> Display · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

The shape of what is loading, so the page keeps its layout while data arrives. Given content, it shows the content in the same place once loading ends.

## Import

```tsx
import { Skeleton } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Shapes

```tsx
import { Skeleton, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Lines of text (the last of several is shorter), a block, and a circle. Lines and blocks take the width they are given. */
export default function Shapes() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 24rem; max-inline-size: 100%">
      <Skeleton lines={3} />
      <Skeleton shape="rect" height={96} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" align="center">
        <Skeleton shape="circle" />
        <Skeleton shape="circle" width={24} />
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Until it loads

`loading` takes a value or a function; when it turns `false` the JSX children show instead.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Avatar, Button, Card, Skeleton, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** While `loading`, the shape of the card shows; then the card itself, in the same place. */
export default function Loading() {
  const s = reactive({ loading: true });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 22rem; max-inline-size: 100%">
      <Button text={() => (s.loading ? 'Finish loading' : 'Load again')} variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.loading = !s.loading)} />
      <Card>
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" align="center">
          <Skeleton shape="circle" loading={() => s.loading}>
            <Avatar name="Grace Hopper" />
          </Skeleton>
          <Skeleton lines={2} loading={() => s.loading} grow>
            <strong>Grace Hopper</strong>
            <div>Wrote the first compiler.</div>
          </Skeleton>
        </Stack>
      </Card>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Movement

```tsx
import { Skeleton, Stack, type SkeletonAnimation } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const ANIMATIONS: SkeletonAnimation[] = ['wave', 'pulse', 'none'];

/** Each way it moves; reduced motion keeps them all still. */
export default function Animations() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 24rem; max-inline-size: 100%">
      {ANIMATIONS.map((animation) => (
        <Stack key={animation} gap="sm">
          <span>{animation}</span>
          <Skeleton lines={2} animation={animation} />
        </Stack>
      ))}
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Loading` | A `progressbar` with `aria-busy` and a name (“Loading…” in the kit language); the shapes are hidden from screen readers. |
| `Loaded` | The role and the busy state go; the content is read as it is. |
| `Motion` | Reduced motion keeps the wave and the pulse still: their duration follows the motion durations. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-skeleton` | The skeleton. `data-shape`, `data-animation`, `data-loading`. |
| `.mx-skeleton__bone` | One shape (a line, the block, the circle). |
| `.mx-skeleton__content` | What shows once loaded. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `skeleton.bone` | Unit: a shape, in each of `text`, `rect`, `circle`; its `color` is what the wave and the pulse mix in. |
| `skeleton.line-height, skeleton.line-gap, skeleton.last-line` | A line of text, the space between lines, the last line’s share of the width. |
| `skeleton.circle-size, skeleton.rect-height` | A circle or a block given no size. |
| `skeleton.animation, skeleton.duration, skeleton.easing, skeleton.wave-mix, skeleton.pulse-dim` | How it moves when not told, how long, at what pace, and how strongly. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `Bind<SkeletonShape>` | `'text'` | `text` (lines), `rect` (a block: a picture, a field), `circle` (an avatar). |
| `lines` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | How many lines of text; the last of several is shorter. |
| `width` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | the room it is in | A CSS length, or pixels as a number; a circle’s size (default: the language’s). |
| `height` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | a line / the language’s | A CSS length, or pixels as a number. |
| `animation` | `Bind<SkeletonAnimation>` | the language’s | `wave`, `pulse`, `none`. Fluent and the desktop languages sweep a wave, Material and Lilac pulse. |
| `loading` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | While `true` the skeleton shows; then its JSX children do. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | the kit’s “Loading…” | What screen readers say while it loads. |
| `visible` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `content` | read-only | The part holding what shows once loaded, for adding to it from code. |


---

# Tabs

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Tabs show one panel at a time under a strip of tabs: from JSX or from code, closable, with icons and badges, scroll buttons when the tabs do not fit, four placements and panels built when they are first shown.

## Import

```tsx
import { Tabs, Tab } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

A `<Tab>`'s children are its panel. `value` is the selected tab's `key` (else its index) and `x-model` binds it two-way. Created with `new`, tabs are added, inserted and removed from code.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Tab, Tabs, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Tabs from JSX bound with x-model, and tabs created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ page: 'general' as string | number, name: '', log: '' });
  let added = 0;

  const reports = new Tabs({ label: 'Reports', closable: true });
  reports.add(new Tab({ title: 'Summary', content: () => <p>The summary, built when it was first shown.</p> }));
  reports.onSelectionChanged((e) => (s.log = e.tab ? `Selected “${e.tab.title}”${e.byUser ? ' by the user' : ' from code'}.` : 'No tab left.'));

  const addReport = () => {
    const n = ++added;
    const tab = reports.add(new Tab({ title: `Report ${n}`, content: () => <p>Report {n}.</p> }));
    reports.select(tab);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Tabs label="Settings" x-model={() => s.page}>
        <Tab key="general" title="&General">
          <TextBox label="Name" x-model={() => s.name} helpText="Its text stays while you switch tabs." />
        </Tab>
        <Tab key="advanced" title="&Advanced">
          <p>Advanced settings.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab key="about" title="A&bout">
          <p>Version 1.0.</p>
        </Tab>
      </Tabs>
      <output class="tabs-page">{() => `value: "${s.page}"`}</output>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a report from code" variant="outline" onclick={addReport} />
        <output class="tabs-log">{() => s.log}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" class="tabs-coded" style="inline-size: 100%" onBuilt={(c) => c.controls.add(reports)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Closable tabs

A close button on every tab (`closable`), or on some (a tab's own `closable` wins). Delete or a middle click closes the focused or pointed tab. `onClose` can cancel: ask about unsaved work first.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Tab, Tabs } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const HomeIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M2.5 7.5L8 3l5.5 4.5M4 6.5v6.5h8V6.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A close button on every tab but Home; onClose keeps the draft open while it is protected. */
export default function Closable() {
  const s = reactive({ keepDraft: true });
  return (
    <>
      <Button
        text={() => (s.keepDraft ? 'Draft is protected' : 'Draft can close')}
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        toggle
        x-model={() => s.keepDraft}
      />
      <Tabs
        label="Documents"
        closable
        onClose={(e) => {
          if (e.tab.key === 'draft' && s.keepDraft) e.cancel = true;
        }}
      >
        <Tab title="Home" icon={() => <HomeIcon />} closable={false}>
          <p>Home cannot be closed.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab key="draft" title="Draft">
          <p>Closing is cancelled while the draft is protected.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab title="Notes">
          <p>Notes.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab title="Ideas">
          <p>Ideas.</p>
        </Tab>
      </Tabs>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Many tabs

When the tabs do not fit, arrow buttons scroll the strip (`scrollButtons`, on by default); the selected tab and the one with focus scroll into view.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Tab, Tabs } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const MONTHS = ['January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June', 'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'];

/** Twelve tabs in a narrow strip, with scroll buttons that can be turned off. */
export default function ManyTabs() {
  const s = reactive({ scrollButtons: true });

  const months = new Tabs({ label: 'Months', scrollButtons: () => s.scrollButtons });
  for (const month of MONTHS) months.add(new Tab({ title: month, content: () => <p>{month}: nothing planned yet.</p> }));

  return (
    <>
      <Button text="Scroll buttons" variant="outline" size="sm" toggle x-model={() => s.scrollButtons} />
      <Stack class="tabs-months" style="inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 28rem" onBuilt={(c) => c.controls.add(months)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Placement

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Tab, Tabs, type TabsPlacement } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PLACEMENTS: TabsPlacement[] = ['top', 'bottom', 'start', 'end'];

/** The strip above, below, or beside the panel. */
export default function Placement() {
  const s = reactive({ placement: 'top' as TabsPlacement });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Placement">
        {PLACEMENTS.map((placement) => (
          <Button
            key={placement}
            text={placement}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.placement === placement ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.placement === placement}
            onclick={() => (s.placement = placement)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Tabs label="Placement" class="tabs-placement" placement={() => s.placement}>
        <Tab title="Profile">
          <p>Profile.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab title="Security">
          <p>Security.</p>
        </Tab>
        <Tab title="Billing">
          <p>Billing.</p>
        </Tab>
      </Tabs>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Manual activation

By default an arrow key selects the tab it moves to. With `activation="manual"` it only moves focus and Enter or Space selects: better when a panel is slow to show.

```tsx
import { Tab, Tabs } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Arrow keys move focus only; Enter or Space selects. */
export default function ManualActivation() {
  return (
    <Tabs label="Manual" class="tabs-manual" activation="manual">
      <Tab title="One">
        <p>One.</p>
      </Tab>
      <Tab title="Two">
        <p>Two.</p>
      </Tab>
      <Tab title="Three">
        <p>Three.</p>
      </Tab>
    </Tabs>
  );
}
```

## Icons, badges, disabled tabs

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Tab, Tabs } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const MailIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M2.5 4h11v8h-11zM2.5 4.5L8 8.5l5.5-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A tab with an icon, a count that follows state and a tooltip, and a disabled tab. */
export default function IconsAndBadges() {
  const s = reactive({ unread: 3 });
  return (
    <Tabs label="Mail">
      <Tab title="Inbox" icon={() => <MailIcon />} badge={() => (s.unread ? s.unread : null)} hint="Mail you have not read">
        <Button text="Read one" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.unread = Math.max(0, s.unread - 1))} />
      </Tab>
      <Tab title="Sent">
        <p>Sent mail.</p>
      </Tab>
      <Tab title="Archive" enabled={false}>
        <p>Archive.</p>
      </Tab>
    </Tabs>
  );
}
```

## Variants and sizes

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Tab, Tabs, type TabsVariant } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const VARIANTS: TabsVariant[] = ['line', 'pill'];

/** Both variants in the three sizes, stretched or not. */
export default function VariantsAndSizes() {
  const s = reactive({ variant: 'line' as TabsVariant, stretch: false });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        {VARIANTS.map((variant) => (
          <Button
            key={variant}
            text={variant}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.variant === variant ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.variant === variant}
            onclick={() => (s.variant = variant)}
          />
        ))}
        <Button text="Stretch" size="sm" variant="outline" toggle x-model={() => s.stretch} />
      </Stack>
      {(['sm', 'md', 'lg'] as const).map((size) => (
        <Tabs key={size} label={`Size ${size}`} size={size} variant={() => s.variant} stretch={() => s.stretch}>
          <Tab title="Day">
            <p>{`Size ${size}.`}</p>
          </Tab>
          <Tab title="Week">
            <p>Week.</p>
          </Tab>
          <Tab title="Month">
            <p>Month.</p>
          </Tab>
        </Tabs>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Lazy panels

A panel is built the first time it is shown and kept afterwards, so what was typed in it stays (`lazy`, on by default; `lazy={false}` builds every panel at once). A tab with a `content` factory and `keepAlive={false}` has its content disposed while hidden and made again when it shows. JSX children are made once by the page, so they are always kept.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Stack, Tab, Tabs, TextBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Panels built when first shown: one kept, one made again each time it shows. */
export default function LazyPanels() {
  const s = reactive({ builds: 0 });

  const tabs = new Tabs({ label: 'Lazy panels' });
  tabs.add(new Tab({ title: 'First', content: () => <p>Always here.</p> }));
  tabs.add(
    new Tab({
      title: 'Kept',
      content: () => {
        s.builds++;
        return <TextBox label="Type, switch tabs, come back" />;
      },
    }),
  );
  tabs.add(
    new Tab({
      title: 'Made each time',
      keepAlive: false,
      content: () => {
        s.builds++;
        return <TextBox label="This one starts empty each time" />;
      },
    }),
  );

  return (
    <>
      <Stack style="inline-size: 100%" onBuilt={(c) => c.controls.add(tabs)} />
      <output class="tabs-builds">{() => `Panels built: ${s.builds}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Into the strip, onto the selected tab; again, into its panel. |
| `Left / Right` | The previous / next tab, wrapping around (reversed in right-to-left text). With `start` and `end` placement: Up / Down. |
| `Home / End` | The first / last tab. |
| `Enter / Space` | Select the focused tab (with `activation="manual"`). |
| `Delete` | Closes the focused tab when it is closable. |
| `Alt + key (`&General`)` | Selects that tab and focuses it (Control + Option + key on Apple platforms). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Roles` | `tablist`, `tab` (a `<button>`) and `tabpanel`; `aria-orientation="vertical"` with `start` and `end` placement. |
| `State` | `aria-selected` on the tabs; `aria-controls` ties a tab to its panel and `aria-labelledby` names the panel by its tab. |
| `Focus` | One Tab stop in the strip (the selected tab). A panel with nothing focusable in it takes focus itself (`tabindex="0"`), so its text can be reached. |
| `Disabled tabs` | `aria-disabled="true"`; the arrow keys skip them. |
| `Close button` | Not a Tab stop and hidden from screen readers (a button inside a tab would be a control inside a control); Delete closes the tab and `aria-keyshortcuts="Delete"` announces it. Its tooltip comes from `uiLocale`. |
| `Scroll buttons` | For the pointer only, hidden from screen readers: the arrow keys reach every tab and scroll it into view. |

## Localization

Tabs write one text: the close button's tooltip, `uiLocale.strings.close`. Every tab follows a change at once.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of every component on the page, the tabs' close button included. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        The close button reads <output class="tabs-close-name">{() => kitTexts.strings.close}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-tabs` | The root. `data-placement`, `data-variant`, `data-size`, `data-stretch`, `data-overflow`, `data-scroll-buttons`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-tabs__strip, .mx-tabs__list` | The strip and the tab list in it (the scroll box). |
| `.mx-tabs__tab` | A tab: `aria-selected`, `aria-disabled`, `data-closable`. |
| `.mx-tabs__icon, .mx-tabs__label, .mx-tabs__badge, .mx-tabs__close` | The parts of a tab. |
| `.mx-tabs__scroll` | A scroll button: `data-direction` (`back`, `forward`), `data-end` when it has nowhere to go. |
| `.mx-tabs__panels, .mx-tabs__panel` | The panels and a panel (the tab's own element). |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `tabs.container, tabs.strip, tabs.list, tabs.scroll, tabs.scroll-icon` | Units: the whole, the strip with its line along the panel (`bottom`, `start`, `end`; the pill tray: `pill`, `pill-bottom` …), the row of tabs, the scroll buttons and their glyph. |
| `tabs.tab, tabs.label, tabs.icon, tabs.badge, tabs.close, tabs.close-icon` | Units: a tab in each state (`hover`, `pressed`, `selected`, `disabled`, `focus`; in the pill variant `pill`, `pill-hover` …) and its parts. |
| `tabs.indicator, tabs.separator, tabs.panel` | Units: the line variant's mark (`vertical`, `hover`, `selected`, `selected-disabled`), a line between two tabs, the panel (`pill`, `pill-across`, `focus`). |
| `tabs.height.*, tabs.pill-height.*, tabs.padding.*, tabs.font-size.*, tabs.line-height.*, tabs.indicator-inset.*` | Sizes per size class. |
| `tabs.pill-gap, tabs.tab-overlap, tabs.indicator-offset, tabs.indicator-inset-vertical, tabs.close-pull, tabs.vertical-width` | Where the layout puts the pieces: between pills, over the strip's line, the mark, the close button, a vertical strip's width. |
| `tabs.curve-display, tabs.curve-size, tabs.curve-frame-width, tabs.curve-frame-color` | Outward curves at the selected tab's corners on the panel's side, in its fill. |

## API reference

### Tabs props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | the first tab | The selected tab's `key`, else its index. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `selectedIndex` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | The selected tab's index in `tabs`. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Names the tab list for screen readers (`aria-label`). The same property as `text`. |
| `activation` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'manual'>` | `'auto'` | `auto`: an arrow key selects the tab it moves to. `manual`: arrows move focus only; Enter or Space selects. |
| `placement` | `Bind<TabsPlacement>` | `'top'` | `top`, `bottom`, `start`, `end`. `start` and `end` stack the tabs vertically. |
| `variant` | `Bind<TabsVariant>` | `'line'` | `line`: a bar on the selected tab. `pill`: the tabs sit on a tray and the selected one is raised. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`, from the density tokens. |
| `stretch` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The tabs share the whole width. |
| `scrollButtons` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Arrow buttons at the ends of the strip when the tabs do not fit. Off: a thin scroll bar. |
| `closable` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Every tab gets a close button. A tab's own `closable` wins. |
| `lazy` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A panel is built when it is first shown, then kept. A tab's own `lazy` wins. |
| `keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false`: what a tab's `content` made is disposed while the tab is hidden and made again when it shows. A tab's own `keepAlive` wins. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. `tabStop={false}` takes the tab strip out of the Tab order. |

### Tab props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The caption; `&General` makes Alt+G select the tab. The same property as `text`. |
| `key` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Names the tab in `value`. The JSX `key` works too. |
| `icon` | `Bind<IconSource \| null>` | — | An icon before the title. |
| `badge` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | — | A short text after the title (a count); empty or `null` shows none. |
| `hint` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A tooltip. |
| `closable` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | the Tabs | A close button on this tab. |
| `lazy, keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | the Tabs | This tab's own setting. |
| `content` | `() => ComponentBase \| ComponentBase[]` | — | Makes the panel content when the panel is built: instead of, or after, the JSX children. |
| `enabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false`: the tab cannot be selected and the arrow keys skip it. |
| `visible` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false`: the tab is left out; a selected one hands the selection to a neighbour. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `tabs` | read-only, reactive | The tabs, in strip order. |
| `selectedTab` | read-only, reactive | The selected `Tab`, `null` when there is none. |
| `Tab.isSelected, Tab.isClosable` | read-only, reactive | Whether the tab is selected; whether it shows a close button. |
| `Tab.contentBuilt` | read-only | Whether its panel has been built. |
| `Tab.owner, Tab.headerElement` | read-only | Its `Tabs`; its button in the strip. A tab's own element is its panel. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `add(tab)` | `Tab` | Adds a tab at the end. A tab of another `Tabs` moves here. |
| `insert(index, tab)` | `Tab` | Adds a tab at an index. |
| `remove(tab)` | `boolean` | Removes the tab and disposes it; no `onClose`. The selection and focus move to a neighbour. |
| `select(tab \| index)` | `boolean` | Selects a tab from code; `false` when it is hidden or not there. |
| `close(tab)` | `boolean` | Closes a tab as its close button does: `onClose` can cancel it. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Focuses the selected tab. |
| `Tab.select(), Tab.close(), Tab.focus()` | `boolean` | The same, from the tab. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onSelecting(e)` | The user is about to select a tab. `e`: `{ tab, index, previousTab, previousIndex, cancel, source, event }`; `e.cancel = true` keeps the current one. |
| `onSelectionChanged(e)` | The selected tab changed. `e`: `{ tab, index, previousTab, previousIndex, byUser, source, event? }`. |
| `onClose(e)` | A tab is about to close, by its button, Delete, a middle click or `close()`. `e`: `{ tab, index, byUser, cancel, source, event? }`. |

# Breadcrumb

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

The way to the current page: each step a link or a button, the current page last. Steps that do not fit go into a menu after the first.

## Import

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Links and buttons

A step with `href` is a link; `rel='router'` lets the MotifJS router take it. A step without one is a button: `onItemClick` tells it.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Breadcrumb, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Links the router takes (`rel="router"`), a step that is a button, the current page last; one made from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ last: '' });
  const coded = new Breadcrumb({ label: 'Settings path', items: ['Settings', 'Account', 'Security'] });

  // Several on one page: each gets a name of its own.
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Breadcrumb
        label="Docs path"
        rel="router"
        items={[{ text: 'Docs', href: '/' }, { text: 'Components', href: '/button' }, 'Display', { text: 'Breadcrumb' }]}
        onItemClick={(e) => (s.last = String((e.item as { text?: string }).text ?? e.item))}
      />
      <span>{() => (s.last ? `Pressed: ${s.last}` : 'Press a step')}</span>
      <span onConfig={(c) => c.controls.add(coded)} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## When they do not fit

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const PATH = ['Workspace', 'Projects', 'Kit', 'Components', 'Navigation', 'Breadcrumb', 'Examples', 'Overflow'];

/** Steps that do not fit go into the menu after the first; drag the box's corner to see it. `maxItems` caps the count. */
export default function Overflow() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <div style="resize: horizontal; overflow: hidden; inline-size: 22rem; min-inline-size: 10rem; max-inline-size: 100%; padding-block: 0.25rem">
        <Breadcrumb label="Path that fits" items={PATH} />
      </div>
      <Breadcrumb label="Path of three" items={PATH} maxItems={3} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Sizes

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb, Stack, type ControlSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const SIZES: ControlSize[] = ['sm', 'md', 'lg'];

/** Each size, with a disabled step. */
export default function Sizes() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      {SIZES.map((size) => (
        <Breadcrumb key={size} label={`Path ${size}`} size={size} items={['Home', { text: 'Archived', enabled: false }, 'Reports', `Size ${size}`]} />
      ))}
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Landmark` | A `nav` named “Breadcrumb” in the kit language, holding an ordered list. Several on one page: give each its own `label`. |
| `Current page` | `aria-current="page"`; it is not a link. |
| `Menu` | The steps that do not fit are a menu behind a button named “More pages”; choosing one presses the step itself. |
| `Disabled` | `aria-disabled`; a disabled link loses its address. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-breadcrumb` | The breadcrumb. `data-size`. |
| `.mx-breadcrumb__list, .mx-breadcrumb__item` | The list and each step. |
| `.mx-breadcrumb__link, .mx-breadcrumb__current, .mx-breadcrumb__text` | A pressable step, the current page, a step’s text. |
| `.mx-breadcrumb__divider, .mx-breadcrumb__more` | The divider after a step, and the menu of the steps that do not fit. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `breadcrumb.link, .current, .divider` | Units: a step (`hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled`), the current page, the divider (its shape: a chevron, a slash in Material). |
| `breadcrumb.height.*, .padding.*, .font-size.*` | A step per size. |
| `breadcrumb.gap, .divider-size` | The space around a divider, and its size. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly (BreadcrumbItem \| string)[]>` | `[]` | The steps, the current page last: `BreadcrumbItem`s (`text`, `href`, `icon`, `enabled`, `data`) or plain texts. A step with `href` is a link, one without a button. |
| `rel` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The links’ `rel`; `router` lets the MotifJS router take them (from the menu too). |
| `maxItems` | `Bind<number \| null>` | as many as fit | The most steps shown; the first and the last stay, those between go into the menu. |
| `lastIsCurrent` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The last step is the current page: not pressable, `aria-current="page"`. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | the kit’s “Breadcrumb” | What screen readers call it. |

### Events and properties

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onItemClick` | event | A step was pressed, on the breadcrumb or in its menu (`item`, `index`); `cancel = true` keeps a link from being followed. |
| `collapsed` | read-only | The indexes of the steps now in the menu. |

# Pagination

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Moving through pages of items: the sizes to choose from, where the page stands, the steps and a button per page around the current one. It turns compact when it does not fit. It looks and works as the grid’s pager.

## Import

```tsx
import { Pagination } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

`x-model` binds the page; `onPageChanged` tells the page size too, so the data can be loaded for both.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Pagination, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The page bound with `x-model`, the sizes to choose from; one made with `new` from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ page: 3, size: 25 });
  const coded = new Pagination({ label: 'Pages made in code', total: 40, pageSize: 10, mode: 'full', showInfo: false });

  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Pagination
        label="Orders"
        total={1234}
        pageSizes={[10, 25, 50, 0]}
        pageSize={() => s.size}
        x-model={() => s.page}
        onPageChanged={(e) => e.byUser && (s.size = e.pageSize)}
      />
      <span>{() => `Page ${s.page}, ${s.size || 'all'} per page`}</span>
      <span onConfig={(c) => c.controls.add(coded)} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Looks

```tsx
import { Pagination, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The compact look; adaptive in a narrow box (drag its corner); more neighbours; and only the pages. */
export default function Looks() {
  return (
    <Stack gap="lg">
      <Pagination label="Compact" mode="compact" total={500} pageSizes={[20, 50]} pageSize={20} page={4} />
      <div style="resize: horizontal; overflow: hidden; inline-size: 26rem; min-inline-size: 22rem; max-inline-size: 100%">
        <Pagination label="Adaptive" total={500} pageSizes={[20, 50]} pageSize={20} page={4} showInfo={false} />
      </div>
      <Pagination label="Two each side" mode="full" neighbors={2} total={1000} page={10} showInfo={false} />
      <Pagination label="Pages only" mode="full" pageCount={7} page={2} showInfo={false} showNavigation={false} />
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Landmark` | A `nav` named “Pages” (or its label) in the kit language. |
| `Pages` | Each page button is named “Page 5”; the current one is `aria-current="page"`. |
| `Steps` | Named First page, Previous page, Next page, Last page; disabled at the ends. |
| `Compact` | The page number box is named “Page number”; the info stays readable while hidden. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-pagination` | The pagination. `data-look`: `full` or `compact`. |
| `.mx-pagination__sizes, __size, __size-list` | The page sizes, as buttons or as a drop-down. |
| `.mx-pagination__info, __step, __pages, __page, __gap` | The info, a step (`data-step`), the page buttons and the gaps. |
| `.mx-pagination__jump, __number` | The compact look’s page number box. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `pagination.button-size, .step-variant, .page-variant, .page-tone, .current-variant, .current-tone` | The look of its buttons: the same as the grid’s pager in each language. |
| `pagination.info` | Unit: the info’s text. |
| `pagination.gap, .step-overlap, .number-width, .size-width` | The space between parts, the double arrows, the compact look’s boxes. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | The page, from 1. |
| `value` | `Bind<number>` |  | The same as `page`: what `x-model` binds, two-way. |
| `total` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | How many items there are in all; the pages are counted from it and `pageSize`. |
| `pageSize` | `Bind<number>` | `10` | Items per page; 0: all on one page. |
| `pageCount` | `Bind<number \| null>` | `null` | How many pages, when there is no `total` to count them from. |
| `pageSizes` | `Bind<readonly number[]>` | `[]` | The page sizes to choose from (0: all). Another size keeps the first item of the page in view. |
| `showInfo` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | “Page 3 of 12 (250 items)”. |
| `showNavigation` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The first, previous, next and last steps. |
| `neighbors` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | Page buttons on each side of the current one. |
| `mode` | `Bind<PaginationMode>` | `'adaptive'` | `full`, `compact` (a page number box and a drop-down of sizes), `adaptive`: compact while the full one does not fit. |
| `infoText` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The info of your own: `{page}`, `{count}` and `{total}` are filled in. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | the kit’s “Pages” | What screen readers call it; several on a page need one each. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onPageChanged` | event | The page or the page size changed (`page`, `pageSize`), by the user or by code (`byUser`). |
| `goTo(page)` | method | Goes to a page (from 1), as a press would. |
| `pageCount` | read | How many pages there are now. |
| `compact` | read-only | Whether the compact look shows now. |

# Stepper

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

The steps of a longer task and where the user stands in them: an indicator and a text per step, a line between them, the steps before the current one completed. The [Wizard](wizard.md) adds a page and the buttons to each step.

## Import

```tsx
import { Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

The current step is `value`: a step’s `key`, else its index; `x-model` binds it two-way. From code, `next()`, `previous()` and `goTo()` move it and `onStepChanged` tells.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A stepper bound with x-model, and one made from code and moved with its own methods. */
export default function FromCode() {
    const s = reactive({ step: 0 as string | number | null, at: 0, told: '' });
    const coded = new Stepper({
        label: 'Order',
        items: ['Cart', 'Address', 'Payment', 'Done'],
        linear: false,
        onStepChanged: e => {
            s.at = e.index;
            s.told = `Step ${e.index + 1}${e.byUser ? ', pressed' : ''}`;
        }
    });

    return (
        <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stepper label="Sign up" items={['Account', 'Profile', 'Review']} x-model={() => s.step} />
            <output class="st-value">{() => `value: ${JSON.stringify(s.step)}`}</output>
            <span onConfig={c => c.controls.add(coded)} />
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button text="Back" variant="outline" enabled={() => s.at > 0} onclick={() => void coded.previous()} />
                <Button text="Next" variant="outline" enabled={() => s.at < 3} onclick={() => void coded.next()} />
                <output class="st-told">{() => s.told}</output>
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Statuses

The steps before the current one are completed by themselves. An item may say `status: 'done'` or `'error'` whatever the current step is, be `optional`, be disabled, or carry an `icon` in place of its number; its fields may be functions of your state.

| Status | How |
| --- | --- |
| `pending` | A step to come: its number in the indicator. |
| `current` | The step in hand: `aria-current="step"`. |
| `done` | The steps before the current one, and any step whose item says `status: 'done'`: a check in the indicator, the line before it filled. |
| `error` | A step whose item says `status: 'error'`: a mark in the indicator, the text in the danger colour; read out as “Needs attention”. |
| `optional` | Says “Optional” under the text; in linear order it may be skipped. |
| `disabled` | An item with `enabled: false`, or a step linear order does not reach yet: `aria-disabled`, out of the Tab order. |

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const pencil = () => {
    const svg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 16 16');
    svg.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    svg.innerHTML = '<path d="M11.5 2.5l2 2L5 13H3v-2z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>';
    return svg;
};

/** Completed and failed steps told by the items, an optional step, a disabled one, an icon in place of the number. */
export default function Statuses() {
    const s = reactive({ paid: false });
    const items = [
        { text: 'Cart', status: 'done' as const },
        { text: 'Address', description: 'Checked', status: 'done' as const },
        { text: 'Payment', description: () => (s.paid ? 'Paid' : 'Card declined'), status: () => (s.paid ? 'done' : 'error') },
        { text: 'Gift note', optional: true, icon: pencil() },
        { text: 'Pick-up', enabled: false },
        { text: 'Done' }
    ];
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stepper label="Statuses" items={items} value={5} linear={false} />
            <Button text={() => (s.paid ? 'Decline the card' : 'Take the payment')} variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.paid = !s.paid)} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## In order, or free

`linear` (the default) lets a press reach only the completed steps and the next one; `linear={false}` lets it reach any. Either way `onStepChanging` is asked first: `cancel` keeps the step, a `promise` waits for a check or a server.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { CheckBox, Stack, Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** In linear order a step is reached only after the ones before it; `onStepChanging` refuses a step while the box is unchecked. */
export default function Linear() {
    const s = reactive({ step: 0 as string | number | null, agreed: false, note: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stepper
                label="In order"
                items={['Terms', 'Details', 'Confirm']}
                x-model={() => s.step}
                onStepChanging={e => {
                    if (e.to > 0 && !s.agreed) {
                        e.cancel = true;
                        s.note = 'Accept the terms first.';
                    } else {
                        s.note = '';
                    }
                }}
            />
            <CheckBox label="I accept the terms" x-model={() => s.agreed} />
            <output class="st-note">{() => s.note}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Orientations

```tsx
import { Stack, Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const STEPS = [
    { text: 'Details', description: 'Name and e-mail' },
    { text: 'Address', description: 'Where to send it' },
    { text: 'Payment', description: 'Card or transfer' },
    { text: 'Review' }
];

/** Horizontal with the texts under or after the indicators, and vertical. */
export default function Orientations() {
    return (
        <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stepper label="Texts under" items={STEPS} value={1} linear={false} />
            <Stepper label="Texts after" items={STEPS.slice(0, 3)} value={1} labelPosition="end" linear={false} />
            <div style="inline-size: 18rem">
                <Stepper label="Standing" items={STEPS} value={1} orientation="vertical" linear={false} />
            </div>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Sizes

```tsx
import { Stack, Stepper } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const STEPS = ['Plan', 'Build', 'Ship'];

/** Three sizes, and a stepper without numbers. */
export default function Sizes() {
    return (
        <Stack gap="lg" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stepper label="Small" items={STEPS} value={1} size="sm" linear={false} />
            <Stepper label="Medium" items={STEPS} value={1} linear={false} />
            <Stepper label="Large" items={STEPS} value={1} size="lg" linear={false} />
            <Stepper label="Dots" items={STEPS} value={1} showNumbers={false} size="sm" labelPosition="end" linear={false} />
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | One stop: the step focused last, else the current one, else the first that can be reached. |
| `Arrow keys` | Left and Right (Up and Down standing) move between the steps that can be reached, around the ends; Home and End go to the first and the last. |
| `Enter, Space` | Choose the focused step; `onStepChanging` may refuse. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Landmark` | A `nav` named “Steps” in the kit language, holding an ordered list; several on one page: give each its own `label`. |
| `A step` | A button whose name reads “Step 2 of 4, Address, Where to send it, Completed”: the position, the texts and the status are all in it. |
| `Not clickable` | Plain elements: nothing to press, the current one still `aria-current`. |
| `Lines and marks` | Decorative, hidden from readers. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-stepper` | The stepper. `data-orientation`, `data-labels`, `data-size`. |
| `.mx-stepper__list, .mx-stepper__item` | The list and each step with its line. `data-status` on the item. |
| `.mx-stepper__step` | The step: a button or a div. `data-status`, `aria-current`, `aria-disabled`. |
| `.mx-stepper__indicator, .mx-stepper__number, .mx-stepper__mark, .mx-stepper__icon` | The circle, the number in it, the check or error mark, an icon of your own. |
| `.mx-stepper__label, .mx-stepper__description, .mx-stepper__note` | The texts. |
| `.mx-stepper__line` | The line to the next step. `data-status="done"` up to the current one. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `stepper.step, .indicator, .mark, .label, .description, .note, .line` | Units: the step (`hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled`, `current`, `done`, `error`), its indicator, the mark (`icon` per state), the texts, the line (`done`); the line turns a quarter in a vertical stepper. |
| `stepper.size.*, .font-size.*, .padding.*` | The indicator, the text and the space around a step, per size. |
| `stepper.description-font-size, .gap, .line-gap, .line-min-length` | The second line, the space between indicator and texts, and the line’s margins and least length. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly (StepperItem \| string)[]>` | `[]` | The steps in order: `StepperItem`s (`text`, `description`, `key`, `icon`, `status`, `optional`, `enabled`, `data`) or plain texts. |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | `0` | The current step: its `key`, else its index; `null` for none. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `linear` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A press reaches a completed step, or the one right after the last completed; optional steps may be skipped. |
| `orientation` | `Bind<StepperOrientation>` | `'horizontal'` | `horizontal` or `vertical`. |
| `labelPosition` | `Bind<StepperLabelPosition>` | `'bottom'` | Horizontal only: the texts under the indicator (`bottom`) or after it (`end`). |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`. |
| `clickable` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false` shows the way only: no buttons, no Tab stop. |
| `showNumbers` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The indicator of a step to come shows its number. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | the kit’s “Steps” | What screen readers call it. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onStepChanging` | event | The current step is about to change (`from`, `to`, `fromItem`, `toItem`, `byUser`). `cancel = true` keeps it; `promise` set to a `Promise<boolean>` waits, and the step changes when it resolves to `true`. |
| `onStepChanged` | event | The current step changed (`index`, `item`, `previous`, `byUser`). |
| `selectedIndex` | read-only | The index of the current step; -1 when there is none. |
| `count` | read-only | How many steps there are. |
| `canGoNext, canGoPrevious` | read-only | There is an enabled step after, or before, the current one. |
| `next(), previous()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Goes to the next or the previous enabled step; `false` when there is none or the change was refused. |
| `goTo(step)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Goes to a step by index or key, whatever the order; `onStepChanging` is asked first. |
| `statusOf(index)` | `StepperStatus` | `pending`, `current`, `done` or `error`, as drawn. |
| `canReach(index)` | `boolean` | Whether a press may reach the step. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Reads the items again after they were changed in place. |

# Wizard

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A task in steps: a [Stepper](stepper.md) above or beside one page per step, and the Back and Next buttons under them. Next validates the page first; on the last step it finishes.

## Import

```tsx
import { Wizard, WizardStep } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Pages from JSX

Each `WizardStep` is a step and its page. Next validates the kit’s fields on the page, then the step’s own `validate`; a page that fails keeps the wizard, marks its step and focuses the first invalid field. On the last step Next reads Finish and raises `onFinished`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { CheckBox, Stack, TextBox, Wizard, WizardStep } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Three pages with the kit's fields: Next validates the page first; Finish tells the app. */
export default function Basic() {
    const s = reactive({ name: '', email: '', city: '', agreed: false, result: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Wizard label="Sign up" onFinished={() => (s.result = `Welcome, ${s.name}.`)}>
                <WizardStep title="Account" description="Who you are">
                    <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                        <TextBox label="Name" x-model={() => s.name} required />
                        <TextBox label="E-mail" x-model={() => s.email} required rules={[{ type: 'email' }]} />
                    </Stack>
                </WizardStep>
                <WizardStep title="Address" description="Where you live">
                    <TextBox label="City" x-model={() => s.city} required />
                </WizardStep>
                <WizardStep title="Review" validate={() => s.agreed}>
                    <p>{() => `${s.name || '—'}, ${s.email || '—'}, ${s.city || '—'}`}</p>
                    <CheckBox label="Everything is right" x-model={() => s.agreed} />
                </WizardStep>
            </Wizard>
            <output class="wz-result">{() => s.result}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## From code

`steps` makes the steps from props, each page from a `content` factory when it is first shown; `add`, `insert` and `remove` change them later. `next()`, `previous()`, `goTo()` and `finish()` move it.

```tsx
import { Component, reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Wizard, WizardStep } from '@motifx-community/ui';

// A page made from code: any MotifJS component.
class Note extends Component<HTMLDivElement, { text: string }> {
    override view() {
        return <p>{this.props.text}</p>;
    }
}

/** A wizard made from code: its steps as props with content factories, moved with its methods, a step added later. */
export default function FromCode() {
    const s = reactive({ told: '' });
    const wizard = new Wizard({
        label: 'Setup',
        steps: [
            { title: 'Welcome', content: () => new Note({ text: 'A page made by a factory, built when first shown.' }) },
            { title: 'Options', description: 'Pick what you need', content: () => new Note({ text: 'The second page.' }) },
            { title: 'Done', content: () => new Note({ text: 'The last page; Next reads Finish here.' }) }
        ],
        onStepChanged: e => (s.told = `Step ${e.index + 1}: ${(e.item as { text: string }).text}`),
        onFinished: () => (s.told = 'Finished.')
    });
    const addStep = () => {
        wizard.insert(2, new WizardStep({ title: 'Extra', optional: true, content: () => new Note({ text: 'Added from code.' }) }));
    };
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <span onConfig={c => c.controls.add(wizard)} />
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button text="Go to Done" variant="outline" onclick={() => void wizard.goTo(wizard.steps.length - 1)} />
                <Button text="Add a step" variant="outline" onclick={addStep} />
                <output class="wz-told">{() => s.told}</output>
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Standing

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Switch, TextArea, Wizard, WizardStep } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The stepper beside the pages, the texts after the indicators. */
export default function Vertical() {
    const s = reactive({ plan: 'Team', notify: true, note: '' });
    return (
        <Wizard label="Subscription" orientation="vertical" style="min-block-size: 16rem; inline-size: 100%">
            <WizardStep title="Plan" description="What you pay for">
                <RadioGroup label="Plan" items={['Solo', 'Team', 'Business']} x-model={() => s.plan} />
            </WizardStep>
            <WizardStep title="Alerts" description="How we reach you">
                <Switch label="Send me a monthly summary" x-model={() => s.notify} />
            </WizardStep>
            <WizardStep title="Notes" optional>
                <TextArea label="Anything else?" x-model={() => s.note} rows={3} />
            </WizardStep>
        </Wizard>
    );
}
```

## Your own buttons, finishing that waits

`showNavigation={false}` takes the bar away; your own buttons call the methods. `onFinishing` may set a `promise`: the wizard finishes when it resolves to `true`, and stays otherwise.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TextBox, Wizard, WizardStep } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** No bar: buttons of your own drive it; finishing waits for a promise (a server) and may be refused. */
export default function Custom() {
    const s = reactive({ code: '', busy: false, note: '' });
    let wizard!: Wizard;
    const finish = () => {
        s.note = '';
        void wizard.finish().then(ok => (s.note = ok ? 'Saved.' : s.note || 'Not finished.'));
    };
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Wizard
                ref={(w: Wizard) => (wizard = w)}
                label="Redeem"
                showNavigation={false}
                labelPosition="end"
                onFinishing={e => {
                    s.busy = true;
                    e.promise = new Promise<boolean>(resolve => setTimeout(() => resolve(s.code.toUpperCase() === 'MOTIF'), 600)).then(ok => {
                        s.busy = false;
                        if (!ok) s.note = 'That code is not known.';
                        return ok;
                    });
                }}
            >
                <WizardStep title="Code">
                    <TextBox label="Gift code" x-model={() => s.code} required placeholder="MOTIF" />
                </WizardStep>
                <WizardStep title="Confirm">
                    <p>{() => `Redeem “${s.code}”?`}</p>
                </WizardStep>
            </Wizard>
            <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
                <Button text="Back" variant="outline" onclick={() => void wizard.previous()} />
                <Button text="Next" variant="outline" onclick={() => void wizard.next()} />
                <Button text="Redeem" busy={() => s.busy} onclick={finish} />
                <output class="wz-note">{() => s.note}</output>
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Stepper` | A `nav` of steps as on the [Stepper](stepper.md) page: each a button with its position and status in its name, one Tab stop. |
| `Page` | A `group` named after its step; the hidden pages are out of the tree. |
| `Validation` | A page that fails keeps focus on its first invalid field, with its message; the step reads “Needs attention”. |
| `Buttons` | The kit’s buttons, named in the kit language: “Back”, “Next”, “Finish”. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-wizard` | The wizard. `data-orientation`. |
| `.mx-wizard__stepper` | The stepper (`.mx-stepper` too). |
| `.mx-wizard__pages, .mx-wizard__page` | The pages and each page; a hidden page carries `hidden`. |
| `.mx-wizard__bar, .mx-wizard__previous, .mx-wizard__next` | The bar and its buttons. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `wizard.frame, .page, .bar` | Units: the whole, a page, the bar (a rule over it, its padding). |
| `wizard.previous, wizard.next` | Places: the buttons’ look in the bar (`variant`). |
| `wizard.gap, .bar-gap, .rail-width` | Between the stepper, the pages and the bar; between the buttons; the stepper’s width when it stands beside the pages. |

## API reference

### Wizard props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | `readonly WizardStepProps[]` | `[]` | Steps made from code, each as the props of a `WizardStep`; the JSX `WizardStep` children come first. |
| `value` | `Bind<string \| number \| null>` | `0` | The current step: its `key`, else its index. `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `linear` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A step is reached only after the ones before it; optional steps may be skipped. |
| `orientation` | `Bind<StepperOrientation>` | `'horizontal'` | `horizontal`: the stepper above the pages; `vertical`: beside them. |
| `labelPosition` | `Bind<StepperLabelPosition>` | `'bottom'` | Where the stepper’s texts sit, horizontal only. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | The stepper’s size. |
| `showStepper, showNavigation` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The stepper, and the bar with the Back and Next buttons. |
| `clickable` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The steps of the stepper can be pressed. |
| `lazy` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A page is built when first shown, then kept (a step’s own `lazy` wins). |
| `keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false`: what a step’s `content` made is disposed while hidden and made again when it shows (a step’s own `keepAlive` wins). |
| `previousText, nextText, finishText` | `Bind<string>` | the kit’s “Back”, “Next”, “Finish” | The buttons’ texts. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | the kit’s “Steps” | What screen readers call the stepper. |

### WizardStep props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The step’s text in the stepper. The same property as `text`. |
| `description` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | A second line under the title. |
| `key` | `Bind<string>` | the index | Names the step in `value`; the JSX `key` works too. |
| `icon` | `Bind<IconSource \| null>` | `null` | Drawn in the indicator in place of the number. |
| `optional` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | May be skipped; says so under the title. |
| `enabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | `false` keeps the step from being reached. |
| `error` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Draws the step with an error; the wizard sets it when the page does not validate, and clears it when it does. |
| `validateFields` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The kit’s fields on the page are validated before the wizard moves on from it; the first invalid one takes focus. |
| `validate` | `() => boolean \| Promise<boolean>` | — | Asked after the fields; `false` keeps the page and marks the step. |
| `lazy, keepAlive` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | the wizard’s | See the wizard’s. |
| `content` | `() => ComponentBase \| ComponentBase[]` | — | Makes the page from code, when the page is built. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onStepChanging, onStepChanged` | event | The stepper’s events: `onStepChanging` (`cancel`, `promise`) runs before the page is validated. |
| `onFinishing` | event | The last page validated and the wizard is about to finish; `cancel = true` keeps it open, `promise` waits and finishes on `true`. |
| `onFinished` | event | The wizard finished: every step is drawn done. |
| `next(), previous(), goTo(step)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Next validates the page first and finishes on the last step; Back validates nothing; `goTo` validates when it goes forward. |
| `finish()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Validates the page, asks `onFinishing`, then finishes. |
| `leaveCheck()` | `Promise<boolean>` | Validates the current page the way Next does, without moving. |
| `add(step), insert(index, step), remove(step)` | `WizardStep` / `boolean` | Steps from code; a step of another wizard moves here. |
| `stepper, steps, currentStep, selectedIndex` | read-only | The `Stepper`, the `WizardStep`s in order, the current one and its index. |
| `isLast, isFinished` | read-only | The current step is the last that can be gone to (Next finishes); the wizard finished. |
| `previousButton, nextButton` | read-only | The kit’s buttons in the bar, for an icon or a look of your own. |
