# Sortable

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Items the user puts in order by dragging them, with the pointer or a finger, or with the keys; lists of one group take each other’s items. A drop moves the element and tells you the indexes: your data stays yours.

## Import

```tsx
import { Sortable } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Children as items

The JSX children are the items. Drag one, or focus it and press Ctrl + Down; `onReorder` says from where to where, and the app reorders its own data.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Panel, Sortable, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Rows put in order by dragging, or with Ctrl + an arrow on the focused row; the app reorders its data when told. */
export default function Basic() {
    const s = reactive({ steps: ['Collect the order', 'Pack it', 'Print the label', 'Hand it over'], told: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Sortable
                label="Steps"
                class="so-steps"
                onReorder={e => {
                    const next = s.steps.slice();
                    next.splice(e.toIndex, 0, ...next.splice(e.fromIndex, 1));
                    s.steps = next;
                    s.told = `"${next[e.toIndex]}" is step ${e.toIndex + 1} now`;
                }}
            >
                <Panel variant="outline" padding="sm">
                    Collect the order
                </Panel>
                <Panel variant="outline" padding="sm">
                    Pack it
                </Panel>
                <Panel variant="outline" padding="sm">
                    Print the label
                </Panel>
                <Panel variant="outline" padding="sm">
                    Hand it over
                </Panel>
            </Sortable>
            <output class="so-told">{() => s.told || `Order: ${s.steps.join(' → ')}`}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Items from data, across lists

`items` with an `itemTemplate` draws the rows from your data and keeps each row as the order changes. Two sortables of one `group` take each other’s items: `onRemove` and `onAdd` tell both sides, and each list draws its array again.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Panel, Sortable, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Task {
    id: number;
    title: string;
}

// A task as a row.
const row = (task: Task) => {
    const panel = new Panel({ variant: 'outline', padding: 'sm' });
    panel.element.textContent = task.title;
    return panel;
};

/** Two lists of one group take each other's items; each list draws its own data and the app moves the task between arrays when told. */
export default function Groups() {
    const s = reactive({
        todo: [{ id: 1, title: 'Write the brief' }, { id: 2, title: 'Book the room' }, { id: 3, title: 'Send the invites' }] as Task[],
        done: [{ id: 4, title: 'Pick the date' }] as Task[]
    });
    const reorder = (key: 'todo' | 'done') => (e: { fromIndex: number; toIndex: number }) => {
        const next = s[key].slice();
        next.splice(e.toIndex, 0, ...next.splice(e.fromIndex, 1));
        s[key] = next;
    };
    // The item leaves one array when removed and joins the other when added: the lists draw themselves again.
    const remove = (key: 'todo' | 'done') => (e: { fromIndex: number }) => (s[key] = s[key].filter((_, i) => i !== e.fromIndex));
    const add = (key: 'todo' | 'done') => (e: { item: Task; toIndex: number }) => {
        const next = s[key].slice();
        next.splice(e.toIndex, 0, e.item);
        s[key] = next;
    };
    return (
        <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap="lg" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Stack gap="sm" grow>
                <strong>To do</strong>
                <Sortable<Task> label="To do" class="so-todo" group="tasks" items={() => s.todo} itemTemplate={row} onReorder={reorder('todo')} onRemove={remove('todo')} onAdd={add('todo')} style="min-block-size: 8rem" />
            </Stack>
            <Stack gap="sm" grow>
                <strong>Done</strong>
                <Sortable<Task> label="Done" class="so-done" group="tasks" items={() => s.done} itemTemplate={row} onReorder={reorder('done')} onRemove={remove('done')} onAdd={add('done')} style="min-block-size: 8rem" />
            </Stack>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## A handle, side by side, a refused drag

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Chip, Sortable, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Chips side by side, moved by their handle only (the dots), with Ctrl + Left / Right on the handle; a drag may be refused. */
export default function Handle() {
    const s = reactive({ tags: ['Design', 'Build', 'Test', 'Ship', 'Locked'], told: '' });
    return (
        <Stack gap="md" style="inline-size: 100%">
            <Sortable
                label="Tags"
                class="so-tags"
                orientation="horizontal"
                handle=".so-grip"
                items={() => s.tags}
                itemTemplate={tag => {
                    const chip = new Chip({ text: tag });
                    const grip = document.createElement('span');
                    grip.className = 'mx-glyph so-grip';
                    grip.dataset.icon = 'drag-dots';
                    grip.setAttribute('aria-label', `Move ${tag}`);
                    chip.element.prepend(grip);
                    return chip;
                }}
                onDragStarting={e => {
                    if (e.item === 'Locked') {
                        e.cancel = true;
                        s.told = 'Locked stays where it is.';
                    }
                }}
                onReorder={e => {
                    const next = s.tags.slice();
                    next.splice(e.toIndex, 0, ...next.splice(e.fromIndex, 1));
                    s.tags = next;
                    s.told = next.join(', ');
                }}
            />
            <output class="so-tags-told">{() => s.told}</output>
        </Stack>
    );
}
```

## Behaviour

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Dragging` | With the pointer after a few pixels; with a finger after a long press (a finger that moves before that scrolls). A copy follows the pointer, the item stays faint in its place, a line shows where it would land; the list scrolls near its edges. |
| `Dropping` | The item’s element moves there at once and `onReorder` says from where to where: your data is yours to reorder. Across sortables of a group, `onRemove` and `onAdd` say the same on both sides. |
| `Items from data` | With `items`, each item keeps its component as the order changes (the rows are keyed by item): reordering your array moves the rows, no row is made again. |
| `Keys` | The focused item (its handle when there is one) takes Ctrl + Up / Down (Left / Right side by side), Ctrl + Home / End; each move is told to `onReorder` and read out. |
| `Escape` | Cancels a drag; nothing moves. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `List` | A `group` named by `label`; the items are whatever you put in it. |
| `Items` | One Tab stop that moves between the items with the keys; an item with a focusable part of its own keeps that. A handle is a button named by you. |
| `Moves` | Each move by the keys is read out: “Moved to 2 of 5”. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-sortable` | The list. `data-orientation`, `data-sortable`, `data-drop-target` while a dragged item may land here. |
| `.mx-sortable__item` | Each item. `data-dragging` on the one being dragged. |
| `.mx-sortable__line` | The line where a drop would land. |
| `.mx-sortable__ghost` | The copy after the pointer. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `sortable.container, .item, .line, .ghost` | Units: the list (`target`), an item (`sortable`, `dragging`, `focus`), the line (its thickness and colour; standing in a horizontal list), the copy. |
| `sortable.gap` | Between the items. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` | — | The items, each drawn with `itemTemplate`; without them the JSX children are the items. |
| `itemTemplate` | `(item, index) => ComponentBase` | the item’s text | Makes an item’s component. A function, so it is not bound like the other props. |
| `handle` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | A selector inside an item that takes the drag and the keys; without one the whole item does. |
| `group` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | Sortables of one group take each other’s items. |
| `allowReordering` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The items can be moved; `false` leaves them as they are. |
| `orientation` | `Bind<SortableOrientation>` | `'vertical'` | `vertical` or `horizontal`: the drop line and the move keys follow. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | What screen readers call the list. |

### Events, properties and methods

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onDragStarting` | event | A drag (or a move by the keys) is about to start (`item`, `fromIndex`); `cancel = true` refuses. |
| `onDragChanging` | event | The place it would land changed (`to`, `toIndex`); `cancel = true` refuses that place. |
| `onDragEnding` | event | About to drop; `cancel = true` leaves everything as it was. |
| `onReorder` | event | An item moved within this sortable (`fromIndex`, `toIndex`, `item`), by a drop or the keys. Reorder your data here. |
| `onRemove, onAdd` | event | An item went to another sortable of the group, and came into one: `from`, `to`, the indexes and the item. Move the data between your arrays here. |
| `move(fromIndex, toIndex)` | `boolean` | Moves an item from code as a drop would, telling `onReorder`. |
| `elements` | read-only | The items’ elements, in order. |
| `isDragging` | read-only | An item is being dragged. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Reads the items again after they were changed in place. |

# FormLayout

> Navigation · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Lays out the fields of a data object on a grid. Each field gets an editor — by name, or by the type of its value — bound to the object both ways; groups, spans and buttons arrange them; sending the form checks every field first.

## Import

```tsx
import { FormLayout, type FormItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## A form over an object

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { FormLayout, type FormItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';

const countries = [
  { value: 'TR', text: 'Türkiye' },
  { value: 'DE', text: 'Germany' },
  { value: 'FR', text: 'France' },
];

/** The fields of a customer on two columns: editors by name or by value, a group, a field shown on a condition, a Save button that checks first. */
export default function CustomerForm() {
  const customer = reactive({
    name: 'Ada Lovelace',
    email: '',
    phone: '',
    birthday: null as Date | null,
    country: 'TR' as string | null,
    city: 'İstanbul',
    vip: false,
    credit: 1000,
    note: '',
  });
  const s = reactive({ result: '' });

  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: '&Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email', required: true },
    { field: 'phone', label: 'Phone', editorProps: { mask: '(000) 000 00 00', type: 'tel' } },
    { field: 'birthday', label: 'Birthday', editor: 'date', editorProps: { max: new Date() } },
    {
      group: 'Address',
      columns: 2,
      items: [
        { field: 'country', label: 'Country', editor: 'dropdown', editorProps: { items: countries } },
        { field: 'city', label: 'City' },
      ],
    },
    { field: 'vip', label: 'VIP customer', editor: 'switch' },
    { field: 'credit', label: 'Credit limit', editorProps: { format: { style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY' }, min: 0 }, visible: () => customer.vip },
    { field: 'note', label: 'Note', editor: 'textarea', colSpan: 'all' },
    { button: { text: 'Save', tone: 'accent', submit: true } },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <FormLayout
        data={customer}
        columns={2}
        items={items}
        onValidSubmit={() => (s.result = `Saved ${customer.name}.`)}
        onInvalidSubmit={(e) => (s.result = `${e.invalid.length} field(s) to fix.`)}
      />
      <output class="fl-result">{() => s.result}</output>
      <output class="fl-data">{() => `${customer.name} · ${customer.email || '—'} · ${customer.city} · vip: ${customer.vip}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Editors

By name: `text`, `password`, `email`, `textarea`, `number`, `date`, `datetime`, `time`, `checkbox`, `switch`, `dropdown`, `combobox`, `lookup`, `radio`, `slider`. Left out, the value picks it: a number gets a NumberBox, a boolean a CheckBox, a Date a DateBox, anything else a TextBox. `editorProps` go to the editor. Your own editors are registered once:

```tsx
FormLayout.editors.set('color', (props) => new ColorPicker(props));
{ field: 'tint', label: 'Tint', editor: 'color' }
```

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | `Bind<T \| null>` | — | The object the editors show and change. |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly FormItem[]>` | `[]` | The places of the form; a function is followed. |
| `columns` | `Bind<number>` | `1` | Columns of the grid. |
| `minColumnWidth` | `Bind<string>` | — | As many columns as fit, each at least this wide. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | `'top'` | Passed to every editor. |
| `readOnly` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Every editor read-only. |
| `onValidSubmit(e) / onInvalidSubmit(e)` |  |  | Sent and passed (`{ data, event }`) / sent and failed (`{ valid, invalid }`). |

### FormItem

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `field, label, editor, editorProps` | The property, its caption, its editor and the editor’s props. |
| `required, rules, helpText, enabled, readOnly, visible` | Passed to the editor (each a value or a function); `visible` hides the place. |
| `colSpan` | Columns it spans; `'all'` for the whole row. |
| `group, items, columns` | A captioned group with its own columns. |
| `button` | Button props; `submit: true` sends the form. |
| `template` | Any component made for the place. |

### Members

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `validate(), resetValidation(), submit()` | Check every field, hide the outcome, send the form. |
| `editorOf(field)` | The editor of a field. |
| `refresh()` | Your data object and items may be plain or reactive; the form reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. Every editor reads its value again, the items their texts and states; items added or removed draw the form again. |
| `refreshField(field)` | Reads one field of the data object again, after it was changed in place. |
| `validationGroup, isValid` | The group the fields are checked in. |
| `FormLayout.editors` | The editors known by name. |

# TreeView

> Data · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A tree view shows items in a hierarchy. Rows open and close, are selected one or many at a time, can carry check boxes that add up to their parents, can be searched, and can load their children when they are first opened. Long trees draw only the rows in view.

## Import

```tsx
import { TreeView } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## From JSX and from code

Items are objects with a `children` array (or a `parentId`, see below). `value` is the selected row's key and `x-model` binds it two-way. Created with `new`, the tree is filled and driven from code; items changed in place, plain or reactive, show after `refresh()` (`refreshItem(key)` for one row).

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## File explorer: children that load

`loadChildren` loads a row's children the first time it opens; `hasChildren: false` marks a row with nothing to load. While loading the row is busy; when the load fails it says so and offers a retry (here “Shared” fails once). Icons come from `iconField`, here a function.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Selection

`selectionMode` is `single` (default), `multiple` or `none`. With `multiple`, Ctrl (⌘) + press adds or removes a row, Shift + press selects a range, and the keys follow the APG multi-select tree.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Check boxes: a permissions tree

`showCheckBoxes` puts a check box on every row. Checking a parent checks its children and a parent shows mixed while only some are (`checkRecursive`, on by default). `checkedKeys` gives and reports the checked rows; Space toggles the focused one.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Search and filter

`searchEnabled` adds a search box; matches show with their parents, opened, and clearing the search brings the rows back as they were. `searchValue` (or `filter(text)`) filters from code; `searchMode` is `contains` or `startswith`.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Flat data, fields and templates

Flat rows name their parent (`parentField`, default `parentId`). Any field can be a property name or a function. `itemTemplate` draws a row's content; `enabledField` and `expandedField` act per row.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Large trees

Only open rows are drawn, and with more than `virtualFrom` (500) rows on screen only the rows in view are: here 50 departments of 200 people, 10,050 rows when all are open. Give the tree a height so it scrolls inside.

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Sizes, lines and opening

```tsx
/** A row of the trees on this page. */
export interface Entry {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  folder?: boolean;
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  children?: Entry[];
  enabled?: boolean;
  expanded?: boolean;
  count?: number;
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Into the tree, to the focused (else the selected, else the first) row; out again. One Tab stop. |
| `Down / Up` | The next / previous row on screen. |
| `Right` | Opens a closed row; on an open one, goes to its first child. Left in right-to-left pages. |
| `Left` | Closes an open row; on a closed one, goes to its parent. Right in right-to-left pages. |
| `Home / End, Page Up / Page Down` | The first / last row; a page up or down. |
| `*` | Opens every sibling of the row. |
| `A letter` | The next row whose text starts with it (type several quickly for a longer start). |
| `Enter` | Selects the row (only it, with `multiple`). |
| `Space` | Toggles the check box when shown; otherwise selects (toggles, with `multiple`). |
| `Shift + Down / Up` | With `multiple`: moves and toggles the next row. |
| `Shift + Space, Ctrl + Shift + Home / End, Ctrl + A` | With `multiple`: selects from the last selected row, up to the first / last row, everything. |
| `Down in the search box` | Into the tree. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Tree` | `role="tree"`, named by `label` (or `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` on the tag); `aria-multiselectable` with `multiple`. |
| `Rows` | `role="treeitem"` with `aria-level`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-posinset`, `aria-expanded` on parents, `aria-selected` (unless `none`), `aria-checked` (`true`, `false`, `mixed`) with check boxes, `aria-disabled`. |
| `Children` | An open row holds a `role="group"` with its children. A long tree draws its rows flat, with the same levels and positions. |
| `Loading` | A row whose children load has `aria-busy="true"`; a failed load is described by its message (`aria-describedby`). |
| `Focus` | Roving `tabindex`: one row is in the Tab order. The focus ring shows for the keyboard only. |

## Localization

The tree writes four texts, all from `uiLocale.strings`: `noItems` (nothing to show), `loadFailed` and `retry` (a failed load) and `search` (the search box).

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { kitTexts } from '../../../shared/kit-texts';

/** Switches the texts of the kit; the trees on the page follow at once. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <span>
        A failed load reads <output class="tv-failed">{() => `${kitTexts.strings.loadFailed} ${kitTexts.strings.retry}`}</output>
      </span>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-tree-view` | The root. `data-size`, `data-lines`, `data-checkboxes`, `data-windowed`, `data-empty`, `data-disabled`. |
| `.mx-tree-view__search, .mx-tree-view__body, .mx-tree-view__empty` | The search box, the tree, the empty text. |
| `.mx-tree-view__item` | A row and its children: `data-selected`, `data-expanded`, `data-branch`, `data-state`, `data-loading`, `data-error`, `data-disabled`; `--_level`. |
| `.mx-tree-view__row` | The painted row. |
| `.mx-tree-view__expander, __check, __icon, __text` | The parts of a row. |
| `.mx-tree-view__group` | The children of an open row. |
| `.mx-tree-view__error, .mx-tree-view__retry` | A failed load and its retry button. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `treeview.row, treeview.indicator, treeview.expander, treeview.expander-icon, treeview.spinner` | Units: a row in each state (`hover`, `pressed`, `selected`, `selected-hover`, `focus`, `disabled`), the selection mark, the arrow and its plate, the loading ring. |
| `treeview.check, treeview.mark, treeview.icon, treeview.text, treeview.error, treeview.retry, treeview.empty, treeview.container, treeview.body` | Units: the check box (`hover`, `checked`, `checked-hover`, `disabled`, `checked-disabled`) and the other parts. |
| `treeview.row-height.*, treeview.padding.*, treeview.font-size.*, treeview.line-height.*, treeview.indent.*` | Sizes per size class, and how far each level moves in. |
| `treeview.row-spacing, treeview.expander-plate` | The space between two rows; the arrow's plate the lines are centred under. |
| `treeview.line-width, treeview.line-color, treeview.elbow-length, treeview.elbow-color` | The lines (`showLines`). |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` | `[]` | Nested items (a `children` array) or flat ones (a `parentId`). A function is followed; items changed in place show after `refresh()`. |
| `textField, keyField, childrenField, parentField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | `'text'`, `'id'`, `'children'`, `'parentId'` | A property name or a function `(item) => …`. An item without a key is its own key. `parentField` (or items with a `parentId`) makes the list flat. |
| `iconField, enabledField, expandedField, hasChildrenField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | `'icon'`, `'enabled'`, `'expanded'`, `'hasChildren'` | Per item: an icon, a row that cannot be selected or checked, a row open from the start (a change there opens or closes it), a row that has no children to load. |
| `loadChildren` | `Bind<(item) => Promise<T[]>>` | — | Loads a row's children when it is first opened; the row is busy meanwhile and offers a retry when it fails. |
| `selectionMode` | `Bind<'none' \| 'single' \| 'multiple'>` | `'single'` | How many rows can be selected. |
| `value` | `Bind<unknown>` | `null` | The selected key (`single`) or keys (`multiple`). `x-model` binds it two-way. |
| `expandedKeys` | `Bind<unknown[]>` | `[]` | The open rows. `onExpanded` / `onCollapsed` report the user's changes. |
| `showCheckBoxes` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A check box on every row. |
| `checkRecursive` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Checking a parent checks its children; a parent is mixed when some are checked. |
| `checkedKeys` | `Bind<unknown[]>` | `[]` | The checked rows (a parent is in it when all its children are). `onCheckChanged` reports changes. |
| `searchEnabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A search box at the top. |
| `searchMode` | `Bind<'contains' \| 'startswith'>` | `'contains'` | How the search matches the row text. |
| `searchValue` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The text the rows are filtered by. Matches show with their parents, opened. |
| `expandOn` | `Bind<'expander' \| 'click' \| 'dblclick'>` | `'expander'` | What opens a branch besides its arrow and the keys. |
| `showLines` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Lines under each parent, down to its children. |
| `size` | `Bind<ControlSize>` | `'md'` | `sm`, `md`, `lg`, from the density tokens. |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The tree's accessible name. `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` on the tag work too. |
| `virtualFrom` | `Bind<number>` | `500` | With more rows on screen than this, only the rows in view are drawn. |
| `itemTemplate` | `Bind<(item, host) => cleanup \| void>` | — | Draws a row's content yourself. |
| `enabled / disabled, visible, tabStop, tabIndex` | see Control |  | The shared properties of every control. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `selectedItems, checkedItems` | read-only, reactive | The selected / checked items, in tree order. |
| `treeElement` | read-only | The element with `role="tree"`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expand(key), collapse(key)` | `boolean` | Opens / closes a row; children load first if they have to. The cancelable events run. |
| `expandAll(), collapseAll()` | `void` | Every row whose children are known. No event per row. |
| `select(key), unselect(key), selectAll(), clearSelection()` | `void` | From code; `select` adds to the selection with `multiple`. |
| `check(key, checked?), uncheck(key), checkAll(), uncheckAll()` | `void` | From code. |
| `filter(text)` | `void` | Sets `searchValue`. |
| `scrollTo(key), focusNode(key)` | `boolean` | Opens the row's parents and scrolls it into view (and focuses it). |
| `reload(key?)` | `void` | Loads a row's children again (all loaded children without a key). |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items may be plain or reactive; the tree reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. Which items there are, their children, texts and states are read again; children that loaded stay. |
| `refreshItem(key)` | `void` | Draws one row again after its item was changed in place: its text, icon and state. `refresh()` for its children. |
| `itemOf(key)` | `T \| undefined` | The item with that key. |
| `focus()` | `boolean` | Focuses the row Tab reaches. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onExpanding(e), onCollapsing(e)` | A row is about to open / close. `e`: `{ item, key, byUser, cancel, source, event? }`; `e.cancel = true` leaves it. |
| `onExpanded(e), onCollapsed(e)` | A row opened / closed. `e`: `{ item, key, byUser, source }`. |
| `onSelectionChanged(e)` | `{ value, items, byUser, source, event? }` |
| `onCheckChanged(e)` | `{ item, key, state, keys, byUser, source }`; `item` is `null` when many changed at once. |
| `onItemClick(e)` | A row was pressed, or Enter was pressed on it. `{ item, key, source, event }` |

## Example files

`FromCode.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Panel, Stack, TreeView } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import type { Entry } from './entry';
import { project } from './project';

const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 26rem; background: var(--mx-color-bg-card)';

/** A tree bound with x-model, and a tree made with `new` whose items change in place and are read again on `refresh()`. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const s = reactive({ file: 'tree' as unknown, clicked: '' });
  const menu = reactive<Entry[]>([
    { id: 'home', text: 'Home' },
    { id: 'products', text: 'Products', children: [{ id: 'new', text: 'New' }] },
  ]);
  let added = 0;

  const tree = new TreeView<Entry>({ items: menu, label: 'Menu', selectionMode: 'none' });
  tree.onItemClick((e) => (s.clicked = `Pressed “${e.item.text}”.`));

  const addProduct = () => {
    added++;
    menu[1].children!.push({ id: `p${added}`, text: `Product ${added}` });
    tree.refresh();
    tree.expand('products');
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX}>
        <TreeView class="tv-ways" label="Project files" items={project()} expandedKeys={['src', 'components']} x-model={() => s.file} />
      </Panel>
      <output class="tv-value">{() => `value: ${JSON.stringify(s.file)}`}</output>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Add a product from code" variant="outline" onclick={addProduct} />
        <Button text="Expand all" variant="ghost" onclick={() => tree.expandAll()} />
        <Button text="Collapse all" variant="ghost" onclick={() => tree.collapseAll()} />
        <output class="tv-clicked">{() => s.clicked}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX} ref={(p: Panel) => p.controls.add(tree)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

`FileExplorer.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Panel, TreeView } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import type { Entry } from './entry';
import { FILE, FOLDER, icon } from './icon';

const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 26rem; background: var(--mx-color-bg-card)';

/** A made-up disk: each folder's entries. */
const DISK: Record<string, string[]> = {
  '/': ['Documents/', 'Pictures/', 'Shared/', 'notes.txt'],
  '/Documents/': ['Invoices/', 'Letters/', 'plan.docx'],
  '/Documents/Invoices/': ['2025/', '2026/'],
  '/Documents/Invoices/2025/': ['january.pdf', 'february.pdf'],
  '/Documents/Invoices/2026/': ['march.pdf'],
  '/Documents/Letters/': [],
  '/Pictures/': ['holiday.jpg', 'cat.png'],
  '/Shared/': ['team.xlsx'],
};

function entriesOf(path: string): Entry[] {
  return (DISK[path] ?? []).map((name) => {
    const folder = name.endsWith('/');
    return { id: path + name, text: folder ? name.slice(0, -1) : name, folder, hasChildren: folder };
  });
}

/** Children loaded when a folder first opens, with a load that fails once (Shared) and a retry. */
export default function FileExplorer() {
  const s = reactive({ opened: '', loads: 0 });
  let failed = false;

  const loadChildren = (entry: Entry) =>
    new Promise<Entry[]>((resolve, reject) => {
      s.loads++;
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (entry.id === '/Shared/' && !failed) {
          failed = true;
          reject(new Error('The share is offline.'));
        } else {
          resolve(entriesOf(entry.id));
        }
      }, 500);
    });

  return (
    <>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX}>
        <TreeView
          class="tv-lazy"
          label="Disk"
          items={[{ id: '/', text: 'My disk', folder: true }]}
          loadChildren={loadChildren}
          iconField={(entry: Entry) => icon(entry.folder ? FOLDER : FILE)}
          expandOn="dblclick"
          onExpanded={(e) => (s.opened = `Opened ${e.item.text}.`)}
        />
      </Panel>
      <output class="tv-loads">{() => `Loads: ${s.loads}. ${s.opened}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

`icon.ts`

```tsx
const SVG = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';

export const FOLDER = 'M1.5 3.5h5l1.5 1.5h6.5v8h-13z';
export const FILE = 'M3.5 1.5h6l3 3v10h-9zM9.5 1.5v3h3';

/** A small outline icon, a new element for each row. */
export function icon(path: string): SVGSVGElement {
  const svg = document.createElementNS(SVG, 'svg');
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 16 16');
  const line = svg.appendChild(document.createElementNS(SVG, 'path'));
  line.setAttribute('d', path);
  line.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
  line.setAttribute('stroke', 'currentColor');
  line.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.2');
  line.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin', 'round');
  return svg;
}
```

```tsx
    </>
  );
```

```tsx
const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 26rem; background: var(--mx-color-bg-card)';

const PERMISSIONS = (): Entry[] => [
  {
    id: 'admin',
    text: 'Administration',
    expanded: true,
    children: [
      { id: 'users', text: 'Users', children: [{ id: 'users.view', text: 'View' }, { id: 'users.edit', text: 'Edit' }, { id: 'users.delete', text: 'Delete' }] },

    expanded: true,
    children: [

      { id: 'media', text: 'Media', children: [{ id: 'media.upload', text: 'Upload' }, { id: 'media.delete', text: 'Delete' }] },

/** A permissions tree with check boxes that add up to their parents, the checked keys bound both ways. */

          ref={(t: TreeView<Entry>) => (tree = t)}
          class="tv-checks"
          label="Permissions"
          items={PERMISSIONS()}
          showCheckBoxes
          selectionMode="none"
          checkRecursive={() => s.recursive}
          checkedKeys={() => s.checked}
          onCheckChanged={(e) => (s.checked = e.keys)}
```

`FlatData.tsx`

```tsx
import { Panel, TreeView } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import type { Entry } from './entry';

const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 26rem; background: var(--mx-color-bg-card)';

const FLAT = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Company', parent: null },
  { id: 2, name: 'Sales', parent: 1 },
  { id: 3, name: 'Engineering', parent: 1 },
  { id: 4, name: 'Web', parent: 3 },
  { id: 5, name: 'Mobile', parent: 3 },
];

const MAIL: Entry[] = [
  { id: 'inbox', text: 'Inbox', count: 12, expanded: true, children: [{ id: 'work', text: 'Work', count: 3 }, { id: 'family', text: 'Family' }] },
  { id: 'sent', text: 'Sent' },
  { id: 'spam', text: 'Spam', count: 99, enabled: false },
];

/** Flat rows that name their parent, a text field given as a function, and rows drawn by a template. */
export default function FlatData() {
  const withCount = (item: Entry, host: HTMLElement) => {
    host.append(item.text);
    if (item.count) {
      const badge = document.createElement('strong');
      badge.textContent = ` · ${item.count}`;
      host.append(badge);
    }
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX}>
        <TreeView class="tv-flat" label="Company" items={FLAT} parentField="parent" textField={(row: (typeof FLAT)[number]) => row.name} expandedKeys={[1, 3]} />
      </Panel>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX}>
        <TreeView class="tv-template" label="Mail" items={MAIL} itemTemplate={withCount} />
      </Panel>
    </>
  );
}
```

`SizesAndLines.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Panel, Stack, TreeView } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import type { Entry } from './entry';
import { FILE, FOLDER, icon } from './icon';
import { project } from './project';

const BOX = 'inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 26rem; background: var(--mx-color-bg-card)';

/** Row sizes, lines under the parents, and what opens a row. */
export default function SizesAndLines() {
  const s = reactive({ size: 'md' as 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg', lines: true, expandOn: 'expander' as 'expander' | 'click' | 'dblclick' });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Size">
        {(['sm', 'md', 'lg'] as const).map((size) => (
          <Button
            key={size}
            text={size}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.size === size ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.size === size}
            onclick={() => (s.size = size)}
          />
        ))}
        <Button text="Lines" size="sm" variant="outline" toggle x-model={() => s.lines} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" role="group" aria-label="Opens on">
        {(['expander', 'click', 'dblclick'] as const).map((how) => (
          <Button
            key={how}
            text={`expandOn ${how}`}
            size="sm"
            variant={() => (s.expandOn === how ? 'solid' : 'ghost')}
            aria-pressed={() => s.expandOn === how}
            onclick={() => (s.expandOn = how)}
          />
        ))}
      </Stack>
      <Panel variant="outline" padding="xxs" style={BOX}>
        <TreeView
          class="tv-look"
          label="Look"
          items={project()}
          expandedKeys={['src', 'components', 'docs']}
          size={() => s.size}
          showLines={() => s.lines}
          expandOn={() => s.expandOn}
          iconField={(entry: Entry) => icon(entry.folder ? FOLDER : FILE)}
        />
      </Panel>
    </>
  );
}
```

# ListBox

> Data · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A list that stays on the page. One item or several are chosen with the keys or the pointer; items come from memory or from a data source, can be searched and grouped, and long lists draw only the rows in view.

## Import

```tsx
import { ListBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
```

## From JSX and from code

`items` can be plain values; `x-model` binds the value. Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
/** The cities the lists of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Several items

With `selectionMode` set to `'multiple'` the value is an array, and every change writes a new one. Each switch below is a prop you can bind.

```tsx
/** The cities the lists of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Objects, groups, templates

Objects of your own are read through `textField` and `valueField`; `groupField` puts items under headers, `enabledField` keeps some from being chosen, and `itemTemplate` draws an item your way.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ListBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Country {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  region: string;
  flag: string;
  member?: boolean;
}

const countries: Country[] = [
  { code: 'TR', name: 'Türkiye', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇹🇷' },
  { code: 'DE', name: 'Germany', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇩🇪' },
  { code: 'FR', name: 'France', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇫🇷' },
  { code: 'NO', name: 'Norway', region: 'Europe', flag: '🇳🇴', member: false },
  { code: 'JP', name: 'Japan', region: 'Asia', flag: '🇯🇵' },
  { code: 'KR', name: 'Korea', region: 'Asia', flag: '🇰🇷' },
  { code: 'BR', name: 'Brazil', region: 'Americas', flag: '🇧🇷' },
  { code: 'CA', name: 'Canada', region: 'Americas', flag: '🇨🇦' },
];

/** Objects read through textField and valueField, under group headers, one that cannot be chosen, drawn with a template. */
export default function Countries() {
  const form = reactive({ country: 'JP' as string | null });
  return (
    <>
      <ListBox
        label="Country"
        items={countries}
        textField="name"
        valueField="code"
        groupField="region"
        enabledField={(c: Country) => c.member !== false}
        itemTemplate={(c: Country, host: HTMLElement) => {
          host.textContent = `${c.flag}  ${c.name}`;
        }}
        height={8}
        x-model={() => form.country}
      />
      <output class="lb-country">{() => `code: ${form.country ?? '—'}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## From a data source

With `dataSource` the list reads a `DataSource` of the data layer, and the search goes to it (its `searchFields`). In `'blocks'` mode only the rows in view load while the list scrolls; chosen values on rows not loaded yet stay chosen, and “Select all” loads the values of every matching row. This one holds 5,000 orders.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { ListBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Order {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

const rows: Order[] = Array.from({ length: 5000 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, name: `Order #${String(i + 1).padStart(5, '0')}` }));

/** 5,000 orders from a data source, loaded in blocks while the list scrolls and searched where they live. */
export default function Orders() {
  const form = reactive({ orders: [42, 4321] as number[] });
  const orders = new data.DataSource<Order, number>({
    adapter: new data.ArrayAdapter({ data: rows, key: 'id' }),
    loadMode: 'blocks',
    pageSize: 50,
    searchFields: ['name'],
  });

  return (
    <>
      <ListBox
        label="Orders"
        dataSource={orders}
        textField="name"
        valueField="id"
        selectionMode="multiple"
        selectAll
        searchEnabled
        height={10}
        x-model={() => form.orders}
      />
      <output class="lb-orders">{() => `${form.orders.length} chosen${form.orders.length && form.orders.length < 6 ? `: ${form.orders.join(', ')}` : ''}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Validation and states

```tsx
/** The cities the lists of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | The list is one Tab stop; the search box, when on, is another. |
| `Down, Up, Home, End, Page Down, Page Up` | Move the highlight; items that cannot be chosen are skipped. Single: the item is chosen too. |
| `A letter` | The next item starting with it; letters typed quickly search together. |
| `Space, Enter` | Single: choose the highlighted item. Multiple: choose it or let it go. |
| `Shift + Down / Up` | Multiple: move and choose or let go of the next item. |
| `Shift + Space` | Multiple: choose every item from the last one chosen to the highlighted one. |
| `Control + Shift + Home / End` | Multiple: choose every item from the highlighted one to the first / last. |
| `Control + A` | Multiple: choose every item, or none when all are chosen. |
| `Down in the search box` | Go to the list. |
| `Control + click, Shift + click` | Multiple: add or take away one item; choose the items between. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Pattern` | The APG listbox: the list is `role="listbox"`, focused itself; `aria-activedescendant` names the highlighted option. |
| `Options` | `role="option"` with `aria-selected`; disabled ones `aria-disabled`. Multiple lists are `aria-multiselectable`. |
| `Name` | The label names the list (`aria-labelledby`); help and errors describe it, `aria-invalid` and `aria-required` tell its state. |
| `Groups` | Each group is `role="group"` named by its header. |
| `Long lists` | Only the rows in view are drawn; each option says where it is with `aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize`; rows still loading are `aria-busy`. |
| `Focus` | The highlight shows while the list is in use; with the keys it also gets the focus ring. |

## Localization

“Select all”, the search box, “No items” and “Loading…” come from `uiLocale.strings` (`selectAll`, `search`, `noItems`, `loading`).

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ListBox, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Switches the texts of every list on the page: “Select all”, the search box, “No items”. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <ListBox label="Fruit" items={['Apple', 'Cherry', 'Pear']} selectionMode="multiple" selectAll searchEnabled />
      <ListBox label="Empty" items={[]} height={3} />
    </>
  );
}
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-list-box` | Added to the field. `data-selection-mode`, `data-check-boxes`; the field attributes of TextBox. |
| `.mx-list-box__search` | The search box. |
| `.mx-list, .mx-list__item, .mx-list__header, .mx-list__check` | The list (shared), its options (`data-active`, `data-selected`), group headers and check boxes. |
| `.mx-list__item[data-select-all]` | The "Select all" row; `data-mixed` when some items are chosen. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `listbox.container, listbox.box` | Units: the space around the list box, and around and between its search box and list. |
| `listbox.check` | Unit: the check box of a row in a list of several choices (`checked`, `disabled`, `checked-disabled`). |
| `listbox.keys, listbox.idle` | Units: the ring round the row the keys are on (`selected`), and that row while the list is not in use. |
| `listbox.field, listbox.search, listbox.list` | Places: the field, the search box and the list inside a list box (the list's and the field's own units, as they look here). |
| `list.*` | The rows, as for DropDown: height, padding, highlight, chosen item, headers, "Select all". |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<V \| V[] \| null>` | `null` / `[]` | The chosen value (single) or values (multiple). `x-model` binds it; a change writes a new array. |
| `items / dataSource` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` / `Bind<DataSource \| null>` | — | Items in memory, searched here, or a data source of `@motifx-community/data`, searched where it lives. A data source wins. |
| `textField, valueField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | `'text'`, `'value'` | A property name or a function `(item) => …`. Plain values are their own text and value. |
| `iconField, groupField, enabledField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | — | An icon per item; headers between groups (items in memory); items that cannot be chosen. |
| `selectionMode` | `Bind<'single' \| 'multiple'>` | `'single'` | One value, or an array of them. |
| `showCheckBoxes` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Multiple: check boxes in front of the items; `false` draws a check mark, and a plain click chooses only that item. |
| `selectAll` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Multiple: a "Select all" row that is checked, empty or shows a dash. |
| `selectionFollowsFocus` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Single: the arrow keys choose as they move. Off: they only move, Space or Enter chooses. |
| `searchEnabled` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A search box above the list. |
| `searchMode` | `Bind<'contains' \| 'startswith'>` | `'contains'` | How items in memory match the search. |
| `searchDelay` | `Bind<number>` | `0` / `250` | Milliseconds after the last key before searching (in memory / a data source). |
| `height` | `Bind<number \| string \| null>` | — | Rows (`8`) or a CSS length (`"12rem"`). Without it the list is as high as its items, up to the list’s `max-height` (`list.container`). |
| `itemTemplate` | `Bind<(item, host) => cleanup \| void>` | — | Draws an item your way. |
| `noItemsText` | `Bind<string>` | — | What an empty list says instead of `uiLocale`’s “No items”. |
| `label, labelMode, helpText, hint, readOnly, required, size, variant, stretch, rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | The field props every editor has. |

A prop whose value is a function of its own (`textField`, a template) takes the function itself when it has parameters; a function without parameters is a getter, as for every other prop.

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `selectedItems, selectedItem` | read-only, reactive | The items of the chosen values that are known; with a data source the others are asked by key and follow. |
| `listItems` | read-only | The `DataItems` the list shows (what the last search matched). |
| `searchBox` | read-only | The search `TextBox` while `searchEnabled` is on. |
| `isValid, validationMessage` | read-only, reactive | See TextBox. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selectAllItems()` | `Promise<void>` | Multiple: chooses every item the list shows (a data source: after their values load). |
| `clear()` | `void` | Chooses nothing. |
| `scrollToItem(item)` | `void` | Brings an item into view and highlights it. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items may be plain or reactive; the list reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. It reads which items there are, their texts and values, and the chosen ones again. |
| `validate(), resetValidation(), focus()` |  | See TextBox. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }` |
| `onValidated(e)` | See TextBox. |

## Example files

`FromCode.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ListBox, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** A list bound with x-model, and lists created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const form = reactive({ city: 'İzmir' as string | null, result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const list = new ListBox<string, string>({ label: `Size ${++added}`, items: ['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL'], height: 4 });
    list.onValueChanged((e) => (form.result = `${list.label}: ${e.value}`));
    host?.controls.add(list);
    list.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ListBox label="&City" items={cities} x-model={() => form.city} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <output class="lb-city">{() => `city: ${form.city ?? '—'}`}</output>
        <Button text="Add a list from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
        <output class="lb-made">{() => form.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

`cities.ts`

```tsx
/** The cities the lists of the examples show. */
export const cities = ['Ankara', 'Antalya', 'Bursa', 'İstanbul', 'İzmir', 'Konya', 'Trabzon'];
```

`SeveralItems.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { ListBox, Stack, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** One list switched between one value and several, with check boxes, “Select all”, and a search box. */
export default function SeveralItems() {
  const s = reactive({ picked: ['Bursa', 'Konya'] as string[], multiple: true, checkBoxes: true, selectAll: true, follows: true, search: false });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Switch label="Multiple" x-model={() => s.multiple} />
        <Switch label="Check boxes" x-model={() => s.checkBoxes} />
        <Switch label="Select all" x-model={() => s.selectAll} />
        <Switch label="Selection follows focus" x-model={() => s.follows} />
        <Switch label="Search" x-model={() => s.search} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <ListBox
          label="Cities"
          items={cities}
          selectionMode={() => (s.multiple ? 'multiple' : 'single')}
          showCheckBoxes={() => s.checkBoxes}
          selectAll={() => s.selectAll}
          selectionFollowsFocus={() => s.follows}
          searchEnabled={() => s.search}
          value={() => (s.multiple ? s.picked : (s.picked[0] ?? null))}
          onValueChanged={(e) => (s.picked = Array.isArray(e.value) ? (e.value as string[]) : e.value === null ? [] : [e.value as string])}
        />
        <output class="lb-picked">{() => `value: ${JSON.stringify(s.multiple ? s.picked : (s.picked[0] ?? null))}`}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

`Validation.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ListBox, Stack, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { cities } from './cities';

/** A required list checked in a group, and the read-only and disabled states. */
export default function Validation() {
  const s = reactive({ sizes: [] as string[], result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const check = async () => {
    const result = await group.validate();
    s.result = result.valid ? 'Fine.' : 'Pick a size.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ListBox
        label="Sizes"
        items={['S', 'M', 'L', 'XL']}
        selectionMode="multiple"
        required
        helpText="Pick one or more."
        validationGroup={group}
        x-model={() => s.sizes}
      />
      <ListBox label="Read-only" items={cities} value="Bursa" readOnly height={4} />
      <ListBox label="Disabled" items={cities} value="Bursa" enabled={false} height={4} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Check" variant="outline" onclick={check} />
        <output class="lb-check">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

# TagBox

> Data · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Picks several items. The chosen ones are tags in the field, followed by a text input that searches the list; items come from memory or from a data source, and typed text can become a tag of its own.

## Import

```tsx
import { TagBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
```

## From JSX and from code

`x-model` binds an array; every change writes a new one. Created with `new`, the same properties are set from code.

```tsx
/** The skills the tag boxes of the examples pick from. */
export const skills = ['CSS', 'Go', 'HTML', 'Java', 'JavaScript', 'Kotlin', 'Python', 'Rust', 'SQL', 'Swift', 'TypeScript'];
```

## The list

The list keeps open while you choose, shows the chosen items checked and can have a “Select all” row. Each switch is a prop you can bind.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Stack, Switch, TagBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Person {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  team: string;
  initials: string;
  away?: boolean;
}

const people: Person[] = [
  { id: 1, name: 'Ada Lovelace', team: 'Design', initials: 'AL' },
  { id: 2, name: 'Grace Hopper', team: 'Design', initials: 'GH' },
  { id: 3, name: 'Alan Turing', team: 'Engineering', initials: 'AT' },
  { id: 4, name: 'Barbara Liskov', team: 'Engineering', initials: 'BL', away: true },
  { id: 5, name: 'Edsger Dijkstra', team: 'Engineering', initials: 'ED' },
  { id: 6, name: 'Margaret Hamilton', team: 'Research', initials: 'MH' },
  { id: 7, name: 'Donald Knuth', team: 'Research', initials: 'DK' },
];

/** Draws a person as initials and a name. */
const drawPerson = (p: Person, el: HTMLElement) => {
  const badge = el.appendChild(document.createElement('span'));
  badge.style.color = 'var(--mx-color-accent-fg)';
  badge.style.fontWeight = 'var(--mx-font-weight-semibold)';
  badge.textContent = p.initials;
  el.append(` ${p.name}`);
};

/** Objects in groups, items that cannot be chosen, a template, and the switches of the list. */
export default function TeamList() {
  const s = reactive({ team: [1, 3] as number[], closeOnSelect: false, hideSelected: false, selectAll: false, limit: false });
  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Switch label="Close on select" x-model={() => s.closeOnSelect} />
        <Switch label="Hide chosen" x-model={() => s.hideSelected} />
        <Switch label="Select all" x-model={() => s.selectAll} />
        <Switch label="At most 3" x-model={() => s.limit} />
      </Stack>
      <TagBox
        label="Team"
        items={people}
        textField="name"
        valueField="id"
        groupField="team"
        enabledField={(p: Person) => !p.away}
        itemTemplate={drawPerson}
        closeOnSelect={() => s.closeOnSelect}
        hideSelected={() => s.hideSelected}
        selectAll={() => s.selectAll}
        maxSelected={() => (s.limit ? 3 : 0)}
        placeholder="Add people"
        stretch
        x-model={() => s.team}
      />
      <output class="tg-team">{() => `ids: ${JSON.stringify(s.team)}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## From a data source

With `dataSource` the typed text searches the data source (its `searchFields`). In `'blocks'` mode only the rows in view load; the tags of values on no loaded page are found by key. `maxTags` keeps the field short. This one holds 5,000 customers.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { TagBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

interface Customer {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

const rows: Customer[] = Array.from({ length: 5000 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, name: `Customer ${String(i + 1).padStart(4, '0')}` }));

/** 5,000 customers from a data source, loaded in blocks while the list scrolls; the tags of values not loaded yet are found by key. */
export default function Customers() {
  const mail = reactive({ to: [12, 4321] as number[] });
  const customers = new data.DataSource<Customer, number>({
    adapter: new data.ArrayAdapter({ data: rows, key: 'id' }),
    loadMode: 'blocks',
    pageSize: 50,
    searchFields: ['name'],
  });

  return (
    <>
      <TagBox label="Customers" dataSource={customers} textField="name" valueField="id" maxTags={3} selectAll clearButton stretch x-model={() => mail.to} />
      <output class="tg-customers">{() => `${mail.to.length} chosen${mail.to.length && mail.to.length < 6 ? `: ${mail.to.join(', ')}` : ''}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Tags of your own

With `acceptCustomValue`, Enter adds text that matches no item as a tag; `customValue` shapes it or turns it down. `tagTemplate` draws a tag your way.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TagBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** Typed text that matches no item becomes a tag; `customValue` shapes it or turns it down. */
export default function CustomTags() {
  const issue = reactive({ labels: ['bug'] as string[] });
  return (
    <>
      <TagBox
        label="Labels"
        items={['bug', 'docs', 'feature', 'question']}
        acceptCustomValue
        customValue={(text: string) => (text.length > 1 ? text.toLowerCase() : null)}
        helpText="Type a new label and press Enter."
        x-model={() => issue.labels}
      />
      <output class="tg-labels">{() => `labels: ${JSON.stringify(issue.labels)}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Validation and states

```tsx
/** The skills the tag boxes of the examples pick from. */
export const skills = ['CSS', 'Go', 'HTML', 'Java', 'JavaScript', 'Kotlin', 'Python', 'Rust', 'SQL', 'Swift', 'TypeScript'];
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Typing` | Searches and opens the list; the first match is highlighted. |
| `Down / Up, Alt + Down` | Open the list with every item; move in it. |
| `Enter` | Choose the highlighted item or let it go; the list stays open. With `acceptCustomValue`, text that matches no item becomes a tag. |
| `Backspace in an empty input` | Remove the last tag. |
| `Left at the start of the input` | Go to the last tag. |
| `On a tag: Left, Right, Home, End` | Move between the tags; Right on the last one and End go back to the input. |
| `On a tag: Delete, Backspace` | Remove it. |
| `Escape` | Close the list; closed, empty the text; then, with `clearButton`, remove every tag. |
| `Alt + Up, Tab` | Close the list. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Pattern` | The APG combobox with a multi-select listbox: the input is `role="combobox"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`; the list is `aria-multiselectable`. |
| `Highlight` | `aria-activedescendant` names the highlighted option; focus stays in the input. |
| `Tags` | A `role="list"` of `role="listitem"`s; each has a remove button named “Remove …” from `uiLocale`, and the “+3” tag lists the rest in its title. |
| `Name` | The label names the input; help and errors describe it. |

## Localization

The remove buttons (`removeItem`, “Remove {text}”), the “+3” tag (`moreItems`), “Select all”, the buttons and the list texts come from `uiLocale.strings`.

```tsx
/** The skills the tag boxes of the examples pick from. */
export const skills = ['CSS', 'Go', 'HTML', 'Java', 'JavaScript', 'Kotlin', 'Python', 'Rust', 'SQL', 'Swift', 'TypeScript'];
```

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-tag-box` | Added to the field. `data-open`, `data-text` while text is typed; the field attributes of TextBox. |
| `.mx-tag-box__tags, .mx-tag-box__tag, .mx-tag-box__tag-text, .mx-tag-box__remove` | The tags, one tag (`data-loading` while its item is asked for), its text, its remove button. |
| `.mx-tag-box__more` | The “+3” tag. |
| `.mx-tag-box__input, .mx-tag-box__arrow, .mx-tag-box__clear` | The text input and the buttons. |
| `.mx-tag-box__popup, .mx-list…` | The popup and the shared list. |

### Component tokens

| Token | What it sets |
| --- | --- |
| `tagbox.tag, tagbox.tag-text` | Units: a tag (`more`: the "+N" tag, `loading`, `focus`, `hover`, `fixed`, `disabled`) and its text. |
| `tagbox.remove, tagbox.remove-glyph` | Units: a tag's remove button (`hover`, `pressed`) and its glyph. |
| `tagbox.box, tagbox.tags, tagbox.arrow, tagbox.arrow-glyph` | Units: the box's space round the tags, the tags together, and the arrow that opens the list (`open`). |
| `tagbox.inset, tagbox.input-min-width` | The space between the tags and the field's edge; the narrowest the input gets before it goes to the next line. |
| `list.*, listbox.*, field.*` | The list, the list box and the field. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<V[]>` | `[]` | The values of the chosen items. `x-model` binds it; every change writes a new array. |
| `items / dataSource` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` / `Bind<DataSource \| null>` | — | Items in memory, searched here, or a data source of `@motifx-community/data`, searched where it lives. |
| `textField, valueField, iconField, groupField, enabledField` | `Bind<ItemField<T>>` | — | As for ListBox; groups for items in memory. |
| `placeholder` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | Shown while nothing is chosen. |
| `searchMode, minSearchLength, searchDelay` |  | `'contains'`, `0`, `0` / `250` | How and when the typed text searches, as for ComboBox. |
| `acceptCustomValue` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Enter adds text that matches no item as a tag of its own. |
| `customValue` | `Bind<(text) => V \| null>` | the text | Makes the value of a typed text; `null` turns it down. |
| `autoHighlight` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` (`false` with `acceptCustomValue`) | The first match is highlighted while typing, so Enter takes it. |
| `closeOnSelect` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Choosing an item closes the list. |
| `maxTags` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | Tags shown; the rest are counted in one more tag, “+3”. `0` shows all. |
| `maxSelected` | `Bind<number>` | `0` | Items that can be chosen at most; at the limit the others cannot be chosen. `0`: no limit. |
| `selectAll` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A "Select all" row before the items. |
| `hideSelected` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Chosen items leave the list (items in memory). |
| `openOnFieldClick` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A press on the field opens the list. |
| `showDropDownButton, clearButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true`, `false` | The arrow that opens every item; the button that removes every tag. |
| `itemTemplate, tagTemplate` | `Bind<(item, host) => cleanup \| void>` | — | Draws an item of the list / a tag your way. |
| `matchWidth` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The list is at least as wide as the field. |
| `label, labelMode, helpText, hint, prefix, icon, readOnly, required, size, variant, stretch, rules, error, validateOn, validationGroup` | see TextBox |  | The field props every editor has. |

### Properties

| Property | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `every prop above` | read/write, reactive | A value or a function, like the prop. |
| `selectedItems` | read-only, reactive | The items of the chosen values that are known; with a data source the others are found by key. |
| `listItems` | read-only | The `DataItems` the list shows (what the last search matched). |
| `opened` | read/write, reactive | Whether the list is open; setting it opens or closes it. |
| `inputElement` | read-only | The text input. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(), close()` | `boolean`, `void` | Opens the list (`false` when disabled or read-only); closes it. |
| `clear()` | `void` | Removes every tag. |
| `selectAllItems()` | `Promise<void>` | Chooses every item the list shows, up to `maxSelected` (a data source: after their values load). |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Your items may be plain or reactive; the box reads them as they are. After changing them in place, call `refresh()`. The tags, the open list and `selectedItems` follow. |
| `validate(), resetValidation(), focus()` |  | See TextBox. |

### Events

| Event | When |
| --- | --- |
| `onValueChanged(e)` | `{ value, previousValue, byUser, source, event? }` |
| `onOpened()` | The list opened. |
| `onClosed(reason)` | The list closed: `'escape'`, `'outside'`, `'focus'` or `'code'`. |
| `onValidated(e)` | See TextBox. |

## Example files

`FromCode.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TagBox } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { skills } from './skills';

/** A tag box bound to an array with x-model, and tag boxes created with `new` and added from code. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const form = reactive({ skills: ['TypeScript', 'CSS'] as string[], result: '' });
  let added = 0;
  let host: Stack | null = null;

  const addFromCode = () => {
    const tags = new TagBox<string, string>({ label: `Skills ${++added}`, items: skills, placeholder: 'Pick some' });
    tags.onValueChanged((e) => (form.result = `${tags.label}: ${e.value.join(', ')}`));
    host?.controls.add(tags);
    tags.focus();
  };

  return (
    <>
      <TagBox label="&Skills" items={skills} x-model={() => form.skills} stretch />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <output class="tg-skills">{() => `skills: ${JSON.stringify(form.skills)}`}</output>
        <Button text="Add a tag box from code" variant="outline" onclick={addFromCode} />
        <output class="tg-made">{() => form.result}</output>
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </>
  );
}
```

`skills.ts`

```tsx
/** The skills the tag boxes of the examples pick from. */
export const skills = ['CSS', 'Go', 'HTML', 'Java', 'JavaScript', 'Kotlin', 'Python', 'Rust', 'SQL', 'Swift', 'TypeScript'];
```

`Validation.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TagBox, ValidationGroup } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { skills } from './skills';

/** A required tag box checked in a group, and the read-only and disabled states. */
export default function Validation() {
  const s = reactive({ reviewers: [] as string[], result: '' });
  const group = new ValidationGroup();

  const check = async () => {
    const result = await group.validate();
    s.result = result.valid ? 'Fine.' : 'Pick a reviewer.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <TagBox label="Reviewers" items={skills} required validationGroup={group} x-model={() => s.reviewers} />
      <TagBox label="Read-only" items={skills} value={['Go', 'Rust']} readOnly />
      <TagBox label="Disabled" items={skills} value={['Go', 'Rust']} enabled={false} />
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Check" variant="outline" onclick={check} />
        <output class="tg-check">{() => s.result}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

`Localization.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, TagBox, uiLocale } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { skills } from './skills';

/** Switches the texts of every tag box on the page: remove buttons, “+3”, “Select all”. */
export default function Localization() {
  const s = reactive({ lang: 'en' });
  const toggle = () => {
    s.lang = s.lang === 'en' ? 'tr' : 'en';
    void uiLocale.use(s.lang);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Button text={() => (s.lang === 'en' ? 'Language: English' : 'Dil: Türkçe')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
      <TagBox label="Skills" items={skills} value={['CSS', 'Go', 'HTML', 'Rust']} maxTags={2} selectAll clearButton />
    </>
  );
}
```
