## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Preview and pinned tabs` | A tab says “preview” or “pinned” after its title. The pin mark is for the pointer; the menu (Shift+F10) and Ctrl+K Shift+Enter pin and unpin from the keyboard, Ctrl+K Enter keeps a preview. |
| `Compact pinned tabs` | Show their icon or first letter; the title and description stay in the tab for screen readers. |
| `Scroll buttons` | For the pointer only: the arrow keys reach every tab and scroll it into sight. |
| `Badges and tones` | A badge's text is part of the tab's name; a dot and a tone are colour only, so say what they mean in the title, the tooltip or the badge text. |
| `Announcements` | Pinned, unpinned and kept open are said politely, like opened and closed. |

## API

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `previewTabs` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Documents opened with `preview` take the place of the group's preview tab. `false`: every document opens to stay. |
| `pinnedTabSize` | `Bind<'normal' \| 'compact' \| 'shrink'>` | `'normal'` | Pinned tabs like the others, only their icon (or first letter; the title stays for screen readers), or shrunk to `tabMinWidth`. |
| `pinnedTabsOnSeparateRow` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Pinned tabs in a row of their own, above the others. |
| `closeButtonOnPinned` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Pinned tabs show a close button next to their pin mark. |
| `keepPinned` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Close all, close others, close to the right or left and close saved leave pinned tabs open. |
| `tabSize` | `Bind<'fit' \| 'shrink' \| 'fixed'>` | `'fit'` | As wide as their text; shrinking down to `tabMinWidth` before the strip scrolls; all `tabFixedWidth` wide, shrinking down to `tabMinWidth`. |
| `tabMinWidth, tabMaxWidth, tabFixedWidth` | `Bind<number>` | `80`, `0`, `160` | In pixels. `tabMaxWidth` caps `fit` and `shrink` tabs; 0 leaves only the title's own limit. |
| `wrapTabs` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Tabs that do not fit go on to more rows instead of scrolling. |
| `scrollButtons` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Buttons at the ends of a strip that does not fit (the mouse wheel scrolls it sideways either way). |
| `showDescription` | `Bind<'always' \| 'duplicates' \| 'never'>` | `'duplicates'` | A tab shows its document's description always, only when another open document has the same title, or never. |
| `allowDuplicate` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The same document may be open in several groups; a document's own `allowDuplicate` wins. |
| `splitCopies` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Splitting with a document that may be open twice opens a copy in the new group; otherwise the document moves there. |

### TabDocument

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `preview` | `Bind<boolean>` | A preview tab, in italics: the next preview opened in its group takes its place. It stays after a double click, an edit (`dirty`), `keep`, the menu, or a move. |
| `pinned` | `Bind<boolean>` | Pinned tabs come first, in the order they were pinned, and keep a pin mark that unpins them. Set through `pin` / `unpin` to be asked and told. |
| `badge` | `Bind<string \| number \| boolean \| null>` | A count or short text after the title; `true` shows a dot. |
| `tone` | `Bind<'warning' \| 'danger' \| 'success' \| 'accent' \| null>` | Colours the title and the badge. |
| `description` | `Bind<string>` | Shown as `showDescription` says, and in the lists of documents. |
| `allowDuplicate` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | This document's own setting; `undefined` follows the manager. |
| `clone` | `(copy) => ComponentBase \| null` | Makes the content of a copy in another group. Without it a `content` function is called again, or the manager's `factory` makes it; a component given as it is cannot be copied. |
| `original` | read-only | For a copy, the document it was copied from; `null` for the document itself. A copy has the same `id` and `type` and shares every field but `pinned`, `preview` and `contentLifetime`. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open(doc, { preview?, pinned?, … })` | `TabDocument \| null` | Opens as a preview (replacing the group's preview tab) or pinned. A document open in another group is copied there when it may be open twice. |
| `keep(doc)` | `boolean` | A preview tab stays. |
| `pin(doc), unpin(doc)` | `boolean` | Pins to the end of the pinned tabs; unpins to the first place after them. |
| `closeOthers(doc), closeToRight(doc), closeToLeft(doc), closeSaved(group?)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Close several documents, each one asking through `onClosing`; pinned tabs stay while `keepPinned` is on. |
| `closeAll(group?, pinned?)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Pinned tabs stay while `keepPinned` is on, unless `pinned` is `true`. |
| `split(group, direction, doc?)` | `TabGroup \| null` | Copies `doc` into the new group when it may be open twice and `splitCopies` is on; moves it otherwise. |

### Events

| Event | What it carries |
| --- | --- |
| `onKeeping(e), onKept(e)` | `{ document, group, byUser }`; `keeping` is cancelable. |
| `onPinning(e), onPinned(e), onUnpinning(e), onUnpinned(e)` | `{ document, group, byUser }`; the `…ing` ones are cancelable. |
| `onClosing(e)` | Also `lastCopy`: no other copy of the document stays open, so ask about unsaved changes only then. A preview replaced by the next one closes through it too: when it cancels (or sets a promise) the old preview stays, kept. |
| `onSplitting(e), onSplit(e)` | Also `copy`: whether the document is copied (`splitting`), the copy made (`split`). |

The rest of the API is on the [overview](tabdocs.md#api); the menus, the lists and the keys on [Menus and keys](tabdocs-menus.md).

## Example files

`Preview.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, ListBox, Stack, Switch, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

/**
 * Choosing a file opens it as a preview (in italics): the next one chosen takes its place. A double
 * click on the tab, an edit, "Keep open" or moving it makes it stay.
 */
export default function Preview() {
  const s = reactive({ previewTabs: true, kept: [] as string[] });
  // Narrow beside its log, it still shows as on a desktop (see the Tablet and phone page).
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Files in preview', previewTabs: () => s.previewTabs, presentation: 'desktop' });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; flex: 1 1 0px; min-inline-size: 0';
  docs.onKept((e) => s.kept.unshift(e.document.title));

  const show = (path: string | null) => {
    if (path) docs.open(docs.findDocument(path) ?? fileDocument(path), { preview: true });
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Switch label="Preview tabs" x-model={() => s.previewTabs} />
        <Button text="Keep open" variant="outline" enabled={() => !!docs.activeDocument?.preview} onclick={() => docs.keep(docs.activeDocument!)} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => `preview: ${docs.activeGroup?.previewDocument?.title ?? 'none'}; kept: ${s.kept.join(', ') || 'none'}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <div style="display: flex; gap: var(--mx-space-3); inline-size: 100%">
        <ListBox
          label="Files"
          items={FILES}
          textField="path"
          valueField="path"
          height="28rem"
          style="inline-size: 14rem; flex: none"
          onValueChanged={(e) => show(e.value as string | null)}
        />
        {docs}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

`files.tsx`

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a made-up project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },
  { path: 'package.json', text: '{\n  "name": "shop",\n  "private": true\n}' },
  { path: 'vite.config.ts', text: "import { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\nexport default defineConfig({});" },
];

/** A file's text, as a document's content. */
export function source(text: string): ComponentBase {
  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.
  return <pre style="margin: 0; padding: var(--mx-space-4); overflow: visible; font: var(--mx-font-size-body) / var(--mx-font-line-body) var(--mx-font-family-mono)">{text}</pre>;
}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */
export function fileDocument(path: string, extra: TabDocumentOptions = {}): TabDocument {
  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  return new TabDocument({
    id: path,
    type: 'file',
    title: path.slice(at + 1),
    description: at > 0 ? path.slice(0, at) : '',
    icon: () => <FileIcon />,
    content: () => source(file?.text ?? ''),
    ...extra,
  });
}
```

`Pinning.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, Switch, TabDocumentManager, type PinnedTabSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

/** Pinned tabs stay first, in the order they were pinned. Their pin mark unpins them; the menu and Ctrl+K Shift+Enter do too. */
export default function Pinning() {
  const s = reactive({ size: 'normal' as PinnedTabSize, separateRow: false, closeButton: false, keepPinned: true });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({
    label: 'Files with pinned tabs',
    pinnedTabSize: () => s.size,
    pinnedTabsOnSeparateRow: () => s.separateRow,
    closeButtonOnPinned: () => s.closeButton,
    keepPinned: () => s.keepPinned,
  });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  for (const file of FILES) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99, pinned: file.path === 'README.md' || file.path === 'package.json' });

  const toggle = () => {
    const doc = docs.activeDocument;
    if (doc) (doc.pinned ? docs.unpin(doc) : docs.pin(doc));
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup
          label="Pinned tab size"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'normal', text: 'Normal' },
            { value: 'compact', text: 'Compact' },
            { value: 'shrink', text: 'Shrink' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.size}
        />
        <Switch label="Row of their own" x-model={() => s.separateRow} />
        <Switch label="Close button" x-model={() => s.closeButton} />
        <Switch label="Close all keeps them" x-model={() => s.keepPinned} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text={() => (docs.activeDocument?.pinned ? 'Unpin active' : 'Pin active')} variant="outline" onclick={toggle} />
        <Button text="Close all" variant="outline" onclick={() => docs.closeAll()} />
        <Button text="Open the files again" variant="ghost" onclick={() => FILES.forEach((f) => docs.findDocument(f.path) || docs.open(fileDocument(f.path), { index: 99 }))} />
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`Sizing.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Stack, Switch, TabDocumentManager, type TabSize } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { notes } from './contents';

/** More tabs than fit: they scroll (wheel or buttons), shrink, take one width, or go on to more rows. */
export default function Sizing() {

      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">

          label="Tab size"
          orientation="horizontal"

            { value: 'shrink', text: 'Shrink' },
            { value: 'fixed', text: 'Fixed' },
          ]}

          itemValue="value"

}
```

`contents.tsx`

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, confirm, DataGrid, FormLayout, type FormItem, type GridColumn } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { makeOrders, type Order } from './orders';

const columns: GridColumn<Order>[] = [
  { field: 'id', title: 'No', type: 'number', width: 70 },
  { field: 'customer', title: 'Customer', width: 160 },
  { field: 'city', title: 'City', width: 110 },
  { field: 'amount', title: 'Amount', type: 'number', width: 100 },
];

/** A grid of orders that fills its tab. */
export function ordersGrid(count = 60): ComponentBase {
  return <DataGrid rows={makeOrders(count)} rowKey="id" columns={columns} label="Orders" style="block-size: 100%" />;
}

/** The fields a customer is edited with. */
export interface Customer {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  city: string;
}

/** The forms open over each customer: a copy of a document has a form of its own over the same object. */
const formsOf = new WeakMap<Customer, Set<FormLayout<Customer>>>();

/**
 * A form over a customer: what is typed goes straight into it. The form reads the object as it is, so the other forms
 * over the same customer are told to read the field again.
 */
export function customerForm(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City' },
  ];
  const forms = formsOf.get(customer) ?? new Set<FormLayout<Customer>>();
  formsOf.set(customer, forms);
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout<Customer>
        data={customer}
        items={items}
        ref={(form: FormLayout<Customer>) => {
          forms.add(form);
          form.motif.setDisposable(() => forms.delete(form));
        }}
        onFieldChanged={(e) => {
          for (const other of forms) if (other.data === e.data && !other.isDisposed) other.refreshField(e.field);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** A few paragraphs of plain text. */
export function notes(title: string): ComponentBase {
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 40rem">
      <h3 style="margin-block-start: 0">{title}</h3>
      <p>Any component can be a document: a form, a grid, a chart or plain text like this.</p>
      <p>Drag the line between two groups, or focus it with Tab and use the arrow keys. A double click on it gives the groups the same size.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

const CITIES = ['İstanbul', 'Ankara', 'İzmir', 'London', 'New York'];

/** A customer card: text fields and a drop-down list of cities over a reactive customer, and a button that asks in a dialog. */
export function customerCard(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City', editor: 'dropdown', editorProps: { items: CITIES } },
  ];
  let card: ComponentBase | null = null;
  // The dialog opens where the card is: in a new window, there.
  const clear = async () => {
    if (await confirm('Clear the customer card?', { title: 'Clear', host: card! })) Object.assign(customer, { name: '', email: '', city: '' });
  };
  return (
    <div ref={(c: ComponentBase) => (card = c)} style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout data={customer} items={items} />
      <Button text="Clear…" variant="outline" onclick={clear} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`Look.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, TabDocument, TabDocumentManager, type TabShowDescription } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { notes } from './contents';
import { fileDocument } from './files';

/** A count or a dot over the tab, a colour by what the document needs, and a description only where two titles are the same. */
export default function Look() {
  const s = reactive({ unread: 3, errors: 1, description: 'duplicates' as TabShowDescription });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Badges and tones', showDescription: () => s.description });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  docs.open(new TabDocument({ id: 'inbox', title: 'Inbox', badge: () => s.unread || null, tone: () => (s.unread ? 'accent' : null), content: () => notes('Inbox') }));
  docs.open(new TabDocument({ id: 'build', title: 'Build', badge: () => s.errors || null, tone: () => (s.errors ? 'danger' : 'success'), content: () => notes('Build') }), { index: 99 });
  docs.open(new TabDocument({ id: 'quota', title: 'Quota', badge: true, tone: 'warning', content: () => notes('Quota') }), { index: 99 });
  docs.open(fileDocument('src/index.ts'), { index: 99 });
  docs.open(fileDocument('src/orders/index.ts'), { index: 99 });

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <Button text="New mail" variant="outline" onclick={() => s.unread++} />
        <Button text="Read all" variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.unread = 0)} />
        <Button text={() => (s.errors ? 'Fix the build' : 'Break the build')} variant="outline" onclick={() => (s.errors = s.errors ? 0 : 2)} />
        <RadioGroup
          label="Description"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'duplicates', text: 'Same titles' },
            { value: 'always', text: 'Always' },
            { value: 'never', text: 'Never' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.description}
        />
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`Duplicates.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, Switch, TabDocument, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { customerForm } from './contents';

/**
 * One customer open in two groups: each copy has a form of its own over the same data, and both
 * tabs follow the title and the unsaved changes. Splitting copies the document; turned off, it moves.
 */
export default function Duplicates() {
  const s = reactive({ allow: true });
  const saved = reactive({ name: 'Ada Lovelace', email: 'ada@example.com', city: 'London' });
  const ada = reactive({ ...saved });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Two copies', allowDuplicate: () => s.allow });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  const doc = docs.open(
    new TabDocument({
      id: 'ada',
      type: 'customer',
      title: () => ada.name || 'New customer',
      dirty: () => ada.name !== saved.name || ada.email !== saved.email || ada.city !== saved.city,
      content: () => customerForm(ada),
    }),
  )!;
  docs.split(docs.groups[0], 'right', doc);

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Switch label="Allow two copies" x-model={() => s.allow} />
        <Button text="Split the active group" variant="outline" onclick={() => docs.activeGroup && docs.split(docs.activeGroup, 'down', docs.activeDocument ?? undefined)} />
        <Button text="Save" variant="outline" enabled={() => doc.dirty} onclick={() => Object.assign(saved, { ...ada })} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => `${docs.documents.length} tab(s) for ${new Set(docs.documents.map((d) => d.id)).size} document(s)`}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

# TabDocumentManager: Menus and keys

> TabDocumentManager · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

The commands around the tabs: context menus on tabs and on the empty strip, a searchable list of a group's documents, the app's own toolbar buttons, the recently used list, back and forward, reopening what was closed, locked groups, and the keys for all of them.

## Context menus

Every tab has the commands of its document, the empty strip those of its group. `menuItems` leaves built-in items out; `onContextMenuOpening` changes the list for each document or cancels it. `newDocument` makes a document for a double click on the empty strip.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a made-up project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },
  { path: 'package.json', text: '{\n  "name": "shop",\n  "private": true\n}' },
  { path: 'vite.config.ts', text: "import { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\nexport default defineConfig({});" },
];

/** A file's text, as a document's content. */
export function source(text: string): ComponentBase {
  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.
  return <pre style="margin: 0; padding: var(--mx-space-4); overflow: visible; font: var(--mx-font-size-body) / var(--mx-font-line-body) var(--mx-font-family-mono)">{text}</pre>;
}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */
export function fileDocument(path: string, extra: TabDocumentOptions = {}): TabDocument {
  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  return new TabDocument({
    id: path,
    type: 'file',
    title: path.slice(at + 1),
    description: at > 0 ? path.slice(0, at) : '',
    icon: () => <FileIcon />,
    content: () => source(file?.text ?? ''),
    ...extra,
  });
}
```

| Command | Item | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | Close | The tab; its key is shown next to it. |
| `closeOthers, closeRight, closeLeft, closeSaved, closeAll` | Close others / to the right / to the left / saved / all | Pinned tabs stay while `keepPinned` is on. |
| `copyTitle` | Copy the title | To the clipboard. |
| `keepOpen` | Keep open | Only on a preview tab. |
| `pin, unpin` | Pin / Unpin | Whichever applies. |
| `splitUp, splitDown, splitLeft, splitRight` | Split up / down / left / right | A new group on that side with the document (or a copy, see `splitCopies`). |
| `moveNext, movePrevious` | Move to the next / previous group | Splits when there is no group that way. |
| `moveTo` | Move to… | Chooses where the tab goes with the keys ([Drag and drop](tabdocs-drag.md#keys)). |
| `moveGroupTo` | Move group to… (empty strip) | The same for the whole group. |
| `newDocument` | New document (empty strip) | Only with `newDocument`. |
| `reopenClosed` | Reopen closed (empty strip) | Dimmed while nothing can be reopened. |
| `lock, unlock` | Lock group / Unlock group (empty strip) |  |

## The open documents list and toolbar buttons

The “…” button (or Ctrl+K Ctrl+P) lists the group's documents, or every group's with `openListScope: 'all'`: type to search, Enter opens. `toolbarItems` adds the app's buttons to every group; a document's `actions` show while it is the active one.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a made-up project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },
  { path: 'package.json', text: '{\n  "name": "shop",\n  "private": true\n}' },
  { path: 'vite.config.ts', text: "import { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\nexport default defineConfig({});" },
];

/** A file's text, as a document's content. */
export function source(text: string): ComponentBase {
  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.
  return <pre style="margin: 0; padding: var(--mx-space-4); overflow: visible; font: var(--mx-font-size-body) / var(--mx-font-line-body) var(--mx-font-family-mono)">{text}</pre>;
}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */
export function fileDocument(path: string, extra: TabDocumentOptions = {}): TabDocument {
  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  return new TabDocument({
    id: path,
    type: 'file',
    title: path.slice(at + 1),
    description: at > 0 ? path.slice(0, at) : '',
    icon: () => <FileIcon />,
    content: () => source(file?.text ?? ''),
    ...extra,
  });
}
```

## Recently used, back and forward, reopen

The recently used list switches between documents the way a desktop editor does with Ctrl+Tab. `goBack` and `goForward` follow the documents activated in every group; `reopenClosed` opens the last closed one where it was.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a made-up project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },
  { path: 'package.json', text: '{\n  "name": "shop",\n  "private": true\n}' },
  { path: 'vite.config.ts', text: "import { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\nexport default defineConfig({});" },
];

/** A file's text, as a document's content. */
export function source(text: string): ComponentBase {
  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.
  return <pre style="margin: 0; padding: var(--mx-space-4); overflow: visible; font: var(--mx-font-size-body) / var(--mx-font-line-body) var(--mx-font-family-mono)">{text}</pre>;
}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */
export function fileDocument(path: string, extra: TabDocumentOptions = {}): TabDocument {
  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  return new TabDocument({
    id: path,
    type: 'file',
    title: path.slice(at + 1),
    description: at > 0 ? path.slice(0, at) : '',
    icon: () => <FileIcon />,
    content: () => source(file?.text ?? ''),
    ...extra,
  });

```

## Locked groups

`lock(group)` keeps a group for what is in it: `open` without a group goes to another one, or to a new group beside it when all are locked (a single group still takes it). The lock is saved with the layout.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, confirm, DataGrid, FormLayout, type FormItem, type GridColumn } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { makeOrders, type Order } from './orders';

const columns: GridColumn<Order>[] = [
  { field: 'id', title: 'No', type: 'number', width: 70 },
  { field: 'customer', title: 'Customer', width: 160 },
  { field: 'city', title: 'City', width: 110 },
  { field: 'amount', title: 'Amount', type: 'number', width: 100 },
];

/** A grid of orders that fills its tab. */
export function ordersGrid(count = 60): ComponentBase {
  return <DataGrid rows={makeOrders(count)} rowKey="id" columns={columns} label="Orders" style="block-size: 100%" />;
}

/** The fields a customer is edited with. */
export interface Customer {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  city: string;
}

/** The forms open over each customer: a copy of a document has a form of its own over the same object. */
const formsOf = new WeakMap<Customer, Set<FormLayout<Customer>>>();

/**
 * A form over a customer: what is typed goes straight into it. The form reads the object as it is, so the other forms
 * over the same customer are told to read the field again.
 */
export function customerForm(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City' },
  ];
  const forms = formsOf.get(customer) ?? new Set<FormLayout<Customer>>();
  formsOf.set(customer, forms);
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout<Customer>
        data={customer}
        items={items}
        ref={(form: FormLayout<Customer>) => {
          forms.add(form);
          form.motif.setDisposable(() => forms.delete(form));
        }}
        onFieldChanged={(e) => {
          for (const other of forms) if (other.data === e.data && !other.isDisposed) other.refreshField(e.field);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** A few paragraphs of plain text. */
export function notes(title: string): ComponentBase {
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 40rem">
      <h3 style="margin-block-start: 0">{title}</h3>
      <p>Any component can be a document: a form, a grid, a chart or plain text like this.</p>
      <p>Drag the line between two groups, or focus it with Tab and use the arrow keys. A double click on it gives the groups the same size.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

const CITIES = ['İstanbul', 'Ankara', 'İzmir', 'London', 'New York'];

/** A customer card: text fields and a drop-down list of cities over a reactive customer, and a button that asks in a dialog. */
export function customerCard(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City', editor: 'dropdown', editorProps: { items: CITIES } },
  ];
  let card: ComponentBase | null = null;
  // The dialog opens where the card is: in a new window, there.
  const clear = async () => {
    if (await confirm('Clear the customer card?', { title: 'Clear', host: card! })) Object.assign(customer, { name: '', email: '', city: '' });
  };
  return (
    <div ref={(c: ComponentBase) => (card = c)} style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout data={customer} items={items} />
      <Button text="Clear…" variant="outline" onclick={clear} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

A page in a browser tab never receives Ctrl+W, Ctrl+Tab, Ctrl+Shift+T, Ctrl+Page Up / Down and often Ctrl+1…9: the browser keeps them. So a manager starts with keys that reach it there, the way the web version of the editor picks them (Ctrl+Alt for a Ctrl the browser keeps; Ctrl+E, the quick-open key, for the recent list), and keeps the desktop key as a second one. An installed app (display mode standalone) gets every key: there `keyPreset: 'auto'` takes `TabDocumentManager.desktopKeys`. `keys` changes any of them; an empty list turns one off.

| Browser tab | Installed app | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Ctrl + Alt + W` | Ctrl + W, Ctrl + F4 | Closes the active document (`closeTab`). |
| `Alt + Page Down / Page Up` | Ctrl + Page Down / Page Up | The next / previous tab (`nextTab`, `previousTab`). |
| `Ctrl + Alt + 1 … 9` | Ctrl + 1 … 9 | Focuses a group (`focusGroup`). |
| `Ctrl + E, Ctrl + Shift + E` | Ctrl + Tab, Ctrl + Shift + Tab | The recently used list: opens it, then walks it while Ctrl is held; letting go opens the highlighted document (`recentNext`, `recentPrevious`). |
| `Alt + Left / Right` | the same | Back and forward (`goBack`, `goForward`). |
| `Ctrl + Alt + Shift + T` | Ctrl + Shift + T | Reopens the document closed last (`reopenClosed`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then W / U` | the same | Closes the group's documents / the saved ones (`closeAllTabs`, `closeSavedTabs`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then Enter` | the same | Keeps a preview tab (`keepOpen`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then Shift + Enter` | the same | Pins or unpins the active document (`togglePin`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then Ctrl + P` | the same | Opens the "…" list (`showOpenList`). |
| `Ctrl + \` | the same | Splits to the right (`splitRight`). |
| `Shift + F10, the Menu key` | the same | The context menu of the focused tab. |

```tsx
// The desktop keys everywhere, and Ctrl+Q to close.
new TabDocumentManager({ keyPreset: 'desktop', keys: { closeTab: ['Ctrl+Q'] } });
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Context menus` | The kit's `ContextMenu`: a `menu` opened by the right button, Shift+F10 or the Menu key on a tab, named after the document (or the group, on the strip); focus goes back to the tab when it closes. |
| `The "…" list` | One menu: a search field, the documents as a `menu` named “Open documents” (`menuitemradio` items, the shown one checked; the description, the group and unsaved changes are said with each one) and the `menu` of commands. Up and Down go on from the search through the documents and the commands; typing on a document goes back to the search; Tab goes from part to part; Enter opens; Escape closes. |
| `The recently used list` | The same menu of documents, named “Recently used documents”, with focus on the highlighted document, so it is read as it moves. It works without holding a key: the arrows move, a letter goes to a title, Enter opens, Escape closes. |
| `Locked groups` | A locked group is named “Group 1, locked”; its toolbar has an “Unlock group” button. |
| `Announcements` | Locked and unlocked are said politely, like the other changes. |

## API

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `contextMenu` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The context menus of tabs and of the empty strip. |
| `menuItems` | `Bind<Partial<Record<TabMenuCommand, boolean>>>` | `{}` | `false` leaves a built-in item out: `{ copyTitle: false }`. |
| `openList` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The "…" button in each group's toolbar. |
| `openListScope, recentListScope` | `Bind<'group' \| 'all'>` | `'group'` | Whether the "…" list and the recently used list show the group's documents or every group's. |
| `toolbarItems` | `(group) => ToolbarItem[]` |  | The app's buttons in every group's toolbar, made once per group (text, `icon`, `hint`, `tone`, `visible`, `enabled`, `click`…). |
| `newDocument` | `(group) => TabDocument \| TabDocumentOptions \| null` |  | Makes a new document for a double click on the empty strip and for the strip menu. |
| `historySize` | `Bind<number>` | `50` | How many activated documents `goBack` remembers; 0 turns the history off. |
| `closedHistorySize` | `Bind<number>` | `10` | How many closed documents `reopenClosed` remembers; 0 turns it off. Only documents whose content can be made again (a `content` function, the `factory`, a copy) are kept. |
| `keyPreset` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'browser' \| 'desktop'>` | `'auto'` | Which keys the manager starts with (see Keyboard); `auto` takes the desktop keys when the page runs installed. |
| `groupActions` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The split, maximize and "…" buttons. |

### TabDocument

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | `Bind<readonly ToolbarItem[]>` | Buttons in the group's toolbar while this document is the active one, before the built-in ones. |

### Methods and properties

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `showOpenList(group?)` | `boolean` | Opens a group's "…" list: the documents to search and open, close all, close saved, lock or unlock. |
| `showRecentList(by?)` | `boolean` | Opens the recently used list with the next document (or, with `-1`, the last) highlighted. |
| `goBack(), goForward()` | `boolean` | The document activated before (or after) the current one, in whatever group. `canGoBack`, `canGoForward` say whether there is one (reactive). |
| `reopenClosed()` | `TabDocument \| null` | Opens the document closed last again, in its group and place. `closedDocuments` lists them (reactive). |
| `lock(group), unlock(group)` | `boolean` | Also `group.lock()`, `group.unlock()`; `group.locked` reads it. |
| `openNew(group?)` | `TabDocument \| null` | Makes a document with `newDocument` and opens it. |
| `moveToGroup(doc, which)` | `boolean` | `'next'`, `'previous'`, or the group on a side (`'left'`, `'right'`, `'up'`, `'down'`); splits when there is no group that way. |
| `copyTitle(doc)` | `Promise<boolean>` | Writes the title to the clipboard. |
| `recentDocuments` | read-only, reactive | The open documents of every group, the one activated last first. |

### Events

| Event | What it carries |
| --- | --- |
| `onContextMenuOpening(e)` | `{ document, group, items, byKeyboard }`, cancelable; `document` is `null` for the empty strip. Change `items` (each built-in one has its command in `data`) or add your own. |
| `onLocking(e), onLocked(e), onUnlocking(e), onUnlocked(e)` | `{ group, byUser }`; the `…ing` ones are cancelable. |

The rest of the API is on the [overview](tabdocs.md#api); preview and pinned tabs, sizes and copies on [Tabs](tabdocs-tabs.md).

## Example files

`ContextMenus.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Stack, Switch, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument, source } from './files';

/**
 * Right-click a tab (or press Shift+F10 on it) for its menu, and the empty strip for the group's.
 * `onContextMenuOpening` adds an item for files; a double click on the empty strip makes a new file.
 */
export default function ContextMenus() {
  const s = reactive({ menus: true, copy: true, split: true, made: 0, said: '' });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({
    label: 'Files with menus',
    contextMenu: () => s.menus,
    menuItems: () => ({ copyTitle: s.copy, splitUp: s.split, splitDown: s.split, splitLeft: s.split, splitRight: s.split }),
    newDocument: () => {
      const n = ++s.made;
      return { id: `untitled-${n}`, title: `Untitled-${n}`, content: () => source('') };
    },
  });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  docs.onContextMenuOpening((e) => {
    const doc = e.document;
    if (doc?.type !== 'file') return;
    e.items.push({ text: 'Show the path', beginGroup: true, click: () => (s.said = String(doc.id)) });
  });
  for (const file of FILES.slice(0, 4)) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <Switch label="Context menus" x-model={() => s.menus} />
        <Switch label="Copy the title" x-model={() => s.copy} />
        <Switch label="Split items" x-model={() => s.split} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => (s.said ? `path: ${s.said}` : 'Right-click a tab, or the strip after the tabs')}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`OpenList.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Stack, TabDocumentManager, type TabListScope } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

const FormatIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M3 4h10M3 8h6M3 12h8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round" />
  </svg>
);

const RunIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M5 3.5v9l7-4.5z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/**
 * The "…" button lists the group's documents to search and open, with close all, close saved and
 * lock under them. The app adds its own buttons: "Run" for every group, "Format" while a file of code is active.
 */
export default function OpenList() {
  const s = reactive({ scope: 'group' as TabListScope, runs: 0, formatted: '' });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({
    label: 'Open documents',
    openListScope: () => s.scope,
    toolbarItems: (group) => [{ icon: () => <RunIcon />, hint: () => `Run group ${group.index + 1}`, tone: 'accent', click: () => s.runs++ }],
  });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  for (const file of FILES) {
    const code = file.path.endsWith('.ts');
    const doc = fileDocument(file.path, code ? { actions: [{ icon: () => <FormatIcon />, hint: 'Format', click: () => (s.formatted = file.path) }] } : {});
    docs.open(doc, { index: 99, group: file.path.startsWith('src/') ? docs.groups[0] : (docs.groups[1] ?? docs.split(docs.groups[0], 'right')!) });
  }
  docs.findDocument('src/app.ts')!.dirty = true;

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup
          label="The list shows"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'group', text: "The group's documents" },
            { value: 'all', text: 'Every group' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.scope}
        />
        <output class="td-state">{() => `runs: ${s.runs}${s.formatted ? `; formatted ${s.formatted}` : ''}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`Recent.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, TabDocumentManager, type TabKeyPreset, type TabListScope } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

/**
 * Hold Ctrl and press E (Ctrl+Tab in an installed app) for the documents used last: E again walks
 * the list, Shift walks back, letting go of Ctrl opens one. Back and forward go over the documents
 * activated in every group; a closed document opens again where it was.
 */
export default function Recent() {
  const s = reactive({ scope: 'group' as TabListScope, preset: 'auto' as TabKeyPreset });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Recently used', recentListScope: () => s.scope, keyPreset: () => s.preset });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  for (const file of FILES.slice(0, 5)) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  docs.split(docs.groups[0], 'right', docs.findDocument('README.md') ?? undefined);
  docs.open(fileDocument('package.json'), { group: docs.groups[1] });

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup
          label="Recent list"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'group', text: 'This group' },
            { value: 'all', text: 'Every group' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.scope}
        />
        <RadioGroup
          label="Keys"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'auto', text: 'Auto' },
            { value: 'browser', text: 'Browser tab' },
            { value: 'desktop', text: 'Installed app' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.preset}
        />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Recent list" variant="outline" onclick={() => docs.showRecentList()} />
        <Button text="Back" variant="outline" enabled={() => docs.canGoBack} onclick={() => docs.goBack()} />
        <Button text="Forward" variant="outline" enabled={() => docs.canGoForward} onclick={() => docs.goForward()} />
        <Button text="Reopen closed" variant="outline" enabled={() => docs.closedDocuments.length > 0} onclick={() => docs.reopenClosed()} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => `keys: ${docs.keys.recentNext.join(' or ')}, ${docs.keys.goBack[0]}, ${docs.keys.reopenClosed[0]}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`Locked.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { notes } from './contents';

/** A locked group keeps what it has: documents opened without naming a group go elsewhere, into a new group when every one is locked. */
export default function Locked() {
  const s = reactive({ opened: 0, log: [] as { id: number; text: string }[] });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Notes and a terminal' });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  const write = (text: string) => s.log.unshift({ id: s.log.length, text });
  docs.onLocked((e) => write(`group ${e.group.index + 1} locked`));
  docs.onUnlocked((e) => write(`group ${e.group.index + 1} unlocked`));
  docs.onOpened((e) => write(`${e.document.title} opened in group ${e.group.index + 1}`));
  docs.open({ id: 'terminal', title: 'Terminal', content: () => notes('Terminal') });
  docs.lock(docs.groups[0]);
  docs.split(docs.groups[0], 'right');

  const open = () => {
    const n = ++s.opened;
    docs.open({ id: `note-${n}`, title: `Note ${n}`, content: () => notes(`Note ${n}`) });
  };
  const toggle = (index: number) => {
    const group = docs.groups[index];
    if (group) (group.locked ? docs.unlock(group) : docs.lock(group));
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Open a note" variant="outline" onclick={open} />
        <Button text={() => (docs.groups[0]?.locked ? 'Unlock group 1' : 'Lock group 1')} variant="outline" onclick={() => toggle(0)} />
        <Button text={() => (docs.groups[1]?.locked ? 'Unlock group 2' : 'Lock group 2')} variant="outline" enabled={() => docs.groups.length > 1} onclick={() => toggle(1)} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => s.log.slice(0, 3).map((l) => l.text).join('; ')}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

`contents.tsx`

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, confirm, DataGrid, FormLayout, type FormItem, type GridColumn } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { makeOrders, type Order } from './orders';

const columns: GridColumn<Order>[] = [
  { field: 'id', title: 'No', type: 'number', width: 70 },
  { field: 'customer', title: 'Customer', width: 160 },
  { field: 'city', title: 'City', width: 110 },
  { field: 'amount', title: 'Amount', type: 'number', width: 100 },
];

/** A grid of orders that fills its tab. */
export function ordersGrid(count = 60): ComponentBase {
  return <DataGrid rows={makeOrders(count)} rowKey="id" columns={columns} label="Orders" style="block-size: 100%" />;
}

/** The fields a customer is edited with. */
export interface Customer {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  city: string;
}

/** The forms open over each customer: a copy of a document has a form of its own over the same object. */
const formsOf = new WeakMap<Customer, Set<FormLayout<Customer>>>();

/**
 * A form over a customer: what is typed goes straight into it. The form reads the object as it is, so the other forms
 * over the same customer are told to read the field again.
 */
export function customerForm(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City' },
  ];
  const forms = formsOf.get(customer) ?? new Set<FormLayout<Customer>>();
  formsOf.set(customer, forms);
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout<Customer>
        data={customer}
        items={items}
        ref={(form: FormLayout<Customer>) => {
          forms.add(form);
          form.motif.setDisposable(() => forms.delete(form));
        }}
        onFieldChanged={(e) => {
          for (const other of forms) if (other.data === e.data && !other.isDisposed) other.refreshField(e.field);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** A few paragraphs of plain text. */
export function notes(title: string): ComponentBase {
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 40rem">
      <h3 style="margin-block-start: 0">{title}</h3>
      <p>Any component can be a document: a form, a grid, a chart or plain text like this.</p>
      <p>Drag the line between two groups, or focus it with Tab and use the arrow keys. A double click on it gives the groups the same size.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

const CITIES = ['İstanbul', 'Ankara', 'İzmir', 'London', 'New York'];

/** A customer card: text fields and a drop-down list of cities over a reactive customer, and a button that asks in a dialog. */
export function customerCard(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City', editor: 'dropdown', editorProps: { items: CITIES } },
  ];
  let card: ComponentBase | null = null;
  // The dialog opens where the card is: in a new window, there.
  const clear = async () => {
    if (await confirm('Clear the customer card?', { title: 'Clear', host: card! })) Object.assign(customer, { name: '', email: '', city: '' });
  };
  return (
    <div ref={(c: ComponentBase) => (card = c)} style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout data={customer} items={items} />
      <Button text="Clear…" variant="outline" onclick={clear} />
    </div>
  );
}
```


---

# TabDocumentManager: Drag and drop

> TabDocumentManager · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Tabs and whole groups dragged as in a code editor: along a strip, to another group, beside a group or along an edge of the layout, between two managers, and the same moves from the keyboard. Every drop goes through the methods and events of what it does.

## Dragging tabs and groups

A copy of the tab follows the pointer; a mark shows where it goes among tabs, and a translucent area which half of a group (or all of it) a drop would take. Resting on a tab of another group activates it; the strip scrolls near its ends. The content is moved, never made again.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a made-up project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },
  { path: 'package.json', text: '{\n  "name": "shop",\n  "private": true\n}' },
  { path: 'vite.config.ts', text: "import { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\nexport default defineConfig({});" },
];

/** A file's text, as a document's content. */
export function source(text: string): ComponentBase {
  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.
  return <pre style="margin: 0; padding: var(--mx-space-4); overflow: visible; font: var(--mx-font-size-body) / var(--mx-font-line-body) var(--mx-font-family-mono)">{text}</pre>;
}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */
export function fileDocument(path: string, extra: TabDocumentOptions = {}): TabDocument {
  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  return new TabDocument({
    id: path,
    type: 'file',
    title: path.slice(at + 1),
    description: at > 0 ? path.slice(0, at) : '',
    icon: () => <FileIcon />,
    content: () => source(file?.text ?? ''),
    ...extra,
  });
}
```

| Dropped | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| `Along the strip` | Reorders. A tab dropped among the pinned ones is pinned, one dropped among the others unpinned (`pinOnDrag`). |
| `On another strip` | Moves the tab there, at the place under the pointer; on the empty part of a strip, at the end. |
| `The middle of a group` | Moves the tab into that group, after its active tab (`openPosition`). |
| `An edge of a group` | Splits that group: a new group on that side with the tab. The edge zones are `dropEdgeSize` deep. |
| `An edge of the layout` | A thin band along the manager's sides (`layoutEdgeSize`): a new group along that whole side (`layoutEdgeDrop`). |
| `Ctrl held (Option on a Mac)` | Opens a copy there instead, when the document may be open twice (`allowDuplicate`, `copyModifier`). |
| `A group, by the empty part of its bar or its handle` | Moves the group with all its tabs beside another group or along an edge of the layout; into another group (or its strip) its tabs join that group. |
| `Outside the manager` | Floats in a window of its own (see [Dock and floating windows](tabdocs-dock.md)); where it may not float (`allowFloat`), or over a manager outside its `dragGroup`, it is refused (`target: 'outside'`). |

## Settings

Each part of drag and drop is a setting and changes live; a document's own `allowDrag` and a group's own `allowDrop` and `dropSides` win over the manager's.

```tsx

  </svg>
);

  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
```

## Between two managers

Managers that share a `dragGroup` take each other's tabs and groups. The tab, its panel and its content go along; the other manager asks through its own `onOpening`, after `onMoving` in the first.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

export const FileIcon = () => (

  </svg>
);
```

## From the keyboard

Keys move the active tab along its strip or to another group, and “Move to…” (the tab's menu, the strip's menu for a whole group, Ctrl+K M, or `showMoveTo`) reaches every place a drag does, with the same areas shown and each place announced.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocument, type TabDocumentOptions } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** A page with a folded corner: a file. */
export const FileIcon = () => (
  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M4 1.75h5l3 3v9.5H4zM9 1.75v3h3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);

/** A few files of a made-up project. */
export const FILES = [
  { path: 'src/index.ts', text: "export { App } from './app';\nexport { router } from './router';" },
  { path: 'src/app.ts', text: "import { Application } from '@motifx/core';\n\nexport const App = Application.CreateBuilder().build();" },
  { path: 'src/router.ts', text: "export const router = { mode: 'history', routes: [] };" },
  { path: 'src/orders/index.ts', text: "export * from './orders';" },
  { path: 'src/orders/orders.ts', text: 'export interface Order {\n  id: number;\n  amount: number;\n}' },
  { path: 'README.md', text: '# Shop\n\nA small shop written with MotifJS.' },
  { path: 'package.json', text: '{\n  "name": "shop",\n  "private": true\n}' },
  { path: 'vite.config.ts', text: "import { defineConfig } from 'vite';\n\nexport default defineConfig({});" },
];

/** A file's text, as a document's content. */
export function source(text: string): ComponentBase {
  // The panel scrolls (and takes focus for it): the text itself does not.
  return <pre style="margin: 0; padding: var(--mx-space-4); overflow: visible; font: var(--mx-font-size-body) / var(--mx-font-line-body) var(--mx-font-family-mono)">{text}</pre>;
}

/** A document for a file: its name as the title, its folder as the description. */
export function fileDocument(path: string, extra: TabDocumentOptions = {}): TabDocument {
  const file = FILES.find((f) => f.path === path);
  const at = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  return new TabDocument({
    id: path,
    type: 'file',
    title: path.slice(at + 1),
    description: at > 0 ? path.slice(0, at) : '',
    icon: () => <FileIcon />,
    content: () => source(file?.text ?? ''),
    ...extra,
  });
}
```

| Browser | Installed app (desktop keys) | Does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Alt + Shift + Page Up / Page Down` | Ctrl + Shift + Page Up / Page Down | The active tab a place along its strip (`moveTabLeft`, `moveTabRight`). |
| `Ctrl + Alt + Right / Left` | the same | The active document to the next / previous group (`moveToNextGroup`, `moveToPreviousGroup`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then Shift + an arrow` | the same | To the group on that side, or into a new group there (`moveToGroupLeft`, `…Right`, `…Up`, `…Down`). |
| `Ctrl + K, then M` | the same | "Move to…" for the active document (`moveTo`); the tab's menu and the strip's menu have it too. |

### In “Move to…”

| Key | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `Arrows` | A side of the group; again towards that side, the next group that way, or the edge of the layout; the other way, back to the middle (`targetLeft`, `targetRight`, `targetUp`, `targetDown`). |
| `Tab, Shift + Tab` | The next / previous group, its middle (`targetNextGroup`, `targetPreviousGroup`). |
| `Enter` | Moves it there (`targetDrop`). |
| `Escape` | Leaves everything where it was (`targetCancel`); so does a press anywhere. |

## Changing or refusing a drop

`onDragOver` sees each place and may change it or refuse it; `onDropping` may still stop the drop. Then the events of what the drop does fire (`onMoved`, `onSplit`, …) and `onDropped`.

```tsx
docs.onDragOver((e) => {
  // Reports stay in their own group: no drop anywhere else.
  if (e.document?.type === 'report' && e.group !== e.from) e.cancel = true;
});
docs.onDropping((e) => {
  // A drop on the right edge of a group opens the new group below it instead.
  if (e.target === 'group' && e.side === 'right') e.side = 'down';
});
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Every drag has keys` | "Move to…" reaches every place a pointer can: each side of each group, the edges of the layout, other managers of the same `dragGroup`. |
| `Announcements` | Each place "Move to…" points at is said ("New group to the right of group 2", or "cannot go here"), then moved, copied, split, or canceled. |
| `Touch and pen` | A long press starts the drag, so a swipe still scrolls the strip; held still and let go, it opens the tab's menu. |
| `Escape` | Cancels a pointer drag too, and puts back what resting on tabs activated and what the strips scrolled. |

## API

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowDrag` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Tabs can be dragged; a document's own `allowDrag` wins. |
| `allowDragGroups` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Groups can be dragged by the empty part of their bar. |
| `groupDragHandle` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | A handle at the start of each group's toolbar to drag the group by, also when its tabs fill the bar; a click on it (or Enter) starts “Move group to…”. |
| `dropSides` | `Bind<readonly ('center' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'up' \| 'down')[]>` | all five | Where a drop on a group's content may go; a group's own `dropSides` wins. |
| `dropEdgeSize` | `Bind<number \| string>` | `'33%'` | How deep the edge zones of a group's content are: pixels, or a share. |
| `layoutEdgeDrop, layoutEdgeSize` | `Bind<boolean>`, `Bind<number>` | `true`, `16` | Drops along the edges of the whole layout, and how deep that band is, in pixels. |
| `dragThreshold` | `Bind<number>` | `5` | How far, in pixels, the pointer moves before a press becomes a drag. |
| `longPressDelay` | `Bind<number>` | `500` | How long, in milliseconds, a finger or a pen rests on a tab before it drags it; a swipe before that scrolls the strip. |
| `dragHoverActivate, dragHoverDelay` | `Bind<boolean>`, `Bind<number>` | `true`, `750` | Resting on a tab of another group while dragging activates it, after that many milliseconds. |
| `pinOnDrag` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Dragging across the border between pinned and other tabs pins or unpins; `false` keeps each tab on its side. |
| `copyModifier` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'ctrl' \| 'alt' \| 'shift' \| 'meta' \| 'none'>` | `'auto'` | The key that makes a drop a copy: Ctrl, Option on Apple platforms. |
| `dragGroup` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null` | Managers with the same name take each other's tabs and groups. |
| `dragGhost, dragAutoScroll` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The copy of the tab under the pointer; the strip scrolling near its ends. |

### TabGroup

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowDrop` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Drops into the group and beside it; `false` for a group that takes nothing. Saved with the layout. |
| `dropSides` | `Bind<readonly TabDropSide[] \| null>` | `null` | The group's own drop sides; `null` follows the manager. Saved with the layout. |

### TabDocument

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowDrag` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | This document's own setting; `undefined` follows the manager. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `move(doc, group, index?)` | `boolean` | What a drop on a strip or into a group does (milestone 1). |
| `split(group \| null, direction, doc?)` | `TabGroup \| null` | What a drop on an edge does; `null` splits the whole layout along that edge. |
| `moveGroup(group, target \| null, side)` | `boolean` | A whole group beside `target` (`'left'`, `'right'`, `'up'`, `'down'`), into it (`'center'`), or along an edge of the layout (`target` `null`). |
| `moveInGroup(doc, by)` | `boolean` | A place along the strip (`-1` towards the start), not past the pinned or the other tabs. |
| `moveToGroup(doc, which)` | `boolean` | `'next'`, `'previous'`, or the group on that side (`'left'`, `'right'`, `'up'`, `'down'`); a new group when there is none. |
| `showMoveTo(doc \| group)` | `boolean` | "Move to…" from the keyboard (see below). |
| `cancelDrag()` | `boolean` | Stops a drag or "Move to…"; everything goes back. |
| `addDropTarget(target, index?)` | `() => void` | A target of your own, asked before the built-in one: `placeAt(x, y, drag)`, `marks(place, drag)`, `drop(place, drag)`. Returns the function that removes it. |
| `dragging` | read-only, reactive | `{ document, group, manager, copy }` while something is dragged, else `null`. |
| `dropTargets` | read-only | The targets in the order they are asked. |

### Events

| Event | What it carries |
| --- | --- |
| `onDragStarting(e)` | `{ document, group, pointerType, byKeyboard }`, cancelable; `document` is `null` for a group. |
| `onDragOver(e)` | `{ document, from, target, manager, group, index, side, copy, byKeyboard }`: change the place, or `cancel` to refuse it. `target` is `'strip'`, `'group'`, `'edge'`, `'float'`, `'dock-guide'`, `'dock-area'` or `'outside'` (refused). |
| `onDropping(e)` | The same, just before the drop; cancel keeps everything where it is. |
| `onDropped(e)` | Where it ended: `group` is the new group of a split, `document` the copy when one was opened. |
| `onDragEnded(e)` | `{ document, from, dropped, byKeyboard }`, dropped or not. |
| `onMoving / onMoved, onSplitting / onSplit, onOpening / onOpened, onPinning…` | Still fire for what the drop does, so there is one way the model changes. A tab from another manager arrives through `onOpening` there, after `onMoving` here. |

### Styling hooks

| Selector or token | What |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-tabdocs[data-dragging]` | While dragging: `move`, `copy` or `none` (what a drop would do now); the cursor follows it. |
| `.mx-tabdocs__tab[data-dragging], .mx-tabdocs__group[data-dragging]` | The tab, or the group, being dragged. |
| `.mx-tabdocs__ghost` | The copy under the pointer; `data-kind` (`tab`, `group`), `data-target` (`move`, `copy`, `none`). |
| `.mx-tabdocs__drop` | The translucent area a drop would take; it glides between places (the motion tokens: none with reduced motion). |
| `.mx-tabdocs__insert` | The mark between two tabs. |
| `.mx-tabdocs__grip` | The group's handle (`groupDragHandle`), a button of the group's toolbar. |
| `tabdocs.drop, drop-fill, insert, ghost` | Their units (the ghost: `copy`, `refused`; a dragged tab: the `tab` unit's `dragging`). |

The rest of the API is on the [overview](tabdocs.md#api), [Tabs](tabdocs-tabs.md) and [Menus and keys](tabdocs-menus.md).

## Example files

`DragDrop.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { TabDocumentManager, type TabDroppedEventArgs } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';

/** What a drop did, in a few words. */
function describe(e: TabDroppedEventArgs): string {
  const what = e.document?.title ?? 'a group';
  const where = e.target === 'strip' ? `place ${e.index + 1} of a strip` : e.target === 'edge' ? `the ${e.side} edge` : e.side === 'center' ? 'a group' : `the ${e.side} of a group`;
  return `${what} ${e.copy ? 'copied' : 'moved'} to ${where}`;
}

/**
 * Drag a tab along its strip, onto another strip, into a group (the middle of its content) or
 * beside it (an edge), or along an edge of the whole layout. Drag a group by the empty part of its
 * bar or by its handle. Hold Ctrl (Option on a Mac) while dropping for a copy; Escape puts everything back.
 */
export default function DragDrop() {
  const s = reactive({ last: 'Drag a tab, or a group by its handle.' });
  // Narrow groups, for the narrow column of this page; a handle drags a group whose tabs fill its bar.
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Files to drag', allowDuplicate: true, minGroupWidth: 100, groupDragHandle: true });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  for (const file of FILES.slice(0, 4)) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  const right = docs.split(docs.activeGroup!, 'right')!;
  for (const file of FILES.slice(4, 6)) right.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  const below = docs.split(right, 'down')!;
  for (const file of FILES.slice(6)) below.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  docs.onDropped((e) => (s.last = describe(e)));
  docs.onDragEnded((e) => {
    if (!e.dropped) s.last = 'Nothing moved.';
  });

  return (
    <>
      {docs}
      <output class="td-state">{() => s.last}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

`files.tsx`
