```tsx
// On start: no click, so the windows wait as floating windows.
docs.restoreWindows = 'reopen';
docs.loadLayout(JSON.parse(localStorage.layout), restore);
reopenButton.onclick = () => docs.reopenWindows();
```

## What works in a new window

| Part | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Tabs and groups` | Everything a group does: pinning, previews, the "…" list, the recently used list, splitting, the splitters by the mouse and the keys, maximize is the main window's only. |
| `Menus, lists, tooltips` | They open in the new window's own top layer: the kit's `Popup`, `ContextMenu` and `Tooltip` go to the document of the element they open at. |
| `Keys` | The manager's keys, every control's shortcuts and access keys: the kit listens in every connected document (`connectDocument`). |
| `Content` | Any component: a form with a `DropDown`, a `DataGrid` with its filter popup and its keys, an `MxForm` dialog opened from it (in that window). |
| `Drag and drop` | Inside the window as in the page: strips, the zones or guides of a group, the edges of its layout. No dock areas and no floating there: those are the main window's. |
| `The look` | The page's style sheets (also constructed ones) and the attributes of `<html>` and `<body>` (`data-theme`, `data-identity`, density, `dir`, `lang`, classes) are copied and followed: change the theme here and every window follows. |

### Limits

| Topic | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `Frames` | An `<iframe>` in a document loads again when it moves into another window: browsers do that for every moved frame. |
| ``onMounted` of content made there` | Core waits for the page's own document (CORE-REPORTS R30): the manager lets content it makes in a new window arrive in the page for a moment first. A component an app builds later inside such content gets no `onMounted`. |
| `The window's place` | Browsers tell when a window is resized, not when it moves: `rect` is read when it is needed. |
| `A closed window` | It is gone before anything can ask: its documents come back (or close, each one asking in the main window). `onWindowClosing` cannot keep it. |

## Changing or refusing

```tsx
docs.onWindowOpening((e) => {
  // Reports open on the second screen, wide.
  if (e.document?.type === 'report') e.rect = { x: screen.width, y: 0, width: 1200, height: 800 };
});
docs.onWindowClosing((e) => {
  // Drafts close with their window, everything else comes back.
  if (e.kind === 'browser') e.then = e.window.documents.every((d) => d.type === 'draft') ? 'close' : 'back';
});
docs.onError((e) => {
  if (e.error === 'windowBlocked') toast('Allow pop-ups for this site to open documents in windows of their own.');
});
```

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `The window` | Its content is a `main` landmark named after the manager; its groups, strips and tabs are what they are in the page, with the roving tab stop. |
| `Focus` | Moving into a new window by the user focuses the document there; moving back focuses it in the main window. |
| `Announcements` | Politely, in the window that has focus: moved into a new window, back in the main window, window closed, the browser did not open the window. |

## API

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowNewWindow` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Documents, groups and floating windows may move into new windows; a document's own `allowNewWindow` wins. |
| `newWindowUrl` | `Bind<string>` | `'about:blank'` | The page a new window opens, on the page's own origin (one of the app's, with nothing in it); it is waited for before the move. |
| `newWindowTitle` | `Bind<string \| ((doc, window) => string)>` | `'{title} – {page}'` | The window's title: `{title}` is its active document's title, `{page}` the page's title; it follows them. |
| `newWindowSize` | `Bind<{ width, height } \| null>` | `null` | The size a new window opens at; `null`: the size of what moves into it. |
| `newWindowFallback` | `Bind<'float' \| 'none'>` | `'float'` | When the browser opens no window: a floating window in the page instead, or nothing. |
| `newWindowCloseAction` | `Bind<'back' \| 'close'>` | `'back'` | When a new window closes, its documents go back to the main window (into the group they came from), or close; `onWindowClosing` may change it each time. |
| `restoreWindows` | `Bind<'float' \| 'reopen' \| 'main'>` | `'float'` | What `loadLayout` does with saved new windows: floating windows, windows again (see below), or groups at the right of the main window. |
| `openWindow` | `(request) => Window \| null` | `window.open` | Opens the window: an application shell, a host page with its own frame, a test. `request` is `{ url, name, features, rect }`. |
| `dragOutToNewWindow` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A drag let go past the edge of the browser window opens a new window there; past the edge of a new window it goes back. |

### Methods

| Method | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `moveToNewWindow(target, options?)` | `TabBrowserWindow \| null` | `target`: a document, a group or a floating window; `options`: `{ rect, url }` (`rect` on the screen). `null` when it may not move, `onWindowOpening` cancels, or the browser opens none (then `onError`). |
| `moveToMainWindow(target)` | `boolean` | A document, a group or a `TabBrowserWindow`: back into the group it came from, else the main window's active one. A window left empty closes. |
| `closeWindow(window), focusWindow(window)` | `Promise<boolean>`, `boolean` | Also for a new window: closing does what `newWindowCloseAction` says. |
| `reopenWindows()` | `number` | Opens again the saved windows the browser blocked (`restoreWindows: 'reopen'`); call it from a click or a key. |
| `browserWindows` | read-only, reactive | The new windows, the one used last at the end. |
| `saveLayout(), loadLayout(layout, factory?)` | `TabLayout` (version 3) | Also `browserWindows`: `rect` on the screen, the layout, the group they came from (`home`). Versions 1 and 2 still load. |

### TabBrowserWindow

| Member | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `window` | `Window` | The browser window. |
| `element` | `HTMLDivElement` | The manager's part in that window (`.mx-tabdocs.mx-tabdocs__page`), filling it. |
| `rect` | read-only | Its place on the screen and the size of its page, in pixels. |
| `groups, documents, activeGroup, activeDocument, index` | read-only, reactive | What it holds; its title follows `activeDocument`. |
| `moveToMainWindow(), close(), focus()` | methods | The manager's methods for this window. |

### TabDocument

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowNewWindow` | `Bind<boolean \| undefined>` | This document's own setting; `undefined` follows the manager. |
| `browserWindow` | read-only, reactive | The new window it is in, `null` in the main window (also on `TabGroup`). |

### Events

| Event | What it carries |
| --- | --- |
| `onWindowOpening(e) / onWindowOpened(e)` | `{ document, group, window, rect, url }`, cancelable, `rect` and `url` may be changed (`window`: the floating window that moves); then `{ window, document, group }`. |
| `onWindowClosing(e) / onWindowClosed(e)` | Also for new windows, with `kind: 'floating' \| 'browser'` and `then: 'back' \| 'close'` (may be changed). Then `reason`: `'closed'`, `'docked'` (brought back), `'empty'` or `'moved'` (a floating window that went into a new window). |
| `onError(e)` | `{ error, document, group, fallback }`: `'windowBlocked'` (no window came) or `'windowNotUsable'` (a page of another origin); `fallback` may be changed. |
| `onClosing` | A document of a closed window closes (`newWindowCloseAction: 'close'`) back in the main window, so a dirty one is asked about there. |
| `onLayoutChanging / onLayoutChanged` | Also `'newWindow'` and `'mainWindow'`, with `window`. |
| `onDragOver, onDropping, onDropped` | New `target` kinds: `'new-window'` (with `rect` on the screen) and `'main-window'`; an `'edge'` place in a new window has `browserWindow`. |

### For other windows in the kit

| Export | What |
| --- | --- |
| `connectDocument(doc), disconnectDocument(doc), pageDocuments()` | The kit's document-wide listeners (keys, access keys, tooltips, the focus guard) work in another same-origin document too; it is disconnected when its window closes. |
| `mirrorPage(source, target)` | Copies the page's style sheets and the attributes of `<html>` and `<body>` into another document and keeps them in step; returns the function that stops. |
| `ResizeWatch` | A `ResizeObserver` that follows its elements into another window (a browser's observer only reports elements of its own window). |

The rest of the API is on the [overview](tabdocs.md#api), [Tabs](tabdocs-tabs.md), [Menus and keys](tabdocs-menus.md), [Drag and drop](tabdocs-drag.md) and [Dock and floating windows](tabdocs-dock.md).

## Example files

`NewWindow.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TabDocument, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { customerCard, notes, ordersGrid } from './contents';

/** A document moves into a browser window of its own and back; what was typed, chosen and scrolled stays as it was. */
export default function NewWindow() {
  const customer = reactive({ name: 'Ada Lovelace', email: 'ada@example.com', city: 'London' });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Documents in new windows' });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  docs.open(new TabDocument({ id: 'customer', title: 'Customer', tooltip: () => `Customer: ${customer.name}`, content: () => customerCard(customer) }));
  docs.open(new TabDocument({ id: 'orders', title: 'Orders', content: () => ordersGrid(60) }));
  docs.open(new TabDocument({ id: 'notes', title: 'Notes', content: () => notes('Notes') }));

  const active = () => docs.activeDocument;
  const windows = () => {
    const list = docs.browserWindows;
    if (!list.length) return 'Every document is in this window.';
    return list.map((w, i) => `Window ${i + 1}: ${w.documents.map((d) => d.title).join(', ')}`).join('. ') + '.';
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Move the active document into a new window" variant="outline" enabled={() => !!active() && !active()!.browserWindow} onclick={() => docs.moveToNewWindow(active()!)} />
        <Button text="Move its group" variant="outline" enabled={() => !!docs.activeGroup && !docs.activeGroup.browserWindow} onclick={() => docs.moveToNewWindow(docs.activeGroup!)} />
        <Button text="Bring everything back" variant="outline" enabled={() => docs.browserWindows.length > 0} onclick={() => docs.browserWindows.forEach((w) => w.moveToMainWindow())} />
      </Stack>
      {docs}
      <output class="td-state">{() => `${windows()} Customer: ${customer.name}, ${customer.city}.`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

`contents.tsx`

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, confirm, DataGrid, FormLayout, type FormItem, type GridColumn } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { makeOrders, type Order } from './orders';

const columns: GridColumn<Order>[] = [
  { field: 'id', title: 'No', type: 'number', width: 70 },
  { field: 'customer', title: 'Customer', width: 160 },
  { field: 'city', title: 'City', width: 110 },
  { field: 'amount', title: 'Amount', type: 'number', width: 100 },
];

/** A grid of orders that fills its tab. */
export function ordersGrid(count = 60): ComponentBase {
  return <DataGrid rows={makeOrders(count)} rowKey="id" columns={columns} label="Orders" style="block-size: 100%" />;
}

/** The fields a customer is edited with. */
export interface Customer {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  city: string;
}

/** The forms open over each customer: a copy of a document has a form of its own over the same object. */
const formsOf = new WeakMap<Customer, Set<FormLayout<Customer>>>();

/**
 * A form over a customer: what is typed goes straight into it. The form reads the object as it is, so the other forms
 * over the same customer are told to read the field again.
 */
export function customerForm(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City' },
  ];
  const forms = formsOf.get(customer) ?? new Set<FormLayout<Customer>>();
  formsOf.set(customer, forms);
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout<Customer>
        data={customer}
        items={items}
        ref={(form: FormLayout<Customer>) => {
          forms.add(form);
          form.motif.setDisposable(() => forms.delete(form));
        }}
        onFieldChanged={(e) => {
          for (const other of forms) if (other.data === e.data && !other.isDisposed) other.refreshField(e.field);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** A few paragraphs of plain text. */
export function notes(title: string): ComponentBase {
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 40rem">
      <h3 style="margin-block-start: 0">{title}</h3>
      <p>Any component can be a document: a form, a grid, a chart or plain text like this.</p>
      <p>Drag the line between two groups, or focus it with Tab and use the arrow keys. A double click on it gives the groups the same size.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

const CITIES = ['İstanbul', 'Ankara', 'İzmir', 'London', 'New York'];

/** A customer card: text fields and a drop-down list of cities over a reactive customer, and a button that asks in a dialog. */
export function customerCard(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City', editor: 'dropdown', editorProps: { items: CITIES } },
  ];
  let card: ComponentBase | null = null;
  // The dialog opens where the card is: in a new window, there.
  const clear = async () => {
    if (await confirm('Clear the customer card?', { title: 'Clear', host: card! })) Object.assign(customer, { name: '', email: '', city: '' });
  };
  return (
    <div ref={(c: ComponentBase) => (card = c)} style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout data={customer} items={items} />
      <Button text="Clear…" variant="outline" onclick={clear} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`WindowOptions.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { confirm, Stack, Switch, TabDocument, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { customerForm, notes } from './contents';

/** Closing a new window brings its documents back or closes them; a browser that blocks the window gets a floating one. Every event is logged. */
export default function WindowOptions() {
  const s = reactive({ back: true, blocked: false, fallback: true, log: [] as { id: number; text: string }[] });
  let next = 0;
  const note = (text: string) => {
    s.log.unshift({ id: ++next, text });
    if (s.log.length > 6) s.log.pop();
  };
  const draft = reactive({ name: 'Draft customer', email: '', city: '' });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({
    label: 'New window settings',
    newWindowCloseAction: () => (s.back ? 'back' : 'close'),
    newWindowFallback: () => (s.fallback ? 'float' : 'none'),
    // A browser that blocks windows hands back none: here a switch plays that browser.
    openWindow: (r) => (s.blocked ? null : window.open(r.url, r.name, r.features)),
    onWindowOpening: (e) => note(`windowOpening: ${e.document?.title ?? 'a group'}`),
    onWindowOpened: (e) => note(`windowOpened: window ${e.window.index + 1}`),
    onWindowClosing: (e) => note(`windowClosing (${e.kind}): then ${e.then}`),
    onWindowClosed: (e) => note(`windowClosed (${e.kind}): ${e.reason}`),
    onError: (e) => note(`error: ${e.error}, fallback ${e.fallback}`),
  });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  docs.open(new TabDocument({ id: 'draft', title: 'Draft', dirty: () => draft.email === '', content: () => customerForm(draft) }));
  docs.open(new TabDocument({ id: 'notes', title: 'Notes', content: () => notes('Notes') }));
  // A document with unsaved changes asks before it closes, in the main window.
  docs.onClosing((e) => {
    if (e.document.dirty) e.promise = confirm(`${e.document.title} has unsaved changes. Close it anyway?`, { title: 'Close', tone: 'caution' });
  });

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <Switch label="Documents come back when the window closes" x-model={() => s.back} />
        <Switch label="The browser blocks new windows" x-model={() => s.blocked} />
        <Switch label="Float when blocked" x-model={() => s.fallback} />
      </Stack>
      {docs}
      <ol class="td-log" aria-label="Events">
        {s.log.map((entry) => (
          <li key={entry.id}>{entry.text}</li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </>
  );
}
```

`WindowLayout.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, TabDocument, TabDocumentManager, type TabLayout, type TabLayoutDocument, type TabRestoreWindows } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { notes, ordersGrid } from './contents';

/** Makes a saved document again by its type. */
function restore(saved: TabLayoutDocument): TabDocument {
  if (saved.type === 'orders') return new TabDocument({ ...saved, content: () => ordersGrid(40) });
  return new TabDocument({ ...saved, content: () => notes(saved.title) });
}

/**
 * The layout saves its new windows too (place on the screen, layout). Loading puts them back as
 * floating windows, among the documents, or as windows again: a browser opens windows only on a
 * click, so the restore button, a click, may open them, and "Reopen windows" opens what was blocked.
 */
export default function WindowLayout() {
  const s = reactive({ json: '', saved: null as TabLayout | null, mode: 'float' as TabRestoreWindows });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Saved layout with new windows', restoreWindows: () => s.mode });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 28rem; inline-size: 100%';
  docs.open(restore({ id: 'orders', type: 'orders', title: 'Orders' }));
  docs.open(restore({ id: 'notes', type: 'notes', title: 'Notes' }));
  docs.open(restore({ id: 'todo', type: 'notes', title: 'To do' }));

  const save = () => {
    s.saved = docs.saveLayout();
    s.json = JSON.stringify(s.saved, null, 2);
  };
  save();

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Move To do into a new window" variant="outline" onclick={() => docs.moveToNewWindow(docs.findDocument('todo')!)} />
        <Button text="Save layout" variant="outline" onclick={save} />
        <Button text="Restore layout" variant="outline" enabled={() => !!s.saved} onclick={() => s.saved && docs.loadLayout(s.saved, restore)} />
        <Button text="Reopen windows" variant="outline" onclick={() => docs.reopenWindows()} />
      </Stack>
      <RadioGroup
        label="Saved windows come back"
        orientation="horizontal"
        items={[
          { value: 'float', text: 'As floating windows' },
          { value: 'reopen', text: 'As windows again' },
          { value: 'main', text: 'In this window' },
        ]}
        itemText="text"
        itemValue="value"
        x-model={() => s.mode}
      />
      {docs}
      <pre class="td-json" tabindex="0" aria-label="The saved layout" style="max-block-size: 14rem; overflow: auto; inline-size: 100%">
        {() => s.json}
      </pre>
    </>
  );
}
```


---

# TabDocumentManager: Tablet and phone

> TabDocumentManager · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

On a tablet and a phone a layout of groups, splits and dock areas does not fit as it is. The manager keeps the layout and shows it another way: the same documents, groups and areas, the same saved JSON, the content moved and never made again. It goes by its own width, not by the device; on a touch screen its tabs and buttons get larger.

## Import

```tsx
import { TabDocumentManager, type TabPresentation, type TabDockPresentation } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Three ways to show one layout

| Presentation | What shows |
| --- | --- |
| `Desktop` | The layout as it is: groups side by side and one under the other, dock areas around them, floating windows, new browser windows. |
| `Tablet` | At most two groups side by side: the first branch of the layout on one side, the rest on the other, each showing the group used last; the groups that do not fit fold as tabs into the strip of the group beside them (their tabs keep their own group: a tap activates that group there). Dock areas become drawers from their edge, the bottom one a sheet, opened from their titles along the edges or by a finger swiping in from the edge. A floating window is a large sheet. |
| `Phone` | One document, full screen. Above it a bar: its title (a swipe left or right goes to the document beside it, a tap opens its commands in an action sheet), its close button and the number of open documents, which opens the list of them. Tools of the dock areas are buttons in a bar at the bottom: a tap opens a sheet (peek, half, full by its handle; swipe down closes it), or a drawer for an area that asks for one. A floating window is a full-screen sheet. New browser windows are off; the tab menu is an action sheet. |

Pick one: the layout under it does not change. Save the layout in each presentation: the JSON is the same.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, RadioGroup, Stack, TabDocumentManager, type TabPresentation } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';
import { explorer, outline, output, problems, toolDocument } from './tools';

/**
 * One layout shown four ways: two groups (the second split again), the explorer and the outline on
 * the left, problems and output at the bottom, a floating window. Pick a presentation: the layout
 * stays the same (Save shows its JSON does not change), only where things show changes.
 */
export default function Presentations() {
  const s = reactive({ presentation: 'tablet' as TabPresentation, shown: '', saved: '' });
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Editor shown as on a desktop, a tablet or a phone', presentation: () => s.presentation, minGroupWidth: 120 });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 32rem; inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 100%';
  const open = (path: string) => docs.open(docs.findDocument(path) ?? fileDocument(path), { focus: true });
  for (const file of FILES.slice(0, 3)) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  const right = docs.split(docs.activeGroup!, 'right', docs.findDocument('src/router.ts')!)!;
  right.open(fileDocument('README.md'));
  docs.split(right, 'down', docs.findDocument('README.md')!);
  docs.dock(
    toolDocument('explorer', 'Explorer', () => explorer(open)),
    'left',
  );
  docs.dock(toolDocument('outline', 'Outline', outline), 'left');
  docs.dock(toolDocument('problems', 'Problems', problems), 'bottom');
  docs.dock(toolDocument('output', 'Output', output), 'bottom');
  docs.float(docs.open(fileDocument('package.json'))!, { x: 80, y: 80, width: 360, height: 220 });
  docs.activate(docs.findDocument('src/index.ts')!);
  docs.onPresentationChanged((e) => (s.shown = `${e.from} → ${e.to} (${e.width} px wide)`));
  let first = '';
  const save = () => {
    const json = JSON.stringify(docs.saveLayout());
    first ||= json;
    s.saved = `Saved as ${docs.currentPresentation}: ${json.length} characters, ${json === first ? 'the same as the first save' : 'not the same as the first save'}.`;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup
          label="Presentation"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'auto', text: 'By its width' },
            { value: 'desktop', text: 'Desktop' },
            { value: 'tablet', text: 'Tablet' },
            { value: 'phone', text: 'Phone' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.presentation}
        />
        <output class="td-state">{() => (s.shown ? `Shown: ${s.shown}` : `Shown as: ${docs.currentPresentation}`)}</output>
      </Stack>
      {docs}
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="Save the layout" variant="outline" onclick={save} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => s.saved || 'The layout saves the same in every presentation.'}</output>
      </Stack>
    </>
  );
}
```

## By its own width

With `presentation: 'auto'` (the default) the manager watches its own width and the screen's pointer. Under `phoneWidth` (560) it shows as on a phone, whatever the pointer: phones are 360 to 430 pixels wide, while a manager of about 590 beside a desktop page's side column stays a desktop. Under `tabletWidth` (1024) it shows as on a tablet when the screen is a touch screen; with a mouse it stays a desktop (`tabletWhen: 'width'` lets the width alone decide). An app changes both limits to fit its layout. Drag the frame's corner: what you type in the note and how far a file is scrolled stay.

```tsx
import { reactive, type Component } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Stack, TabDocumentManager } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument, source } from './files';
import { problems, toolDocument } from './tools';

/**
 * A manager that follows its own width (`presentation: 'auto'`): drag the frame's corner, or pick a
 * width. Under 560 pixels it shows as on a phone; under 1024 as on a tablet when the screen is a touch
 * screen (with a mouse it stays a desktop). A text and a scroll position are kept across every change:
 * the content moves, it is never made again.
 */
export default function FollowsWidth() {
  const s = reactive({ shown: '', typed: '' });
  let frame!: Component<HTMLDivElement>;
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Editor that follows its width' });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 100%; inline-size: 100%';
  docs.open(
    { id: 'note', title: 'Note', content: () => <textarea aria-label="Note" style="display: block; box-sizing: border-box; inline-size: 100%; block-size: 100%; padding: var(--mx-space-3); font: inherit; border: 0; resize: none" x-model={() => s.typed} /> },
    { index: 99 },
  );
  for (const file of FILES.slice(0, 4)) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  // A long one: a plain swipe over it scrolls it, on a phone too.
  docs.open({ id: 'log', title: 'Build log', content: () => source(Array.from({ length: 80 }, (_, i) => `${String(i + 1).padStart(3, ' ')}  step ${i + 1} done`).join('\n')) }, { index: 99 });
  docs.split(docs.activeGroup!, 'right', docs.findDocument('src/orders/index.ts')!);
  docs.dock(toolDocument('problems', 'Problems', problems), 'bottom');
  docs.activate(docs.findDocument('note')!);
  docs.onPresentationChanged((e) => (s.shown = `${e.to} at ${e.width} px`));
  const width = (px: string) => (frame.element.style.inlineSize = px);

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center">
        <Button text="390 px" variant="outline" onclick={() => width('390px')} />
        <Button text="720 px" variant="outline" onclick={() => width('720px')} />
        <Button text="Full width" variant="outline" onclick={() => width('100%')} />
        <output class="td-state">{() => s.shown || `Shown as: ${docs.currentPresentation}`}</output>
      </Stack>
      <div
        ref={(c: Component<HTMLDivElement>) => (frame = c)}
        class="td-frame"
        style="box-sizing: border-box; inline-size: 100%; max-inline-size: 100%; min-inline-size: 18rem; block-size: 30rem; overflow: hidden; resize: horizontal; border: var(--mx-border-width-1) solid var(--mx-color-stroke-card); border-radius: var(--mx-radius-lg)"
      >
        {docs}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

## Settings and events

Every part is a setting, live: how dock areas show on each (an area may say its own), the swipe from an edge, the back button, how the tab menus show. `onPresentationChanging` can refuse a change.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Stack, Switch, TabDocumentManager, type TabDockPresentation, type TabPresentation } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { FILES, fileDocument } from './files';
import { outline, problems, toolDocument } from './tools';

/**
 * Every part is a setting: how dock areas show on a phone and a tablet (the outline area says its
 * own), the swipe from an edge, the back button. onPresentationChanging can refuse a change: with
 * "Stay a phone" on, the phone does not go back to a tablet.
 */
export default function PresentationEvents() {
  const s = reactive({
    presentation: 'phone' as TabPresentation,
    phoneDock: 'sheet' as TabDockPresentation,
    tabletDock: 'auto' as TabDockPresentation,
    edge: true,
    back: true,
    stay: false,
    log: [] as string[],
  });
  const log = (line: string) => {
    s.log.push(line);
    if (s.log.length > 5) s.log.shift();
  };
  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({
    label: 'Editor with presentation settings',
    presentation: () => s.presentation,
    phoneDockMode: () => s.phoneDock,
    tabletDockMode: () => s.tabletDock,
    edgeSwipe: () => s.edge,
    backButton: () => s.back,
    onPresentationChanging: (e) => {
      log(`changing ${e.from} → ${e.to}`);
      if (s.stay && e.from === 'phone') e.cancel = true;
    },
    onPresentationChanged: (e) => log(`changed to ${e.to}`),
  });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 30rem; inline-size: 100%';
  for (const file of FILES.slice(0, 3)) docs.open(fileDocument(file.path), { index: 99 });
  docs.dock(toolDocument('problems', 'Problems', problems), 'bottom');
  docs.dock(toolDocument('outline', 'Outline', outline), 'right');
  // The outline's area chooses a drawer for itself on a phone.
  docs.dockArea('right')!.phoneDockMode = 'drawer';
  const modes = [
    { value: 'auto', text: 'Auto' },
    { value: 'sheet', text: 'Sheet' },
    { value: 'drawer', text: 'Drawer' },
    { value: 'hidden', text: 'Hidden' },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup
          label="Presentation"
          orientation="horizontal"
          items={[
            { value: 'tablet', text: 'Tablet' },
            { value: 'phone', text: 'Phone' },
          ]}
          itemText="text"
          itemValue="value"
          x-model={() => s.presentation}
        />
        <Switch label="Stay a phone" x-model={() => s.stay} />
        <Switch label="Swipe from an edge" x-model={() => s.edge} />
        <Switch label="Back goes back" x-model={() => s.back} />
      </Stack>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" wrap align="center" gap="lg">
        <RadioGroup label="Dock areas on a phone" orientation="horizontal" items={modes} itemText="text" itemValue="value" x-model={() => s.phoneDock} />
        <RadioGroup label="On a tablet" orientation="horizontal" items={modes} itemText="text" itemValue="value" x-model={() => s.tabletDock} />
      </Stack>
      <output class="td-state">{() => s.log.join(' · ') || 'No changes yet.'}</output>
      {docs}
    </>
  );
}
```

## The phone's list of documents

| Gesture or key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Tap a row` | Shows that document and closes the list. |
| `Swipe a row sideways` | Closes the document (asking as `onClosing` says; a document that may only be hidden is hidden). Let go early, it goes back. |
| `Long press, then drag` | Lifts the row: drag it up or down its group, or into another group's section; let go to move the document there (`onMoving` / `onMoved`). |
| `Long press, let go` | Opens the document's commands in an action sheet. |
| `Search` | Filters by title and description. |
| `Up, Down, Home, End; Enter` | Between the rows; Enter shows the document. |
| `Delete; Alt+Up, Alt+Down; the Menu key` | Closes it; moves it a place up or down (past an end, into the group before or after); opens its commands. |

## The back button

Android's back button and the browser's back gesture go through the session history. Each sheet, drawer and list holds one entry while it is open and takes it back when it closes otherwise, so no entry is left behind; the manager holds one while it can go back through its documents.

| When | Back |
| --- | --- |
| `A sheet or a drawer is open (a tool, a window, the list, an action sheet)` | The back button closes the one on top. |
| `Nothing is open, and the manager has gone through documents` | It goes back to the document before (`goBack`), as long as there is one. |
| `Nothing to go back to` | It is the browser's again: the page goes back. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `presentation` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'desktop' \| 'tablet' \| 'phone'>` | `'auto'` | How the layout shows: by the manager's own width, or always one way. |
| `phoneWidth` | `Bind<number>` | `560` | Under this width (in pixels of the manager, not of the screen) `auto` shows it as on a phone, whatever the pointer. |
| `tabletWidth` | `Bind<number>` | `1024` | Under this width `auto` shows it as on a tablet, on a touch screen (see `tabletWhen`). |
| `tabletWhen` | `Bind<'touch' \| 'width'>` | `'touch'` | `'touch'`: the tablet layout only when the screen's pointer is a finger (`(pointer: coarse)`, followed live); with a mouse a narrow manager stays a desktop until it is under `phoneWidth`. `'width'`: the width alone. |
| `narrowBars` | `Bind<'compact' \| 'documents'>` | `'compact'` | How the documents' groups' bars look on a tablet or a phone: with the `compact…` settings (no scroll buttons, shrinking tabs, small buttons, a single document as a title), as in the dock areas; `'documents'` keeps the desktop bar. Change the `compact…` props to change that look. |
| `phoneDockMode` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'sheet' \| 'drawer' \| 'hidden'>` | `'sheet'` | How dock areas show on a phone; an area's own `phoneDockMode` wins. |
| `tabletDockMode` | `Bind<'auto' \| 'sheet' \| 'drawer' \| 'hidden'>` | `'auto'` | How dock areas show on a tablet: `auto` is a drawer for the sides and the top, a sheet for the bottom. An area's own `tabletDockMode` wins. |
| `edgeSwipe` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | On a tablet or a phone a finger swiping in from an edge opens the dock area there, as a drawer. |
| `backButton` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | On a phone the browser's back goes back through the documents once nothing is open on top. |
| `menuPresentation` | `Bind<'menu' \| 'sheet' \| 'auto' \| null>` | `null` | How the tab menus show; `null`: an action sheet on a phone, a sheet for a finger on a tablet, a menu on a desktop. |
| `onPresentationChanging` | `(e: PresentationChangingEventArgs) => void` | — | `{ from, to, width, cancel }`: refused, the layout keeps showing as it does until the width or the setting changes again. |
| `onPresentationChanged` | `(e: PresentationChangedEventArgs) => void` | — | `{ from, to, width }`. |

### Members

| Member | Returns | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `currentPresentation` | read-only, reactive | How it shows now: `'desktop'`, `'tablet'` or `'phone'`. |
| `showDocumentList(), hideDocumentList()` | `boolean` | On a phone: opens or closes the list of open documents. `documentListOpen` is reactive. |
| `showTool(doc), hideTool(area)` | `boolean` | On a tablet or a phone: opens a dock area's drawer or sheet with that document shown, or closes it. `activate(doc)` of a tool or of a document in a floating window opens its drawer or sheet too. |
| `TabDockArea.phoneDockMode, tabletDockMode` | read/write, reactive | The area's own setting; `null` follows the manager. |
| `split, move, float, dock, saveLayout…` | unchanged | Work as on a desktop and change the layout; it is shown the way the presentation allows. `moveToNewWindow` returns `null` on a phone. |

The drawers and sheets are the kit's [Drawer](drawer.md) and [BottomSheet](bottomsheet.md), the action sheet its [ActionSheet](actionsheet.md).


---

# TabDocumentManager: A whole workspace

> TabDocumentManager · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A whole screen made of the kit's parts: a menu bar, the manager, a DataGrid with everything turned on, forms and a tool docked at the bottom. Each part is the same component it is on its own page; the manager only holds them.

## An order desk

The orders grid filters, groups, searches, sums, edits in batches and runs row actions, also from its context menu. Its tab shows the unsaved mark while edits wait to be saved. Open a customer from a row (its menu or the actions column): the card opens in the group on the right. Drag a tab to a guide, float it, move it into a new window, or use the menus: the grid keeps its filters, its scroll and its unsaved edits wherever it goes.

```tsx
import type { ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, confirm, DataGrid, FormLayout, type FormItem, type GridColumn } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { makeOrders, type Order } from './orders';

const columns: GridColumn<Order>[] = [
  { field: 'id', title: 'No', type: 'number', width: 70 },
  { field: 'customer', title: 'Customer', width: 160 },
  { field: 'city', title: 'City', width: 110 },
  { field: 'amount', title: 'Amount', type: 'number', width: 100 },
];

/** A grid of orders that fills its tab. */
export function ordersGrid(count = 60): ComponentBase {
  return <DataGrid rows={makeOrders(count)} rowKey="id" columns={columns} label="Orders" style="block-size: 100%" />;
}

/** The fields a customer is edited with. */
export interface Customer {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  city: string;
}

/** The forms open over each customer: a copy of a document has a form of its own over the same object. */
const formsOf = new WeakMap<Customer, Set<FormLayout<Customer>>>();

/**
 * A form over a customer: what is typed goes straight into it. The form reads the object as it is, so the other forms
 * over the same customer are told to read the field again.
 */
export function customerForm(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City' },
  ];
  const forms = formsOf.get(customer) ?? new Set<FormLayout<Customer>>();
  formsOf.set(customer, forms);
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout<Customer>
        data={customer}
        items={items}
        ref={(form: FormLayout<Customer>) => {
          forms.add(form);
          form.motif.setDisposable(() => forms.delete(form));
        }}
        onFieldChanged={(e) => {
          for (const other of forms) if (other.data === e.data && !other.isDisposed) other.refreshField(e.field);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** A few paragraphs of plain text. */
export function notes(title: string): ComponentBase {
  return (
    <div style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 40rem">
      <h3 style="margin-block-start: 0">{title}</h3>
      <p>Any component can be a document: a form, a grid, a chart or plain text like this.</p>
      <p>Drag the line between two groups, or focus it with Tab and use the arrow keys. A double click on it gives the groups the same size.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

const CITIES = ['İstanbul', 'Ankara', 'İzmir', 'London', 'New York'];

/** A customer card: text fields and a drop-down list of cities over a reactive customer, and a button that asks in a dialog. */
export function customerCard(customer: Customer): ComponentBase {
  const items: FormItem[] = [
    { field: 'name', label: 'Name', required: true },
    { field: 'email', label: 'Email', editor: 'email' },
    { field: 'city', label: 'City', editor: 'dropdown', editorProps: { items: CITIES } },
  ];
  let card: ComponentBase | null = null;
  // The dialog opens where the card is: in a new window, there.
  const clear = async () => {
    if (await confirm('Clear the customer card?', { title: 'Clear', host: card! })) Object.assign(customer, { name: '', email: '', city: '' });
  };
  return (
    <div ref={(c: ComponentBase) => (card = c)} style="padding: var(--mx-space-4); max-inline-size: 32rem">
      <FormLayout data={customer} items={items} />
      <Button text="Clear…" variant="outline" onclick={clear} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Example files

`Workspace.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive, type ComponentBase } from '@motifx/core';
import { DataGrid, MenuBar, TabDocument, TabDocumentManager, type GridAction, type GridColumn, type GridSummary, type MenuItem } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import type { Order } from '../../datagrid/examples/order';
import { columns, makeOrders } from '../../datagrid/examples/orders';
import { customerCard, type Customer } from './contents';

// Narrow, the grid moves columns into the row's details, the lowest number first; the customer always stays.
const PRIORITY: Partial<Record<keyof Order, number>> = { note: 0, paid: 1, date: 2, city: 3, status: 4, id: 5, amount: 6 };
const deskColumns: GridColumn<Order>[] = columns.map((c) => ({
  ...c,
  sticky: undefined,
  hidingPriority: PRIORITY[c.field as keyof Order],
  width: c.field === 'customer' ? 150 : c.field === 'amount' ? 100 : c.width,
}));

const summary: GridSummary<Order> = {
  totalItems: [
    { column: 'id', summaryType: 'count', showInColumn: 'customer' },
    { column: 'amount', summaryType: 'sum' },
  ],
  groupItems: [{ column: 'amount', summaryType: 'sum', alignByColumn: true }],
};

/**
 * An order desk: a menu bar over the manager, the orders in a full grid (filters, grouping, search,
 * summaries, batch editing, row actions and their context menu, export), a customer card that opens
 * in a tab from a row, and an activity log docked at the bottom.
 */
export default function Workspace() {
  const s = reactive({ orders: makeOrders(500), selected: 0, log: [] as { id: number; text: string }[], gridReady: 0 });
  let grid: DataGrid<Order> | null = null;
  let logId = 0;
  const write = (text: string) => {
    s.log.unshift({ id: ++logId, text });
    s.log.splice(40);
  };

  const docs = new TabDocumentManager({ label: 'Order desk', dockGuides: true, dockAreaSize: { bottom: 160 } });
  docs.element.style.cssText = 'block-size: 36rem; inline-size: 100%';

  const customers = new Map<string, Customer>();
  const openCustomer = (name: string) => {
    const id = `customer:${name}`;
    const open = docs.findDocument(id);
    if (open) return void docs.activate(open, true);
    let customer = customers.get(name);
    if (!customer) {
      customer = reactive({ name, email: `${name.split(' ')[0].toLowerCase()}@example.com`, city: '' });
      customers.set(name, customer);
    }
    const card = customer;
    const doc = new TabDocument({ id, type: 'customer', title: () => card.name || 'New customer', description: 'Customer', content: () => customerCard(card) });
    // Customers open beside the orders: in the group on the right, or in a new one there.
    const side = docs.groups.find((g) => g !== orders.group && !g.dockArea && !g.window && !g.browserWindow);
    if (side) docs.open(doc, { group: side, focus: true });
    else {
      const opened = docs.open(doc, { group: orders.group ?? undefined, focus: true });
      if (opened && orders.group) docs.split(orders.group, 'right', opened);
    }
  };

  const openOrder: GridAction<Order> = { id: 'customer', text: 'Open the customer', onclick: (row) => openCustomer(row.customer) };
  const approve: GridAction<Order> = {
    id: 'approve',
    text: 'Approve',
    tone: 'accent',
    visible: (row) => row.status === 'Draft',
    onclickMany: (rows) => {
      for (const row of rows) row.status = 'Approved';
      write(`${rows.length} orders approved`);
    },
    onclick: (row) => {
      row.status = 'Approved';
      write(`order ${row.id} approved`);
    },
  };

  const ordersGrid = (): ComponentBase => (
    <DataGrid
      style="block-size: 100%"
      rows={() => s.orders}
      rowKey="id"
      columns={deskColumns}
      label="Orders"
      locale="en"
      saveMode="batch"
      summary={summary}
      export={{ formats: ['csv'] }}
      actions={(_row: Order, state) => (state.isRemoved ? ['restore'] : [openOrder, approve, 'edit', 'remove'])}
      settings={{
        editable: true,
        selection: 'multiple',
        filterRow: true,
        headerFilter: true,
        groupPanel: true,
        searchPanel: true,
        columnChooserButton: true,
        exportButton: true,
        totalSummary: true,
        groupSummary: true,
        rowStatus: true,
        striped: true,
        actionsContextMenu: true,
        // Narrow beside a customer: the actions stay one "…" button, and columns that do not fit go into the row's details.
        actionsDisplay: 'menu',
        actionsWidth: 48,
        columnHidingEnabled: true,
      }}
      onSelectionChanged={(e) => (s.selected = e.selection.all ? s.orders.length - e.selection.except.length : e.selection.keys.length)}
      onSaved={() => write('changes saved')}
      ref={(g: DataGrid<Order>) => {
        grid = g;
        s.gridReady++;
      }}
    />
  );
  // The tab shows the unsaved mark while the grid has edits that are not saved.
  const orders = new TabDocument({
    id: 'orders',
    type: 'orders',
    title: 'Orders',
    pinned: true,
    closable: false,
    badge: () => s.orders.length,
    dirty: () => s.gridReady > 0 && !!grid?.hasChanges,
    content: ordersGrid,
  });
  const activity = new TabDocument({
    id: 'activity',
    type: 'tool',
    title: 'Activity',
    closable: false,
    content: () => (
      <ol style="margin: 0; padding: var(--mx-space-2) var(--mx-space-4); font-size: var(--mx-font-size-caption)" aria-label="Activity">
        {s.log.map((line) => (
          <li key={line.id}>{line.text}</li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    ),
  });

  docs.open(orders);
  // The log waits folded at the bottom edge: a click on its title slides it out.
  docs.dock(activity, 'bottom');
  docs.autoHide(docs.dockArea('bottom')!);
  docs.activate(orders);

  docs.onOpened((e) => write(`opened ${e.document.title}`));
  docs.onClosed((e) => write(`closed ${e.document.title}`));
  docs.onMoved((e) => write(`moved ${e.document.title}`));
  docs.onFloated((e) => write(`${e.document?.title ?? 'a group'} floats`));
  docs.onDocked((e) => write(`${e.document?.title ?? 'a group'} docked${e.side ? ` on the ${e.side}` : ''}`));
  docs.onHidden((e) => write(`${e.document.title} hidden`));

  const active = () => docs.activeDocument;
  const menu: MenuItem[] = [
    {
      text: '&File',
      items: [
        { text: 'New customer', click: () => openCustomer(`Customer ${customers.size + 1}`) },
        { text: 'Reopen closed', enabled: () => docs.documents.length > 0, click: () => docs.reopenClosed() },
        { text: 'Close', shortcut: 'Ctrl+Alt+W', beginGroup: true, enabled: () => !!active()?.closable, click: () => active() && docs.close(active()!) },
        { text: 'Close all', click: () => docs.closeAll() },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: '&Orders',
      items: [
        { text: 'Save changes', enabled: () => s.gridReady > 0 && !!grid?.hasChanges, click: () => grid?.saveEditData() },
        { text: 'Undo changes', enabled: () => s.gridReady > 0 && !!grid?.hasChanges, click: () => grid?.cancelEditData() },
        { text: 'Group by city', beginGroup: true, click: () => grid?.groupBy('city') },
        { text: 'Clear grouping', click: () => grid?.clearGrouping() },
        { text: 'Clear filters', click: () => grid?.clearFilters() },
        { text: 'Choose columns…', beginGroup: true, click: () => grid?.showColumnChooser() },
        { text: 'Export to CSV', click: () => grid?.exportCsv({ fileName: 'orders' }) },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: '&View',
      items: [
        { text: 'Split right', click: () => docs.activeGroup && docs.split(docs.activeGroup, 'right') },
        { text: 'Split down', click: () => docs.activeGroup && docs.split(docs.activeGroup, 'down') },
        { text: 'Maximize the group', beginGroup: true, click: () => docs.activeGroup && docs.maximizeGroup(docs.activeGroup) },
        { text: 'Restore the groups', click: () => docs.restoreGroups() },
        { text: 'Same sizes', click: () => docs.evenSizes() },
      ],
    },
    {
      text: '&Window',
      items: [
        { text: 'Float the active tab', enabled: () => !!active() && !active()!.window, click: () => active() && docs.float(active()!) },
        { text: 'Move into a new window', enabled: () => !!active() && !active()!.browserWindow, click: () => active() && docs.moveToNewWindow(active()!) },
        { text: 'Dock back', enabled: () => !!active()?.window, click: () => active() && docs.dock(active()!) },
        {
          text: 'Show the activity',
          beginGroup: true,
          // The close button of its area hides it (it cannot close): shown again, it goes back where it was.
          click: () => (activity.isHidden ? docs.show(activity, { focus: true }) : activity.dockArea?.autoHidden ? docs.showAutoHidden(activity) : docs.activate(activity, true)),
        },
      ],
    },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <MenuBar items={menu} label="Order desk" />
      {docs}
      <output class="td-state">{() => `${s.orders.length} orders · ${s.selected} selected${s.gridReady > 0 && grid?.hasChanges ? ' · unsaved changes' : ''}`}</output>
    </>
  );
}
```

# Scheduler

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Appointments over days and hours: day, week, work week and month views, all-day and multi-day bars, appointments at the same time side by side, and "+N more" where a day is full. From an array or a data source, with every setting live.

## Import

```tsx
import { Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
```

## Basics

Give it the appointments; it reads `startDate`, `endDate`, `text` and `allDay` by default (`fields` names others). The bar moves by the view's step and the date opens a calendar.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Meeting {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  color?: string;
  description?: string;
}

/** A week of appointments around today, so the examples always show something. */
export function sampleAppointments(): Meeting[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour: number, minute = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  return reactive([
    {
      id: 1,
      text: 'Team standup',
      startDate: day(0, 9),
      endDate: day(0, 9, 15),
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      text: 'Design review',
      startDate: day(0, 10),
      endDate: day(0, 11, 30),
      color: '#7c4dff',
    },
    {
      id: 3,
      text: 'Lunch with Ana',
      startDate: day(0, 12, 30),
```

## Views and settings

`views` lists the built-in types or views of their own: a name, a caption, an `intervalCount` and settings that win over the scheduler's. Every setting is a value or a function that is followed.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { sampleAppointments, type Meeting } from './sample-appointments';

/** Views of its own (three days, two weeks) next to the built-in ones, and settings bound to switches. */
export default function Views() {
  const s = reactive({
    allDay: true,
    dim: true,
    cascade: false,
    quarter: false,
    holidays: true,
  });
  // Every Friday is a holiday here, to show the look.
  const friday = (date: Date) => date.getDay() === 5;
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <div class="docs-flow">
        <Switch label="All-day panel" x-model={() => s.allDay} />
        <Switch label="Ended ones quieter" x-model={() => s.dim} />
        <Switch label="Cascade" x-model={() => s.cascade} />
        <Switch label="15-minute cells" x-model={() => s.quarter} />
        <Switch label="Fridays off" x-model={() => s.holidays} />
      </div>
      <Scheduler<Meeting>
        appointments={sampleAppointments()}
        views={[
          'day',
          { type: 'day', name: 'threeDays', text: '3 days', intervalCount: 3 },
          'workWeek',
          { type: 'week', name: 'twoWeeks', text: '2 weeks', intervalCount: 2 },
          'month',
        ]}
        currentView="threeDays"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={20}
        allDayPanel={() => s.allDay}
        dimPast={() => s.dim}
        overlapMode={() => (s.cascade ? 'cascade' : 'columns')}
        cellDuration={() => (s.quarter ? 15 : 30)}
        isHoliday={() => (s.holidays ? friday : null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## From a data source

With a `DataSource` (REST, OData, a service…) it asks for the days on screen only, and asks again when the view moves. It shows that it is loading, and a retry when a load fails.

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

## Templates

`appointmentTemplate` draws the content of each appointment; the scheduler still places it, colours it with its `color` and names it for screen readers.

```tsx
import { Scheduler, type AppointmentTemplateContext } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { sampleAppointments, type Meeting } from './sample-appointments';

/** The content of each appointment drawn by a template; the scheduler still places, colours and names it. */
export default function Templates() {
  const template = (c: AppointmentTemplateContext<Meeting>) =>
    c.allDay ? (
      <strong>{c.text}</strong>
    ) : (
      <div class="sched-card">
        <strong>{c.text}</strong>
        <span>{c.allDay ? 'All day' : c.time}</span>
        {c.appointment.color ? <span class="sched-tag">{c.appointment.color === '#c62828' ? 'urgent' : 'team'}</span> : <span class="sched-tag">personal</span>}
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Meeting> appointments={sampleAppointments()} currentView="day" startDayHour={8} endDayHour={18} appointmentTemplate={template} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## From code

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Scheduler, Stack } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { sampleAppointments, type Meeting } from './sample-appointments';

/** A scheduler made with `new`, added from code and driven by its methods. */
export default function FromCode() {
  const state = reactive({ said: '' });
  let host: Stack | null = null;
  let scheduler: Scheduler<Meeting> | null = null;

  const make = () => {
    if (scheduler) return;
    scheduler = new Scheduler<Meeting>({
      appointments: sampleAppointments(),
      currentView: 'workWeek',
      locale: 'tr-TR',
      firstDayOfWeek: 1,
    });
    scheduler.onDateChanged(
      (e) => (state.said = `Shows ${e.range.start.toLocaleDateString('tr-TR')} – ${new Date(e.range.end.getTime() - 1).toLocaleDateString('tr-TR')}`),
    );
    scheduler.onSelectionChanged(
      (e) =>
        (state.said = e.selection
          ? `Selected ${e.selection.start.toLocaleString('tr-TR')} – ${e.selection.end.toLocaleTimeString('tr-TR')}`
          : 'Nothing selected'),
    );
    host?.controls.add(scheduler);
  };
  // The work week shows Monday to Friday: the next of those days.
  const nextWorkday = () => {
    const t = new Date();
    let start = new Date(t.getFullYear(), t.getMonth(), t.getDate() + 1, 9);
    while (start.getDay() === 0 || start.getDay() === 6) start = new Date(start.getFullYear(), start.getMonth(), start.getDate() + 1, 9);
    scheduler?.showDate(start);
    scheduler?.selectCells({
      start,
      end: new Date(start.getTime() + 90 * 60_000),
      allDay: false,
    });
    scheduler?.scrollToTime(8);
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <div class="docs-flow">
        <Button text="Create" variant="outline" onclick={make} />
        <Button text="Previous" variant="outline" onclick={() => scheduler?.previous()} />
        <Button text="Next" variant="outline" onclick={() => scheduler?.next()} />
        <Button text="Select the next workday 9:00–10:30" variant="outline" onclick={nextWorkday} />
        <Button text="Month" variant="outline" onclick={() => scheduler?.showView('month')} />
      </div>
      <p class="sched-log" role="status">
        {() => state.said}
      </p>
      <Stack ref={(c: Stack) => (host = c)} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Arrows` | Move over the cells (mirrored right to left); past the first or the last day the view moves on. Up from the first time goes to the all-day panel. In the month, Up and Down move by a week. |
| `Shift + arrows` | Select from the cell where it began. |
| `Home / End` | The first / last day of the row; with Ctrl the first / last cell. |
| `Page Up / Page Down` | A screen of times up / down; in the month, the month before / after. |
| `Enter, Space` | On a cell: double click, click. On an appointment: the same. |
| `Escape` | Clears the selection. |
| `Tab` | The bar, the cells (one Tab stop), the all-day panel, then each appointment. |
| `T, N / J, P / K` | Today, next, previous (option `keys`; not in a text field). |
| `D, W, X, M` | Day, week, work week and month view. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Cells` | The times are a `grid` (the all-day panel and the month too) with one Tab stop; each cell is named with its day and time and has `aria-selected`. |
| `Appointments` | Buttons in their own group after the cells, named by their time, text and day ("continues" when they go on over days). |
| `Changes` | A new date or view is said in a polite live region (`announce`). |
| `Loading` | `aria-busy` while the data source loads; a failed load is an alert with Retry. |

## Localization

Dates and times come from `Intl` in its `locale` (12 or 24 hours, the first day of the week); its texts from `uiLocale` (English, Turkish), each one changed with `texts`.

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-scheduler` | `data-view="day\|week\|workWeek\|month"`. |
| `.mx-scheduler__bar, __title, __view-button` | The bar. |
| `.mx-scheduler__date, __all-day, __cells, __cell` | The day views: `data-today`, `data-work`, `data-hour-start`, `aria-selected`. |
| `.mx-scheduler__month-cell` | `data-today`, `data-outside`, `data-holiday`. |
| `.mx-scheduler__appointment` | `data-kind="timed\|bar\|chip"`, `data-before`, `data-after`, `data-short`, `data-past`, `data-disabled`; its colour is `--_color`. |
| `.mx-scheduler__more, __more-list, __now` | "+N more", its list, the current time. |
| `scheduler.scheduler, bar, head, date, day-number, hour, time-row, cell, now, week-row, appointment, tooltip, more, more-item, state, …` | Units: every piece in its states (a cell: `today`, `off`, `holiday`, `month`, `outside`, `weekend`, `past`, `hover`, `selected`, `focus` …). |
| `scheduler.height, slot-height, ruler-width, lane-size, appointment-tint, appointment-*-width, appointment-*-mix, chip-*, …` | Sizes, and the shares that mix an appointment's own colour into its fill, its text and its four edges. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `appointments` | `Bind<readonly T[]>` | `[]` | The appointments in memory. Your data may be plain or reactive; the component reads it as it is. After changing it in place, call `refresh()`. Its own edits (the form, a drag, the methods) show at once. |
| `dataSource` | `Bind<DataSource \| null>` | `null` | The appointments from `@motifx-community/data`, in place of `appointments`. |
| `remoteFiltering` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Asks the data source for the days shown only (a filter on the start and end fields, added to its own). |
| `fields` | `Bind<Partial<SchedulerFields>>` | see below | The fields it reads: `key`, `start`, `end`, `text`, `allDay`, `description`, `color`, `disabled`, `visible`. |
| `views` | `Bind<(type \| SchedulerView)[]>` | day, week, work week, month | The views offered. A `SchedulerView` has its own `name`, `text`, `intervalCount`, hours, `cellDuration`, `allDayPanel`, `maxAppointmentsPerCell`. |
| `currentView` | `Bind<string>` | the week | The view on screen, by name. |
| `currentDate` | `Bind<Date>` | today | The date the view shows. |
| `firstDayOfWeek` | `Bind<number \| null>` | the locale's | 0 Sunday … 6 Saturday. |
| `workDays` | `Bind<number[]>` | Monday–Friday | The work week, and the days shaded apart. |
| `workStartHour / workEndHour` | `Bind<number>` | 9 / 17 | The work hours; the rest is shaded. |
| `startDayHour / endDayHour` | `Bind<number>` | 0 / 24 | The hours the day columns show. |
| `cellDuration` | `Bind<number>` | 30 | Minutes in a cell. |
| `allDayPanel` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The panel of all-day and multi-day appointments over the hours. |
| `allDayLines` | `Bind<number>` | 3 | Lines the all-day panel grows to before "+N more". |
| `maxAppointmentsPerCell` | `Bind<number \\| 'auto'>` | `'auto'` | Appointments in a month day before "+N more"; `auto`: as many as fit. |
| `overlapMode` | `Bind<'columns' \\| 'cascade'>` | `'columns'` | Appointments at the same time side by side, or each a little to the side. |
| `isHoliday` | `Bind<(date) => boolean>` | — | Days marked as holidays. |
| `showCurrentTime` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The line at the current time. |
| `dimPast` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Appointments that have ended look quieter. |
| `scrollHour` | `Bind<number \| null>` | work start | The hour the day columns scroll to; by default the work start, or now later on today. |
| `toolbar` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The bar with today, previous, next, the date and the views. |
| `locale` | `Bind<string>` | the page's | Dates, times and the week. |
| `appointmentTemplate` | `Bind<(context) => Component>` | — | Draws an appointment’s content: `{ appointment, start, end, text, time, allDay, view }`. |
| `texts` | `Bind<Partial<UiStrings>>` | — | Its own texts over `uiLocale`. |
| `keys` | `Bind<Partial<SchedulerKeys>>` | see Keyboard | Its keys; an empty list turns one off. |
| `announce` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Says the new date or view to screen readers. |

### Methods and properties

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `goToday(), next(), previous()` | Move the view (asking `onDateChanging`). |
| `showDate(date), showView(name)` | Show a date, another view. |
| `scrollToTime(hour, minute?)` | Scrolls the day columns to a time of day. |
| `selectCells(cell \| null)` | Selects the cells of a time in the days shown. |
| `appointmentsIn(start, end), findAppointment(key)` | The appointments in a time; one by its key. |
| `refresh()` | Reads the appointments and the resources again. Your data may be plain or reactive; the component reads it as it is. After changing it in place, call `refresh()`. |
| `refreshAppointment(appointment)` | Reads one appointment again (an occurrence: its series), after you changed it in place. |
| `refreshResources()` | Reads the resources again: their items, after you changed them in place. |
| `visibleRange, resolvedView, selectedCells, shownAppointments, loading` | Reactive state. |
| `textOf(key, values?)` | A text of `uiLocale` or `texts`, filled in. |

### Events

| Event | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| `onViewChanging / onViewChanged` | `{ from, to, byUser, cancel }`: another view; cancel keeps this one. |
| `onDateChanging / onDateChanged` | `{ from, to, byUser, cancel }` / `{ …, range }`: today, previous, next, a date chosen. |
| `onCellClick / onCellDblClick` | `{ cell: { start, end, allDay }, event, cancel }`; Space and Enter on a cell too. |
| `onAppointmentClick / onAppointmentDblClick` | `{ appointment, start, end, event, cancel }`; Space and Enter on an appointment too. |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `{ selection }`: the selected cells as one time, or `null`. |
| `onContentReady` | `{ range, appointments }`: after a load, a new date or view, new data. |
| `onMoreOpening` | `{ date, appointments, cancel }`: "+N more" was pressed; cancel to show the day yourself. |

`FromSource.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';
import { sampleAppointments, type Meeting } from './sample-appointments';

/** Appointments from a data source that answers late, like a server: only the days shown are asked for. */
export default function FromSource() {
  const asked = reactive({ text: '' });
  const adapter = new SlowAdapter<Meeting, number>({ data: sampleAppointments(), key: 'id' }, 600);
  const source = new data.DataSource<Meeting, number>({
    adapter,
    // 'all': a view needs every appointment of its days; the scheduler asks for those days only.
    loadMode: 'all',
  });
  source.onChanged((e) => {
    if (e.reason !== 'loading') return;
    const filter = JSON.stringify(source.filter);
    asked.text = `Asked: ${filter.length > 140 ? filter.slice(0, 140) + '…' : filter}`;
  });
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo" onDisposing={() => source.dispose()}>
      <Scheduler<Meeting> dataSource={source} currentView="month" />
      <p class="sched-log">{() => asked.text}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`slow-adapter.ts`

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

# Scheduler: Editing

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Appointments are added, moved, resized, copied and deleted with the pointer, the keys and code; every change asks its event first, can wait for a server, and goes back when saving fails.

## Drag, resize, edit

The box itself goes where the appointment would go while it is dragged, on the step of `snapMinutes`; near the edges the view scrolls. A finger starts a drag with a long press.

```tsx
      startDate: day(8, 0),
      endDate: day(11, 0),
      allDay: true,
      color: '#ad1457',
    },
    {
      id: 15,
      text: 'Dentist',
      startDate: day(-5, 8, 30),
      endDate: day(-5, 9, 15),
    },
  ]) as Meeting[];
}
```

## Saving to a server

With a data source the changes go through its adapter. While one saves the appointment stays where it was put and cannot be changed; when it fails `onDataError` tells, and it goes back.

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

## The form

`onFormOpening` gets the form's `items` (a `FormLayout`) and its `data`: add your own fields, take some away, or cancel and show a form of your own.

```tsx
import { Scheduler, type FormOpeningEventArgs } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { sampleAppointments, type Meeting } from './sample-appointments';

type Booking = Meeting & { room?: string };

const rooms = [
  { value: 'blue', text: 'Blue room' },
  { value: 'green', text: 'Green room' },
  { value: 'online', text: 'Online' },
];

/** The form gets a field of its own (a room) and loses the description; the room is written to the appointment's `room` field. */
export default function CustomForm() {
  const opening = (e: FormOpeningEventArgs<Booking>) => {
    e.data.room = e.appointment?.room ?? 'online';
    e.items.splice(
      e.items.findIndex((item) => item.field === 'description'),
      1,
    );
    e.items.push({ field: 'room', label: 'Room', editor: 'dropdown', editorProps: { items: rooms }, colSpan: 'all' });
    e.form.title = e.appointment ? `Edit ${e.appointment.text}` : 'Book a room';
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Booking> appointments={sampleAppointments()} currentView="day" startDayHour={8} endDayHour={18} onFormOpening={opening} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Rules

`onMoving` and `onResizing` say where an appointment may go: cancelled, the drag shows it cannot drop there. An appointment's own `allowDrag` and `allowResize` lock it.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, type DragEventArgs } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { sampleAppointments, type Meeting } from './sample-appointments';

type Locked = Meeting & { allowDrag?: boolean; allowResize?: boolean };

/** Nothing may go over lunch (12:00–13:00) or onto a weekend: the drag shows it cannot drop there. "Lunch with Ana" is locked in place. */
export default function Rules() {
  const list = sampleAppointments() as Locked[];
  const lunch = list.find((m) => m.text === 'Lunch with Ana');
  if (lunch) {
    lunch.allowDrag = false;
    lunch.allowResize = false;
  }
  const s = reactive({ said: '' });
  const allowed = (e: DragEventArgs<Locked>) => {
    const weekend = [0, 6].includes(e.start.getDay());
    const noon = new Date(e.start.getFullYear(), e.start.getMonth(), e.start.getDate(), 12);
    const overLunch = !e.allDay && e.start < new Date(noon.getTime() + 3_600_000) && e.end > noon;
    e.cancel = weekend || overLunch;
    s.said = weekend ? 'Not on a weekend.' : overLunch ? 'Not over lunch.' : '';
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Locked> appointments={list} startDayHour={8} endDayHour={19} onMoving={allowed} onResizing={allowed} />
      <p class="sched-log" role="status">
        {() => s.said}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## From code

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { sampleAppointments, type Meeting } from './sample-appointments';

/** The same changes from code: add, move, delete, open the form for a new one. */
export default function EditFromCode() {
  const state = reactive({ appointments: sampleAppointments(), said: '' });
  let scheduler: Scheduler<Meeting> | null = null;
  const tomorrow = (hour: number) => {
    const t = new Date();
    return new Date(t.getFullYear(), t.getMonth(), t.getDate() + 1, hour);
  };
  const planning = () => state.appointments.find((m) => m.text === 'Planning');
  const add = async () => {
    const added = await scheduler?.addAppointment({ id: Date.now(), text: 'Planning', startDate: tomorrow(11), endDate: tomorrow(12), color: '#6a1b9a' });
    state.said = added ? `Added ${added.text}` : 'Not added';
  };
  const later = async () => {
    const item = planning();
    if (!item) {
      state.said = 'Add it first';
      return;
    }
    const hour = 3_600_000;
    const ok = await scheduler?.updateAppointment(item, {
      startDate: new Date(item.startDate.getTime() + hour),
      endDate: new Date(item.endDate.getTime() + hour),
    });
    state.said = ok ? 'Moved an hour later' : 'Not moved';
  };
  const remove = async () => {
    const item = planning();
    state.said = item && (await scheduler?.deleteAppointment(item)) ? 'Deleted' : 'Nothing to delete';
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <div class="docs-flow">
        <Button text="Add tomorrow 11:00" variant="outline" onclick={add} />
        <Button text="An hour later" variant="outline" onclick={later} />
        <Button text="Delete it" variant="outline" onclick={remove} />
        <Button
          text="New in the form"
          variant="outline"
          onclick={() => void scheduler?.showAppointmentForm(null, { start: tomorrow(15), end: tomorrow(16), allDay: false })}
        />
      </div>
      <p class="sched-log" role="status">
        {() => state.said}
      </p>
      <Scheduler<Meeting> appointments={state.appointments} startDayHour={8} endDayHour={19} ref={(c: Scheduler<Meeting>) => (scheduler = c)} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter on cells` | The form for a new appointment over the selection. |
| `Enter on an appointment` | Its form. Space: its tooltip. |
| `Arrows on an appointment` | Move it: Up / Down a step (a week in the month), Left / Right a day. Shift + arrows: its end. Enter saves, Escape takes it back. |
| `Delete` | Deletes the focused appointment (asking first). |
| `Ctrl while dragging` | Drops a copy. |
| `Escape while dragging` | Takes it back. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `editing` | `Bind<boolean \| Partial<SchedulerEditing>>` | `true` | `false`: read only. Or each switch: `allowAdding`, `allowUpdating`, `allowDeleting`, `allowDragging`, `allowResizing`, `allowCopying`, `confirmDelete`. |
| `fields.allowDrag / allowResize / allowEdit / allowDelete` | `string` | the same names | An appointment’s own switches; they win over `editing`. |
| `snapMinutes` | `Bind<number>` | the cell | The step a drag and the keys move by. |
| `minDuration` | `Bind<number>` | `snapMinutes` | The shortest an appointment gets by resizing, in minutes. |
| `tooltip` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | A click on an appointment shows its tooltip with Edit and Delete. |

### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `addAppointment(values)` | Adds where the appointments come from (pushed into the array, or inserted through the data source); resolves to it. |
| `updateAppointment(appointment, changes)` | Changes its fields; resolves `false` when an event said no or saving failed. |
| `deleteAppointment(appointment)` | Deletes it (no question from code). |
| `showAppointmentForm(appointment?, cell?)` | The form for an appointment, or for a new one at `cell` (the selection by default). |
| `showTooltip(appointment, anchor?) / hideTooltip()` | Its tooltip. |

### Events

| Event | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| `onAppointmentAdding / Added` | `{ appointment, byUser, cancel, promise? }`: the values may still be changed; `promise` waits (a server). |
| `onAppointmentUpdating / Updated` | `{ appointment, changes, byUser, cancel, promise? }`. |
| `onAppointmentDeleting / Deleted` | `{ appointment, byUser, cancel, promise? }`, after the question when it asks. |
| `onFormOpening` | `{ appointment, data, items, form, cancel }`: change the fields, or cancel to open your own form. |
| `onMoveStart / onMoving / onMoveEnd` | `{ appointment, start, end, allDay, copy, byKeys, cancel }`: cancel on `moving` marks a place it may not go. |
| `onResizeStart / onResizing / onResizeEnd` | The same, for the edges. |
| `onDataError` | `{ operation, appointment, error }`: saving failed; the appointment shows as it was. |

## Example files

`Editing.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { sampleAppointments, type Meeting } from './sample-appointments';

/** Drag an appointment, pull its edges, Ctrl-drag a copy, double-click to edit, click for its tooltip. Every switch is live. */
export default function Editing() {
  const s = reactive({ drag: true, resize: true, copy: true, ask: true, quarter: false, log: [] as string[] });
  const say = (text: string) => {
    s.log.unshift(text);
    if (s.log.length > 6) s.log.pop();
  };
  const time = (d: Date) => d.toLocaleString([], { weekday: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <div class="docs-flow">
        <Switch label="Drag" x-model={() => s.drag} />
        <Switch label="Resize" x-model={() => s.resize} />
        <Switch label="Ctrl copies" x-model={() => s.copy} />
        <Switch label="Ask before deleting" x-model={() => s.ask} />
        <Switch label="15-minute steps" x-model={() => s.quarter} />
      </div>
      <Scheduler<Meeting>
        appointments={sampleAppointments()}
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={19}
        editing={() => ({ allowDragging: s.drag, allowResizing: s.resize, allowCopying: s.copy, confirmDelete: s.ask })}
        snapMinutes={() => (s.quarter ? 15 : 30)}
        onMoveEnd={(e) => say(`${e.copy ? 'Copied' : 'Moved'} ${e.appointment.text} to ${time(e.start)}${e.byKeys ? ' (keys)' : ''}`)}
        onResizeEnd={(e) => say(`${e.appointment.text} now ${time(e.start)} – ${time(e.end)}`)}
        onAppointmentAdded={(e) => say(`Added ${e.appointment.text}`)}
        onAppointmentUpdated={(e) => say(`Saved ${e.appointment.text}`)}
        onAppointmentDeleted={(e) => say(`Deleted ${e.appointment.text}`)}
      />
      <ol class="sched-events" aria-label="What happened">
        {s.log.map((line, i) => (
          <li key={`${i}-${line}`}>{line}</li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`Saving.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';
import { sampleAppointments, type Meeting } from './sample-appointments';

/** A service that saves late and refuses every third change. */
class PickyService extends SlowAdapter<Meeting, number> {
  private changes = 0;

  protected override async updateRow(key: number, changes: Partial<Meeting>): Promise<Partial<Meeting>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 700));
    if (++this.changes % 3 === 0) throw new Error('The server said no.');
    return super.updateRow(key, changes);
  }
}

/** Move an appointment: it waits where it was put while the server saves, and goes back when saving fails. */
export default function Saving() {
  const s = reactive({ said: 'Move an appointment: it waits for the server; every third change fails.' });
  const source = new data.DataSource<Meeting, number>({ adapter: new PickyService({ data: sampleAppointments(), key: 'id' }, 300), loadMode: 'all' });
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo" onDisposing={() => source.dispose()}>
      <Scheduler<Meeting>
        dataSource={source}
        currentView="workWeek"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={19}
        onAppointmentUpdated={(e) => (s.said = `Saved: ${e.appointment.text}`)}
        onDataError={(e) => (s.said = `Not saved (${(e.error as Error).message}); it is back where it was.`)}
      />
      <p class="sched-log" role="status">
        {() => s.said}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`slow-adapter.ts`

```tsx

export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {

    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {

  }
}
```
