# Scheduler: Recurrence and time zones

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Appointments that repeat by an RFC 5545 rule, with times left out and occurrences changed apart; a question on what a change reaches; an editor of the rule; and the days on the clock of any time zone, summer time included.

## Recurring appointments

An appointment with a `recurrenceRule` is a series: the scheduler shows its occurrences in the days on screen only. `recurrenceException` leaves times out; an appointment whose `recurrenceId` names a series stands in for one of its occurrences. Supported: `FREQ` daily to yearly, `INTERVAL`, `COUNT`, `UNTIL`, `BYDAY` (`2MO`, `-1FR`), `BYMONTHDAY`, `BYMONTH`, `BYYEARDAY`, `BYWEEKNO`, `BYSETPOS`, `WKST`, `BYHOUR`, `BYMINUTE`.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { formatRuleDate } from '@motifx-community/ui';

export interface Booking {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  color?: string;
  recurrenceRule?: string;
  recurrenceException?: string;
  recurrenceId?: number;
  startDateTimeZone?: string;
  endDateTimeZone?: string;
}

/** Series around this week: a daily standup with one day left out and one moved, a review every other week, a report on the last Friday, an all-day Friday. */
export function recurringAppointments(): Booking[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const monday = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() - ((today.getDay() + 6) % 7));
  const day = (offset: number, hour = 0, minute = 0) => new Date(monday.getFullYear(), monday.getMonth(), monday.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  return reactive([
    {
      id: 1,
      text: 'Team standup',
      startDate: day(-21, 9),
      endDate: day(-21, 9, 30),
      recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR',
      // This Tuesday is left out; this Wednesday's is moved (appointment 2).
      recurrenceException: [day(1, 9), day(2, 9)].map((d) => formatRuleDate({ time: d.getTime(), utc: true, dateOnly: false })).join(','),
    },
    { id: 2, text: 'Team standup', startDate: day(2, 11), endDate: day(2, 11, 30), recurrenceId: 1 },
    {
      id: 3,
      text: 'Design review',
      startDate: day(-11, 14),
      endDate: day(-11, 15, 30),
      color: '#7c4dff',
      recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=TH',
    },
    {
      id: 4,
      text: 'Monthly report',
      startDate: day(-60, 16),
      endDate: day(-60, 17),
      color: '#c62828',
      recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=-1FR',
    },
    {
      id: 5,
      text: 'Remote day',
      startDate: day(-3),
      endDate: day(-2),
      allDay: true,
      color: '#00838f',
      recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=FR;COUNT=12',
    },
    { id: 6, text: 'Lunch with Ana', startDate: day(3, 12, 30), endDate: day(3, 13, 30), color: '#2e7d32' },
  ]) as Booking[];
}
```

## Changing a series

Moving, resizing, the form and Delete ask the same question. **This one**: a new appointment takes its place (naming its series) and its time is left out of the series. **This and following**: the series ends before it (`UNTIL`, or a smaller `COUNT`) and a new series goes on from it. **The whole series**: every occurrence moves as this one did; a weekly series moved to another day moves its weekdays.

With a data source every write goes through its adapter, one after another: the new rows first, then the changes, then the deletes. When a later write fails, the earlier ones are taken back through the adapter; `onDataError` tells what was saved (`saved`, `unsaved`) and whether it was all taken back (`undone`). An occurrence changed apart is an ordinary row, linked to its series by `recurrenceId`; deleting the series asks the adapter for those rows, loaded or not. This example runs from a data source.

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

## The recurrence editor

The appointment form holds it (`editing.allowRecurrence`). On its own it is `RecurrenceEditor`: the repeat list, every how many, the weekdays, a day of the month or a weekday by its place, the month, the end; a rule it cannot show whole stays as it is until a choice is changed.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RecurrenceEditor } from '@motifx-community/ui';

/** The editor on its own: it reads and writes the rule text, and says it in words under it. */
export default function RuleEditor() {
  const s = reactive({ rule: 'FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=2TU;COUNT=6' });
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo sched-rule">
      <RecurrenceEditor x-model={() => s.rule} start={new Date()} />
      <p class="sched-log">
        <code>{() => s.rule || '(none)'}</code>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// In a form of your own:
FormLayout.editors.set('recurrence', (p) => new RecurrenceEditor(p));
// { field: 'rule', label: 'Repeat', editor: 'recurrence' }
```

## Time zones

`timeZone` puts the days and hours on a zone's clock. A series repeats on the clock of its start's zone (`startDateTimeZone`), so 09:00 in New York stays 09:00 there over summer time. On the night the clocks go forward the skipped hour is passed (a time in it moves on by the hour); on the night they go back a box is as long as the appointment lasts.

With `editing.allowTimeZones` the form has one time zone picker and a box, **Separate end time zone**: checked, a second picker sets the end's zone (an appointment whose end zone differs opens with it checked); unchecked, the end follows the start's zone again.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import type { Booking } from './recurring-appointments';

/**
 * The same appointments on two clocks. The call repeats at 09:00 in New York, so in Istanbul it moves an hour when America
 * changes its clocks. The flight leaves on Istanbul's clock and lands on New York's: open it, its form has a separate end time zone.
 */
export default function TimeZones() {
  const today = new Date();
  const at = (hour: number) => new Date(Date.UTC(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate(), hour));
  const appointments = reactive([
    // 09:00 in New York, every weekday, in New York's time zone.
    { id: 1, text: 'Call with New York', startDate: at(13), endDate: at(14), startDateTimeZone: 'America/New_York', recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR' },
    { id: 2, text: 'Istanbul lunch', startDate: at(9), endDate: at(10), startDateTimeZone: 'Europe/Istanbul' },
    // 08:00 in Istanbul to 16:00 in New York.
    { id: 3, text: 'Flight to New York', startDate: at(5), endDate: at(20), startDateTimeZone: 'Europe/Istanbul', endDateTimeZone: 'America/New_York' },
  ]) as Booking[];
  const views = [{ type: 'day' as const, intervalCount: 3 }];
  return (
    <div class="sched-zones">
      <div class="sched-card">
        <span class="sched-tag">Europe/Istanbul</span>
        <Scheduler<Booking> appointments={appointments} views={views} timeZone="Europe/Istanbul" startDayHour={6} endDayHour={22} editing={{ allowTimeZones: true }} />
      </div>
      <div class="sched-card">
        <span class="sched-tag">America/New_York</span>
        <Scheduler<Booking> appointments={appointments} views={views} timeZone="America/New_York" startDayHour={0} endDayHour={16} editing={{ allowTimeZones: true }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Arrows (in the question)` | Choose this one, this and the following, the whole series. |
| `Enter / Escape` | Answer / cancel: the change is dropped and the appointment goes back. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Occurrences` | An occurrence is named with how its series repeats; one changed apart says so. The marks are only drawn (`aria-hidden`). |
| `The question` | A modal form: its choices are radio buttons under the question, the first one chosen. |
| `The editor` | A group named "Repeat"; the weekdays are toggle buttons (`aria-pressed`) in a group named by its caption; the line in words is polite live text. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `.mx-scheduler__appointment` | `data-series`, `data-exception`. |
| `scheduler.series-mark, exception-mark` | Units: the marks (`bar`, `chip`, `open`, `past`, `disabled`); a language that has none leaves them out. |
| `scheduler.tooltip-repeat` | Unit: the tooltip’s line on how it repeats (`exception`). |
| `.mx-recurrence-editor, __days, __day, __summary` | The editor, its weekday buttons and its line in words. |
| `recurrence-editor.editor, days-label, days, summary` | Units of the editor; `day-button` is the weekday buttons’ place; `row-gap`, `column-gap`. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `timeZone` | `Bind<string \| null>` | `null`: the browser's | The clock the days and hours are on, an IANA name (`Europe/Istanbul`). Converted with `Intl` only. |
| `seriesEdit` | `Bind<'ask' \\| 'occurrence' \\| 'following' \\| 'series'>` | `'ask'` | What changing or deleting an occurrence reaches. `ask` asks the user; from code it is the occurrence unless the call says. |
| `recurrenceMarks` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | The marks of an occurrence and of one changed apart, where the design language draws them. |
| `editing.allowRecurrence` | `boolean` | `true` | The form holds the recurrence editor. |
| `editing.allowTimeZones` | `boolean` | `false` | The form holds a time zone picker, and a box "Separate end time zone" (`separateEndZone` in the form’s data and `items`) that shows a picker for the end; unchecked, the end follows the start’s zone. Not on all-day appointments. |
| `fields.recurrenceRule` | `string` | `'recurrenceRule'` | How it repeats: an RFC 5545 rule (`FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE`); empty for once. |
| `fields.recurrenceException` | `string` | `'recurrenceException'` | The times left out (`EXDATE`): a text apart by commas (`20261104T090000Z,…`) or a list of dates. |
| `fields.recurrenceId` | `string` | `'recurrenceId'` | On an occurrence changed apart: the key of its series. |
| `fields.startTimeZone / endTimeZone` | `string` | `'startDateTimeZone'` / `'endDateTimeZone'` | The zone the start (and the series) and the end are set in; empty for the scheduler’s (the start) and for the start’s (the end). |

### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `updateAppointment(appointment, changes, scope?)` | For an occurrence, `scope` says what the change reaches: `occurrence`, `following` or `series`. |
| `deleteAppointment(appointment, scope?)` | The same for a delete. |
| `askSeries(appointment, action?)` | Asks the user what a change (`update`) or a delete (`delete`) reaches; resolves to the answer or `null`. |
| `seriesOf(appointment)` | The series of an occurrence or of one changed apart; a series itself; else `null`. |
| `isOccurrence(appointment), isException(appointment)` | An occurrence the scheduler made from a rule; one changed apart from its series. |
| `occurrencesOf(series, start, end)` | The occurrences of a series in a time. |
| `recurrenceText(appointment)` | How it repeats, in plain words of the locale. |

### Events

| Event | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| `onSeriesAsking` | `{ appointment, series, action, scopes, scope, cancel }`: set `scope` to answer without the question, narrow `scopes`, or cancel the change. |
| `onSeriesAnswered` | `{ appointment, series, action, scope, byUser }`: `scope` is `null` when the question was cancelled. |
| `onAppointmentUpdating / Updated` | Now also `scope` and `series` (`null` for an appointment that happens once); `Updated` gives `added`: the occurrence changed apart, or the series that goes on. |
| `onAppointmentDeleting / Deleted` | Now also `scope` and `series`. |
| `onDataError` | Now also `saved` and `unsaved` (each `{ kind, appointment, changes? }`) and `undone`: what a change of a series wrote before it failed, and whether it was all taken back. |

### RecurrenceEditor

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `Bind<string>` | `''` | The rule as RFC 5545 text; empty when it does not repeat. Two-way with `x-model`. |
| `start` | `Bind<Date \| null>` | now | When it starts: a rule’s weekday and day of the month come from it unless the rule names them. |
| `allDay` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Its last date is written as a date (else as the end of that day, in UTC). |
| `timeZone` | `Bind<string \| null>` | the browser's | The zone the series repeats in. |
| `frequencies` | `Bind<("never" \\| frequency)[]>` | all five | The choices of the repeat list. |
| `firstDayOfWeek, locale, texts, readOnly, summary` | — | — | The first weekday button; names and words; read only; the line in words. |
| `rule, summaryText` | — | — | The rule read from `value`, and how it repeats in words. Reactive. |
| `onValueChanged` | `{ value, previousValue, byUser }` | — | A choice changed the rule. |

### Parts

| Part | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `TimeZone.of(name) / TimeZone.local` | A zone: `wall(moment)`, `moment(wall, later?)`, `offset`, `dayStart`, `addDays`, `sameDay`, `toLocal` / `fromLocal` (for editors), `TimeZone.names()`. |
| `parseRecurrenceRule(text) / formatRecurrenceRule(rule)` | A rule as an object (`RecurrenceRule`) and back. |
| `recurrenceDates(rule, start, from, to, options?)` | The times a rule happens in a range, as wall clock times. |
| `describeRecurrence(rule, start, options)` | A rule in plain words. |
| `readRuleDates, addRuleDate, filterRuleDates, parseRuleDate, formatRuleDate` | Exception dates as a field holds them. |
| `rangeFilter(range, fields)` | The data layer’s filter for a range: starts before it ends and (ends at or after it starts, or has a rule). The scheduler’s `remoteFiltering` uses it. |

## Example files

`Recurring.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { recurringAppointments, type Booking } from './recurring-appointments';

/** Series with a rule each; one day left out of the standup, one moved apart. Click one: its tooltip says how it repeats. */
export default function Recurring() {
  const s = reactive({ marks: true });
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <div class="docs-flow">
        <Switch label="Marks" x-model={() => s.marks} />
      </div>
      <Scheduler<Booking> appointments={recurringAppointments()} startDayHour={8} endDayHour={18} recurrenceMarks={() => s.marks} editing={false} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`recurring-appointments.ts`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { formatRuleDate } from '@motifx-community/ui';

export interface Booking {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  color?: string;
  recurrenceRule?: string;
  recurrenceException?: string;
  recurrenceId?: number;
  startDateTimeZone?: string;
  endDateTimeZone?: string;
}

/** Series around this week: a daily standup with one day left out and one moved, a review every other week, a report on the last Friday, an all-day Friday. */
export function recurringAppointments(): Booking[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const monday = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() - ((today.getDay() + 6) % 7));
  const day = (offset: number, hour = 0, minute = 0) => new Date(monday.getFullYear(), monday.getMonth(), monday.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  return reactive([
    {
      id: 1,
      text: 'Team standup',
      startDate: day(-21, 9),
      endDate: day(-21, 9, 30),
      recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR',
      // This Tuesday is left out; this Wednesday's is moved (appointment 2).
      recurrenceException: [day(1, 9), day(2, 9)].map((d) => formatRuleDate({ time: d.getTime(), utc: true, dateOnly: false })).join(','),
    },
    { id: 2, text: 'Team standup', startDate: day(2, 11), endDate: day(2, 11, 30), recurrenceId: 1 },
    {
      id: 3,
      text: 'Design review',
      startDate: day(-11, 14),
      endDate: day(-11, 15, 30),
      color: '#7c4dff',
      recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2;BYDAY=TH',
    },
    {
      id: 4,
      text: 'Monthly report',
      startDate: day(-60, 16),
      endDate: day(-60, 17),
      color: '#c62828',
      recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=-1FR',
    },
    {
      id: 5,
      text: 'Remote day',
      startDate: day(-3),
      endDate: day(-2),
      allDay: true,
      color: '#00838f',
      recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=FR;COUNT=12',
    },
    { id: 6, text: 'Lunch with Ana', startDate: day(3, 12, 30), endDate: day(3, 13, 30), color: '#2e7d32' },
  ]) as Booking[];
}
```

`SeriesQuestion.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { RadioGroup, Scheduler, type SeriesEditMode } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';
import { recurringAppointments, type Booking } from './recurring-appointments';

/**
 * The series come from a data source, as from a server. Drag an occurrence, change it in its form or
 * delete it: the scheduler asks what the change reaches, unless the setting answers, and writes
 * it through the adapter (an occurrence changed apart is a row of its own).
 */
export default function SeriesQuestion() {
  const s = reactive({ mode: 'ask' as SeriesEditMode, log: [] as string[] });
  let next = 100;
  const adapter = new SlowAdapter<Booking, number>({ data: recurringAppointments(), key: 'id', createKey: () => next++ }, 200);
  const source = new data.DataSource<Booking, number>({ adapter, loadMode: 'all' });
  const say = (text: string) => {
    s.log.unshift(text);
    if (s.log.length > 6) s.log.pop();
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo" onDisposing={() => source.dispose()}>
      <RadioGroup
        label="A change to an occurrence reaches"
        orientation="horizontal"
        items={[
          { value: 'ask', text: 'Ask' },
          { value: 'occurrence', text: 'This one' },
          { value: 'following', text: 'This and following' },
          { value: 'series', text: 'The whole series' },
        ]}
        x-model={() => s.mode}
      />
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        dataSource={source}
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        seriesEdit={() => s.mode}
        onSeriesAnswered={(e) => say(`Asked about ${e.appointment.text} (${e.action}): ${e.scope ?? 'cancelled'}`)}
        onAppointmentUpdated={(e) => say(`Saved ${e.appointment.text}${e.scope ? `, ${e.scope}` : ''}`)}
        onAppointmentDeleted={(e) => say(`Deleted ${e.appointment.text}${e.scope ? `, ${e.scope}` : ''}`)}
        onDataError={(e) => say(`Not saved: ${String(e.error)}${e.undone ? '' : ' (part of it was)'}`)}
      />
      <ol class="sched-events" aria-label="What happened">
        {s.log.map((line, i) => (
          <li key={`${i}-${line}`}>{line}</li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`slow-adapter.ts`

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

# Scheduler: Resources and groups

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

Rooms, people and any other kind of resource: they colour the appointments, split the columns into groups (nested, or under each date), say when each one works and when nothing may be put in.

## Resources

`resources` lists the kinds. An appointment holds an item's value in the kind's `field`; with `allowMultiple`, a list (one meeting, two people). The kind marked `useColorAsDefault` colours the appointments (else the first kind whose item has a colour); an appointment's own `color` wins. The tooltip names its items, and the form has a picker for each kind.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Booking {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  roomId?: number;
  ownerIds?: number[];
  color?: string;
  description?: string;
}

export interface Room {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  workStartHour?: number;
  workEndHour?: number;
}

export interface Person {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  /** The room the person works in. */
  roomId: number;
  workDays?: number[];
}

export const rooms: Room[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Atlas', color: '#1565c0' },
  // Open from 10 to 18.
  { id: 2, text: 'Bosphorus', color: '#2e7d32', workStartHour: 10, workEndHour: 18 },
  { id: 3, text: 'Cappadocia', color: '#6a1b9a' },
];

export const people: Person[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Ana Silva', color: '#ad1457', roomId: 1 },
  { id: 2, text: 'Ben Okafor', color: '#ef6c00', roomId: 1 },
  // Works Monday to Thursday.
  { id: 3, text: 'Cem Yılmaz', color: '#00838f', roomId: 2, workDays: [1, 2, 3, 4] },
  { id: 4, text: 'Dana Ivanova', color: '#455a64', roomId: 3 },
];

/** A week of bookings around today: each in a room, with one or more people. */
export function bookings(): Booking[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour: number, minute = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  return reactive([
    { id: 1, text: 'Team standup', startDate: day(0, 9), endDate: day(0, 9, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1, 2] },
    { id: 2, text: 'Design review', startDate: day(0, 10), endDate: day(0, 11, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1] },
    { id: 3, text: 'Supplier call', startDate: day(0, 14), endDate: day(0, 15), roomId: 2, ownerIds: [3] },
    { id: 4, text: 'Hiring panel', startDate: day(1, 13), endDate: day(1, 15), roomId: 3, ownerIds: [4, 2] },
    { id: 5, text: 'Budget', startDate: day(1, 10), endDate: day(1, 11), roomId: 2, ownerIds: [3] },
    { id: 6, text: 'Workshop', startDate: day(2, 9), endDate: day(2, 12), roomId: 3, ownerIds: [4] },
    { id: 7, text: 'One-on-one', startDate: day(2, 15), endDate: day(2, 15, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [2] },
    { id: 8, text: 'Offsite', startDate: day(3, 0), endDate: day(5, 0), allDay: true, roomId: 3, ownerIds: [1, 4] },
    { id: 9, text: 'Retro', startDate: day(-1, 16), endDate: day(-1, 17), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1, 2] },
    { id: 10, text: 'Customer visit', startDate: day(-2, 11), endDate: day(-2, 12, 30), roomId: 2, ownerIds: [3, 1] },
  ]) as Booking[];
}
```

## Groups

`groups` splits the columns: each item of the first kind, then each of the next under it (`parentExpr` keeps a person under their own room). The day, week, work week and month views show a head per level. `groupByDate` turns it round: each day, with the groups under it. A drag (or Alt + Shift + arrows) to another group changes the resource: in a list, only the group's own value changes.

```tsx

  description?: string;

  color: string;

  workEndHour?: number;
```

## A head of your own

`resourceHeaderTemplate` draws a group's head: any MotifJS component, made for each head with the item, its name, colour, level and (by date) the date.

## Availability

An item's own work hours and days (`workStartHour`, `workEndHour`, `workDays`) shade its columns. `blockedTimes` blocks a time, once or by a rule, for every resource or the ones named. `allowOffHours: false` keeps what the user moves or saves inside the work hours, `allowOverlap: false` keeps it off another appointment of its group; a function there decides it all. A box being moved shows where it may not go, and the form says why it cannot save.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Booking {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  roomId?: number;
  ownerIds?: number[];
  color?: string;
  description?: string;
}

export interface Room {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  workStartHour?: number;
  workEndHour?: number;
}

export interface Person {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  /** The room the person works in. */
  roomId: number;
  workDays?: number[];
}

export const rooms: Room[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Atlas', color: '#1565c0' },
  // Open from 10 to 18.
  { id: 2, text: 'Bosphorus', color: '#2e7d32', workStartHour: 10, workEndHour: 18 },
  { id: 3, text: 'Cappadocia', color: '#6a1b9a' },
];

export const people: Person[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Ana Silva', color: '#ad1457', roomId: 1 },
  { id: 2, text: 'Ben Okafor', color: '#ef6c00', roomId: 1 },
  // Works Monday to Thursday.
  { id: 3, text: 'Cem Yılmaz', color: '#00838f', roomId: 2, workDays: [1, 2, 3, 4] },
  { id: 4, text: 'Dana Ivanova', color: '#455a64', roomId: 3 },
];

/** A week of bookings around today: each in a room, with one or more people. */
export function bookings(): Booking[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour: number, minute = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  return reactive([
    { id: 1, text: 'Team standup', startDate: day(0, 9), endDate: day(0, 9, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1, 2] },
    { id: 2, text: 'Design review', startDate: day(0, 10), endDate: day(0, 11, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1] },
    { id: 3, text: 'Supplier call', startDate: day(0, 14), endDate: day(0, 15), roomId: 2, ownerIds: [3] },
    { id: 4, text: 'Hiring panel', startDate: day(1, 13), endDate: day(1, 15), roomId: 3, ownerIds: [4, 2] },
    { id: 5, text: 'Budget', startDate: day(1, 10), endDate: day(1, 11), roomId: 2, ownerIds: [3] },
    { id: 6, text: 'Workshop', startDate: day(2, 9), endDate: day(2, 12), roomId: 3, ownerIds: [4] },
    { id: 7, text: 'One-on-one', startDate: day(2, 15), endDate: day(2, 15, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [2] },
    { id: 8, text: 'Offsite', startDate: day(3, 0), endDate: day(5, 0), allDay: true, roomId: 3, ownerIds: [1, 4] },
    { id: 9, text: 'Retro', startDate: day(-1, 16), endDate: day(-1, 17), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1, 2] },
    { id: 10, text: 'Customer visit', startDate: day(-2, 11), endDate: day(-2, 12, 30), roomId: 2, ownerIds: [3, 1] },
  ]) as Booking[];
}
```

## From a data source

A kind's `items` may be a data source: it is loaded once and followed (a filter, an added room). Appointments from a data source group the same way; with `remoteFiltering`, grouped by a field of one value, the source is asked for the resources shown too (`rangeFilter` with `resources`).

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

```tsx
// The same filter for a request of your own:
source.setFilter(rangeFilter(scheduler.visibleRange, scheduler.fields, { resources: { roomId: [1, 2] } }));
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Alt + Shift + Left / Right (on an appointment)` | Moves it to the group before or after; Enter saves, Escape takes it back. Mirrored right to left. |
| `Arrows on the cells` | Over every column: the days of each group (by date, the groups of each day). |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Cells` | A cell reads its group before its time ("Atlas, Ana Silva, Monday 26 October, 09:00") and a blocked time after it ("not available: Lunch"). |
| `Heads` | The heads of the groups are drawn only (`aria-hidden`): every cell names its group. |
| `Moving` | Moving by the keys says where it would go, its group, and whether it is free there. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `scheduler.group-header (`inner`, `month`), group-swatch` | Units: a group’s head at each level, and its item’s colour before the name. |
| `scheduler.group-divider (`inner`, `head`)` | Unit: the line between groups (by date, between days), down the heads and the cells. |
| `scheduler.cell `blocked`, scheduler.unavailable` | A cell in a blocked time, and a layer over it (a hatch). |
| `scheduler.drop-mark` | Unit: the mark on a box where it may not go (with the `appointment` unit’s `invalid` state). |
| `scheduler.resource-swatch (`tooltip`), tooltip-resource-label, tooltip-resource-item` | Units: an item’s colour in the form’s pickers and the tooltip; the tooltip’s lines of resources. |
| `.mx-scheduler__group-head` | `data-level`, `data-edge`; cells `data-edge`, `data-blocked`. |

## API reference

### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resources` | `Bind<SchedulerResource[]>` | `[]` | The kinds of resources the appointments use. Each colours them, may group the columns and gets a picker in the form. |
| `groups` | `Bind<string[]>` | `[]` | The resource fields the columns are grouped by, outer first (`['roomId', 'ownerIds']`). A view’s own `groups` wins; `[]` there for none. |
| `groupByDate` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | The groups stand under each date, not the dates under each group. A view’s own wins. |
| `resourceHeaderTemplate` | `Bind<((context: ResourceHeaderContext) => ComponentBase) \\| null>` | `null` | Draws a group’s head in place of its name. |
| `blockedTimes` | `Bind<SchedulerBlockedTime[]>` | `[]` | Times nothing may be put in: `{ start, end, text?, allDay?, recurrenceRule?, resources? }`. Shaded on the days shown; with `resources`, only for those. |
| `allowOverlap` | `Bind<boolean \\| ((check: SchedulerTimeCheck) => boolean)>` | `true` | Whether what the user moves, resizes or saves may overlap another appointment of its group (any one, without groups). A function decides the whole check: `true` when the time is free. |
| `allowOffHours` | `Bind<boolean>` | `true` | Whether the user may put an appointment outside the work hours (of its resources, else the scheduler’s). |
| `keys.previousGroup / nextGroup` | `string[]` | `Alt+Shift+ArrowLeft` / `…Right` | On a focused appointment, grouped: moves it to the group before or after. |

### SchedulerResource

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | `string` | — | The appointment field that holds the item’s value (`roomId`), or a list of them (`ownerIds`). |
| `label` | `Bind<string>` | the field | The form’s label; how the cells and the tooltip name the kind. |
| `items` | `Bind<R[] \\| DataSource<R> \\| null>` | `[]` | The items, in memory or from a data source (loaded once, then followed). Your data may be plain or reactive; the component reads it as it is. After changing it in place, call `refreshResources()` (or `refresh()`). |
| `valueExpr, displayExpr, colorExpr` | `string` | `'id'`, `'text'`, `'color'` | The item fields of its value, its name and its colour. |
| `allowMultiple` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | An appointment may have several: the field holds a list, the form has a tag box. |
| `useColorAsDefault` | `Bind<boolean>` | `false` | Appointments take this kind’s colour (else the first kind whose item has one). Their own `color` wins. |
| `parentExpr` | `string` | — | The item field naming its item of the kind above it in `groups`: nested, a group shows only its own. |
| `workStartHourExpr, workEndHourExpr, workDaysExpr` | `string` | `'workStartHour'`, `'workEndHour'`, `'workDays'` | An item’s own work hours and days; they win over the scheduler’s (the innermost item’s, in nested groups). |

### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `checkTime(appointment, start, end, options?)` | Whether it may be there (`free`) and what is there: `overlapping`, `blocked`, `offHours`. `options`: `allDay`, `resources` (the values it would have). |
| `resourcesOf(appointment)` | Its items by kind: `{ field, label, items: { value, text, color, item }[] }[]`. |
| `refreshResources()` | Reads the items again, after you changed them in place. |
| `rangeFilter(range, fields, { resources })` | The data layer’s filter for a range, now also for the resources shown (`{ roomId: [1, 2] }`, fields of one value). |

### Events

| Event | Arguments |
| --- | --- |
| `onMoving / onResizing` | Now also `resources`: the values its resource fields would get in another group. `cancel` starts `true` where the time is not free; `false` lets it go there. |
| `onMoveStart / onMoveEnd …` | `resources` too. |
| `onAppointmentClick / DblClick` | `group`: the resource values of the group it was clicked in. |
| `onCellClick / DblClick` | `cell.resources`: the cell’s group; a new appointment there gets them. |

## Example files

`Resources.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

/**
 * Two kinds of resources: a booking has one room and one or more people. Their colours paint the
 * bookings; the choice says which kind does (`useColorAsDefault`, a function, so it follows).
 * Click a booking: the tooltip names its room and its people.
 */
export default function Resources() {
  const s = reactive({ by: 'room' });
  const resources = [
    { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms, useColorAsDefault: () => s.by === 'room' },
    { field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true, useColorAsDefault: () => s.by === 'people' },
  ];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <RadioGroup
        label="Colour by"
        orientation="horizontal"
        items={[
          { value: 'room', text: 'Room' },
          { value: 'people', text: 'People' },
        ]}
        itemText="text"
        itemValue="value"
        x-model={() => s.by}
      />
      <Scheduler<Booking> appointments={bookings()} resources={resources} currentView="week" startDayHour={8} endDayHour={18} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`Grouped.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

/**
 * Columns grouped by room, then by the people of each room (`parentExpr`: a person's room). Drag a
 * booking to another person: only that person changes, the others stay on it. "Group by date" puts
 * the people under each day.
 */
export default function Grouped() {
  const s = reactive({ byDate: false });
  const resources = [
    { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms },
    { field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true, parentExpr: 'roomId', useColorAsDefault: true },
  ];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Switch label="Group by date" x-model={() => s.byDate} />
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['roomId', 'ownerIds']}
        groupByDate={() => s.byDate}
        views={['day', { type: 'workWeek', name: 'workWeek' }, 'month']}
        currentView="day"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`HeaderTemplate.tsx`

```tsx
import { Scheduler, type ResourceHeaderContext } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking, type Person } from './resource-data';

/** A person's head drawn by a template: their initials in their colour, their name and their room. */
function PersonHead(context: ResourceHeaderContext) {
  const person = context.item as Person;
  const initials = context.text
    .split(' ')
    .map((part) => part[0])
    .join('');
  const room = rooms.find((r) => r.id === person.roomId)?.text ?? '';
  return (
    <div class="sched-person">
      <span class="sched-person__avatar" style={{ '--person-color': context.color }} aria-hidden="true">
        {initials}
      </span>
      <span class="sched-person__name">
        <strong>{context.text}</strong>
        <small>{room}</small>
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Grouped by person, each head made by `resourceHeaderTemplate`. */
export default function HeaderTemplate() {
  const resources = [{ field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true, useColorAsDefault: true }];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['ownerIds']}
        currentView="day"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        resourceHeaderTemplate={(context: ResourceHeaderContext) => PersonHead(context)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`Availability.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { RadioGroup, Scheduler, type SchedulerBlockedTime, type SchedulerTimeCheck } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

/**
 * When a booking may go: Bosphorus is open 10 to 18 (its own work hours), lunch is blocked every
 * weekday, Cappadocia is closed tomorrow. Outside the hours nothing goes (`allowOffHours`); the
 * choice says whether bookings in a room may overlap, or a rule of its own lets two at once.
 */
export default function Availability() {
  const s = reactive({ overlap: 'no', said: '' });
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour);
  const blocked: SchedulerBlockedTime[] = [
    { start: day(0, 12), end: day(0, 13), text: 'Lunch', recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR' },
    { start: day(1), end: day(1), allDay: true, text: 'Closed for cleaning', resources: { roomId: 3 } },
  ];
  /** Two at once fit in a room, but never over a blocked time or out of its hours. */
  const twoAtOnce = (check: SchedulerTimeCheck<Booking>) => !check.blocked.length && !check.offHours && check.overlapping.length < 2;
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <RadioGroup
        label="Bookings in a room"
        orientation="horizontal"
        items={[
          { value: 'no', text: 'May not overlap' },
          { value: 'two', text: 'Two at once (a rule)' },
          { value: 'yes', text: 'May overlap' },
        ]}
        itemText="text"
        itemValue="value"
        x-model={() => s.overlap}
      />
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={[{ field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms }]}
        groups={['roomId']}
        currentView="day"
        views={[{ type: 'day', intervalCount: 2 }]}
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={19}
        blockedTimes={blocked}
        allowOffHours={false}
        allowOverlap={() => (s.overlap === 'two' ? twoAtOnce : s.overlap === 'yes')}
        onMoving={(e) => (s.said = e.cancel ? 'Not free there.' : '')}
        onMoveEnd={() => (s.said = '')}
      />
      <p class="sched-log">{() => s.said}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`ResourcesFromSource.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';
import { CheckBox, Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { SlowAdapter } from '../../../shared/slow-adapter';
import { bookings, rooms, type Booking, type Room } from './resource-data';

/**
 * The rooms and the bookings both come from data sources that answer late. The rooms load once and
 * are followed: filter them and the groups change. Grouped by room, the bookings are asked for the
 * days and the rooms shown only.
 */
export default function ResourcesFromSource() {
  const s = reactive({ two: false, asked: '' });
  const roomSource = new data.DataSource<Room, number>({ adapter: new SlowAdapter<Room, number>({ data: rooms, key: 'id' }, 400), loadMode: 'all' });
  const source = new data.DataSource<Booking, number>({ adapter: new SlowAdapter<Booking, number>({ data: bookings(), key: 'id' }, 600), loadMode: 'all' });
  source.onChanged((e) => {
    if (e.reason !== 'loading') return;
    const rooms = JSON.stringify((source.filter as { and?: unknown[] } | null)?.and?.slice(2) ?? []);
    s.asked = `Asked for the rooms: ${rooms}`;
  });
  const onlyTwo = (on: boolean) => void roomSource.setFilter(on ? { field: 'id', op: 'in', value: [1, 2] } : null);
  return (
    <div
      class="sched-demo"
      onDisposing={() => {
        source.dispose();
        roomSource.dispose();
      }}
    >
      <CheckBox
        label="Only Atlas and Bosphorus"
        x-model={() => s.two}
        onValueChanged={(e: { value: boolean | null }) => onlyTwo(!!e.value)}
      />
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        dataSource={source}
        resources={[{ field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: roomSource }]}
        groups={['roomId']}
        currentView="workWeek"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
      />
      <p class="sched-log">{() => s.asked}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`slow-adapter.ts`

```tsx
import { data } from '@motifx-community/data';

/** Rows in memory that answer a little later, the way a server does; for the examples. */
export class SlowAdapter<T extends object, K> extends data.ArrayAdapter<T, K> {
  constructor(
    options: data.ArrayAdapterOptions<T>,
    private readonly delayMs = 300,
  ) {
    super(options);
  }

  override async load(options: data.LoadOptions = {}): Promise<data.LoadResult<T>> {
    await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, this.delayMs));
    return super.load(options);
  }
}
```

# Scheduler: The appointment form

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

The appointment form set up without events: which fields, in which order, in groups and tabs; editors of your own; checks per field; fields shown or locked for one appointment only. Or a form of your own.

## Items, groups and tabs

`editing.form.items` lists what the form holds. A built-in item and a resource are named by their fields; an item with the same `field` changes that one (here the title's label and a rule). The time zone row (`timeZone`) and the recurrence editor (`recurrenceRule`) are items like the others: move them, or leave them out. `tabs` and groups hold items named the same way.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

  id: number;
  text: string;

  roomId: number;
  workDays?: number[];

  { id: 1, text: 'Atlas', color: '#1565c0' },
  // Open from 10 to 18.

];

  { id: 1, text: 'Ana Silva', color: '#ad1457', roomId: 1 },

  // Works Monday to Thursday.

  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour: number, minute = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  return reactive([
    { id: 1, text: 'Team standup', startDate: day(0, 9), endDate: day(0, 9, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1, 2] },
    { id: 2, text: 'Design review', startDate: day(0, 10), endDate: day(0, 11, 30), roomId: 1, ownerIds: [1] },
    { id: 3, text: 'Supplier call', startDate: day(0, 14), endDate: day(0, 15), roomId: 2, ownerIds: [3] },
```

## Editors of your own

`editor` may be a function: it gets the props a named editor gets (`label`, `value`, `onValueChanged`, `validationGroup`, `rules` …), so any component that takes them is checked with the form. `template` places any MotifJS component; it gets the form (its reactive `data`) and its place (`field`, `validationGroup`). `rules` are the kit's validation rules, added to a built-in's own.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Booking {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  roomId?: number;
  ownerIds?: number[];
  color?: string;
  description?: string;
}

export interface Room {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  workStartHour?: number;
  workEndHour?: number;
}

export interface Person {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  /** The room the person works in. */
  roomId: number;
  workDays?: number[];
}

export const rooms: Room[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Atlas', color: '#1565c0' },
  // Open from 10 to 18.
  { id: 2, text: 'Bosphorus', color: '#2e7d32', workStartHour: 10, workEndHour: 18 },
  { id: 3, text: 'Cappadocia', color: '#6a1b9a' },
];

export const people: Person[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Ana Silva', color: '#ad1457', roomId: 1 },
  { id: 2, text: 'Ben Okafor', color: '#ef6c00', roomId: 1 },
  // Works Monday to Thursday.
```

```tsx
// By name, for every form of the page:
FormLayout.editors.set('priority', (props) => new Slider({ ...props, min: 1, max: 5 }));

```

## Fields for one appointment

`visible`, `readOnly`, `enabled`, `required`, `label` and `helpText` may be functions of the form: `(form) => form.data.roomId === 3`. They read the form's data as it is now, so a field shows when another changes.


## A form of your own

`onFormOpening` gets the items `editing.form` made and may still change them; `cancel` keeps the scheduler's form closed. Open your own, then save with `addAppointment` or `updateAppointment`: the events and the checks run as for the scheduler's form.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

  endDate: Date;

  roomId?: number;
  ownerIds?: number[];

  description?: string;

  text: string;
  color: string;
  workStartHour?: number;
  workEndHour?: number;
}

  color: string;
  /** The room the person works in. */
  roomId: number;
  workDays?: number[];
}

export const rooms: Room[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Atlas', color: '#1565c0' },
  // Open from 10 to 18.
  { id: 2, text: 'Bosphorus', color: '#2e7d32', workStartHour: 10, workEndHour: 18 },
  { id: 3, text: 'Cappadocia', color: '#6a1b9a' },
];

export const people: Person[] = [
```

## API reference

### editing.form

| Member | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `(string \\| SchedulerFormItem)[]` | the built-ins, the resources after All day | What the form holds, in order: a built-in item by its field, a resource by its field, or an item of your own. Unknown names are left out. |
| `columns` | `number` | `2` | Columns of the form (a group and a tab may have their own). |
| `minColumnWidth` | `string` | — | With it, as many columns as fit, each at least this wide; `columns` is the most. |
| `labelMode` | `Bind<FieldLabelMode>` | the language’s | Where the labels go. |
| `title` | `FormBind<string>` | New / Edit appointment | The form’s title; a function of the form may say it per appointment. |
| `width` | `string` | the language’s | The form’s width, a CSS length. |

### Built-in items

| Name | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `text, description` | The title (required) and the description. |
| `start, end` | Each two items: a date and time, and (all day) a date. The end checks it is after the start and that the time is free. |
| `allDay` | The all-day switch. |
| `timeZone` | The time zone row: `startTimeZone`, `separateEndZone`, `endTimeZone` (with `editing.allowTimeZones`), each may be named alone too. |
| `recurrenceRule` | The recurrence editor (with `editing.allowRecurrence`). |
| `a resource’s field` | Its picker: a drop-down, or a tag box for a kind of several; each item with its colour. |

### SchedulerFormItem

| Member | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `field, label, editor, editorProps, colSpan` | As a kit form item. `editor` may be a name or a function that makes the editor from the props a named one gets. |
| `visible, enabled, readOnly, required, label, helpText, group` | A value, a function that is followed, or a function of the form `(form) => …` (its `appointment`, `data`, `isNew`): shown or locked for one appointment only. |
| `rules` | Kit validation rules (or a function of the form giving them); added to a built-in’s own. |
| `items, group, columns` | A group under a caption, its items named or given the same way. |
| `tabs` | `[{ title, items, columns?, visible? }]`: tabs, every tab checked when the form is saved; the tab of the first field that failed shows. |
| `template` | `(form, place) => ComponentBase`: any MotifJS component for this place; `place` has the `field` and the `validationGroup` to check it with the others. |
| `button` | A button of the form. |

### How they combine

| Case | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| `A built-in or a resource named by `field`` | Its settings win; `rules` add; `visible` and `enabled` hold when both say so; `readOnly` when either does; `editorProps` merge. |
| ``onFormOpening`` | Still fires, with the items as `editing.form` made them; it may change them, or cancel to open a form of your own. |

### FormLayout

| Member | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `FormItem.tabs` | Tabs of items in any `FormLayout`; a check shows the tab of the first field that failed. |
| `FormItem.editor (a function)` | Makes the editor from the props a named one gets. |
| `FormItem.template(context)` | Gets `{ data, field, validationGroup }`. |
| `editor: 'tagbox'` | A tag box by name. |

## Example files

`DeclaredForm.tsx`

```tsx
import { Scheduler, type SchedulerForm } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

/**
 * The form set up by `editing.form` alone: the title on top with a rule of its own, then three tabs.
 * Built-in items and resources are named by their fields; the time zone row (`timeZone`) and the
 * recurrence editor are items like the others. Double-click a booking.
 */
export default function DeclaredForm() {
  const form: SchedulerForm<Booking> = {
    columns: 2,
    items: [
      { field: 'text', label: 'Subject', rules: [{ type: 'length', min: 3, message: 'At least three letters.' }] },
      {
        tabs: [
          { title: 'When', items: ['start', 'end', 'timeZone', 'allDay', 'recurrenceRule'] },
          { title: 'Where and who', columns: 1, items: ['roomId', 'ownerIds'] },
          { title: 'Notes', columns: 1, items: [{ field: 'description', label: 'Agenda' }] },
        ],
      },
    ],
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={[
          { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms, useColorAsDefault: true },
          { field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true },
        ]}
        currentView="workWeek"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        editing={{ allowTimeZones: true, form }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`CustomEditors.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, Slider, type AppointmentFormContext, type FormTemplateContext, type SchedulerForm } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

type Rated = Booking & { priority?: number };

const COLORS = ['#1565c0', '#2e7d32', '#ad1457', '#ef6c00', '#455a64'];

/** A component of your own as an editor: a row of colours, bound to the form's data. */
function ColorChoice(form: AppointmentFormContext<Rated>, place: FormTemplateContext) {
  const data = form.data as Record<string, unknown>;
  return (
    <div class="sched-colors" role="group" aria-label="Colour">
      <span class="sched-colors__label">Colour</span>
      {COLORS.map((color) => (
        <button
          key={color}
          type="button"
          class="sched-colors__swatch"
          style={{ background: color }}
          aria-label={color}
          aria-pressed={() => data[place.field] === color}
          onclick={() => (data[place.field] = data[place.field] === color ? '' : color)}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Editors of your own: a slider made by a function (it takes the props a named editor gets, so it
 * is checked with the form), and a row of colours from a template. A rule of the form's own: an
 * interview needs two people.
 */
export default function CustomEditors() {
  const form: SchedulerForm<Rated> = {
    items: [
      'text',
      'start',
      'end',
      { field: 'priority', label: 'Priority', editor: (props) => new Slider({ ...props, min: 1, max: 5, step: 1 }), colSpan: 'all' },
      { field: 'color', colSpan: 'all', template: ColorChoice },
      'roomId',
      {
        field: 'ownerIds',
        rules: (f) => [
          {
            type: 'custom',
            ignoreEmpty: false,
            check: (value: unknown) => !/interview/i.test(String(f.data.text)) || (Array.isArray(value) && value.length >= 2) || 'An interview needs two people.',
          },
        ],
      },
      'description',
    ],
  };
  const appointments = reactive(bookings().map((b) => ({ ...b, priority: 3 }))) as Rated[];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Rated>
        appointments={appointments}
        resources={[
          { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms },
          { field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true },
        ]}
        currentView="workWeek"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        editing={{ allowRecurrence: false, form }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`ConditionalFields.tsx`

```tsx
import { Scheduler, type SchedulerForm } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, people, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

type Catered = Booking & { catering?: boolean; guests?: number };

/**
 * Fields for one appointment only, each a function of the form: catering shows only for
 * Cappadocia (the big room), the number of guests only with catering; a booking that has begun
 * keeps its room; the people are needed for an interview.
 */
export default function ConditionalFields() {
  const now = new Date();
  const form: SchedulerForm<Catered> = {
    items: [
      'text',
      'start',
      'end',
      { field: 'roomId', readOnly: (f) => !f.isNew && !!f.appointment && f.appointment.startDate < now, helpText: (f) => (!f.isNew && !!f.appointment && f.appointment.startDate < now ? 'It has begun: the room stays.' : '') },
      { field: 'catering', label: 'Catering', editor: 'switch', visible: (f) => f.data.roomId === 3 },
      { field: 'guests', label: 'Guests', editor: 'number', editorProps: { min: 1, max: 40 }, visible: (f) => f.data.roomId === 3 && !!f.data.catering, required: true },
      { field: 'ownerIds', required: (f) => /interview/i.test(String(f.data.text)) },
      'description',
    ],
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Catered>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={[
          { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms, useColorAsDefault: true },
          { field: 'ownerIds', label: 'People', items: people, allowMultiple: true },
        ]}
        currentView="workWeek"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        editing={{ allowRecurrence: false, form }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`OwnForm.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Button, FormLayout, MxForm, Scheduler, Stack, type FormOpeningEventArgs } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { bookings, rooms, type Booking } from './resource-data';

/**
 * A form of your own: `onFormOpening` cancels the scheduler's and opens a short one (a title and a
 * room), then saves through the scheduler, so its events and its checks still run.
 */
export default function OwnForm() {
  const opening = async (e: FormOpeningEventArgs<Booking>) => {
    e.cancel = true;
    const data = reactive({ text: String(e.data.text), roomId: (e.data.roomId as number | null) ?? 1 });
    const form = new MxForm({ title: e.appointment ? 'Quick edit' : 'Quick booking', modal: true });
    let layout: FormLayout<typeof data> | null = null;
    form.content = (
      <FormLayout<typeof data>
        data={data}
        ref={(c: FormLayout<typeof data>) => (layout = c)}
        items={[
          { field: 'text', label: 'Title', required: true },
          { field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', editor: 'radio', editorProps: { items: rooms, itemText: 'text', itemValue: 'id', orientation: 'horizontal' } },
        ]}
      />
    );
    form.footer = (
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" justify="end">
        <Button text="Save" tone="accent" onclick={async () => layout && (await layout.validate()).valid && form.close('ok')} />
        <Button text="Cancel" onclick={() => form.close('cancel')} />
      </Stack>
    );
    if ((await form.showDialog(e.source)) !== 'ok') return;
    if (e.appointment) await e.source.updateAppointment(e.appointment, { text: data.text, roomId: data.roomId });
    else await e.source.addAppointment({ text: data.text, roomId: data.roomId, startDate: e.data.start ?? new Date(), endDate: e.data.end ?? new Date() });
  };
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Booking>
        appointments={bookings()}
        resources={[{ field: 'roomId', label: 'Room', items: rooms, useColorAsDefault: true }]}
        currentView="workWeek"
        startDayHour={8}
        endDayHour={18}
        onFormOpening={(e) => void opening(e)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```


---

# Scheduler: Timeline

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

A row per resource with the time running along it: a day, a week, a work week or a month. Appointments at the same time stack in their row, and the row grows to fit them.

## Timeline views

`timelineDay`, `timelineWeek`, `timelineWorkWeek` and `timelineMonth` show the groups as rows (one row without `groups`). The scale over the cells has two tiers: the days over their hours (the months over their days). It stays at the top while the rows scroll, the resource column at the start while the time scrolls. The line at the current time, blocked times and the hours outside work carry over; a drag moves an appointment along its row or to another one, and its ends change its time.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Job {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  teamId?: number;
  ownerId?: number;
  color?: string;
  recurrenceRule?: string;
}

export interface Team {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
}

export interface Member {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  /** The team the person is in. */
  teamId: number;
  workStartHour?: number;
  workEndHour?: number;
}

export const teams: Team[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Field service', color: '#1565c0' },
  { id: 2, text: 'Workshop', color: '#2e7d32' },
  { id: 3, text: 'Support desk', color: '#6a1b9a' },
];

export const members: Member[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Ana Silva', color: '#ad1457', teamId: 1 },
  { id: 2, text: 'Ben Okafor', color: '#ef6c00', teamId: 1 },
  { id: 3, text: 'Cem Yılmaz', color: '#00838f', teamId: 1, workStartHour: 7, workEndHour: 15 },
  { id: 4, text: 'Dana Ivanova', color: '#455a64', teamId: 2 },
  { id: 5, text: 'Emil Novak', color: '#5d4037', teamId: 2 },
  { id: 6, text: 'Fatma Demir', color: '#c62828', teamId: 3, workStartHour: 12, workEndHour: 20 },
  { id: 7, text: 'Gus Moreau', color: '#283593', teamId: 3 },
];

const WORK = ['Install', 'Repair', 'Inspection', 'Calls', 'Delivery', 'Training', 'Planning', 'Visit'];

/** A fortnight of jobs around today: a few a day for each person, some over each other, some over days. */
export function jobs(): Job[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour: number, minute = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  const out: Job[] = [];
  let id = 1;
  for (const member of members) {
    for (let offset = -7; offset <= 7; offset++) {
      // A stable spread: each person's day has its own hours.
      const seed = (member.id * 31 + offset * 17 + 400) % 97;
      if (seed % 5 === 0) continue;
      const start = 8 + (seed % 6);
      const length = 1 + (seed % 3);
      out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[seed % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start), endDate: day(offset, start + length, seed % 2 ? 30 : 0), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
      if (seed % 4 === 1) out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[(seed + 3) % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start + 1), endDate: day(offset, start + 2, 30), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
    }
  }
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Trade fair', startDate: day(1, 0), endDate: day(3, 0), allDay: true, teamId: 1, ownerId: 1 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Night shift', startDate: day(0, 20), endDate: day(1, 6), teamId: 3, ownerId: 7 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Stand-up', startDate: day(-7, 9), endDate: day(-7, 9, 15), teamId: 2, ownerId: 4, recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR' });
  return reactive(out) as Job[];
}
```

## Nested groups

With two kinds in `groups`, each row is an item of the inner kind under its item of the outer kind: the resource column has a level per kind, the outer name on the first of its rows. The time runs right to left in a right-to-left page.


## Templates

Every template can be given to the scheduler and to a view; the view's own wins. A template is made once for the element it draws and gets a context whose fields follow it.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;

  ownerId?: number;
  color?: string;
  recurrenceRule?: string;

];
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Left / Right (cells)` | Along the time, mirrored right to left; past the first or the last cell the view moves on. |
| `Up / Down (cells)` | To the row above or below. |
| `Home / End, Ctrl + Home / End` | The row’s first and last cell; with Ctrl, of the first and the last row. |
| `PageUp / PageDown` | A screen of rows. |
| `Shift + arrows` | Selects cells along the row. |
| `Left / Right (appointment)` | Moves it a snap step along the time (a day in the timeline month); Shift: its end. |
| `Up / Down (appointment)` | Moves it to the row above or below (its group changes); Enter saves, Escape takes it back. |

## Accessibility

| Topic | How |
| --- | --- |
| `Rows` | The rows are a grid’s rows; each cell reads its group, its date and its time, and a blocked time after them. |
| `Resource column, scale` | Drawn only (`aria-hidden`): every cell names its group and its time. |
| `Appointments` | Each row’s appointments are in a cell of their own, named by the row; an appointment reads its text, its time and whether it goes on. |

## Styling

| Hook | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `scheduler.scale, scale-upper (`today`), scale-lower (`day-start`, `day`, `weekend`, `today`)` | Units: the head over the cells and its two tiers. |
| `scheduler.timeline-corner, timeline-corner-label` | Units: the corner over the resource column, the names of the kinds. |
| `scheduler.resource-cell (`inner`, `first`, `continued`)` | Unit: a level of the resource column. |
| `scheduler.timeline-row (`first`), timeline-divider (`inner`)` | Units: a row along the time and the line over it; the line where an outer group starts. |
| `scheduler.cell `line`, `line-hour`, `line-day`` | The cells along the time: the line before each, stronger where an hour and a day start. |
| `scheduler.appointment `line`, `line-before`, `line-after`` | An appointment on a lane, and its cut ends. |
| `timeline-cell-width, timeline-resource-width, timeline-lane-size, timeline-row-min-height` | Plain tokens: a cell’s least width (cells stretch to fill the room when they are few), a level of the resource column, a lane, an empty row. |

## API reference

### Timeline views

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `'timelineDay' \\| 'timelineWeek' \\| 'timelineWorkWeek' \\| 'timelineMonth'` | — | A row per group, the time along it: hours of a day, of a week, of a work week; the days of a month. |
| `intervalCount` | `Bind<number>` | 1 | How many days, weeks or months it shows. |
| `startDate` | `Bind<Date \\| null>` | `null` | With `intervalCount` over 1: the date its intervals are counted from, so they stay put when the date moves. |
| `cellDuration` | `Bind<number>` | the scheduler's | Minutes in a cell along the time (the timeline month: a day). |
| `startDayHour / endDayHour` | `Bind<number>` | the scheduler's | The hours of each day shown; the time before and after is left out. |
| `groups` | `Bind<string[]>` | the scheduler's | The resource fields the rows are grouped by, outer first; nested groups stand in levels of the resource column. |
| `maxAppointmentsPerCell` | `Bind<number \\| 'auto'>` | `'auto'` | Lanes a row has before "+N more" (per day); `'auto'`: the row grows to fit them all. |
| `scrolling` | `Bind<'auto' \\| 'standard' \\| 'virtual'>` | `'auto'` | Every row and cell built, or only what is in view (see Big data). |
| `name, text` | `string`, `Bind<string>` | the type | Its name for `currentView` and its caption in the bar. |
| `…Template` | see Templates | the scheduler's | A view’s own template wins; `null` turns one off there. |

### Templates

| Prop (and view setting) | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `appointmentTemplate` | `(context: AppointmentTemplateContext) => Component` | An appointment’s content: `{ appointment, start, end, text, time, allDay, view, group }`. |
| `appointmentTooltipTemplate` | `(context: TooltipTemplateContext) => Component` | The tooltip’s content: `{ appointment, text, time, canEdit, canDelete, edit(), remove(), close() }`. |
| `dataCellTemplate` | `(context: CellTemplateContext) => Component` | A cell’s content: `{ start, end, allDay, resources, view, today, work, blocked }`; the cell keeps its look, keys and name. |
| `dateCellTemplate` | `(context: DateTemplateContext) => Component` | A day’s head (the dates, the month’s weekdays, a timeline’s days): `{ date, weekday, number, today, view, resources }`. |
| `timeCellTemplate` | `(context: TimeTemplateContext) => Component` | An hour of the ruler and of a timeline’s scale: `{ date, minutes, text, view }`. |
| `resourceHeaderTemplate` | `(context: ResourceHeaderContext) => Component` | A group’s head: in a timeline, the resource column’s cell. |
| `agendaRowTemplate` | `(context: AgendaRowContext) => Component` | An agenda row’s content (see Agenda). |
| `moreListTemplate` | `(context: MoreListContext) => Component` | The list "+N more" opens: `{ date, appointments, choose(appointment, event) }`. |

### Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `scrollToTime(hour, minute?)` | In a timeline: along to that time on the date shown (else the first day). |
| `scrollTo(date, resources?)` | Brings a time into view: its cell along the time and the row of `resources` (the group’s values); in the day views its hour and its column. |

## Example files

`Timeline.tsx`

```tsx
import { Scheduler } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { jobs, members, type Job } from './timeline-data';

/**
 * The four timeline views, a row per person. Jobs at the same time stack in their row, and the row
 * grows. Drag one along its row or to another person; drag its ends to change its time.
 */
export default function Timeline() {
  const resources = [{ field: 'ownerId', label: 'Person', items: members, useColorAsDefault: true }];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Job>
        appointments={jobs()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['ownerId']}
        views={['timelineDay', 'timelineWeek', 'timelineWorkWeek', 'timelineMonth']}
        currentView="timelineWeek"
        startDayHour={7}
        endDayHour={20}
        cellDuration={60}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`NestedTimeline.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, Switch } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { jobs, members, teams, type Job } from './timeline-data';

/**
 * Rows grouped by team, then by the people of each team (`parentExpr`). Up and Down on a job move it
 * to the row above or below; Left and Right move it along the time. "Right to left" mirrors the
 * time and the resource column.
 */
export default function NestedTimeline() {
  const s = reactive({ rtl: false });
  const resources = [
    { field: 'teamId', label: 'Team', items: teams },
    { field: 'ownerId', label: 'Person', items: members, parentExpr: 'teamId', useColorAsDefault: true },
  ];
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo" dir={() => (s.rtl ? 'rtl' : 'ltr')}>
      <Switch label="Right to left" x-model={() => s.rtl} />
      <Scheduler<Job>
        appointments={jobs()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['teamId', 'ownerId']}
        views={['timelineDay', 'timelineWorkWeek']}
        currentView="timelineDay"
        startDayHour={7}
        endDayHour={21}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`TimelineSettings.tsx`

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';
import { Scheduler, Switch, type MoreListContext } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { jobs, members, type Job } from './timeline-data';

/** A short list of its own for "+N more": the day and each job's name. */
function Jobs(context: MoreListContext<Job>) {
  return (
    <div class="sched-more">
      <strong>{() => context.date?.toLocaleDateString() ?? ''}</strong>
      {context.appointments.map((job) => (
        <button key={job.id} type="button" class="sched-more__item" onclick={(e: MouseEvent) => context.choose(job, e)}>
          {job.text}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Views with settings of their own: a working day in half hours, a fortnight in four-hour cells
 * counted from a fixed Monday (`startDate`), and a month of days with at most two lanes a row
 * ("+N more" opens a list of its own). A setting not given is the scheduler's.
 */
export default function TimelineSettings() {
  const s = reactive({ dim: true });
  const resources = [{ field: 'ownerId', label: 'Person', items: members, useColorAsDefault: true }];
  const monday = new Date(2026, 0, 5);
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Switch label="Ended ones quieter" x-model={() => s.dim} />
      <Scheduler<Job>
        appointments={jobs()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['ownerId']}
        views={[
          { type: 'timelineDay', name: 'workday', text: 'Workday', startDayHour: 8, endDayHour: 18, cellDuration: 30 },
          { type: 'timelineWeek', name: 'fortnight', text: 'Fortnight', intervalCount: 2, startDate: monday, cellDuration: 240 },
          { type: 'timelineMonth', name: 'month', text: 'Month', maxAppointmentsPerCell: 2, moreListTemplate: Jobs },
        ]}
        currentView="fortnight"
        dimPast={() => s.dim}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`TimelineTemplates.tsx`

```tsx
import { Scheduler, type AppointmentTemplateContext, type CellTemplateContext, type DateTemplateContext, type ResourceHeaderContext, type TimeTemplateContext } from '@motifx-community/ui';
import { jobs, members, type Job, type Member } from './timeline-data';

/**
 * Templates, for the scheduler and for one view: the person's head with their hours, each day's
 * head, the hours, a mark on the cells outside the work hours (in the week only: a view's own
 * template wins) and the job's content.
 */
export default function TimelineTemplates() {
  const resources = [{ field: 'ownerId', label: 'Person', items: members, useColorAsDefault: true }];
  const head = (c: ResourceHeaderContext) => {
    const person = c.item as Member;
    return (
      <div class="sched-person">
        <span class="sched-person__avatar" style={{ '--person-color': c.color }} aria-hidden="true">
          {c.text
            .split(' ')
            .map((p) => p[0])
            .join('')}
        </span>
        <span class="sched-person__name">
          <strong>{c.text}</strong>
          <small>{`${person.workStartHour ?? 9}:00–${person.workEndHour ?? 17}:00`}</small>
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  };
  const date = (c: DateTemplateContext) => <span class="sched-date">{`${c.weekday} ${c.number}`}</span>;
  const time = (c: TimeTemplateContext) => <span class="sched-time">{c.text}</span>;
  const cell = (c: CellTemplateContext) => <span class="sched-off" data-off={() => (!c.work ? '' : null)} aria-hidden="true" />;
  const job = (c: AppointmentTemplateContext<Job>) => (
    <span class="sched-job">
      <strong>{c.text}</strong> <span>{c.time}</span>
    </span>
  );
  return (
    <div class="sched-demo">
      <Scheduler<Job>
        appointments={jobs()}
        resources={resources}
        groups={['ownerId']}
        views={['timelineDay', { type: 'timelineWeek', dataCellTemplate: cell }]}
        currentView="timelineWeek"
        startDayHour={7}
        endDayHour={20}
        cellDuration={60}
        resourceHeaderTemplate={head}
        dateCellTemplate={date}
        timeCellTemplate={time}
        appointmentTemplate={job}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```


---

# Scheduler: Agenda

> Scheduler · @motifx-community/ui 0.1.0-beta.2

The coming days as a list: each day with its appointments in time order, a day with none left out.

## Agenda

`agenda` lists `agendaDuration` days from the date shown (7 by default). An appointment that lasts days is on each of them; one that takes the day says so. The list is a list box: the arrows move over its rows, and Space and Enter do what a click and a double click do.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Meeting {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  color?: string;
  description?: string;
}

/** A week of appointments around today, so the examples always show something. */
export function sampleAppointments(): Meeting[] {
```

## By resource

With `groups`, each group's days stand under its name. A data source is asked for the days shown, as in the other views.

```tsx
import { reactive } from '@motifx/core';

export interface Job {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  startDate: Date;
  endDate: Date;
  allDay?: boolean;
  teamId?: number;
  ownerId?: number;
  color?: string;
  recurrenceRule?: string;
}

export interface Team {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
}

export interface Member {
  id: number;
  text: string;
  color: string;
  /** The team the person is in. */
  teamId: number;
  workStartHour?: number;
  workEndHour?: number;
}

export const teams: Team[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Field service', color: '#1565c0' },
  { id: 2, text: 'Workshop', color: '#2e7d32' },
  { id: 3, text: 'Support desk', color: '#6a1b9a' },
];

export const members: Member[] = [
  { id: 1, text: 'Ana Silva', color: '#ad1457', teamId: 1 },
  { id: 2, text: 'Ben Okafor', color: '#ef6c00', teamId: 1 },
  { id: 3, text: 'Cem Yılmaz', color: '#00838f', teamId: 1, workStartHour: 7, workEndHour: 15 },
  { id: 4, text: 'Dana Ivanova', color: '#455a64', teamId: 2 },
  { id: 5, text: 'Emil Novak', color: '#5d4037', teamId: 2 },
  { id: 6, text: 'Fatma Demir', color: '#c62828', teamId: 3, workStartHour: 12, workEndHour: 20 },
  { id: 7, text: 'Gus Moreau', color: '#283593', teamId: 3 },
];

const WORK = ['Install', 'Repair', 'Inspection', 'Calls', 'Delivery', 'Training', 'Planning', 'Visit'];

/** A fortnight of jobs around today: a few a day for each person, some over each other, some over days. */
export function jobs(): Job[] {
  const today = new Date();
  const day = (offset: number, hour: number, minute = 0) => new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate() + offset, hour, minute);
  const out: Job[] = [];
  let id = 1;
  for (const member of members) {
    for (let offset = -7; offset <= 7; offset++) {
      // A stable spread: each person's day has its own hours.
      const seed = (member.id * 31 + offset * 17 + 400) % 97;
      if (seed % 5 === 0) continue;
      const start = 8 + (seed % 6);
      const length = 1 + (seed % 3);
      out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[seed % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start), endDate: day(offset, start + length, seed % 2 ? 30 : 0), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
      if (seed % 4 === 1) out.push({ id: id++, text: WORK[(seed + 3) % WORK.length], startDate: day(offset, start + 1), endDate: day(offset, start + 2, 30), teamId: member.teamId, ownerId: member.id });
    }
  }
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Trade fair', startDate: day(1, 0), endDate: day(3, 0), allDay: true, teamId: 1, ownerId: 1 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Night shift', startDate: day(0, 20), endDate: day(1, 6), teamId: 3, ownerId: 7 });
  out.push({ id: id++, text: 'Stand-up', startDate: day(-7, 9), endDate: day(-7, 9, 15), teamId: 2, ownerId: 4, recurrenceRule: 'FREQ=DAILY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR' });
  return reactive(out) as Job[];
}
```

## Templates

`agendaRowTemplate` draws a row's content; `appointmentTooltipTemplate` the tooltip's, here and in every view.

```tsx

];

export function jobs(): Job[] {
```
